               (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (take q (- (len q) 1)) p))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))))
(lemma snoc_conn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (u int) (v int) (i int))
  (requires (walk g p s u) (connected g u v) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i) (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (if (< (+ i 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q i) (idx p i)))
        (assert (== (idx q (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ i 1))))
        (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q i) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx q i) u))
        (assert (== (idx q (+ i 1)) v))))))
(lemma walk_snoc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (walk g p s u) (connected g u v))
  (ensures (walk g (concat p (seq-lit v)) s v))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call snoc_conn g p s u v i))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) s))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))))
(lemma prefix_conn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len p) 2))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i) (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) i) (idx p i)))
    (assert (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ i 1))))
    (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))))
(lemma walk_prefix (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (walk g p s t) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures (walk g (take p (- (len p) 1)) s (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
           (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) t))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_conn g p i))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) s))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
(lemma vertex_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (k int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (== (idx p 0) s) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (call connected_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k))
        (obtain ((i int)) (edge_at g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) i))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- k 1))) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- k 1))) i) 0) (len g)))))
      (block))))
(lemma pigeon (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (all_below s n) (all_diff s))
  (ensures (<= (len s) n))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 0)
      (if (> (len s) 0)
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx s 0)) (< (idx s 0) n)))
        (block))
      (if (exists ((i0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (len s))) (== (idx s i0) (- n 1))))
        (block
          (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (== (idx s i) (- n 1))))
          (ghost-let s2 (seq int) (seq-build (- (len s) 1)
            (fn (j) (if (== j i) (idx s (- (len s) 1)) (idx s j)))))
          (assert (all_below s2 (- n 1)))
          (assert (all_diff s2))
          (call pigeon s2 (- n 1)))
        (block
          (assert (all_below s (- n 1)))
          (call pigeon s (- n 1)))))))
(lemma has_repeat (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (all_below s n) (> (len s) n))
  (ensures (not (all_diff s)))
  (body (if (all_diff s) (call pigeon s n) (block))))
(lemma weight_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))) (path_weight g (drop p m)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== m (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (take p (+ m 1)) p))
        (assert (== (len (drop p m)) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (drop p m)) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let p1 (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (drop p m))
        (assert (>= (len r) 2))
        (call weight_split g p1 m)
        (assert (== (take p1 (+ m 1)) (take p (+ m 1))))
        (assert (== (drop p1 m) (take r (- (len r) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 2))))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g r) (+ (path_weight g (take r (- (len r) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx r (- (len r) 2)) (idx r (- (len r) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g p1) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))))
(lemma cut_conn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (- (len p) (- b a)) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (cut p a b) i) (idx (cut p a b) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (cut p a b))
    (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) (- b a))))
    (if (< i a)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q i) (idx p i)))
        (assert (== (idx q (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ i 1))))
        (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1)))))
      (if (== i a)
        (block
          (assert (== (idx q i) (idx p b)))
          (assert (== (idx q (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ b 1))))
          (assert (connected g (idx p b) (idx p (+ b 1)))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx q i) (idx p (+ i (- b a)))))
          (assert (== (idx q (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ (+ i 1) (- b a)))))
          (assert (connected g (idx p (+ i (- b a))) (idx p (+ (+ i 1) (- b a))))))))))
(lemma cut_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (walk g p s t) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b)))
  (ensures (walk g (cut p a b) s t))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call cut_conn g p a b i))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (cut p a b))
    (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) (- b a))))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0)))
    (if (== b (- (len p) 1))
      (assert (== (idx q a) (idx p a)))
      (assert (== (idx q (- (- (len p) (- b a)) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) t))))
(lemma cut_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (cut p a b)) (path_weight g (seg p a b)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (cut p a b))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (drop p a))
    (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) (- b a))))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (len p) a)))
    (call weight_split g p a)
    (call weight_split g r (- b a))
    (call weight_split g q a)
    (assert (== (take q (+ a 1)) (take p (+ a 1))))
    (assert (== (drop q a) (drop r (- b a))))))
(lemma seg_conn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- b a))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (seg p a b) i) (idx (seg p a b) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (seg p a b) i) (idx p (+ i a))))
    (assert (== (idx (seg p a b) (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ (+ i 1) a))))
    (assert (connected g (idx p (+ i a)) (idx p (+ (+ i 1) a))))))
(lemma seg_cycle (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b)))
  (ensures (is_path g (seg p a b)) (> (len (seg p a b)) 1)
           (== (idx (seg p a b) 0) (idx (seg p a b) (- (len (seg p a b)) 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call seg_conn g p a b i))
    (assert (== (len (seg p a b)) (+ (- b a) 1)))
    (assert (is_path g (seg p a b)))
    (assert (== (idx (seg p a b) 0) (idx p a)))
    (assert (== (idx (seg p a b) (- b a)) (idx p b)))))
(lemma cut_no_worse (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (not (has_negative_cycle g)) (walk g p s t) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b)))
  (ensures (walk g (cut p a b) s t) (< (len (cut p a b)) (len p)) (<= (path_weight g (cut p a b)) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (call cut_path g p a b s t)
    (call cut_weight g p a b)
    (call seg_cycle g p a b)
    (assert (>= (path_weight g (seg p a b)) 0))))
(lemma shorten (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (not (has_negative_cycle g)) (walk g p s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (exists ((q (seq int))) (and (and (walk g q s t) (<= (len q) (len g))) (<= (path_weight g q) (path_weight g p)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (len g))
      (assert (and (and (walk g p s t) (<= (len p) (len g))) (<= (path_weight g p) (path_weight g p))))
      (block
        (forall ((k int)) (call vertex_range g p s k))
        (assert (all_below p (len g)))
        (call has_repeat p (len g))
        (obtain ((a int)) (exists ((b0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b0)) (< b0 (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b0)))))
        (obtain ((b int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b))))
        (call cut_no_worse g p a b s t)
        (call shorten g (cut p a b) s t)))))

(lemma init_state (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g))
            (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
            (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len dist))) (!= y start)) (is none (idx dist y))))
            (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len wit))) (== (idx wit y) (seq-lit start)))))
  (ensures (sound g start dist wit 1) (complete g start dist 1) (bounded dist 0))
  (body
    (ghost-let base (seq int) (seq-lit start))
    (assert (== (len base) 1))
    (assert (== (idx base 0) start))
    (assert (is_path g base))
    (assert (walk g base start start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g base) 0))))
(lemma sound_up (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (w (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (sound g start d w a) (<= a b))
  (ensures (sound g start d w b))
  (body))
(lemma bounded_up (params (d (seq (option int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (bounded d a) (<= a b))
  (ensures (bounded d b))
  (body))
(lemma step_mono (params (dist (seq (option int))) (n0 (seq (option int))) (n1 (seq (option int))) (x int) (c int))
  (requires (mono dist n0) (upd_d n0 n1 x (some c)) (or (is none (idx n0 x)) (< c (field (idx n0 x) value))))
  (ensures (mono n0 n1) (mono dist n1) (improved dist n1))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx n1 x) (some c)))
    (assert (is some (idx n1 x)))))
(lemma step_sound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (n0 (seq (option int))) (w0 (seq (seq int)))
                          (n1 (seq (option int))) (w1 (seq (seq int))) (x int) (c int) (path (seq int)) (lim int))
  (requires (sound g start n0 w0 lim) (== (len w0) (len n0)) (upd_d n0 n1 x (some c)) (upd_w w0 w1 x path)
            (walk g path start x) (<= (len path) lim) (== (path_weight g path) c))
  (ensures (sound g start n1 w1 lim))
  (body))
(lemma step_bounded (params (n0 (seq (option int))) (n1 (seq (option int))) (x int) (c int) (b int))
  (requires (bounded n0 b) (upd_d n0 n1 x (some c)) (and (<= (neg b) c) (<= c b)))
  (ensures (bounded n1 b))
  (body))
(lemma row_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (n0 (seq (option int))) (n1 (seq (option int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (mono n0 n1) (row_done g dist n0 u m))
  (ensures (row_done g dist n1 u m))
  (body))
(lemma rows_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (n0 (seq (option int))) (n1 (seq (option int))) (m int))
  (requires (mono n0 n1) (rows_done g dist n0 m))
  (ensures (rows_done g dist n1 m))
  (body))
(lemma row_extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (row_done g dist next u i) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (rel dist next u (idx (idx g u) i)))
  (ensures (row_done g dist next u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma rows_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int))) (u int))
  (requires (rows_done g dist next u) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (row_done g dist next u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (rows_done g dist next (+ u 1)))
  (body))
(lemma extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int)))
                      (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int) (lim int))
  (requires (sound g start dist wit lim) (distinct_ok g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w)
            (is some (idx dist u)))
  (ensures (walk g (concat (idx wit u) (seq-lit v)) start v)
           (<= (len (concat (idx wit u) (seq-lit v))) (+ lim 1))
           (== (path_weight g (concat (idx wit u) (seq-lit v))) (+ (field (idx dist u) value) w)))
  (body
    (assert (walk g (idx wit u) start u))
    (assert (edge_at g u v i))
    (call edge_connected g u v i)
    (call edge_weight g u v i)
    (call walk_snoc g (idx wit u) start u v)
    (call weight_snoc g (idx wit u) v)
    (assert (== (idx (idx wit u) (- (len (idx wit u)) 1)) u))))
(lemma path_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int)))
                         (v int) (p (seq int)) (lim int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (distinct_ok g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len next) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (>= lim 1)
            (complete g start dist lim) (rows_done g dist next (len g)) (mono dist next)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (walk g p start v) (<= (len p) (+ lim 1)))
  (ensures (is some (idx next v)) (<= (field (idx next v) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) lim)
      (assert (and (is some (idx dist v)) (<= (field (idx dist v) value) (path_weight g p))))
      (block
        (call walk_prefix g p start v)
        (call vertex_range g p start (- (len p) 2))
        (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let p1 (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call connected_edge g u v)
        (obtain ((i int)) (edge_at g u v i))
        (call edge_weight g u v i)
        (assert (<= (len p1) lim))
        (assert (walk g p1 start u))
        (assert (and (is some (idx dist u)) (<= (field (idx dist u) value) (path_weight g p1))))
        (assert (rel dist next u (idx (idx g u) i)))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g p1) (get_edge_weight g u v))))))))
(lemma step_complete (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int))) (lim int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (distinct_ok g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len next) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (>= lim 1)
            (complete g start dist lim) (rows_done g dist next (len g)) (mono dist next))
  (ensures (complete g start next (+ lim 1)))
  (body (forall ((v int) (p (seq int))) (call path_step g start dist next v p lim))))
(lemma stable_up (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (lim int) (top int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (distinct_ok g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (>= lim 1) (<= lim top)
            (complete g start dist lim) (rows_done g dist dist (len g)) (mono dist dist))
  (ensures (complete g start dist top))
  (decreases (- top lim))
  (body
    (if (< lim top)
      (block
        (call step_complete g start dist dist lim)
        (call stable_up g start dist (+ lim 1) top))
      (block))))
(lemma stable_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (lim int) (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (distinct_ok g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (>= lim 1) (complete g start dist lim) (rows_done g dist dist (len g)) (mono dist dist)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures (is some (idx dist v)) (<= (field (idx dist v) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (assert (walk g p start v))
    (if (< lim (len p))
      (block
        (call stable_up g start dist lim (len p))
        (assert (and (is some (idx dist v)) (<= (field (idx dist v) value) (path_weight g p)))))
      (assert (and (is some (idx dist v)) (<= (field (idx dist v) value) (path_weight g p)))))))
(lemma final_vertex (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (lim int) (v int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (distinct_ok g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (>= lim 1)
            (sound g start dist wit lim) (complete g start dist lim)
            (rows_done g dist dist (len g)) (mono dist dist)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (match (idx dist v)
             (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                            (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
             (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (forall ((p0 (seq int))) (call stable_walk g start dist lim v p0))
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none) (block))
      (case (some d0)
        (block
          (assert (walk g (idx wit v) start v))
          (assert (== (path_weight g (idx wit v)) d0))
          (assert (is_shortest_dist g start v d0)))))))
(lemma final_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (lim int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (distinct_ok g) (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (>= lim 1)
            (sound g start dist wit lim) (complete g start dist lim)
            (rows_done g dist dist (len g)) (mono dist dist))
  (ensures (final_ok g start dist))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call final_vertex g start dist wit lim v))
    (assert (final_ok g start dist))))
(lemma found_cycle (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (lim int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (== (len dist) (len g)) (== (len next) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g))
            (complete g start dist (len g)) (sound g start next wit lim) (improved dist next))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (if (has_negative_cycle g)
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (and (< x (len dist)) (< x (len next))))
                               (and (is some (idx next x))
                                    (or (is none (idx dist x)) (< (field (idx next x) value) (field (idx dist x) value))))))
        (assert (walk g (idx wit x) start x))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (idx wit x)) (field (idx next x) value)))
        (call shorten g (idx wit x) start x)
        (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (walk g q start x) (<= (len q) (len g))) (<= (path_weight g q) (path_weight g (idx wit x)))))
        (assert (and (is some (idx dist x)) (<= (field (idx dist x) value) (path_weight g q))))))))

(def bellman_ford
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call wf_view graph)
    (assert (== g (field graph adj)))

  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))

(lemma inj_bound (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (within s n) (inj s) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (<= (len s) n))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx s 0)) (< (idx s 0) n)))
        (ghost-let m int (- (len s) 1))
        (ghost-let c int (idx s m))
        (assert (and (<= 0 c) (< c n)))
        (assert (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k m)) (!= (idx s k) c))))
        (ghost-let t (seq int) (seq-build m (fn (k2) (if (== (idx s k2) (- n 1)) c (idx s k2)))))
        (assert (== (len t) m))
        (assert (forall ((k3 int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k3) (< k3 m)) (== (idx t k3) (if (== (idx s k3) (- n 1)) c (idx s k3))))))
        (assert (within t (- n 1)))
        (assert (inj t))
        (call inj_bound t (- n 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma pw_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 2 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g (take p k)) (+ (path_weight g (take p (- k 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- k 2)) (idx p (- k 1))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq int) (take p k))
    (assert (== (len t) k))
    (assert (== (take t (- k 1)) (take p (- k 1))))
    (assert (== (idx t (- k 2)) (idx p (- k 2))))
    (assert (== (idx t (- k 1)) (idx p (- k 1))))
    (assert (== (path_weight g t) (+ (path_weight g (take t (- (len t) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx t (- (len t) 2)) (idx t (- (len t) 1))))))))
(lemma pw_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (and (<= i j) (< j (len p)))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g (take p (+ j 1))) (+ (path_weight g (take p (+ i 1))) (path_weight g (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i)))))
  (decreases (- j i))
  (body
    (ghost-let s (seq int) (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i))
    (assert (== (len s) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (if (== j i)
      (assert (== (path_weight g s) 0))
      (block
        (call pw_split g p i (- j 1))
        (call pw_step g p (+ j 1))
        (ghost-let s1 (seq int) (drop (take p j) i))
        (assert (== (take s (- j i)) s1))
        (assert (== (idx s (- (- j i) 1)) (idx p (- j 1))))
        (assert (== (idx s (- j i)) (idx p j)))
        (assert (== (path_weight g s) (+ (path_weight g (take s (- (len s) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx s (- (len s) 2)) (idx s (- (len s) 1))))))))))
(lemma cycle_of_repeat (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 i) (and (< i j) (< j (len p))))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
    (< (path_weight g (take p (+ j 1))) (path_weight g (take p (+ i 1)))))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (call pw_split g p i j)
    (ghost-let s (seq int) (drop (take p (+ j 1)) i))
    (assert (== (len s) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx s 0) (idx p i)))
    (assert (== (idx s (- j i)) (idx p j)))
    (assert (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- j i)))
      (and (== (idx s k) (idx p (+ i k))) (== (idx s (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ (+ i k) 1)))))))
    (assert (forall ((k2 int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k2) (< k2 (- (len s) 1))) (connected g (idx s k2) (idx s (+ k2 1))))))
    (assert (is_path g s))
    (assert (< (path_weight g s) 0))
    (assert (and (and (is_path g s) (> (len s) 1)) (and (== (idx s 0) (idx s (- (len s) 1))) (< (path_weight g s) 0))))
    (assert (has_negative_cycle g))))
(lemma long_cycle (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (lighter g p) (within p (len g)) (> (len p) (len g)))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (if (inj p)
      (call inj_bound p (len g))
      (block
        (obtain ((a int)) (exists ((b0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b0)) (< b0 (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b0)))))
        (obtain ((b int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (len p))) (== (idx p a) (idx p b))))
        (assert (< (path_weight g (take p (+ b 1))) (path_weight g (take p (+ a 1)))))
        (call cycle_of_repeat g p a b)))))
(lemma wf_at (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (and (and (<= 0 j) (<= j i)) (< i (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
    (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= j k) (< k i)) (!= (get (idx row k) 0) v))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v j) (get (idx row i) 1)))
  (decreases (- i j))
  (body
    (if (< j i)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row j) 0) v))
        (call wf_at row v i (+ j 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma edge_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (distinct_targets g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (connected g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== (get_edge_weight g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (assert (connected g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
    (assert (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k i)) (!= (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
    (call wf_at (idx g u) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) i 0)))
(lemma conn_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (distinct_targets g) (weights_and_size_bounded g) (connected g u v))
  (ensures (and (<= -100000 (get_edge_weight g u v)) (<= (get_edge_weight g u v) 100000)))
  (body
    (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g u v w))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1) w))))
    (call edge_weight g u e)
    (assert (has_edge g u v w))
    (assert (and (>= w -100000) (<= w 100000)))))
(lemma weight_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (distinct_targets g) (weights_and_size_bounded g) (is_path g p))
  (ensures (<= (path_weight g p) (* 100000 (- (len p) 1))) (>= (path_weight g p) (* -100000 (- (len p) 1))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (>= (len p) 2)
      (block
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (len q) (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1)))
          (and (== (idx q k) (idx p k)) (== (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))))
        (assert (is_path g q))
        (call weight_range g q)
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (call conn_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))
      (block))))
(lemma heavy_cycle (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (p (seq int)) (v int) (c int))
  (requires
    (distinct_targets g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (wit_ok g start (len g) p v c)
    (or (< c -10000000000) (> c 10000000000)))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (if (> (len p) (len g))
      (block
        (assert (lighter g p))
        (assert (within p (len g)))
        (call long_cycle g p))
      (block
        (call weight_range g p)
        (assert (<= (len g) 100000))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) c))))))
(lemma concat_facts (params (pu (seq int)) (v int))

  (requires (> (len pu) 0))

  (body

(lemma lighter_pair (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int)) (pu (seq int)) (v int) (c int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (lighter g pu)
    (settled g dist pu)
    (> (len pu) 0)
    (== (path_weight g (concat pu (seq-lit v))) c)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (< c (idx dist v))
    (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b (+ (len pu) 1)))
    (== (idx (concat pu (seq-lit v)) a) (idx (concat pu (seq-lit v)) b)))
  (ensures (< (path_weight g (take (concat pu (seq-lit v)) (+ b 1))) (path_weight g (take (concat pu (seq-lit v)) (+ a 1)))))
  (body
    (call concat_facts pu v)

        (assert (== (idx pu a) (idx pu b)))

        (assert (< (path_weight g (take pu (+ b 1))) (path_weight g (take pu (+ a 1))))))

(lemma ext_lighter (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int)) (pu (seq int)) (v int) (c int))
  (requires

(lemma ext_settled_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (pu (seq int)) (v int) (c int) (m int))
  (requires

(lemma ext_settled (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (pu (seq int)) (v int) (c int))
  (requires

(lemma extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (pu (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (wit_ok g start (len dist) pu u (idx dist u))
    (settled g dist pu)

  (body (forall ((x int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))) (is some (idx a x)))
        (lands b x (field (idx a x) value))))))
(ghost-fn set_at ((a (seq (option int))) (b (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len b) (len a)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len a))))
             (and (== (idx b v) (some c))
                  (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))) (!= x v)) (== (idx b x) (idx a x))))))))
(ghost-fn set_w ((a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int))) (v int) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len b) (len a)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len a))))
             (and (== (idx b v) q)
                  (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))) (!= x v)) (== (idx b x) (idx a x))))))))
(ghost-fn better_at ((a (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len a)))
             (or (is none (idx a v)) (< c (field (idx a v) value))))))
(ghost-fn sound ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist))) (and (< x (len wit)) (is some (idx dist x))))
        (and (ends g s (idx wit x) x)
             (and (== (path_weight g (idx wit x)) (field (idx dist x) value))
                  (<= (len (idx wit x)) m)))))))
(ghost-fn bnd ((dist (seq (option int))) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist))) (is some (idx dist x)))
        (and (<= (neg m) (field (idx dist x) value)) (<= (field (idx dist x) value) m))))))
(ghost-fn row_done ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int))) (u int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i lim)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
             (and (< i (len (idx g u))) (and (< u (len dist)) (is some (idx dist u)))))
        (lands next (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx dist u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn rows_done ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int))) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u lim)) (< u (len g)))
             (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (and (< u (len dist)) (is some (idx dist u)))))
        (lands next (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (+ (field (idx dist u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn covers ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((p (seq int)))
    (=> (and (and (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) s)) (<= (len p) m))
        (lands dist (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (path_weight g p))))))
(ghost-fn strict ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (c int) (x int) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((p (seq int)))
    (=> (and (ends g s p x) (<= (len p) m)) (> (path_weight g p) c)))))
(ghost-fn changed_at ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (x int) (m int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist)))
             (and (is some (idx dist x)) (strict g s (field (idx dist x) value) x m)))))
(ghost-fn in_bound ((t (seq int)) (m int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t))) (and (<= 0 (idx t k)) (< (idx t k) m))))))
(ghost-fn dup_pair ((t (seq int)) (i int) (j int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (and (< j (len t)) (== (idx t i) (idx t j))))))
(ghost-fn dup_from ((t (seq int)) (i int)) bool
  (body (exists ((j int)) (dup_pair t i j))))
(ghost-fn has_dup ((t (seq int))) bool
  (body (exists ((i int)) (dup_from t i))))
(ghost-fn seen_before ((t (seq int)) (x int) (l int)) bool
  (body (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i l)) (and (< i (len t)) (== (idx t i) x))))))

  (ensures (== (weight_from row (get (idx row i) 0) j) (get (idx row i) 1)))

(lemma path_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (p (seq int)) (i int))

  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p i)) (< (idx p i) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (> i 0)

        (call conn_range g (idx p (- i 1)) (idx p i)))

(lemma path_take_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len p))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- m 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take p m) i) (idx (take p m) (+ i 1))))

    (assert (== (idx (take p m) (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ i 1))))

(lemma path_take (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int))

  (ensures (connected g (idx (drop p t) i) (idx (drop p t) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (drop p t) i) (idx p (+ i t))))
    (assert (== (idx (drop p t) (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ (+ i t) 1))))

(lemma path_drop (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (t int))

(lemma extend_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (t int) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) t) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat p (seq-lit t)) i) (idx (concat p (seq-lit t)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit t)))
    (assert (== (idx q i) (idx p i)))
    (if (< (+ i 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ i 1))))
        (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q (+ i 1)) t))))))
(lemma extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) t))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit t)))
    (== (len (concat p (seq-lit t))) (+ (len p) 1))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit t)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit t)) (len p)) t)
    (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit t))) (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) t))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call extend_at g p t i))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit t)))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (take q (- (len q) 1)) p))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) t))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (+ (path_weight g (take q (- (len q) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))))))
(lemma weight_join (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (b (seq int)))
  (requires (>= (len a) 1) (>= (len b) 1) (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g (concat a (drop b 1))) (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (< (len b) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat a (drop b 1)) a))
        (assert (== (path_weight g b) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let b0 (seq int) (take b (- (len b) 1)))
        (ghost-let h (seq int) (concat a (drop b 1)))
        (assert (== (len b0) (- (len b) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx b0 0) (idx b 0)))
        (call weight_join g a b0)
        (assert (== (take h (- (len h) 1)) (concat a (drop b0 1))))
        (assert (== (idx h (- (len h) 1)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx h (- (len h) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 2))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g h) (+ (path_weight g (take h (- (len h) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx h (- (len h) 2)) (idx h (- (len h) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g b) (+ (path_weight g b0) (get_edge_weight g (idx b (- (len b) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))))))))
(lemma path_join_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (b (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g a) (is_path g b) (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len (concat a (drop b 1))) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) i) (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body

    (if (< (+ i 1) (len a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx h i) (idx a i)))
        (assert (== (idx h (+ i 1)) (idx a (+ i 1))))
        (assert (connected g (idx a i) (idx a (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let t int (- (+ i 1) (len a)))
        (assert (== (idx h i) (idx b t)))
        (assert (== (idx h (+ i 1)) (idx b (+ t 1))))
        (assert (connected g (idx b t) (idx b (+ t 1))))))))
(lemma path_join (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (b (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g a) (is_path g b) (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat a (drop b 1)))
    (== (len (concat a (drop b 1))) (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) 0) (idx a 0))
    (== (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) (- (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)) 1)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call path_join_at g a b i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat a (drop b 1))))
    (if (< (len b) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (len b) 1))
        (assert (== (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) (- (len a) 1)) (idx a (- (len a) 1)))))
      (assert (== (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) (- (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)) 1)) (idx (drop b 1) (- (len b) 2)))))))
(lemma split_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ t 1)))
    (is_path g (drop p t))
    (== (idx (take p (+ t 1)) t) (idx p t))
    (== (idx (drop p t) 0) (idx p t))
    (== (concat (take p (+ t 1)) (drop (drop p t) 1)) p)
    (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (take p (+ t 1))) (path_weight g (drop p t)))))
  (body
    (call path_take g p (+ t 1))
    (call path_drop g p t)
    (ghost-let a (seq int) (take p (+ t 1)))
    (ghost-let b (seq int) (drop p t))
    (assert (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
    (assert (== (concat a (drop b 1)) p))
    (call weight_join g a b)))

(lemma covers_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int))) (m int) (p (seq int)))

(lemma fix_answer (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (m0 int) (v int))

            (sound g s dist wit m0) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))))

  (ensures (== (weight_from row (get (idx row i) 0) j) (get (idx row i) 1)))
  (decreases (- i j))
  (body (if (< j i) (call weight_from_at row i (+ j 1)) (block))))

(lemma extend_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (t int) (i int))

  (body

    (assert (== (idx q i) (idx p i)))
    (if (< (+ i 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ i 1))))
        (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx q (+ i 1)) t))))))
(lemma extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) t))

    (== (len (concat p (seq-lit t))) (+ (len p) 1))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit t)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit t)) (len p)) t)
    (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit t))) (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) t))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call extend_at g p t i))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit t)))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (take q (- (len q) 1)) p))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) t))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (+ (path_weight g (take q (- (len q) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))))))
(lemma weight_join (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (b (seq int)))
  (requires (>= (len a) 1) (>= (len b) 1) (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g (concat a (drop b 1))) (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (< (len b) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat a (drop b 1)) a))
        (assert (== (path_weight g b) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let b0 (seq int) (take b (- (len b) 1)))
        (ghost-let h (seq int) (concat a (drop b 1)))
        (assert (== (len b0) (- (len b) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx b0 0) (idx b 0)))
        (call weight_join g a b0)
        (assert (== (take h (- (len h) 1)) (concat a (drop b0 1))))
        (assert (== (idx h (- (len h) 1)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx h (- (len h) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 2))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g h) (+ (path_weight g (take h (- (len h) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx h (- (len h) 2)) (idx h (- (len h) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g b) (+ (path_weight g b0) (get_edge_weight g (idx b (- (len b) 2)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))))))))
(lemma path_join_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (b (seq int)) (i int))
  (requires (is_path g a) (is_path g b) (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- (len (concat a (drop b 1))) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) i) (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let h (seq int) (concat a (drop b 1)))
    (if (< (+ i 1) (len a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx h i) (idx a i)))
        (assert (== (idx h (+ i 1)) (idx a (+ i 1))))
        (assert (connected g (idx a i) (idx a (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let t int (- (+ i 1) (len a)))
        (assert (== (idx h i) (idx b t)))
        (assert (== (idx h (+ i 1)) (idx b (+ t 1))))
        (assert (connected g (idx b t) (idx b (+ t 1))))))))
(lemma path_join (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (b (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g a) (is_path g b) (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat a (drop b 1)))
    (== (len (concat a (drop b 1))) (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)))
    (== (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) 0) (idx a 0))
    (== (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) (- (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)) 1)) (idx b (- (len b) 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((i int)) (call path_join_at g a b i))
    (assert (is_path g (concat a (drop b 1))))
    (if (< (len b) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (len b) 1))
        (assert (== (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) (- (len a) 1)) (idx a (- (len a) 1)))))
      (assert (== (idx (concat a (drop b 1)) (- (+ (len a) (- (len b) 1)) 1)) (idx (drop b 1) (- (len b) 2)))))))
(lemma split_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (+ t 1)))
    (is_path g (drop p t))
    (== (idx (take p (+ t 1)) t) (idx p t))
    (== (idx (drop p t) 0) (idx p t))
    (== (concat (take p (+ t 1)) (drop (drop p t) 1)) p)
    (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g (take p (+ t 1))) (path_weight g (drop p t)))))
  (body
    (call path_take g p (+ t 1))
    (call path_drop g p t)
    (ghost-let a (seq int) (take p (+ t 1)))
    (ghost-let b (seq int) (drop p t))
    (assert (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
    (assert (== (concat a (drop b 1)) p))
    (call weight_join g a b)))

(lemma covers_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (next (seq (option int))) (m int) (p (seq int)))

(lemma covers_fix (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (m0 int) (m int))
  (requires (wf g) (covers g s dist m0) (rows_done g dist dist (len g)) (>= m0 1) (>= m m0))
  (ensures (covers g s dist m))
  (decreases (- m m0))
  (body
    (if (> m m0)
      (block

        (call lower_eq dist dist)
        (call covers_step g s dist dist (- m 1)))

(lemma fix_answer (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s int) (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (m0 int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len wit) (len dist)) (covers g s dist m0) (rows_done g dist dist (len g)) (>= m0 1)

  (ensures (match (idx dist v)
             (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                            (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) s) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
             (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g s v d))))
  (body
    (forall ((q (seq int))) (call fix_one g s dist m0 q))
    (if (is some (idx dist v))
      (block
        (assert (ends g s (idx wit v) v))

            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))

    (ends g s (concat (idx wit u) (seq-lit (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))

(lemma dup_intro (params (t (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (dup_pair t i j))
  (ensures (has_dup t))
  (body (assert (dup_from t i))))
(lemma pigeon (params (t (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (in_bound t m) (> (len t) m))
  (ensures (has_dup t))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= 0 (idx t 0)))
        (assert (< (idx t 0) m)))
      (block
        (ghost-let l int (- (len t) 1))
        (ghost-let x int (idx t l))
        (assert (and (<= 0 x) (< x m)))
        (if (seen_before t x l)
          (block
            (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i l)) (and (< i (len t)) (== (idx t i) x))))
            (assert (dup_pair t i l))
            (call dup_intro t i l))
          (block
            (ghost-let r (seq int) (seq-build l (fn (i2) (if (== (idx t i2) (- m 1)) x (idx t i2)))))
            (assert (== (len r) l))
            (assert (in_bound r (- m 1)))
            (call pigeon r (- m 1))
            (assert (has_dup r))
            (obtain ((a int)) (dup_from r a))
            (obtain ((b int)) (dup_pair r a b))
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a b)) (< b l)))
            (assert (!= (idx t a) x))
            (assert (!= (idx t b) x))
            (assert (== (idx r a) (if (== (idx t a) (- m 1)) x (idx t a))))
            (assert (== (idx r b) (if (== (idx t b) (- m 1)) x (idx t b))))
            (assert (== (idx r a) (idx r b)))

                  (=>
                    (and
                      (bf_prefix g u e x q)
                      (== (get (idx (idx g x) q) 0) v))
                    (is none (idx old x))))))
            (case (some nd)
              (and
                (or
                  (== (idx old v) (some nd))
                  (exists ((x int) (q int) (sd int))
                    (and
                      (and
                        (bf_prefix g u e x q)
                        (== (get (idx (idx g x) q) 0) v))
                      (and
                        (== (idx old x) (some sd))
                        (== nd (+ sd (get (idx (idx g x) q) 1)))))))
                (and
                  (match (idx old v)
                    (case (none) true)
                    (case (some od) (<= nd od)))
                  (forall ((x int) (q int) (sd int))
                    (=>
                      (and
                        (and
                          (bf_prefix g u e x q)
                          (== (get (idx (idx g x) q) 0) v))
                        (== (idx old x) (some sd)))
                      (<= nd (+ sd (get (idx (idx g x) q) 1))))))))))))))

(lemma bf_round_initial_at
  (params

      (case (some d)

        (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
        (assert (bf_path_to g start v (seq-lit start) 0))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
        (forall ((p (seq int))) (call bf_zero_path g start v p)))

        (forall ((p (seq int))) (call bf_zero_path g start v p))))))

  (params

    (== g (view wg))

    (obtain ((q int))

          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))

            (<= 0 q)
            (< q (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))

            (get

                (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 1)))

      (seq-lit v)

        (get_edge_weight

(ghost-fn bf_update
  ((s (seq (option int))) (i int) (value (option int)))
  (seq (option int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (body
    (seq-build (len s)
      (fn (k) (if (== k i) value (idx s k))))))

(ghost-fn bf_relax_partial
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (old (seq (option int)))
   (next (seq (option int)))
   (u int)
   (e int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len old) (len g)) (== (len next) (len old)))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
          (match (idx next v)
            (case (none)
              (and
                (is none (idx old v))
                (forall ((x int) (q int))
                  (=>
                    (and
                      (bf_prefix g u e x q)
                      (== (get (idx (idx g x) q) 0) v))
                    (is none (idx old x))))))
            (case (some nd)
              (and
                (or
                  (== (idx old v) (some nd))
                  (exists ((x int) (q int) (sd int))
                    (and
                      (and
                        (bf_prefix g u e x q)
                        (== (get (idx (idx g x) q) 0) v))
                      (and
                        (== (idx old x) (some sd))
                        (== nd (+ sd (get (idx (idx g x) q) 1)))))))
                (and
                  (match (idx old v)
                    (case (none) true)
                    (case (some od) (<= nd od)))
                  (forall ((x int) (q int) (sd int))
                    (=>
                      (and
                        (and
                          (bf_prefix g u e x q)
                          (== (get (idx (idx g x) q) 0) v))
                        (== (idx old x) (some sd)))
                      (<= nd (+ sd (get (idx (idx g x) q) 1))))))))))))))

(lemma bf_zero_path

  (ensures

    (== (path_weight g p) 0))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g p))
    (assert (> (len p) 0))
    (assert (<= (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (- (len p) 1) 0))
    (assert (== end start))
    (assert (< (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0))))

(lemma bf_round_initial_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dists (seq (option int)))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dists) (len g))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len g)))
        (== (idx dists k) (if (== k start) (some 0) (none)))))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dists v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (bf_path_to g start v p 0) false)))
      (case (some d)
        (and
          (exists ((p (seq int)))
            (and (bf_path_to g start v p 0)
                 (== (path_weight g p) d)))
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (=> (bf_path_to g start v p 0)
                (>= (path_weight g p) d)))))))
  (body
    (if (== v start)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx dists v) (some 0)))
        (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
        (assert (bf_path_to g start v (seq-lit start) 0))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
        (forall ((p (seq int))) (call bf_zero_path g start v p)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx dists v) (none)))
        (forall ((p (seq int))) (call bf_zero_path g start v p))))))

(lemma bf_changed_tracks
  (params

    (after (seq (option int)))

(lemma bf_weight_from_unique
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (target int)
    (q int)
    (i int))

    (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len row)))

    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= i j) (< j (len row)))
          (!= j q))
        (!= (get (idx row j) 0) target))))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from row target i)
        (get (idx row q) 1)))
  (decreases (- q i))
  (body
    (if (== i q)
      (block
        (assert (== (get (idx row i) 0) target))
        (assert
          (==
            (weight_from row target i)
            (get (idx row i) 1))))
      (block
        (assert (< i q))
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) target))
        (call bf_weight_from_unique row target q (+ i 1))
        (assert
          (==
            (weight_from row target i)
            (weight_from row target (+ i 1))))))))

(lemma bf_path_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 1))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (==
      (idx
        (take p (- (len p) 1))
        (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
      (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (connected
      g
      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
      (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (==
      (path_weight g p)
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (get_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take
      p
      (- (len p) 1)
      (- (len p) 2))
    (forall ((i int)) (call bf_path_prefix_at g p i))
    (assert
      (connected
        g
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))

  (params

    (v int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 0)

      (<= 0 i)

        (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) i)

      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))

(lemma bf_append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (has_edge g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((q int))
      (and
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 q)
            (< q (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))
        (and
          (==
            (get
              (idx
                (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
                q)
              0)
            v)
          (==
            (get
              (idx
                (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
                q)
              1)
            w))))
    (call bf_edge_weight_at
      wg
      g
      (idx p (- (len p) 1))
      q)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int)) (call bf_append_path_at g p v i))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert
      (==
        (get_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          v)
        w))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

  (params

    (obtain ((q int))

          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))

            (<= 0 q)
            (< q (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))

      (seq-lit v)

    (start int)

    (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (and (<= 0 steps) (< steps (len g)))
    (bf_round_ok g start old steps)
    (bf_round_bound old steps)
    (bf_relax_partial g old next (len g) 0))
  (ensures
    (bf_round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (bf_round_bound next (+ steps 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_relax_complete_at wg g start old next steps v))))

(lemma bf_fixed_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq (option int)))
    (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (>= steps 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old steps)
    (bf_round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== next old)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (exists ((d int))
      (and
        (== (idx old v) (some d))
        (>= (path_weight g p) d))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (+ steps 1))
      (block
        (assert (bf_path_to g start v p steps))
        (match (idx old v)
          (case (none) (assert false))
          (case (some direct_dist)
            (assert (>= (path_weight g p) direct_dist)))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len p) 1))
        (call bf_path_prefix g p)
        (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let prefix_path (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
        (call bf_fixed_path
          wg g start old next steps u prefix_path)
        (obtain ((prefix_dist int))
          (and
            (== (idx old u) (some prefix_dist))
            (>= (path_weight g prefix_path) prefix_dist)))
        (obtain ((bounded_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_path_to g start u bounded_path steps)
            (== (path_weight g bounded_path) prefix_dist)))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge g u v edge_weight))
        (obtain ((edge_position int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_position)
                (< edge_position (len (idx g u)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 0) v)
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 1) edge_weight))))
        (call bf_edge_weight_at wg g u edge_position)
        (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) edge_weight))
        (call bf_append_path
          wg g bounded_path v edge_weight)
        (assert
          (bf_path_to
            g
            start
            v
            (concat bounded_path (seq-lit v))
            (+ steps 1)))
        (match (idx next v)
          (case (none) (assert false))
          (case (some fixed_dist)
            (block
              (assert
                (<= fixed_dist (+ prefix_dist edge_weight)))
              (assert
                (==
                  (path_weight g p)
                  (+ (path_weight g prefix_path) edge_weight)))
              (assert (== (idx old v) (some fixed_dist))))))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq (option int)))
    (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (>= steps 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old steps)
    (bf_round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== next old)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call bf_fixed_path
            wg g start old next steps v p)))
      (case (some fixed_value)
        (block
          (obtain ((witness_path (seq int)))
            (and
              (bf_path_to
                g start v witness_path (+ steps 1))
              (==
                (path_weight g witness_path)
                fixed_value)))
          (forall ((p2 (seq int)))
            (call bf_fixed_path
              wg g start old next steps v p2))
          (assert
            (exists ((p3 (seq int)))
              (and
                (and
                  (is_path g p3)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p3 0) start)
                    (==
                      (idx p3 (- (len p3) 1))
                      v)))
                (==
                  (path_weight g p3)
                  fixed_value))))
          (assert
            (forall ((p4 (seq int)))
              (=>
                (and
                  (is_path g p4)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p4 0) start)
                    (==
                      (idx p4 (- (len p4) 1))
                      v)))
                (>=
                  (path_weight g p4)

(lemma bf_fixed_result
  (params

  (ensures
    (and
      (== (len next) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))

          (match (idx next v)

(lemma bf_path_vertex_range
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (and (<= 0 (- k 1)) (< (- k 1) (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
        (obtain ((q int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
                (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 q)
                (< q (len (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))))))
            (and
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))
                    q)
                  0)
                (idx p k))
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))
                    q)
                  1)
                w))))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (len g))))))))

(lemma bf_skip_range
  (params (x int) (removed int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 removed) (< removed n))
    (!= x removed))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (bf_skip_value x removed))
      (< (bf_skip_value x removed) (- n 1))))
  (body
    (if (< x removed) (block) (block))))

(lemma bf_skip_injective
  (params (x int) (y int) (removed int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))
    (and (<= 0 removed) (< removed n))
    (!= x removed)
    (!= y removed)
    (== (bf_skip_value x removed) (bf_skip_value y removed)))
  (ensures (== x y))
  (body
    (if (< x removed)
      (if (< y removed) (block) (block))
      (if (< y removed) (block) (block)))))

(lemma bf_path_repetition
  (params
    (p (seq int))
    (n int))
  (requires
    (>= n 1)
    (== (len p) (+ n 1))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
        (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) n)))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx p 1) 0))
        (assert
          (exists ((base_i int) (base_j int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 base_i) (< base_i base_j))
                (< base_j (len p)))
              (== (idx p base_i) (idx p base_j))))))
      (block
        (ghost-let removed int (idx p n))
        (if
          (exists ((hit int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 hit) (< hit n))
              (== (idx p hit) removed)))
          (block
            (obtain ((found int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 found) (< found n))
                (== (idx p found) removed)))
            (assert
              (exists ((found_i int) (found_j int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 found_i) (< found_i found_j))
                    (< found_j (len p)))
                  (== (idx p found_i) (idx p found_j))))))
          (block
            (ghost-let reduced (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (map_index)
                  (bf_skip_value (idx p map_index) removed))))
            (assert (== (len reduced) n))
            (forall ((range_index int))
              (call bf_skip_range
                (idx p range_index)
                removed
                n))
            (assert
              (forall ((bounded_index int))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (<= 0 bounded_index)
                    (< bounded_index (len reduced)))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 (idx reduced bounded_index))
                    (< (idx reduced bounded_index) (- n 1))))))
            (call bf_path_repetition reduced (- n 1))
            (obtain ((left int) (right int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 left) (< left right))
                  (< right (len reduced)))
                (== (idx reduced left) (idx reduced right))))
            (assert (!= (idx p left) removed))
            (assert (!= (idx p right) removed))
            (call bf_skip_injective
              (idx p left)
              (idx p right)
              removed
              n)
            (assert
              (exists ((lifted_i int) (lifted_j int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 lifted_i) (< lifted_i lifted_j))
                    (< lifted_j (len p)))
                  (== (idx p lifted_i) (idx p lifted_j)))))))))))

(lemma bf_take_path_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (< 0 k) (<= k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (- k 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (take p k) i)
      (idx (take p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_idx_take p k i)
    (call law_idx_take p k (+ i 1))))

(lemma bf_take_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (< 0 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (== (idx (take p k) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p k) (- k 1)) (idx p (- k 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (call law_idx_take p k 0)
    (call law_idx_take p k (- k 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (call bf_take_path_at g p k i))))

(lemma bf_drop_path_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and
      (<= 0 i)
      (< i (- (len (drop p k)) 1))))
  (ensures
    (connected
      g
      (idx (drop p k) i)
      (idx (drop p k) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_drop p k)
    (call law_idx_drop p k i)
    (call law_idx_drop p k (+ i 1))))

(lemma bf_drop_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (drop p k))
    (== (idx (drop p k) 0) (idx p k))
    (==
      (idx (drop p k) (- (len (drop p k)) 1))
      (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_drop p k)
    (call law_idx_drop p k 0)
    (call law_idx_drop
      p
      k
      (- (len (drop p k)) 1))
    (forall ((i int)) (call bf_drop_path_at g p k i))))

(lemma bf_append_connected
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+
        (path_weight g p)
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int)) (call bf_append_path_at g p v i))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+
          (path_weight g p)
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            v))))))

(lemma bf_join_paths
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (b (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g a)
    (is_path g b)
    (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b))
    (==
      (idx (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b) 0)
      (idx a 0))
    (==
      (idx
        (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b)
        (- (len (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b)) 1))
      (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b))
      (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (== (len b) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (path_weight g b) 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b)
            a)))
      (block
        (ghost-let b_prefix (seq int)
          (take b (- (len b) 1)))
        (call bf_path_prefix g b)
        (call bf_join_paths g a b_prefix)
        (ghost-let joined_prefix (seq int)
          (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b_prefix))
        (assert
          (==
            (idx joined_prefix (- (len joined_prefix) 1))
            (idx b (- (len b) 2))))
        (call bf_append_connected
          g
          joined_prefix
          (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
        (assert
          (==
            (concat
              joined_prefix
              (seq-lit (idx b (- (len b) 1))))
            (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b)))
        (assert
          (==
            (get_edge_weight
              g
              (idx b (- (len b) 2))
              (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
            (-
              (path_weight g b)
              (path_weight g b_prefix))))))))

(lemma bf_path_weight_split
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g p)
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (path_weight g (drop p k)))))
  (body
    (call bf_take_path g p (+ k 1))
    (call bf_drop_path g p k)
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k)
        (idx (drop p k) 0)))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ k 1))
      (drop p k))
    (assert
      (==
        (concat
          (take (take p (+ k 1)) k)
          (drop p k))
        p))))

(lemma bf_remove_repeat
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
      (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((cycle (seq int)) (shorter (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g cycle)
          (and
            (> (len cycle) 1)
            (==
              (idx cycle 0)
              (idx cycle (- (len cycle) 1)))))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g shorter)
            (and
              (== (idx shorter 0) (idx p 0))
              (==
                (idx shorter (- (len shorter) 1))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
          (and
            (< (len shorter) (len p))
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight g shorter)
                (path_weight g cycle))))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (+ i 1)))
    (ghost-let through_cycle (seq int) (take p (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let cycle_part (seq int) (drop through_cycle i))
    (ghost-let suffix (seq int) (drop p j))
    (ghost-let shorter_part (seq int)
      (concat (take prefix (- (len prefix) 1)) suffix))
    (call bf_take_path g p (+ i 1))
    (call bf_take_path g p (+ j 1))
    (call bf_drop_path g through_cycle i)
    (call bf_drop_path g p j)
    (assert
      (==
        (idx prefix (- (len prefix) 1))
        (idx suffix 0)))
    (call bf_join_paths g prefix suffix)
    (call bf_path_weight_split g p j)
    (call bf_path_weight_split g through_cycle i)
    (assert
      (==
        (take through_cycle (+ i 1))
        prefix))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx cycle_part 0)
        (idx p i)))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx cycle_part (- (len cycle_part) 1))
        (idx p j)))
    (assert (> (len cycle_part) 1))
    (assert (< (len shorter_part) (len p)))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g shorter_part)
          (path_weight g cycle_part))))
    (assert
      (exists ((cycle_result (seq int)) (shorter_result (seq int)))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g cycle_result)
            (and
              (> (len cycle_result) 1)
              (==
                (idx cycle_result 0)
                (idx cycle_result (- (len cycle_result) 1)))))
          (and
            (and
              (is_path g shorter_result)
              (and
                (== (idx shorter_result 0) (idx p 0))
                (==
                  (idx shorter_result (- (len shorter_result) 1))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
            (and
              (< (len shorter_result) (len p))
              (==
                (path_weight g p)
                (+
                  (path_weight g shorter_result)
                  (path_weight g cycle_result))))))))))

(lemma bf_long_improvement_cycle
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq (option int)))
    (n int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (bf_round_ok g start old (- n 1))
    (bf_path_to g start v p n)
    (== (len p) (+ n 1))
    (match (idx old v)
      (case (none) true)
      (case (some old_dist)
        (< (path_weight g p) old_dist))))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (forall ((k int))
      (call bf_path_vertex_range wg g p k))
    (call bf_path_repetition p n)
    (obtain ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
    (call bf_remove_repeat g p i j)
    (obtain ((cycle (seq int)) (shorter (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g cycle)
          (and
            (> (len cycle) 1)
            (==
              (idx cycle 0)
              (idx cycle (- (len cycle) 1)))))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g shorter)
            (and
              (== (idx shorter 0) start)
              (==
                (idx shorter (- (len shorter) 1))
                v)))
          (and
            (< (len shorter) (len p))
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight g shorter)
                (path_weight g cycle)))))))
    (if (< (path_weight g cycle) 0)
      (block
        (assert (has_negative_cycle g)))
      (block
        (assert (<= (len shorter) n))
        (assert
          (bf_path_to
            g start v shorter (- n 1)))
        (match (idx old v)
          (case (none) (assert false))
          (case (some old_value)
            (block
              (assert
                (>=
                  (path_weight g shorter)
                  old_value))
              (assert
                (<=
                  (path_weight g p)
                  (path_weight g shorter)))
              (assert false))))))))

(lemma bf_changed_vertex_cycle
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq (option int)))
    (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_round_ok g start old steps)
    (bf_round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (!= (idx next v) (idx old v)))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (match (idx old v)
          (case (none) (assert false))
          (case (some old_value)
            (block

  (params

  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (+ steps 1))
      (block
        (assert (bf_path_to g start v p steps))
        (match (idx old v)
          (case (none) (assert false))
          (case (some direct_dist)
            (assert (>= (path_weight g p) direct_dist)))))

        (assert (> (len p) 1))
        (call bf_path_prefix g p)
        (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))

        (call bf_fixed_path
          wg g start old next steps u prefix_path)

          (and

            (== (path_weight g bounded_path) prefix_dist)))

            g
            start
            v
            (concat bounded_path (seq-lit v))
            (+ steps 1)))
        (match (idx next v)

          (case (some fixed_dist)
            (block
              (assert
                (<= fixed_dist (+ prefix_dist edge_weight)))
              (assert

                  (path_weight g p)
                  (+ (path_weight g prefix_path) edge_weight)))
