(lemma bf_path_repetition
  (params
    (p (seq int))
    (n int))
  (requires
    (>= n 1)
    (== (len p) (+ n 1))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
        (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) n)))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx p 1) 0))
        (assert
          (exists ((base_i int) (base_j int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 base_i) (< base_i base_j))
                (< base_j (len p)))
              (== (idx p base_i) (idx p base_j))))))
      (block
        (ghost-let removed int (idx p n))
        (if
          (exists ((hit int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 hit) (< hit n))
              (== (idx p hit) removed)))
          (block
            (obtain ((found int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 found) (< found n))
                (== (idx p found) removed)))
            (assert
              (exists ((found_i int) (found_j int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 found_i) (< found_i found_j))
                    (< found_j (len p)))
                  (== (idx p found_i) (idx p found_j))))))
          (block
            (ghost-let reduced (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (map_index)
                  (bf_skip_value (idx p map_index) removed))))
            (assert (== (len reduced) n))
            (forall ((range_index int))
              (call bf_skip_range
                (idx p range_index)
                removed
                n))
            (assert
              (forall ((bounded_index int))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (<= 0 bounded_index)
                    (< bounded_index (len reduced)))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 (idx reduced bounded_index))
                    (< (idx reduced bounded_index) (- n 1))))))
            (call bf_path_repetition reduced (- n 1))
            (obtain ((left int) (right int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 left) (< left right))
                  (< right (len reduced)))
                (== (idx reduced left) (idx reduced right))))
            (assert (!= (idx p left) removed))
            (assert (!= (idx p right) removed))
            (call bf_skip_injective
              (idx p left)
              (idx p right)
              removed
              n)
            (assert
              (exists ((lifted_i int) (lifted_j int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 lifted_i) (< lifted_i lifted_j))
                    (< lifted_j (len p)))
                  (== (idx p lifted_i) (idx p lifted_j)))))))))))

      (idx p (- (len p) 1))

(lemma bf_fixed_path
  (params

    (steps int)

    (bf_round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== next old)

    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (exists ((d int))
      (and
        (== (idx old v) (some d))
        (>= (path_weight g p) d))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (+ steps 1))
      (block
        (assert (bf_path_to g start v p steps))
        (match (idx old v)
          (case (none) (assert false))
          (case (some direct_dist)
            (assert (>= (path_weight g p) direct_dist)))))
      (block
        (assert (> (len p) 1))
        (call bf_path_prefix g p)
        (ghost-let u int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let prefix_path (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
        (call bf_fixed_path
          wg g start old next steps u prefix_path)
        (obtain ((prefix_dist int))
          (and
            (== (idx old u) (some prefix_dist))
            (>= (path_weight g prefix_path) prefix_dist)))
        (obtain ((bounded_path (seq int)))
          (and
            (bf_path_to g start u bounded_path steps)
            (== (path_weight g bounded_path) prefix_dist)))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge g u v edge_weight))
        (obtain ((edge_position int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_position)
                (< edge_position (len (idx g u)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 0) v)
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) edge_position) 1) edge_weight))))
        (call bf_edge_weight_at wg g u edge_position)
        (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) edge_weight))
        (call bf_append_path
          wg g bounded_path v edge_weight)
        (assert
          (bf_path_to
            g
            start
            v
            (concat bounded_path (seq-lit v))
            (+ steps 1)))
        (match (idx next v)
          (case (none) (assert false))
          (case (some fixed_dist)
            (block
              (assert
                (<= fixed_dist (+ prefix_dist edge_weight)))
              (assert
                (==
                  (path_weight g p)
                  (+ (path_weight g prefix_path) edge_weight)))
              (assert (== (idx old v) (some fixed_dist))))))))))

(lemma bf_path_repetition
  (params
    (p (seq int))
    (n int))
  (requires
    (>= n 1)
    (== (len p) (+ n 1))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
        (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) n)))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx p 1) 0))
        (assert
          (exists ((base_i int) (base_j int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 base_i) (< base_i base_j))
                (< base_j (len p)))
              (== (idx p base_i) (idx p base_j))))))
      (block
        (ghost-let removed int (idx p n))
        (if
          (exists ((hit int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 hit) (< hit n))
              (== (idx p hit) removed)))
          (block
            (obtain ((found int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 found) (< found n))
                (== (idx p found) removed)))
            (assert
              (exists ((found_i int) (found_j int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 found_i) (< found_i found_j))
                    (< found_j (len p)))
                  (== (idx p found_i) (idx p found_j))))))
          (block
            (ghost-let reduced (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (map_index)
                  (bf_skip_value (idx p map_index) removed))))
            (assert (== (len reduced) n))
            (forall ((range_index int))
              (call bf_skip_range
                (if
                  (and
                    (<= 0 range_index)
                    (< range_index (len p)))
                  (idx p range_index)
                  0)
                removed
                n))
            (assert
              (forall ((bounded_index int))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (<= 0 bounded_index)
                    (< bounded_index (len reduced)))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 (idx reduced bounded_index))
                    (< (idx reduced bounded_index) (- n 1))))))
            (call bf_path_repetition reduced (- n 1))
            (obtain ((left int) (right int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 left) (< left right))
                  (< right (len reduced)))
                (== (idx reduced left) (idx reduced right))))
            (assert (!= (idx p left) removed))
            (assert (!= (idx p right) removed))
            (call bf_skip_injective
              (idx p left)
              (idx p right)
              removed
              n)
            (assert
              (exists ((lifted_i int) (lifted_j int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 lifted_i) (< lifted_i lifted_j))
                    (< lifted_j (len p)))
                  (== (idx p lifted_i) (idx p lifted_j)))))))))))

(lemma bf_path_prefix

(lemma bf_append_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path g p)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (has_edge g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))

      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))

    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (obtain ((q int))
      (and
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 q)
            (< q (len (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))
        (and
          (==
            (get
              (idx
                (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
                q)
              0)
            v)
          (==
            (get
              (idx
                (idx g (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
                q)
              1)
            w))))
    (call bf_edge_weight_at
      wg
      g
      (idx p (- (len p) 1))
      q)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int)) (call bf_append_path_at g p v i))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert
      (==
        (get_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))
          v)
        w))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))

    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call bf_fixed_path
            wg g start old next steps v p)))
      (case (some fixed_value)
        (block
          (obtain ((witness_path (seq int)))
            (and
              (bf_path_to
                g start v witness_path (+ steps 1))
              (==
                (path_weight g witness_path)
                fixed_value)))
          (forall ((p2 (seq int)))
            (call bf_fixed_path
              wg g start old next steps v p2))
          (assert
            (exists ((p3 (seq int)))
              (and
                (and
                  (is_path g p3)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p3 0) start)
                    (==
                      (idx p3 (- (len p3) 1))
                      v)))
                (==
                  (path_weight g p3)
                  fixed_value))))
          (assert
            (forall ((p4 (seq int)))
              (=>
                (and
                  (is_path g p4)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p4 0) start)
                    (==
                      (idx p4 (- (len p4) 1))
                      v)))
                (>=
                  (path_weight g p4)
                  fixed_value)))))))))

(lemma bf_fixed_result
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq (option int)))
    (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (>= steps 0)
    (bf_round_ok g start old steps)
    (bf_round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== next old))
  (ensures
    (and
      (== (len next) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx next v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (is_path g p)
                    (and
                      (== (idx p 0) start)
                      (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false)))
            (case (some d)
              (is_shortest_dist g start v d)))))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call bf_fixed_vertex wg g start old next steps v))))

(lemma bf_path_vertex_range
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (and (<= 0 (- k 1)) (< (- k 1) (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k) w))
        (obtain ((q int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
                (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 q)
                (< q (len (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))))))
            (and
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))
                    q)
                  0)
                (idx p k))
              (==
                (get
                  (idx
                    (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))
                    q)
                  1)
                w))))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (len g))))))))

(lemma bf_skip_range
  (params (x int) (removed int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 removed) (< removed n))
    (!= x removed))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (bf_skip_value x removed))
      (< (bf_skip_value x removed) (- n 1))))
  (body
    (if (< x removed) (block) (block))))

(lemma bf_skip_injective
  (params (x int) (y int) (removed int) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 1)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))
    (and (<= 0 removed) (< removed n))
    (!= x removed)
    (!= y removed)
    (== (bf_skip_value x removed) (bf_skip_value y removed)))
  (ensures (== x y))
  (body
    (if (< x removed)
      (if (< y removed) (block) (block))
      (if (< y removed) (block) (block)))))

(lemma bf_path_repetition
  (params
    (p (seq int))
    (n int))
  (requires
    (>= n 1)
    (== (len p) (+ n 1))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
        (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) n)))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p 0) 0))
        (assert (== (idx p 1) 0))
        (assert
          (exists ((base_i int) (base_j int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 base_i) (< base_i base_j))
                (< base_j (len p)))
              (== (idx p base_i) (idx p base_j))))))
      (block
        (ghost-let removed int (idx p n))
        (if
          (exists ((hit int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 hit) (< hit n))
              (== (idx p hit) removed)))
          (block
            (obtain ((found int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 found) (< found n))
                (== (idx p found) removed)))
            (assert
              (exists ((found_i int) (found_j int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 found_i) (< found_i found_j))
                    (< found_j (len p)))
                  (== (idx p found_i) (idx p found_j))))))
          (block
            (ghost-let reduced (seq int)
              (seq-build n
                (fn (map_index)
                  (bf_skip_value (idx p map_index) removed))))
            (assert (== (len reduced) n))
            (forall ((range_index int))
              (call bf_skip_range
                (if
                  (and
                    (<= 0 range_index)
                    (< range_index (len p)))
                  (idx p range_index)
                  0)
                removed
                n))
            (assert
              (forall ((bounded_index int))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (<= 0 bounded_index)
                    (< bounded_index (len reduced)))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 (idx reduced bounded_index))
                    (< (idx reduced bounded_index) (- n 1))))))
            (call bf_path_repetition reduced (- n 1))
            (obtain ((left int) (right int))
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 left) (< left right))
                  (< right (len reduced)))
                (== (idx reduced left) (idx reduced right))))
            (assert (!= (idx p left) removed))
            (assert (!= (idx p right) removed))
            (call bf_skip_injective
              (idx p left)
              (idx p right)
              removed
              n)
            (assert
              (exists ((lifted_i int) (lifted_j int))
                (and
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 lifted_i) (< lifted_i lifted_j))
                    (< lifted_j (len p)))
                  (== (idx p lifted_i) (idx p lifted_j)))))))))))

(lemma bf_take_path_at
  (params

  (body

(lemma bf_take_path
  (params

    (== (idx (take p k) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p k) (- k 1)) (idx p (- k 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p k)
    (call law_idx_take p k 0)
    (call law_idx_take p k (- k 1))

(lemma bf_drop_path_at
  (params

(lemma bf_drop_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires

      (idx (drop p k) (- (len (drop p k)) 1))

  (body
    (call law_len_drop p k)
    (call law_idx_drop p k 0)

      p
      k

(lemma bf_append_connected
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+
        (path_weight g p)
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (forall ((i int)) (call bf_append_path_at g p v i))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat
      p
      (seq-lit v)
      (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
    (assert
      (==
        (take
          (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        p))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+
          (path_weight g p)
          (get_edge_weight
            g
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            v))))))

(lemma bf_join_paths
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq int))
    (b (seq int)))
  (requires
    (is_path g a)
    (is_path g b)
    (== (idx a (- (len a) 1)) (idx b 0)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b))
    (==
      (idx (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b) 0)
      (idx a 0))
    (==
      (idx
        (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b)
        (- (len (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b)) 1))
      (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b))
      (+ (path_weight g a) (path_weight g b))))
  (decreases (len b))
  (body
    (if (== (len b) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (path_weight g b) 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b)
            a)))
      (block
        (ghost-let b_prefix (seq int)
          (take b (- (len b) 1)))
        (call bf_path_prefix g b)
        (call bf_join_paths g a b_prefix)
        (ghost-let joined_prefix (seq int)
          (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b_prefix))
        (assert
          (==
            (idx joined_prefix (- (len joined_prefix) 1))
            (idx b (- (len b) 2))))
        (call bf_append_connected
          g
          joined_prefix
          (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
        (assert
          (==
            (concat
              joined_prefix
              (seq-lit (idx b (- (len b) 1))))
            (concat (take a (- (len a) 1)) b)))
        (assert
          (==
            (get_edge_weight
              g
              (idx b (- (len b) 2))
              (idx b (- (len b) 1)))
            (-
              (path_weight g b)
              (path_weight g b_prefix))))))))

(lemma bf_path_weight_split
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g p)
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p (+ k 1)))
        (path_weight g (drop p k)))))
  (body
    (call bf_take_path g p (+ k 1))
    (call bf_drop_path g p k)
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (take p (+ k 1)) k)
        (idx (drop p k) 0)))
    (call bf_join_paths
      g
      (take p (+ k 1))
      (drop p k))
    (assert
      (==
        (concat
          (take (take p (+ k 1)) k)
          (drop p k))
        p))))

(lemma bf_remove_repeat
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
      (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((cycle (seq int)) (shorter (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g cycle)
          (and
            (> (len cycle) 1)
            (==
              (idx cycle 0)
              (idx cycle (- (len cycle) 1)))))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g shorter)
            (and
              (== (idx shorter 0) (idx p 0))
              (==
                (idx shorter (- (len shorter) 1))
                (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
          (and
            (< (len shorter) (len p))
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight g shorter)
                (path_weight g cycle))))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let prefix (seq int) (take p (+ i 1)))
    (ghost-let through_cycle (seq int) (take p (+ j 1)))
    (ghost-let cycle_part (seq int) (drop through_cycle i))
    (ghost-let suffix (seq int) (drop p j))
    (ghost-let shorter_part (seq int)
      (concat (take prefix (- (len prefix) 1)) suffix))
    (call bf_take_path g p (+ i 1))
    (call bf_take_path g p (+ j 1))
    (call bf_drop_path g through_cycle i)
    (call bf_drop_path g p j)
    (assert
      (==
        (idx prefix (- (len prefix) 1))
        (idx suffix 0)))
    (call bf_join_paths g prefix suffix)
    (call bf_path_weight_split g p j)
    (call bf_path_weight_split g through_cycle i)
    (assert
      (==
        (take through_cycle (+ i 1))
        prefix))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx cycle_part 0)
        (idx p i)))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx cycle_part (- (len cycle_part) 1))
        (idx p j)))
    (assert (> (len cycle_part) 1))
    (assert (< (len shorter_part) (len p)))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g shorter_part)
          (path_weight g cycle_part))))
    (assert
      (exists ((cycle_result (seq int)) (shorter_result (seq int)))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g cycle_result)
            (and
              (> (len cycle_result) 1)
              (==
                (idx cycle_result 0)
                (idx cycle_result (- (len cycle_result) 1)))))
          (and
            (and
              (is_path g shorter_result)
              (and
                (== (idx shorter_result 0) (idx p 0))
                (==
                  (idx shorter_result (- (len shorter_result) 1))
                  (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
            (and
              (< (len shorter_result) (len p))
              (==
                (path_weight g p)
                (+
                  (path_weight g shorter_result)
                  (path_weight g cycle_result))))))))))

(lemma bf_long_improvement_cycle
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq (option int)))
    (n int)
    (v int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (bf_round_ok g start old (- n 1))
    (bf_path_to g start v p n)
    (== (len p) (+ n 1))
    (match (idx old v)
      (case (none) true)
      (case (some old_dist)
        (< (path_weight g p) old_dist))))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (forall ((k int))
      (call bf_path_vertex_range wg g p k))
    (call bf_path_repetition p n)
    (obtain ((i int) (j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i j))
          (< j (len p)))
        (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
    (call bf_remove_repeat g p i j)
    (obtain ((cycle (seq int)) (shorter (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g cycle)
          (and
            (> (len cycle) 1)
            (==
              (idx cycle 0)
              (idx cycle (- (len cycle) 1)))))
        (and
          (and
            (is_path g shorter)
            (and
              (== (idx shorter 0) start)
              (==
                (idx shorter (- (len shorter) 1))
                v)))
          (and
            (< (len shorter) (len p))
            (==
              (path_weight g p)
              (+
                (path_weight g shorter)
                (path_weight g cycle)))))))
    (if (< (path_weight g cycle) 0)
      (block
        (assert (has_negative_cycle g)))
      (block
        (assert (<= (len shorter) n))
        (assert
          (bf_path_to
            g start v shorter (- n 1)))
        (match (idx old v)
          (case (none) (assert false))
          (case (some old_value)
            (block
              (assert
                (>=
                  (path_weight g shorter)
                  old_value))
              (assert
                (<=
                  (path_weight g p)
                  (path_weight g shorter)))
              (assert false))))))))

(lemma bf_changed_vertex_cycle
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq (option int)))
    (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_round_ok g start old steps)
    (bf_round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (!= (idx next v) (idx old v)))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (match (idx next v)
      (case (none)
        (match (idx old v)
          (case (none) (assert false))
          (case (some old_value)
            (block
              (obtain ((old_path (seq int)))
                (and
                  (bf_path_to
                    g start v old_path steps)
                  (==
                    (path_weight g old_path)
                    old_value)))
              (assert
                (bf_path_to
                  g start v old_path (+ steps 1)))
              (assert false)))))
      (case (some next_value)
        (block
          (obtain ((next_path (seq int)))
            (and
              (bf_path_to
                g start v next_path (+ steps 1))
              (==
                (path_weight g next_path)
                next_value)))
          (match (idx old v)
            (case (none) (block))
            (case (some old_value2)
              (block
                (obtain ((previous_path (seq int)))
                  (and
                    (bf_path_to
                      g start v previous_path steps)
                    (==
                      (path_weight g previous_path)
                      old_value2)))
                (assert
                  (bf_path_to
                    g start v previous_path (+ steps 1)))
                (assert (<= next_value old_value2))
                (assert (!= next_value old_value2))
                (assert (< next_value old_value2)))))
          (assert
            (match (idx old v)
              (case (none) true)
              (case (some old_value3)
                (< next_value old_value3))))
          (assert (> (len next_path) (+ steps 1)))
          (assert (== (len next_path) (+ steps 2)))
          (call bf_long_improvement_cycle
            wg
            g
            start
            old
            (len g)
            v
            next_path))))))

(lemma bf_changed_after_order
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (old (seq (option int)))
    (next (seq (option int)))
    (steps int))
  (requires
    (== g (view wg))
    (well_formed wg)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (bf_round_ok g start old steps)
    (bf_round_ok g start next (+ steps 1))
    (== (+ steps 1) (len g))
    (!= next old))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (!= (idx next v) (idx old v))))
    (call bf_changed_vertex_cycle
      wg g start old next steps v)))

(def bellman_ford
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut distances (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n
        (fn (initial_index)
          (if (== initial_index start) (some 0) (none)))))
    (call bf_round_initial (view graph) start distances)
    (let-mut pass i64 0)
    (while true
      (invariant (and (<= 0 pass) (< pass n)))
      (invariant (== (len distances) n))
      (invariant (bf_round_ok (view graph) start distances pass))
      (invariant (bf_round_bound distances pass))
      (decreases (- n pass))
      (ghost-let old (seq (option int)) distances)
      (let-mut next (vec (option i64))
        (seq-build n
          (fn (copy_index) (idx distances copy_index))))
      (let-mut changed bool false)
      (call bf_relax_initial (view graph) old next)
      (let-mut source_index i64 0)
      (while (< source_index n)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 source_index) (<= source_index n)))
        (invariant (== (len next) n))
        (invariant
          (bf_relax_partial
            (view graph)
            old
            next
            source_index
            0))
        (invariant (== changed (!= next old)))
        (decreases (- n source_index))
        (let degree i64
          (len (idx (field graph adj) source_index)))
        (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
        (while (< edge_index degree)
          (invariant
            (and (<= 0 edge_index) (<= edge_index degree)))
          (invariant (== (len next) n))
          (invariant
            (bf_relax_partial
              (view graph)
              old
              next
              source_index

(ghost-fn updw ((s0 (seq (seq int))) (s1 (seq (seq int))) (v int) (x (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x)
                  (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len s0))) (!= y v)) (== (idx s1 y) (idx s0 y))))))))
(ghost-fn upd_flag ((s0 (seq bool)) (s1 (seq bool)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (idx s1 v)
                  (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len s0))) (!= y v)) (== (idx s1 y) (idx s0 y))))))))
(ghost-fn res_rel ((d (seq int)) (res (seq (option int)))) bool
  (body (and (== (len res) (len d))
             (forall ((x int))
               (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d)))
                   (if (>= (idx d x) 0)
                       (and (is some (idx res x)) (== (field (idx res x) value) (idx d x)))
                       (is none (idx res x))))))))
(ghost-fn open_count ((s (seq bool)) (m int)) int

  (decreases m)
  (body (if (== m 0) 0 (+ (open_count s (- m 1)) (if (idx s (- m 1)) 0 1)))))

  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len s))))

(lemma count_settle (params (s0 (seq bool)) (s (seq bool)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (upd_flag s0 s u) (not (idx s0 u)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len s0))))

(lemma extend_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (i int))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i) (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) i) (idx p i)))
    (if (< i (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (connected g (idx p i) (idx p (+ i 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)) (idx p (+ i 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== i (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx (seq-lit v) 0) v))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ i 1)) v))))))
(lemma path_extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures
    (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1))
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) v)
    (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (forall ((i int)) (call extend_link g p v i))
    (assert (is_path g q))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (== (idx q (len p)) v))
    (assert (== (take q (- (len q) 1)) p))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q)
                (+ (path_weight g (take q (- (len q) 1)))
                   (get_edge_weight g (idx q (- (len q) 2)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))))))
(lemma weight_prefix (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (< 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1)))
               (+ (path_weight g (take p m)) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq int) (take p (+ m 1)))
    (assert (== (len t) (+ m 1)))
    (call law_take_take p (+ m 1) m)
    (assert (== (take t (- (len t) 1)) (take p m)))
    (assert (== (idx t (- (len t) 2)) (idx p (- m 1))))
    (assert (== (idx t (- (len t) 1)) (idx p m)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g t)
                (+ (path_weight g (take t (- (len t) 1)))
                   (get_edge_weight g (idx t (- (len t) 2)) (idx t (- (len t) 1))))))))

(lemma closed_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (d (seq int)) (s (seq bool)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (targets_distinct g) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len s) (len g))
            (no_frontier d s) (closed g d s)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len d))) (>= (idx d a) 0) (connected g a b))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len d)))
           (>= (idx d b) 0)
           (<= (idx d b) (+ (idx d a) (get_edge_weight g a b))))
  (body
    (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g a b w))
    (obtain ((e int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g a)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) e) 1) w))))
    (call edge_weight_at g a e)
    (assert (idx s a))
    (assert (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len d))))
    (assert (>= (idx d b) 0))
    (assert (<= (idx d b) (+ (idx d a) w)))))
(lemma reach (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq int)) (s (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires
    (targets_ok g) (targets_distinct g) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len s) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len d))) (== (idx d start) 0)
    (no_frontier d s) (closed g d s)
    (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p m)) (< (idx p m) (len d)))
    (>= (idx d (idx p m)) 0)
    (<= (idx d (idx p m)) (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1)))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call reach g start d s p (- m 1))
        (assert (== (take p (+ (- m 1) 1)) (take p m)))
        (assert (<= (idx d (idx p (- m 1))) (path_weight g (take p m))))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call closed_step g d s (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))
        (call weight_prefix g p m))
      (block
        (assert (== m 0))
        (assert (== (idx p m) start))
        (assert (== (len (take p (+ m 1))) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))) 0))))))
(lemma lower_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq int)) (s (seq bool)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (targets_ok g) (targets_distinct g) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len s) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len d))) (== (idx d start) 0)
    (no_frontier d s) (closed g d s)
    (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len d)))
    (>= (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) 0)
    (<= (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (call reach g start d s p (- (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (take p (+ (- (len p) 1) 1)) p))))
(lemma finish_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq int)) (s (seq bool))
                          (wit (seq (seq int))) (res (seq (option int))) (v int))
  (requires
    (targets_ok g) (targets_distinct g) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len s) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len d))) (== (idx d start) 0)
    (no_frontier d s) (closed g d s) (witnesses g start d wit) (res_rel d res)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx res v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
      (case (some c) (is_shortest_dist g start v c))))
  (body
    (forall ((q (seq int))) (call lower_bound g start d s q))
    (if (>= (idx d v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (is_path g (idx wit v)))
        (assert (== (idx (idx wit v) 0) start))
        (assert (== (idx (idx wit v) (- (len (idx wit v)) 1)) v))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (idx wit v)) (idx d v)))
        (assert (is_shortest_dist g start v (idx d v)))
        (assert (is some (idx res v)))
        (assert (== (field (idx res v) value) (idx d v))))
      (block
        (assert (is none (idx res v)))))))

                      (wit (seq (seq int))) (res (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (targets_ok g) (targets_distinct g) (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len s) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len d))) (== (idx d start) 0)
    (no_frontier d s) (closed g d s) (witnesses g start d wit) (res_rel d res))
  (ensures
    (== (len res) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx res v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and (is_path g p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
            (case (some c) (is_shortest_dist g start v c))))))
  (body
    (forall ((y int)) (call finish_one g start d s wit res y))))

(spec select_min
  (params (d (ref (slice i64))) (s (ref (slice bool))))
  (returns (b i64))
  (requires (== (len s) (len d)))
  (ensures
    (and (<= -1 b) (< b (len d)))
    (=> (< b 0) (no_frontier d s))
    (=> (>= b 0) (and (not (idx s b)) (>= (idx d b) 0)))
    (=> (>= b 0) (floored d s (idx d b))))
  (effects))
(def select_min
  (body
    (let-mut best i64 -1)
    (let-mut c i64 0)
    (while (< c (len d))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 c) (<= c (len d))))
      (invariant (and (<= -1 best) (< best c)))
      (invariant (=> (>= best 0) (and (not (idx s best)) (>= (idx d best) 0))))
      (invariant (scan_ok d s c best))
      (decreases (- (len d) c))
      (if (and (not (idx s c)) (>= (idx d c) 0))
        (if (or (< best 0) (< (idx d c) (idx d best)))
          (set best c)
          (block))
        (block))
      (set c (+ c 1)))
    (return best)))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call view_facts graph)
    (assert (== g (field graph adj)))
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (assert (== (size graph) n))
    (assert (<= n 100000))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j1) -1)))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut settled (vec bool) (seq-build n (fn (j2) false)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int)) (seq-build n (fn (j3) (seq-lit start))))
    (ghost-let-mut last_d int 0)
    (let-mut k i64 0)
    (let-mut running bool true)
    (call count_init settled n)
    (call count_bounds settled n)
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (while running
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len settled) n))
      (invariant (== (len wit) n))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
      (invariant (>= (open_count settled n) 0))
      (invariant (== (+ k (open_count settled n)) n))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
      (invariant (upper dist (* k 100000)))
      (invariant (settled_known dist settled))
      (invariant (capped dist settled last_d))
      (invariant (floored dist settled last_d))
      (invariant (closed g dist settled))
      (invariant (witnesses g start dist wit))
      (invariant (=> (not running) (no_frontier dist settled)))
      (decreases (+ (open_count settled n) (if running 1 0)))
      (let ((u i64)) (call select_min (borrow dist) (borrow settled)))
      (if (< u 0)
        (set running false)
        (block
          (let du i64 (idx dist u))
          (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
          (assert (== deg (len (idx g u))))
          (assert (not (idx settled u)))
          (assert (>= du 0))
          (assert (<= last_d du))
          (assert (<= du (* k 100000)))
          (assert (<= du 10000000000))
          (call capped_widen dist settled last_d du)
          (assert (floored dist settled du))
          (let-mut i i64 0)
          (while (< i deg)
            (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
            (invariant (== (len dist) n))
            (invariant (== (len settled) n))
            (invariant (== (len wit) n))
            (invariant (and (<= 0 du) (<= du 10000000000)))
            (invariant (<= du (* k 100000)))
            (invariant (not (idx settled u)))
            (invariant (== (idx dist u) du))
            (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
            (invariant (upper dist (+ (* k 100000) 100000)))
            (invariant (settled_known dist settled))
            (invariant (capped dist settled du))
            (invariant (floored dist settled du))
            (invariant (closed g dist settled))
            (invariant (partial g dist u i du))
            (invariant (witnesses g start dist wit))
            (decreases (- deg i))
            (call edge_facts g u i)
            (let v i64 (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
            (let w i64 (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1))
            (assert (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
            (assert (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
            (assert (connected g u v))
            (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
            (let nd i64 (+ du w))
            (let dv i64 (idx dist v))
            (if (or (< dv 0) (< nd dv))
              (block
                (assert (!= v u))
                (assert (!= v start))
                (assert (not (idx settled v)))
                (ghost-let d0 (seq int) dist)
                (ghost-let w0 (seq (seq int)) wit)
                (ghost-set wit (seq-build n (fn (j5) (if (== j5 v) (concat (idx wit u) (seq-lit v)) (idx wit j5)))))
                (set-idx dist v nd)

              (forall ((v int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))) (not (idx done v)))
                    (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist v))))))))

(ghost-fn good_done
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((v int) (p (seq int)))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))) (idx done v))
                    (path_to g start v p))
          (match (idx dist v)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some d) (>= (path_weight g p) d)))))))

(ghost-fn relaxed_done
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (=> (and (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
                              (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))))
                         (idx done u))
                    (has_edge g u v w))
          (match (idx dist u)
            (case (none) true)
            (case (some du)
              (match (idx dist v)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some dv) (<= dv (+ du w))))))))))

(ghost-fn distance_witnesses
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
          (match (idx dist v)
            (case (none) true)
            (case (some d)
              (and (and (is_path g (idx wit v))
                        (== (idx (idx wit v) 0) start))
                   (and (== (idx (idx wit v) (- (len (idx wit v)) 1)) v)
                        (== (path_weight g (idx wit v)) d)))))))))

(ghost-fn finite_bound ((dist (seq (option int))) (b int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
          (match (idx dist v)
            (case (none) true)
            (case (some d) (and (<= 0 d) (<= d b))))))))

(ghost-fn active_partition
  ((done (seq bool)) (todo (seq int)) (rem int) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (and (== (len done) n) (== (len todo) n))
           (and (<= 0 rem) (<= rem n)))
      (and
        (forall ((q int))
          (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q rem))
              (and (and (<= 0 (idx todo q)) (< (idx todo q) n))
                   (not (idx done (idx todo q))))))
        (and
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
                (== (not (idx done v))
                    (exists ((q int))
                      (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q rem)) (== (idx todo q) v))))))
          (forall ((q int) (r int))
            (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q rem))
                              (and (<= 0 r) (< r rem)))
                         (== (idx todo q) (idx todo r)))
                (== q r))))))))

(ghost-fn scan_min
  ((dist (seq (option int))) (todo (seq int))
   (best int) (upto int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (<= 0 best) (< best upto))
         (forall ((q int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q upto))
               (opt_leq_g (idx dist (idx todo best))
                          (idx dist (idx todo q))))))))

(ghost-fn chosen_claim
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq (option int))) (u int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (=> (path_to g start u p)
          (match (idx dist u)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some d) (>= (path_weight g p) d)))))))

(ghost-fn partial_relaxed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (dist (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (upto int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i upto))
          (match (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some dv)
              (<= dv (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn opt_changed
  ((before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
   (at int) (value int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) (some value))
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn bool_marked
  ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (idx after at)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn path_changed
  ((before (seq (seq int))) (after (seq (seq int)))
   (at int) (value (seq int))) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) value)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn int_changed
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int) (value int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) value)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn seed_dist ((dist (seq (option int))) (n int) (start int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len dist) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
               (== (idx dist v) (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))))

(ghost-fn seed_done ((done (seq bool)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len done) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (not (idx done v)))))))

(ghost-fn seed_todo ((todo (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len todo) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (== (idx todo v) v))))))

(ghost-fn seed_wit ((wit (seq (seq int))) (n int) (start int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len wit) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
               (== (idx wit v) (seq-lit start)))))))

(spec option_leq
  (params (a (option i64)) (b (option i64)))
  (returns (r bool))
  (ensures (== r (opt_leq_g a b)))
  (effects))
(def option_leq
  (body
    (match a
      (case (none) (return (is none b)))
      (case (some ax)
        (match b
          (case (none) (return true))
          (case (some by) (return (<= ax by))))))))

(lemma wf_row
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int))
  (requires (well_formed wg)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg))))
  (ensures (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))
  (body))

(lemma find_weight
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (w int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires
    (row_unique row)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (<= i k)) (< k (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row k) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row k) 1) w))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (< i k)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call find_weight row v w (+ i 1) k)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))))

(lemma canonical_weight
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (well_formed wg) (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and
        (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
             (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 0) v)
             (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 1) w))))
    (call wf_row wg u)
    (call find_weight (idx (view wg) u) v w 0 k)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma prefix_path
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
           (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight g p)
          (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
             (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                                (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma extend_path
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (p (seq int)) (start int)
          (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (path_to (view wg) start u p)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (path_to (view wg) start v (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call canonical_weight wg u v w)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))))

(lemma selected_path_lower
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (u int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (min_unfinished dist done u)
    (path_to (view wg) start (idx p (- (len p) 1)) p)
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist u)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start))
        (assert
          (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist start)))
        (assert
          (match (idx dist u)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some bd) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) bd)))))
      (block
        (call prefix_path (view wg) p)
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let prev int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let lastv int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((edgew int)) (has_edge (view wg) prev lastv edgew))
        (call canonical_weight wg prev lastv edgew)
        (assert (>= edgew 0))
        (if (idx done prev)
          (block
            (assert
              (match (idx dist prev)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some pd)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) q) pd))))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist lastv)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ld)
                  (match (idx dist prev)
                    (case (none) false)
                    (case (some pd2) (<= ld (+ pd2 edgew)))))))
            (assert (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist lastv)))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud)))))
          (block
            (call selected_path_lower wg start dist done u q)
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud2)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud2)))))))))

(lemma establish_chosen
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (min_unfinished dist done u))
  (ensures (chosen_claim (view wg) start dist u))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower wg start dist done u p))))

(lemma mark_good
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (good_done g start dist done0)
    (chosen_claim g start dist u)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u)))
  (ensures (good_done g start dist done1))
  (body))

(lemma scan_choose
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (todo (seq int))
    (best int) (q int))
  (requires
    (scan_min dist todo best q)
    (opt_leq_g (idx dist (idx todo q))
               (idx dist (idx todo best))))
  (ensures (scan_min dist todo q (+ q 1)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_keep
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (todo (seq int))
    (best int) (q int))
  (requires
    (scan_min dist todo best q)
    (not (opt_leq_g (idx dist (idx todo q))
                    (idx dist (idx todo best)))))
  (ensures (scan_min dist todo best (+ q 1)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_finished
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (todo (seq int)) (rem int) (best int) (n int))
  (requires
    (active_partition done todo rem n)
    (> rem 0)
    (== (len dist) n)
    (scan_min dist todo best rem))
  (ensures (min_unfinished dist done (idx todo best)))
  (body))

(lemma initial_state
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (todo (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires
    (== n (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))
    (seed_dist dist n start)
    (seed_done done n)
    (seed_todo todo n)
    (seed_wit wit n start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (finite_bound dist 0)
    (active_partition done todo n n))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_good_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (good_done g start dist0 done)
    (not (idx done v))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (good_done g start dist1 done))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_relaxed_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (relaxed_done g dist0 done)
    (not (idx done v))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x)
    (match (idx dist0 v)
      (case (none) true)
      (case (some old) (<= x old))))
  (ensures (relaxed_done g dist1 done))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_bound_update
  (params
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (v int) (x int) (oldb int) (newb int))
  (requires
    (finite_bound dist0 oldb)
    (<= oldb newb)
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x newb))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (finite_bound dist1 newb))
  (body))

(lemma widen_bound
  (params (dist (seq (option int))) (oldb int) (newb int))
  (requires (finite_bound dist oldb) (<= oldb newb))
  (ensures (finite_bound dist newb))
  (body))

(lemma update_witnesses
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (wit0 (seq (seq int))) (wit1 (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (v int) (du int) (w int) (x int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist0 wit0)
    (== (idx dist0 u) (some du))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (== x (+ du w))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x)
    (path_changed wit0 wit1 v (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist1 wit1))
  (body
    (call extend_path wg (idx wit0 u) start u v w)))

(lemma done_edge_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (du int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (chosen_claim (view wg) start dist u)
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (== (idx dist u) (some du))
    (idx done v)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some dv) (<= dv (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (call extend_path wg (idx wit u) start u v w)
    (assert
      (match (idx dist v)
        (case (none) false)
        (case (some dv2) (<= dv2 (+ du w)))))))

(lemma partial_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (i int))
  (requires
    (partial_relaxed g dist u du i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (match (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some dv)
        (<= dv (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed g dist u du (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma partial_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (partial_relaxed g dist0 u du i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== x (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed g dist1 u du (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma finish_relaxed
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done0)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u))
    (== (idx dist u) (some du))
    (partial_relaxed (view wg) dist u du (len (idx (view wg) u))))
  (ensures (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done1))
  (body
    (forall ((v int) (w int))
      (assert
        (=> (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
            (match (idx dist v)
              (case (none) false)
              (case (some dv) (<= dv (+ du w)))))))))

(lemma finish_none_relaxed
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (relaxed_done g dist done0)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u))
    (is none (idx dist u)))
  (ensures (relaxed_done g dist done1))
  (body))

(lemma remove_active
  (params
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool))
    (todo0 (seq int)) (todo1 (seq int))
    (rem int) (best int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires
    (active_partition done0 todo0 rem n)
    (> rem 0)
    (and (<= 0 best) (< best rem))
    (== u (idx todo0 best))
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (int_changed todo0 todo1 best (idx todo0 (- rem 1))))
  (ensures (active_partition done1 todo1 (- rem 1) n))
  (body))

(lemma all_finished
  (params (done (seq bool)) (todo (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (active_partition done todo 0 n))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (idx done v))))
  (body))

(lemma final_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))) (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
    (idx done v)
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                   (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))
  (body
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (assert
            (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                     (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                false))))
      (case (some fd)
        (block
          (assert
            (exists ((p (seq int)))
              (and
                (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                     (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                (== (path_weight (view wg) p) fd))))
          (assert
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                       (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) fd)))))))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
