                   (and (== (idx (idx wit v) (- (len (idx wit v)) 1)) v)
                        (== (path_weight g (idx wit v)) d)))))))))

(ghost-fn finite_bound ((dist (seq (option int))) (b int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
          (match (idx dist v)
            (case (none) true)
            (case (some d) (and (<= 0 d) (<= d b))))))))

(ghost-fn active_partition
  ((done (seq bool)) (todo (seq int)) (rem int) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (and (== (len done) n) (== (len todo) n))
           (and (<= 0 rem) (<= rem n)))
      (and
        (forall ((q int))
          (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q rem))
              (and (and (<= 0 (idx todo q)) (< (idx todo q) n))
                   (not (idx done (idx todo q))))))
        (and
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
                (== (not (idx done v))
                    (exists ((q int))
                      (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q rem)) (== (idx todo q) v))))))
          (forall ((q int) (r int))
            (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q rem))
                              (and (<= 0 r) (< r rem)))
                         (== (idx todo q) (idx todo r)))
                (== q r))))))))

(ghost-fn scan_min
  ((dist (seq (option int))) (todo (seq int))
   (best int) (upto int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (<= 0 best) (< best upto))
         (forall ((q int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q upto))
               (opt_leq_g (idx dist (idx todo best))
                          (idx dist (idx todo q))))))))

(ghost-fn chosen_claim
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq (option int))) (u int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (=> (path_to g start u p)
          (match (idx dist u)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some d) (>= (path_weight g p) d)))))))

(ghost-fn partial_relaxed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (dist (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (upto int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i upto))
          (match (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some dv)
              (<= dv (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn opt_changed
  ((before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
   (at int) (value int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) (some value))
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn bool_marked
  ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (idx after at)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn path_changed
  ((before (seq (seq int))) (after (seq (seq int)))
   (at int) (value (seq int))) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) value)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn int_changed
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int) (value int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) value)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn seed_dist ((dist (seq (option int))) (n int) (start int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len dist) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
               (== (idx dist v) (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))))

(ghost-fn seed_done ((done (seq bool)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len done) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (not (idx done v)))))))

(ghost-fn seed_todo ((todo (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len todo) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (== (idx todo v) v))))))

(ghost-fn seed_wit ((wit (seq (seq int))) (n int) (start int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len wit) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
               (== (idx wit v) (seq-lit start)))))))

(spec option_leq
  (params (a (option i64)) (b (option i64)))
  (returns (r bool))
  (ensures (== r (opt_leq_g a b)))
  (effects))
(def option_leq
  (body
    (match a
      (case (none) (return (is none b)))
      (case (some ax)
        (match b
          (case (none) (return true))
          (case (some by) (return (<= ax by))))))))

(lemma wf_row
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int))
  (requires (well_formed wg)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg))))
  (ensures (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))
  (body))

(lemma find_weight
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (w int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires
    (row_unique row)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (<= i k)) (< k (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row k) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row k) 1) w))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (< i k)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call find_weight row v w (+ i 1) k)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))))

(lemma canonical_weight
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (well_formed wg) (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and
        (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
             (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 0) v)
             (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 1) w))))
    (call wf_row wg u)
    (call find_weight (idx (view wg) u) v w 0 k)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma prefix_path
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
           (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight g p)
          (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
             (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                                (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma extend_path
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (p (seq int)) (start int)
          (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (path_to (view wg) start u p)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (path_to (view wg) start v (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call canonical_weight wg u v w)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))))

(lemma selected_path_lower
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (u int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (min_unfinished dist done u)
    (path_to (view wg) start (idx p (- (len p) 1)) p)
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist u)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start))
        (assert
          (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist start)))
        (assert
          (match (idx dist u)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some bd) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) bd)))))
      (block
        (call prefix_path (view wg) p)
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let prev int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let lastv int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((edgew int)) (has_edge (view wg) prev lastv edgew))
        (call canonical_weight wg prev lastv edgew)
        (assert (>= edgew 0))
        (if (idx done prev)
          (block
            (assert
              (match (idx dist prev)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some pd)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) q) pd))))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist lastv)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ld)
                  (match (idx dist prev)
                    (case (none) false)
                    (case (some pd2) (<= ld (+ pd2 edgew)))))))
            (assert (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist lastv)))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud)))))
          (block
            (call selected_path_lower wg start dist done u q)
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud2)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud2))))))))))

(lemma establish_chosen
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (min_unfinished dist done u))
  (ensures (chosen_claim (view wg) start dist u))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower wg start dist done u p))))

(lemma mark_good
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (good_done g start dist done0)
    (chosen_claim g start dist u)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u)))
  (ensures (good_done g start dist done1))
  (body))

(lemma scan_choose
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (todo (seq int))
    (best int) (q int))
  (requires
    (scan_min dist todo best q)
    (opt_leq_g (idx dist (idx todo q))
               (idx dist (idx todo best))))
  (ensures (scan_min dist todo q (+ q 1)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_keep
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (todo (seq int))
    (best int) (q int))
  (requires
    (scan_min dist todo best q)
    (not (opt_leq_g (idx dist (idx todo q))
                    (idx dist (idx todo best)))))
  (ensures (scan_min dist todo best (+ q 1)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_finished
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (todo (seq int)) (rem int) (best int) (n int))
  (requires
    (active_partition done todo rem n)
    (> rem 0)
    (== (len dist) n)
    (scan_min dist todo best rem))
  (ensures (min_unfinished dist done (idx todo best)))
  (body))

(lemma initial_state
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (todo (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires
    (== n (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))
    (seed_dist dist n start)
    (seed_done done n)
    (seed_todo todo n)
    (seed_wit wit n start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (finite_bound dist 0)
    (active_partition done todo n n))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_good_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (good_done g start dist0 done)
    (not (idx done v))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (good_done g start dist1 done))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_relaxed_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (relaxed_done g dist0 done)
    (not (idx done v))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x)
    (match (idx dist0 v)
      (case (none) true)
      (case (some old) (<= x old))))
  (ensures (relaxed_done g dist1 done))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_bound_update
  (params
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (v int) (x int) (oldb int) (newb int))
  (requires
    (finite_bound dist0 oldb)
    (<= oldb newb)
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x newb))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (finite_bound dist1 newb))
  (body))

(lemma widen_bound
  (params (dist (seq (option int))) (oldb int) (newb int))
  (requires (finite_bound dist oldb) (<= oldb newb))
  (ensures (finite_bound dist newb))
  (body))

(lemma update_witnesses
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (wit0 (seq (seq int))) (wit1 (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (v int) (du int) (w int) (x int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist0 wit0)
    (== (idx dist0 u) (some du))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (== x (+ du w))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x)
    (path_changed wit0 wit1 v (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist1 wit1))
  (body
    (call extend_path wg (idx wit0 u) start u v w)))

(lemma done_edge_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (du int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (chosen_claim (view wg) start dist u)
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (== (idx dist u) (some du))
    (idx done v)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some dv) (<= dv (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (call extend_path wg (idx wit u) start u v w)
    (assert
      (match (idx dist v)
        (case (none) false)
        (case (some dv2) (<= dv2 (+ du w)))))))

(lemma partial_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (i int))
  (requires
    (partial_relaxed g dist u du i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (match (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some dv)
        (<= dv (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed g dist u du (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma partial_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (partial_relaxed g dist0 u du i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== x (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed g dist1 u du (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma finish_relaxed
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done0)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u))
    (== (idx dist u) (some du))
    (partial_relaxed (view wg) dist u du (len (idx (view wg) u))))
  (ensures (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done1))
  (body
    (forall ((v int) (w int))
      (assert
        (=> (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
            (match (idx dist v)
              (case (none) false)
              (case (some dv) (<= dv (+ du w)))))))))

(lemma finish_none_relaxed
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (relaxed_done g dist done0)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u))
    (is none (idx dist u)))
  (ensures (relaxed_done g dist done1))
  (body))

(lemma remove_active
  (params
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool))
    (todo0 (seq int)) (todo1 (seq int))
    (rem int) (best int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires
    (active_partition done0 todo0 rem n)
    (> rem 0)
    (and (<= 0 best) (< best rem))
    (== u (idx todo0 best))
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (int_changed todo0 todo1 best (idx todo0 (- rem 1))))
  (ensures (active_partition done1 todo1 (- rem 1) n))
  (body))

(lemma all_finished
  (params (done (seq bool)) (todo (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (active_partition done todo 0 n))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (idx done v))))
  (body))

(lemma final_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))) (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
    (idx done v)
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                   (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))
  (body
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (assert
            (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                     (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                false))))
      (case (some fd)
        (block
          (assert
            (exists ((p (seq int)))
              (and
                (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                     (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                (== (path_weight (view wg) p) fd))))
          (assert
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                       (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) fd)))))))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n (fn (di) (if (== di start) (some 0) (none)))))
    (let-mut done (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (dj) false)))
    (let-mut todo (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (dk) dk)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (dw) (seq-lit start))))
    (assert (seed_dist dist n start))
    (assert (seed_done done n))
    (assert (seed_todo todo n))
    (assert (seed_wit wit n start))
    (call initial_state graph start dist done todo wit n)
    (let-mut rem i64 n)
    (while (> rem 0)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 rem) (<= rem n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant (== (len todo) n))
      (invariant (== (len wit) n))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) (some 0)))
      (invariant (active_partition done todo rem n))
      (invariant (good_done (view graph) start dist done))
      (invariant (relaxed_done (view graph) dist done))
      (invariant (distance_witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
      (invariant (finite_bound dist (* (- n rem) 100000)))
      (decreases rem)
      (let-mut best i64 0)
      (let-mut scan i64 1)
      (assert (scan_min dist todo best scan))
      (while (< scan rem)
        (invariant (and (<= 1 scan) (<= scan rem)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 best) (< best scan)))
        (invariant (scan_min dist todo best scan))
        (decreases (- rem scan))
        (let candidate i64 (idx todo scan))
        (let incumbent i64 (idx todo best))
        (let candidate_value (option i64) (idx dist candidate))

           (and (<= 0 rem) (<= rem n)))
      (and
        (forall ((q int))
          (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q rem))
              (and (and (<= 0 (idx todo q)) (< (idx todo q) n))
                   (not (idx done (idx todo q))))))
        (and
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
                (== (not (idx done v))
                    (exists ((q int))
                      (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q rem)) (== (idx todo q) v))))))
          (forall ((q int) (r int))
            (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q rem))
                              (and (<= 0 r) (< r rem)))
                         (== (idx todo q) (idx todo r)))
                (== q r))))))))

(ghost-fn scan_min
  ((dist (seq (option int))) (todo (seq int))
   (best int) (upto int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (<= 0 best) (< best upto))
         (forall ((q int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q upto))
               (opt_leq_g (idx dist (idx todo best))
                          (idx dist (idx todo q))))))))

(ghost-fn chosen_claim
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
   (dist (seq (option int))) (u int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (=> (path_to g start u p)
          (match (idx dist u)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some d) (>= (path_weight g p) d)))))))

(ghost-fn partial_relaxed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (dist (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (upto int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i upto))
          (match (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some dv)
              (<= dv (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn opt_changed
  ((before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
   (at int) (value int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) (some value))
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn bool_marked
  ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (idx after at)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn path_changed
  ((before (seq (seq int))) (after (seq (seq int)))
   (at int) (value (seq int))) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) value)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn int_changed
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int) (value int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) value)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn seed_dist ((dist (seq (option int))) (n int) (start int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len dist) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
               (== (idx dist v) (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))))

(ghost-fn seed_done ((done (seq bool)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len done) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (not (idx done v)))))))

(ghost-fn seed_todo ((todo (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len todo) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (== (idx todo v) v))))))

(ghost-fn seed_wit ((wit (seq (seq int))) (n int) (start int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len wit) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
               (== (idx wit v) (seq-lit start)))))))

(spec option_leq
  (params (a (option i64)) (b (option i64)))
  (returns (r bool))
  (ensures (== r (opt_leq_g a b)))
  (effects))
(def option_leq
  (body
    (match a
      (case (none) (return (is none b)))
      (case (some ax)
        (match b
          (case (none) (return true))
          (case (some by) (return (<= ax by))))))))

(lemma wf_row
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int))
  (requires (well_formed wg)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg))))
  (ensures (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))
  (body))

(lemma find_weight
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (w int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires
    (row_unique row)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (<= i k)) (< k (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row k) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row k) 1) w))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (< i k)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call find_weight row v w (+ i 1) k)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))))

(lemma canonical_weight
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (well_formed wg) (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and
        (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
             (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 0) v)
             (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 1) w))))
    (call wf_row wg u)
    (call find_weight (idx (view wg) u) v w 0 k)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma prefix_path
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
           (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight g p)
          (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
             (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                                (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma extend_path
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (p (seq int)) (start int)
          (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (path_to (view wg) start u p)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (path_to (view wg) start v (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call canonical_weight wg u v w)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))))

(lemma selected_path_lower
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (u int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (min_unfinished dist done u)
    (path_to (view wg) start (idx p (- (len p) 1)) p)
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist u)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start))
        (assert
          (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist start)))
        (assert
          (match (idx dist u)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some bd) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) bd)))))
      (block
        (call prefix_path (view wg) p)
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let prev int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let lastv int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (obtain ((edgew int)) (has_edge (view wg) prev lastv edgew))
        (call canonical_weight wg prev lastv edgew)
        (assert (>= edgew 0))
        (if (idx done prev)
          (block
            (assert
              (match (idx dist prev)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some pd)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) q) pd))))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist lastv)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ld)
                  (match (idx dist prev)
                    (case (none) false)
                    (case (some pd2) (<= ld (+ pd2 edgew)))))))
            (assert (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist lastv)))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud)))))
          (block
            (call selected_path_lower wg start dist done u q)
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud2)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud2))))))))))

(lemma establish_chosen
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (min_unfinished dist done u))
  (ensures (chosen_claim (view wg) start dist u))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower wg start dist done u p))))

(lemma mark_good
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (good_done g start dist done0)
    (chosen_claim g start dist u)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u)))
  (ensures (good_done g start dist done1))
  (body))

(lemma scan_choose
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (todo (seq int))
    (best int) (q int))
  (requires
    (scan_min dist todo best q)
    (opt_leq_g (idx dist (idx todo q))
               (idx dist (idx todo best))))
  (ensures (scan_min dist todo q (+ q 1)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_keep
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (todo (seq int))
    (best int) (q int))
  (requires
    (scan_min dist todo best q)
    (not (opt_leq_g (idx dist (idx todo q))
                    (idx dist (idx todo best)))))
  (ensures (scan_min dist todo best (+ q 1)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_finished
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (todo (seq int)) (rem int) (best int) (n int))
  (requires
    (active_partition done todo rem n)
    (> rem 0)
    (== (len dist) n)
    (scan_min dist todo best rem))
  (ensures (min_unfinished dist done (idx todo best)))
  (body))

(lemma initial_state
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (todo (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires
    (== n (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))
    (seed_dist dist n start)
    (seed_done done n)
    (seed_todo todo n)
    (seed_wit wit n start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (finite_bound dist 0)
    (active_partition done todo n n))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_good_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (good_done g start dist0 done)
    (not (idx done v))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (good_done g start dist1 done))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_relaxed_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (relaxed_done g dist0 done)
    (not (idx done v))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x)
    (match (idx dist0 v)
      (case (none) true)
      (case (some old) (<= x old))))
  (ensures (relaxed_done g dist1 done))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_bound_update
  (params
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (v int) (x int) (oldb int) (newb int))
  (requires
    (finite_bound dist0 oldb)
    (<= oldb newb)
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x newb))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (finite_bound dist1 newb))
  (body))

(lemma widen_bound
  (params (dist (seq (option int))) (oldb int) (newb int))
  (requires (finite_bound dist oldb) (<= oldb newb))
  (ensures (finite_bound dist newb))
  (body))

(lemma update_witnesses
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (wit0 (seq (seq int))) (wit1 (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (v int) (du int) (w int) (x int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist0 wit0)
    (== (idx dist0 u) (some du))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (== x (+ du w))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x)
    (path_changed wit0 wit1 v (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist1 wit1))
  (body
    (call extend_path wg (idx wit0 u) start u v w)))

(lemma done_edge_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (du int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (chosen_claim (view wg) start dist u)
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (== (idx dist u) (some du))
    (idx done v)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some dv) (<= dv (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (call extend_path wg (idx wit u) start u v w)
    (assert
      (match (idx dist v)
        (case (none) false)
        (case (some dv2) (<= dv2 (+ du w)))))))

(lemma partial_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (i int))
  (requires
    (partial_relaxed g dist u du i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (match (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some dv)
        (<= dv (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed g dist u du (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma partial_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (partial_relaxed g dist0 u du i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== x (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed g dist1 u du (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma finish_relaxed
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done0)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u))
    (== (idx dist u) (some du))
    (partial_relaxed (view wg) dist u du (len (idx (view wg) u))))
  (ensures (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done1))
  (body
    (forall ((v int) (w int))
      (assert
        (=> (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
            (match (idx dist v)
              (case (none) false)
              (case (some dv) (<= dv (+ du w)))))))))

(lemma finish_none_relaxed
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (relaxed_done g dist done0)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u))
    (is none (idx dist u)))
  (ensures (relaxed_done g dist done1))
  (body))

(lemma remove_active
  (params
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool))
    (todo0 (seq int)) (todo1 (seq int))
    (rem int) (best int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires
    (active_partition done0 todo0 rem n)
    (> rem 0)
    (and (<= 0 best) (< best rem))
    (== u (idx todo0 best))
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (int_changed todo0 todo1 best (idx todo0 (- rem 1))))
  (ensures (active_partition done1 todo1 (- rem 1) n))
  (body))

(lemma all_finished
  (params (done (seq bool)) (todo (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (active_partition done todo 0 n))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (idx done v))))
  (body))

(lemma final_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))) (v int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
    (idx done v)
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                   (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))
  (body
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (assert
            (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                     (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                false))))
      (case (some fd)
        (block
          (assert
            (exists ((p (seq int)))
              (and
                (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                     (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                (== (path_weight (view wg) p) fd))))
          (assert
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                       (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) fd)))))))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n (fn (di) (if (== di start) (some 0) (none)))))
    (let-mut done (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (dj) false)))
    (let-mut todo (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (dk) dk)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (dw) (seq-lit start))))
    (assert (seed_dist dist n start))
    (assert (seed_done done n))
    (assert (seed_todo todo n))
    (assert (seed_wit wit n start))
    (call initial_state graph start dist done todo wit n)
    (let-mut rem i64 n)
    (while (> rem 0)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 rem) (<= rem n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant (== (len todo) n))
      (invariant (== (len wit) n))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) (some 0)))
      (invariant (active_partition done todo rem n))
      (invariant (good_done (view graph) start dist done))
      (invariant (relaxed_done (view graph) dist done))
      (invariant (distance_witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
      (invariant (finite_bound dist (* (- n rem) 100000)))
      (decreases rem)
      (let-mut best i64 0)
      (let-mut scan i64 1)
      (assert (scan_min dist todo best scan))
      (while (< scan rem)
        (invariant (and (<= 1 scan) (<= scan rem)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 best) (< best scan)))
        (invariant (scan_min dist todo best scan))
        (decreases (- rem scan))
        (let candidate i64 (idx todo scan))
        (let incumbent i64 (idx todo best))
        (let candidate_value (option i64) (idx dist candidate))
        (let incumbent_value (option i64) (idx dist incumbent))
        (let ((take_candidate bool))
          (call option_leq candidate_value incumbent_value))
        (if take_candidate
          (block
            (call scan_choose dist todo best scan)
            (set best scan))
          (call scan_keep dist todo best scan))
        (set scan (+ scan 1)))
      (call scan_finished dist done todo rem best n)
      (let u i64 (idx todo best))
      (call establish_chosen graph start dist done u)
      (ghost-let done_before (seq bool) done)
      (set-idx done u true)
      (assert (bool_marked done_before done u))
      (call mark_good (view graph) start dist done_before done u)
      (match (idx dist u)
        (case (none)

    (todo (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires

    (seed_dist dist n start)
    (seed_done done n)

    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)

    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (finite_bound dist 0)
    (active_partition done todo n n))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
            (and (and (<= 0 (idx todo q)) (< (idx todo q) n))
                 (not (idx done (idx todo q)))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (exists ((q int))
              (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
                   (== (idx todo q) v))))))

      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (== (not (idx done v))

        (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))

(lemma partial_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (i int))

    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
         (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len dist)))
    (match (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some dv)
        (<= dv (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed g dist u du (+ i 1)))
  (body))

  ((before (seq bool))
   (after (seq bool))
   (v int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len after) (len before))
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before))))
      (and
        (idx after v)
        (forall ((k int))
          (=> (and
                (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
                (!= k v))
              (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn let_pair
  ((edge (tuple int int))
   (dist (seq int))
   (done (seq bool))
   (u int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len done) (len dist))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
            (and
              (<= 0 (get edge 0))
              (< (get edge 0) (len dist))))
          (=> (not (idx done (get edge 0)))
              (and
                (>= (idx dist (get edge 0)) 0)
                (<= (idx dist (get edge 0))
                    (+ (idx dist u) (get edge 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn row_prefix_closed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (dist (seq int))
   (done (seq bool))
   (u int)
   (upto int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len dist) (len g))
        (and
          (== (len done) (len dist))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and
              (<= 0 upto)
              (<= upto (len (idx g u)))))))
      (and
        (forall ((a int) (v int) (w int))
          (=> (and
                (has_edge g a v w)
                (and
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len dist)))
                    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))))
                  (and
                    (and (idx done a) (!= a u))
                    (and
                      (>= (idx dist a) 0)
                      (not (idx done v))))))
              (and
                (>= (idx dist v) 0)
                (<= (idx dist v)
                    (+ (idx dist a) w)))))
        (forall ((i int))
          (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i upto))
              (let_pair
                (idx (idx g u) i)
                dist done u)))))))

(lemma row_unique
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures
    (unique_row (idx g u)))
  (body))

(lemma weight_from_hit
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int)))
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (unique_row row)
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i j))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row j) 1) w))
  (ensures
    (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- j i))
  (body
    (if
      (== i j)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call weight_from_hit row v w (+ i 1) j)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_lookup
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (call row_unique g u)
    (call weight_from_hit
      (idx g u) v w 0 i)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma path_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (>=
      (get_edge_weight g
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      0)
    (==
      (path_weight g p)
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (get_edge_weight g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (assert
      (connected g
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (obtain ((w int))
      (has_edge g
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1))
        w))
    (call edge_lookup g
      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
      (idx p (- (len p) 1))
      w)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
          (get_edge_weight g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma path_non_negative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p))
  (ensures
    (>= (path_weight g p) 0))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (< (len p) 2)
      (assert (>= (path_weight g p) 0))
      (block
        (call path_step g p)
        (call path_non_negative
          g (take p (- (len p) 1)))))))

(lemma singleton_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (v int))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (seq-lit v))
    (== (path_weight g (seq-lit v)) 0))
  (body))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (is_path g p)
    (has_edge g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert
      (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v))
    (call edge_lookup g
      (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma initial_facts
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len done) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (== (idx dist v)
              (if (== v start) 0 -1))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (== (idx done v) (== v start)))))
  (ensures
    (witnessed g start dist)
    (solved g start dist done)
    (dist_range dist 0)
    (== (occurrences done true) 1)
    (row_prefix_closed g dist done start 0))
  (body
    (call singleton_path g start)
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call path_non_negative g p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist g start start 0))
    (assert (witnessed g start dist))
    (assert (solved g start dist done))
    (assert (dist_range dist 0))
    (assert
      (row_prefix_closed g dist done start 0))))

(lemma relax_witnessed
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (witnessed g start before)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len before)))
    (>= (idx before u) 0)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (changed_at before after v
      (+ (idx before u) w)))
  (ensures
    (witnessed g start after))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx before u))))
    (call append_path g p v w)))

(lemma path_endpoint_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (valid_targets g)
    (is_path g p)
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p 0))
      (< (idx p 0) (len g))))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p i))
            (< (idx p i) (len g))))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (< (len p) 2)
      (block)
      (block
        (call path_endpoint_range
          g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (has_edge g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))
            w))))))

(lemma path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (valid_targets g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (idx done start)
    (solved g start dist done)
    (closed g dist done)
    (best_choice dist done u)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (<= (idx dist u) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (call path_endpoint_range g p)
    (if
      (< (len p) 2)
      (assert false)
      (block
        (call path_step g p)
        (ghost-let end int
          (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let prev int
          (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (if
          (idx done prev)
          (block
            (assert (>= (idx dist prev) 0))
            (assert
              (is_shortest_dist
                g start prev (idx dist prev)))
            (assert
              (<= (idx dist prev)
                  (path_weight g
                    (take p (- (len p) 1)))))
            (obtain ((w int))
              (has_edge g prev end w))
            (call edge_lookup g prev end w))
          (call path_lower_bound
            g start dist done u
            (take p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma chosen_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (valid_targets g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (idx done start)
    (witnessed g start dist)
    (solved g start dist done)
    (closed g dist done)
    (best_choice dist done u))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist g start u (idx dist u)))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call path_lower_bound
        g start dist done u p))
    (assert
      (is_shortest_dist
        g start u (idx dist u)))))

(lemma no_open_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (valid_targets g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (idx done start)
    (closed g dist done)
    (no_finite_open dist done)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures false)
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (call path_endpoint_range g p)
    (if
      (< (len p) 2)
      (assert false)
      (block
        (ghost-let end int
          (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let prev int
          (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (if
          (idx done prev)
          (block
            (obtain ((w int))
              (has_edge g prev end w))
            (assert (>= (idx dist end) 0))
            (assert false))
          (call no_open_path
            g start dist done
            (take p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma chosen_unreachable
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (valid_targets g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (idx done start)
    (closed g dist done)
    (no_finite_open dist done)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
    (not (idx done u)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (=> (and
            (is_path g p)
            (and
              (== (idx p 0) start)
              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
          false)))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call no_open_path
        g start dist done p))))

(lemma mark_solved
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (solved g start dist before)
    (marked_at before after u)
    (if
      (== (idx dist u) -1)
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (=> (and
              (is_path g p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
            false))
      (is_shortest_dist
        g start u (idx dist u))))
  (ensures
    (solved g start dist after))
  (body))

(lemma mark_closed_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int))
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (closed g dist before)
    (marked_at before after u)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures
    (row_prefix_closed g dist after u 0))
  (body))

(lemma mark_closed_unreachable
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int))
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (closed g dist before)
    (marked_at before after u)
    (== (idx dist u) -1))
  (ensures
    (closed g dist after))
  (body))

(lemma relax_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (row_prefix_closed g before done u i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (relaxed_at before after
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (let_pair
      (idx (idx g u) i)
      after done u))
  (ensures
    (row_prefix_closed
      g after done u (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma prefix_closed_done
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (valid_targets g)
    (row_prefix_closed
      g dist done u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures
    (closed g dist done))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (v int) (w int))
      (call edge_lookup g a v w))))

(lemma preserve_solved_dist
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (solved g start before done)
    (not (idx done v))
    (changed_at before after v (idx after v)))
  (ensures
    (solved g start after done))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_range
  (params
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (v int)
    (x int)
    (bound int))
  (requires
    (dist_range before bound)
    (changed_at before after v x)
    (and (>= x 0) (<= x bound)))
  (ensures
    (dist_range after bound))
  (body))

(lemma widen_range
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (small int)
    (large int))
  (requires
    (dist_range dist small)
    (<= small large))
  (ensures
    (dist_range dist large))
  (body))

(lemma count_mark
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (marked_at before after u)
    (not (idx before u)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (occurrences after true)
      (+ (occurrences before true) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma count_has_open
  (params
    (done (seq bool))
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (occurrences done true) count)
    (and (<= 0 count) (< count (len done))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
        (not (idx done v)))))
  (body))

(lemma count_all_done
  (params
    (done (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (==
      (occurrences done true)
      (len done)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
          (idx done v))))
  (body))

(lemma finished_result
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (res (seq (option int))))
  (requires
    (== (len done) (len dist))
    (== (len res) (len dist))
    (solved g start dist done)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
          (idx done v)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len res)))
          (==
            (idx res v)
            (if
              (== (idx dist v) -1)
              (none)
              (some (idx dist v)))))))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len res)))
          (match (idx res v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and
                      (is_path g p)
                      (and
                        (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some d)
              (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))))
  (body))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (unique_rows (view graph)))
    (assert (valid_targets (view graph)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (j)
          (if (== j start) 0 -1))))
    (let-mut done (vec bool)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (j2)
          (== j2 start))))
    (call initial_facts
      (view graph) start dist done)
    (call widen_range dist 0 100000)
    (let-mut first_i i64 0)
    (while
      (< first_i
        (len (idx (field graph adj) start)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 first_i)
          (<= first_i
            (len (idx (field graph adj) start)))))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant
        (witnessed (view graph) start dist))
      (invariant
        (solved (view graph) start dist done))
      (invariant (dist_range dist 100000))
      (invariant
        (row_prefix_closed
          (view graph) dist done start first_i))
      (decreases
        (- (len (idx (field graph adj) start))
           first_i))
      (let first_v i64
        (get
          (idx
            (idx (field graph adj) start)
            first_i)
          0))
      (let first_w i64
        (get
          (idx
            (idx (field graph adj) start)
            first_i)
          1))
      (assert
        (has_edge
          (view graph) start first_v first_w))
      (assert
        (and (>= first_w 0) (<= first_w 100000)))
      (ghost-let prefix_before (seq int) dist)
      (if
        (idx done first_v)
        (block)
        (block
          (ghost-let before (seq int) dist)
          (set-idx dist first_v first_w)
          (assert
            (changed_at
              before dist first_v first_w))
          (call relax_witnessed
            (view graph) start before dist
            start first_v first_w)
          (call preserve_solved_dist
            (view graph) start before dist
            done first_v)
          (call preserve_range
            before dist first_v first_w 100000)))
      (assert
        (relaxed_at
          prefix_before dist first_v))
      (assert
        (let_pair
          (idx
            (idx (view graph) start)
            first_i)
          dist done start))
      (call relax_prefix
        (view graph) prefix_before dist
        done start first_i)
      (set first_i (+ first_i 1)))
    (call prefix_closed_done
      (view graph) dist done start)
    (let-mut count i64 1)
    (while (< count n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 1 count) (<= count n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant (idx done start))
      (invariant
        (==
          (occurrences done true)
          count))
      (invariant
        (witnessed (view graph) start dist))
      (invariant
        (solved (view graph) start dist done))
      (invariant
        (closed (view graph) dist done))
      (invariant
        (dist_range dist (* count 100000)))
      (decreases (- n count))
      (call count_has_open done count)
      (let-mut scan i64 0)
      (let-mut pick i64 -1)
      (let-mut best i64 -1)
      (while (< scan n)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 scan) (<= scan n)))
        (invariant
          (or
            (== pick -1)
            (and
              (and (<= 0 pick) (< pick scan))
              (not (idx done pick)))))
        (invariant
          (=> (== pick -1)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k scan))
                    (idx done k)))))
        (invariant
          (or
            (== best -1)
            (and
              (and (<= 0 best) (< best scan))
              (and
                (not (idx done best))
                (>= (idx dist best) 0)))))
        (invariant
          (=> (!= best -1)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and
                      (and (<= 0 k) (< k scan))
                      (and
                        (not (idx done k))
                        (>= (idx dist k) 0)))
                    (<=
                      (idx dist best)
                      (idx dist k))))))
        (invariant
          (=> (== best -1)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and
                      (and (<= 0 k) (< k scan))
                      (not (idx done k)))
                    (== (idx dist k) -1)))))
        (decreases (- n scan))
        (if
          (not (idx done scan))
          (block
            (if
              (== pick -1)
              (set pick scan)
              (block))
            (if
              (>= (idx dist scan) 0)
