              (case (none) false)
              (case (some d) (>= (path_weight g p) d))))))))

(ghost-fn partial_relaxed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (dist (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (upto int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 upto) (<= upto (len (idx g u))))
        (forall ((i int))
          (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i upto))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                     (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len dist)))
                (match (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                  (case (none) false)
                  (case (some dv)
                    (<= dv (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))))))))

(ghost-fn opt_changed
  ((before (seq (option int))) (after (seq (option int)))
   (at int) (value int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) (some value))
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn bool_marked
  ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (idx after at)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn path_changed
  ((before (seq (seq int))) (after (seq (seq int)))
   (at int) (value (seq int))) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) value)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn int_changed
  ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int) (value int)) bool
  (body
    (and (and (== (len after) (len before))
              (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
         (and (== (idx after at) value)
              (forall ((k int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before))) (!= k at))
                    (== (idx after k) (idx before k))))))))

(ghost-fn seed_dist ((dist (seq (option int))) (n int) (start int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len dist) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
               (== (idx dist v) (if (== v start) (some 0) (none))))))))

(ghost-fn seed_done ((done (seq bool)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len done) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (not (idx done v)))))))

(ghost-fn seed_todo ((todo (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len todo) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (== (idx todo v) v))))))

(ghost-fn seed_wit ((wit (seq (seq int))) (n int) (start int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len wit) n)
         (forall ((v int))
           (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
               (== (idx wit v) (seq-lit start)))))))

(spec option_leq
  (params (a (option i64)) (b (option i64)))
  (returns (r bool))
  (ensures (== r (opt_leq_g a b)))
  (effects))
(def option_leq
  (body
    (match a
      (case (none) (return (is none b)))
      (case (some ax)
        (match b
          (case (none) (return true))
          (case (some by) (return (<= ax by))))))))

(lemma wf_row
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int))
  (requires (well_formed wg)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg))))
  (ensures (row_unique (idx (view wg) u)))
  (body))

(lemma find_weight
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (w int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires
    (row_unique row)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (<= i k)) (< k (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row k) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row k) 1) w))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (< i k)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call find_weight row v w (+ i 1) k)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))))

(lemma canonical_weight
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (well_formed wg) (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and
        (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
             (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 0) v)
             (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 1) w))))
    (call wf_row wg u)
    (call find_weight (idx (view wg) u) v w 0 k)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma prefix_path
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
           (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight g p)
          (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
             (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                                (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma extend_path
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (p (seq int)) (start int)
          (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (path_to (view wg) start u p)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (path_to (view wg) start v (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call canonical_weight wg u v w)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert (> (len p) 0))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len p) 1))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) v))
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight
            (view wg)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len p) 1))
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)))
          w))
    (assert (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))))

(lemma selected_path_lower
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (u int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (min_unfinished dist done u)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (path_to (view wg) start (idx p (- (len p) 1)) p)
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist u)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start))
        (assert (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist start)))
        (assert
          (match (idx dist u)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some bd) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) bd)))))
      (block
        (call prefix_path (view wg) p)
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let prev int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let lastv int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (> (len q) 0))
        (assert (path_to (view wg) start prev q))
        (obtain ((edgew int)) (has_edge (view wg) prev lastv edgew))
        (call canonical_weight wg prev lastv edgew)
        (assert (>= edgew 0))
        (if (idx done prev)
          (block
            (assert
              (and
                (and (and (<= 0 prev) (< prev (len dist)))
                     (idx done prev))
                (path_to (view wg) start prev q)))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist prev)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some pd)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) q) pd))))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist lastv)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ld)
                  (match (idx dist prev)
                    (case (none) false)
                    (case (some pd2) (<= ld (+ pd2 edgew)))))))
            (assert (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist lastv)))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud)))))
          (block
            (call selected_path_lower wg start dist done u q)
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud2)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud2))))))))))

(lemma establish_chosen
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (min_unfinished dist done u))
  (ensures (chosen_claim (view wg) start dist u))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call selected_path_lower wg start dist done u p))))

(lemma mark_good
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (good_done g start dist done0)
    (chosen_claim g start dist u)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u)))
  (ensures (good_done g start dist done1))
  (body))

(lemma scan_choose
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (todo (seq int))
    (best int) (q int))
  (requires
    (scan_min dist todo best q)
    (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len todo)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx todo q)) (< (idx todo q) (len dist)))
    (opt_leq_g (idx dist (idx todo q))
               (idx dist (idx todo best))))
  (ensures (scan_min dist todo q (+ q 1)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_keep
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (todo (seq int))
    (best int) (q int))
  (requires
    (scan_min dist todo best q)
    (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len todo)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx todo q)) (< (idx todo q) (len dist)))
    (not (opt_leq_g (idx dist (idx todo q))
                    (idx dist (idx todo best)))))
  (ensures (scan_min dist todo best (+ q 1)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_finished
  (params
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (todo (seq int)) (rem int) (best int) (n int))
  (requires
    (active_partition done todo rem n)
    (> rem 0)
    (== (len dist) n)
    (scan_min dist todo best rem))
  (ensures (min_unfinished dist done (idx todo best)))
  (body))

(lemma seed_todo_member
  (params (todo (seq int)) (n int) (v int))
  (requires
    (seed_todo todo n)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((q int))
      (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
           (== (idx todo q) v))))
  (body
    (obtain ((q int))
      (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
           (== q v)))
    (assert (== (idx todo q) v))))

(lemma initial_state
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (todo (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires
    (== n (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))
    (seed_dist dist n start)
    (seed_done done n)
    (seed_todo todo n)
    (seed_wit wit n start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (finite_bound dist 0)
    (active_partition done todo n n))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
            (and (and (<= 0 (idx todo q)) (< (idx todo q) n))
                 (not (idx done (idx todo q)))))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call seed_todo_member todo n v))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (== (not (idx done v))
                (exists ((q int))
                  (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
                       (== (idx todo q) v)))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int) (r int))
        (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
                          (and (<= 0 r) (< r n)))
                     (== (idx todo q) (idx todo r)))
            (== q r))))
    (assert (active_partition done todo n n))))

(lemma preserve_good_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (good_done g start dist0 done)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
    (not (idx done v))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (good_done g start dist1 done))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_relaxed_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (done (seq bool)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (relaxed_done g dist0 done)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
    (not (idx done v))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x)
    (match (idx dist0 v)
      (case (none) true)
      (case (some old) (<= x old))))
  (ensures (relaxed_done g dist1 done))
  (body))

(lemma preserve_bound_update
  (params
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (v int) (x int) (oldb int) (newb int))
  (requires
    (finite_bound dist0 oldb)
    (<= oldb newb)
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x newb))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (finite_bound dist1 newb))
  (body))

(lemma widen_bound
  (params (dist (seq (option int))) (oldb int) (newb int))
  (requires (finite_bound dist oldb) (<= oldb newb))
  (ensures (finite_bound dist newb))
  (body))

(lemma update_witnesses
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (wit0 (seq (seq int))) (wit1 (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (v int) (du int) (w int) (x int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist0 wit0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist0)))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len wit0)))
    (== (idx dist0 u) (some du))
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
    (== x (+ du w))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x)
    (path_changed wit0 wit1 v (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist1 wit1))
  (body
    (call extend_path wg (idx wit0 u) start u v w)))

(lemma done_edge_bound
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int) (du int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (== (len done) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist u) (some du))
    (idx done v)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some dv) (<= dv (+ du w)))))
  (body
    (call extend_path wg (idx wit u) start u v w)
    (assert
      (match (idx dist v)
        (case (none) false)
        (case (some dv2) (<= dv2 (+ du w)))))))

(lemma partial_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq (option int))) (u int) (du int) (i int))
  (requires
    (partial_relaxed g dist u du i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
         (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len dist)))
    (match (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some dv)
        (<= dv (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed g dist u du (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma partial_update
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist0 (seq (option int))) (dist1 (seq (option int)))
    (u int) (du int) (i int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires
    (partial_relaxed g dist0 u du i)
    (row_unique (idx g u))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== x (+ du (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (opt_changed dist0 dist1 v x))
  (ensures (partial_relaxed g dist1 u du (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((j int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j i))
            (!= (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v))))
    (assert
      (forall ((j int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j i))
            (== (idx dist1 (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
                (idx dist0 (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))))))
    (assert (partial_relaxed g dist1 u du (+ i 1)))))

(lemma finish_relaxed
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool))
    (u int) (du int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done0)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
    (== (idx dist u) (some du))
    (partial_relaxed (view wg) dist u du (len (idx (view wg) u))))
  (ensures (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done1))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((v int) (w int))
        (=> (has_edge (view wg) u v w)
            (match (idx dist v)
              (case (none) false)
              (case (some dv) (<= dv (+ du w)))))))))

(lemma finish_none_relaxed
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq (option int)))
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (relaxed_done g dist done0)
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (not (idx done0 u))

  (ensures (relaxed_done g dist done1))

(lemma remove_active
  (params
    (done0 (seq bool)) (done1 (seq bool))
    (todo0 (seq int)) (todo1 (seq int))
    (rem int) (best int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires
    (active_partition done0 todo0 rem n)
    (> rem 0)
    (and (<= 0 best) (< best rem))
    (== u (idx todo0 best))
    (bool_marked done0 done1 u)
    (int_changed todo0 todo1 best (idx todo0 (- rem 1))))
  (ensures (active_partition done1 todo1 (- rem 1) n))
  (body))

(lemma all_finished
  (params (done (seq bool)) (todo (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (active_partition done todo 0 n))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (idx done v))))

(lemma final_finite_witness
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (v int) (d int))
  (requires
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist v) (some d)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and (is_path (view wg) p)
             (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) d))))
  (body
    (assert
      (and
        (and (is_path (view wg) (idx wit v))
             (== (idx (idx wit v) 0) start))
        (and
          (== (idx (idx wit v) (- (len (idx wit v)) 1)) v)
          (== (path_weight (view wg) (idx wit v)) d))))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (== p (idx wit v)))
    (assert
      (and
        (and (is_path (view wg) p)
             (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (== (path_weight (view wg) p) d)))))

(lemma final_none_path
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (v int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (idx done v)
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (is none (idx dist v))
    (path_to (view wg) start v p))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (assert
      (match (idx dist v)
        (case (none) false)

(lemma final_some_path
  (params

    (path_to (view wg) start v (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call canonical_weight wg u v w)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert (> (len p) 0))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len p) 1))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) v))
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight
            (view wg)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len p) 1))
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)))
          w))
    (assert (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))))

(lemma selected_path_lower
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (u int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (min_unfinished dist done u)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (path_to (view wg) start (idx p (- (len p) 1)) p)
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist u)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start))
        (assert (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist start)))
        (assert
          (match (idx dist u)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some bd) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) bd)))))
      (block
        (call prefix_path (view wg) p)
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let prev int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let lastv int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (> (len q) 0))
        (assert (path_to (view wg) start prev q))
        (obtain ((edgew int)) (has_edge (view wg) prev lastv edgew))
        (call canonical_weight wg prev lastv edgew)
        (assert (>= edgew 0))
        (if (idx done prev)
          (block
            (assert
              (and
                (and (and (<= 0 prev) (< prev (len dist)))
                     (idx done prev))
                (path_to (view wg) start prev q)))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist prev)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some pd)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) q) pd))))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist lastv)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ld)
                  (match (idx dist prev)
                    (case (none) false)
                    (case (some pd2) (<= ld (+ pd2 edgew)))))))
            (assert (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist lastv)))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud)))))
          (block
            (call selected_path_lower wg start dist done u q)
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud2)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud2))))))))))

    (todo (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires
    (== n (size wg))

    (seed_dist dist n start)
    (seed_done done n)
    (seed_todo todo n)
    (seed_wit wit n start))
  (ensures
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit)
    (finite_bound dist 0)
    (active_partition done todo n n))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((q int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
            (and (and (<= 0 (idx todo q)) (< (idx todo q) n))
                 (not (idx done (idx todo q)))))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (call seed_todo_member todo n v))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (== (not (idx done v))
                (exists ((q int))
                  (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
                       (== (idx todo q) v)))))))
    (assert
      (forall ((q int) (r int))
        (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))
                          (and (<= 0 r) (< r n)))
                     (== (idx todo q) (idx todo r)))
            (== q r))))
    (assert (active_partition done todo n n))))

(lemma final_vertex
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))) (v int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (== (len wit) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
    (idx done v)
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                   (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v d))))
  (body
    (match (idx dist v)
      (case (none)
        (block
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (call final_none_path wg start dist done v p))
          (assert
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                       (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  false)))))
      (case (some fd)
        (block
          (call final_finite_witness wg start dist wit v fd)
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (call final_some_path wg start dist done v fd p))
          (assert
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=> (and (is_path (view wg) p)
                       (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) fd))))
          (assert (is_shortest_dist (view wg) start v fd)))))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n (fn (di) (if (== di start) (some 0) (none)))))
    (let-mut done (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (dj) false)))
    (let-mut todo (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (dk) dk)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (dw) (seq-lit start))))
    (assert (seed_dist dist n start))
    (assert (seed_done done n))
    (assert (seed_todo todo n))
    (assert (seed_wit wit n start))
    (call initial_state graph start dist done todo wit n)
    (let-mut rem i64 n)
    (while (> rem 0)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 rem) (<= rem n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant (== (len todo) n))
      (invariant (== (len wit) n))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) (some 0)))
      (invariant (active_partition done todo rem n))
      (invariant (good_done (view graph) start dist done))
      (invariant (relaxed_done (view graph) dist done))
      (invariant (distance_witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
      (invariant (finite_bound dist (* (- n rem) 100000)))
      (decreases rem)
      (let-mut best i64 0)
      (let-mut scan i64 1)
      (assert (scan_min dist todo best scan))
      (while (< scan rem)
        (invariant (and (<= 1 scan) (<= scan rem)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 best) (< best scan)))
        (invariant (scan_min dist todo best scan))
        (decreases (- rem scan))
        (let candidate i64 (idx todo scan))
        (let incumbent i64 (idx todo best))
        (let candidate_value (option i64) (idx dist candidate))
        (let incumbent_value (option i64) (idx dist incumbent))
        (let ((take_candidate bool))
          (call option_leq candidate_value incumbent_value))
        (if take_candidate
          (block
            (call scan_choose dist todo best scan)
            (set best scan))
          (call scan_keep dist todo best scan))
        (set scan (+ scan 1)))
      (call scan_finished dist done todo rem best n)
      (let u i64 (idx todo best))
      (call establish_chosen graph start dist done u)
      (call wf_row graph u)
      (ghost-let done_before (seq bool) done)
      (set-idx done u true)
      (assert (bool_marked done_before done u))
      (call mark_good (view graph) start dist done_before done u)
      (match (idx dist u)
        (case (none)
          (block
            (call finish_none_relaxed
              (view graph) dist done_before done u)
            (call widen_bound
              dist
              (* (- n rem) 100000)
              (* (+ (- n rem) 1) 100000))))
        (case (some selected_distance)
          (block
            (call widen_bound
              dist
              (* (- n rem) 100000)
              (* (+ (- n rem) 1) 100000))
            (let degree i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
            (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
            (assert
              (partial_relaxed
                (view graph) dist u selected_distance edge_index))
            (while (< edge_index degree)
              (invariant (and (<= 0 edge_index) (<= edge_index degree)))
              (invariant (== (len dist) n))
              (invariant (== (len wit) n))
              (invariant (== (idx dist start) (some 0)))
              (invariant (== (idx dist u) (some selected_distance)))
              (invariant (good_done (view graph) start dist done))
              (invariant
                (relaxed_done (view graph) dist done_before))
              (invariant
                (distance_witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
              (invariant
                (finite_bound dist (* (+ (- n rem) 1) 100000)))
              (invariant
                (partial_relaxed
                  (view graph) dist u selected_distance edge_index))
              (decreases (- degree edge_index))
              (let edge (tuple i64 i64)
                (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) edge_index))
              (let vertex i64 (get edge 0))
              (let edge_weight i64 (get edge 1))
              (assert
                (has_edge (view graph) u vertex edge_weight))
              (assert (and (>= edge_weight 0) (<= edge_weight 100000)))
              (if (idx done vertex)
                (block
                  (call done_edge_bound
                    graph start dist done wit u vertex
                    selected_distance edge_weight)
                  (call partial_step
                    (view graph) dist u selected_distance edge_index))
                (block
                  (assert
                    (in_i64 (+ selected_distance edge_weight)))
                  (let new_distance i64
                    (+ selected_distance edge_weight))
                  (let current_value (option i64) (idx dist vertex))
                  (let improve bool
                    (match current_value
                      (case (none) true)
                      (case (some previous_distance)
                        (< new_distance previous_distance))))
                  (if improve
                    (block
                      (ghost-let dist_before (seq (option int)) dist)
                      (ghost-let wit_before (seq (seq int)) wit)
                      (assert
                        (== (idx dist_before u)
                            (some selected_distance)))
                      (ghost-set wit
                        (seq-build n

    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (v int)
    (x int)
    (bound int))
  (requires
    (dist_range before bound)
    (changed_at before after v x)
    (and (>= x 0) (<= x bound)))
  (ensures
    (dist_range after bound))
  (body))

(lemma widen_range
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (small int)
    (large int))
  (requires
    (dist_range dist small)
    (<= small large))
  (ensures
    (dist_range dist large))
  (body))

(lemma count_mark
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (marked_at before after u)
    (not (idx before u)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (occurrences after true)
      (+ (occurrences before true) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma count_has_open
  (params
    (done (seq bool))
    (count int))

    (== (occurrences done true) count)
    (and (<= 0 count) (< count (len done))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int))

        (not (idx done v)))))
  (body))

(lemma count_all_done

  (ensures

      (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
        (and (not (idx used u))
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
                     (not (idx used v)))
                (<= (idx dist u) (idx dist v)))))))))

(ghost-fn scan_min ((dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool))
                    (upto int) (choice int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len used) (len dist))
      (and (and (<= 0 upto) (<= upto (len dist)))
        (if (== choice -1)
          (forall ((v int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v upto)) (idx used v)))
          (and (and (<= 0 choice) (< choice upto))
            (and (not (idx used choice))
              (forall ((v int))
                (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v upto))
                         (not (idx used v)))
                    (<= (idx dist choice) (idx dist v)))))))))))

(ghost-fn relaxed ((old (seq int)) (new (seq int)) (used (seq bool))
                   (v int) (du int) (w int) (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len new) (len old))
      (and (== (len used) (len old))
        (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
          (forall ((k int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len old)))
              (== (idx new k)
                (if (and (== k v)
                         (and (and (not (idx used v)) (< du inf))
                              (< (+ du w) (idx old v))))
                  (+ du w)
                  (idx old k))))))))))

(ghost-fn partial_closed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int))
                          (u int) (upto int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len dist) (len g))
      (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (and (and (<= 0 upto) (<= upto (len (idx g u))))
          (forall ((i int))
            (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i upto))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                     (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len dist)))
                (<= (idx dist (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                    (+ (idx dist u) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))))))

(ghost-fn result_map ((dist (seq int)) (res (seq (option i64)))
                      (inf int)) bool
  (body
    (and (== (len res) (len dist))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
          (match (idx res v)
            (case (none) (== (idx dist v) inf))
            (case (some d)
              (and (< (idx dist v) inf) (== d (idx dist v))))))))))

(lemma initial_vertex
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
          (dist (seq int)) (v int) (inf int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (== (idx dist v) (if (== v start) 0 inf))
    (> inf 0))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and (<= 0 (idx dist v)) (<= (idx dist v) inf))
      (=> (< (idx dist v) inf)
        (exists ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and (is_path g p)
              (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                   (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx dist v)))))))
  (body
    (if (== v start)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx dist v) 0))
        (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0)))
      (block))))

(lemma initial_state
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
          (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (inf int))
  (requires
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (== (idx dist v) (if (== v start) 0 inf))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))) (not (idx used v))))
    (> inf 0))
  (ensures
    (and (tentative_ok g start dist inf)
      (and (settled_ok g start dist used inf)
           (closed g dist used))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int)) (call initial_vertex g start dist v inf))
    (assert (== (idx dist start) 0))
    (assert (tentative_ok g start dist inf))
    (assert (settled_ok g start dist used inf))
    (assert (closed g dist used))))

(lemma scan_step
  (params (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (upto int)
          (choice int) (next_choice int))
  (requires
    (scan_min dist used upto choice)
    (< upto (len dist))
    (== next_choice
      (if (not (idx used upto))
        (if (or (== choice -1) (< (idx dist upto) (idx dist choice)))
          upto choice)
        choice)))
  (ensures (scan_min dist used (+ upto 1) next_choice))
  (body))

(lemma scan_complete
  (params (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (choice int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len used))
    (scan_min dist used (len dist) choice)
    (!= choice -1))
  (ensures (selected_min dist used choice))
  (body))

(lemma all_true_count
  (params (s (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s)))
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (idx s i))))
  (ensures (== (occurrences (take s k) true) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call all_true_count s (- k 1))
        (call law_take_step s (- k 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))) true)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- k 1)) true))
      (call law_occurrences_none s true))))

(lemma count_has_unused
  (params (used (seq bool)) (round int))
  (requires
    (== (occurrences used true) round)
    (and (<= 0 round) (< round (len used))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int))
      (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used))) (not (idx used v)))))
  (body
    (if
      (exists ((v int))
        (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used))) (not (idx used v))))
      (block)
      (block
        (call all_true_count used (len used))
        (call law_take_all used)
        (assert (== (occurrences used true) (len used)))
        (assert false)))))

(lemma edge_at
  (params (g weighted_graph) (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (well_formed g)
    (weights_non_negative (view g))
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field g adj) u)))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (has_edge (view g) u
        (get (idx (idx (field g adj) u) i) 0)
        (get (idx (idx (field g adj) u) i) 1))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx (field g adj) u) i) 0))
             (< (get (idx (idx (field g adj) u) i) 0) (size g)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (get (idx (idx (field g adj) u) i) 1))
          (<= (get (idx (idx (field g adj) u) i) 1) 100000)))))
  (body
    (assert
      (has_edge (view g) u
        (get (idx (idx (field g adj) u) i) 0)
        (get (idx (idx (field g adj) u) i) 1)))))

(lemma append_path
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int))
          (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (ensures
    (and
      (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (and
        (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
        (and
          (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
                   (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)) v)
          (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
              (+ (path_weight g p) w))))))
  (body))

(lemma edge_weight_sound
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g))
  (ensures
    (and (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w)
         (and (<= 0 w) (<= w 100000))))
  (body))

(lemma selected_path_bound
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
          (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (u int)
          (inf int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (tentative_ok g start dist inf)
    (settled_ok g start dist used inf)
    (closed g dist used)
    (selected_min dist used u)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== u start))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0))
        (assert (<= (idx dist u) 0)))
      (block
        (let prefix (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (let predecessor int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (assert (is_path g prefix))
        (assert (connected g predecessor u))
        (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g predecessor u w))
        (call edge_weight_sound g predecessor u w)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g prefix) w)))
        (if (idx used predecessor)
          (block
            (assert
              (vertex_answer g start dist predecessor inf))
            (assert (!= (idx dist predecessor) inf))
            (assert
              (>= (path_weight g prefix)
                  (idx dist predecessor)))
            (assert
              (<= (idx dist u)
                  (+ (idx dist predecessor) w))))
          (block
            (call selected_path_bound
              g start dist used u inf prefix)
            (assert (>= w 0))))))))

(lemma settle_one
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
          (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (u int) (inf int))
  (requires
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (weights_and_size_bounded g)
    (tentative_ok g start dist inf)
    (settled_ok g start dist used inf)
    (closed g dist used)
    (selected_min dist used u))
  (ensures (vertex_answer g start dist u inf))
  (body
    (if (== (idx dist u) inf)
      (block
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call selected_path_bound g start dist used u inf p))
        (assert
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (=> (and (is_path g p)
                     (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
                false))))
      (block
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (call selected_path_bound g start dist used u inf p))
        (assert
          (forall ((p (seq int)))
            (=> (and (is_path g p)
                     (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                          (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
                (>= (path_weight g p) (idx dist u)))))
        (assert (is_shortest_dist g start u (idx dist u)))))
    (assert (vertex_answer g start dist u inf))))

(lemma relax_vertex
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
          (old (seq int)) (new (seq int)) (used (seq bool))
          (u int) (v int) (w int) (inf int) (k int))
  (requires
    (tentative_ok g start old inf)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w)
    (and (<= 0 w) (<= w 100000))
    (selected_min old used u)
    (relaxed old new used v (idx old u) w inf)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len new))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and (<= 0 (idx new k)) (<= (idx new k) inf))
      (=> (< (idx new k) inf)
        (exists ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and (is_path g p)
              (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                   (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) k)))
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx new k)))))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx new k) (idx old k))
      (block)
      (block
        (assert (== k v))
        (assert (< (idx old u) inf))
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and (is_path g p)
              (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                   (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
            (== (path_weight g p) (idx old u))))
        (call append_path g p u v w)))))

(lemma relax_preserves_tentative
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
          (old (seq int)) (new (seq int)) (used (seq bool))
          (u int) (v int) (w int) (inf int))
  (requires
    (tentative_ok g start old inf)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w)
    (and (<= 0 w) (<= w 100000))
    (selected_min old used u)
    (relaxed old new used v (idx old u) w inf))
  (ensures (tentative_ok g start new inf))
  (body
    (forall ((k int))
      (call relax_vertex g start old new used u v w inf k))
    (assert (== (idx new start) 0))
    (assert (tentative_ok g start new inf))))

(lemma relax_preserves_min
  (params (old (seq int)) (new (seq int)) (used (seq bool))
          (u int) (v int) (w int) (inf int))
  (requires
    (selected_min old used u)
    (<= 0 w)
    (relaxed old new used v (idx old u) w inf))
  (ensures (selected_min new used u))
  (body))

(lemma relax_preserves_settled
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
          (old (seq int)) (new (seq int)) (used (seq bool))
          (v int) (du int) (w int) (inf int))
  (requires
    (settled_ok g start old used inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
    (relaxed old new used v du w inf))
  (ensures (settled_ok g start new used inf))
  (body))

(lemma relax_preserves_closed
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (old (seq int))
          (new (seq int)) (used (seq bool))
          (v int) (du int) (w int) (inf int))
  (requires
    (closed g old used)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
    (relaxed old new used v du w inf))
  (ensures (closed g new used))
  (body))

(lemma partial_index
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (old (seq int))
          (new (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (u int) (i int)
          (v int) (w int) (inf int) (j int))
  (requires
    (partial_closed g old u i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
    (<= 0 w)
    (relaxed old new used v (idx old u) w inf)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (+ i 1))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
           (< (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (len new)))
      (<= (idx new (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0))
          (+ (idx new u) (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1)))))
  (body))

(lemma partial_step
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (old (seq int))
          (new (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (u int) (i int)
          (v int) (w int) (inf int))
  (requires
    (partial_closed g old u i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len old)))
    (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (and (<= 0 w)
         (relaxed old new used v (idx old u) w inf)))
  (ensures (partial_closed g new u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((j int))
      (call partial_index g old new used u i v w inf j))
    (assert (partial_closed g new u (+ i 1)))))

(lemma close_vertex
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (dist (seq int))
          (used_before (seq bool)) (used_after (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires
    (closed g dist used_before)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
    (not (idx used_before u))
    (partial_closed g dist u (len (idx g u)))
    (== (len used_after) (len used_before))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used_before)))
          (== (idx used_after v)
              (if (== v u) true (idx used_before v))))))
  (ensures (closed g dist used_after))
  (body))

(lemma add_settled
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
          (dist (seq int)) (used_before (seq bool))
          (used_after (seq bool)) (u int) (inf int))
  (requires
    (settled_ok g start dist used_before inf)
    (vertex_answer g start dist u inf)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist)))
    (== (len used_after) (len used_before))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used_before)))
          (== (idx used_after v)
              (if (== v u) true (idx used_before v))))))
  (ensures (settled_ok g start dist used_after inf))
  (body))

(lemma mark_count_prefix
  (params (before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool))
          (u int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len before)))
    (not (idx before u))
    (== (len after) (len before))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
          (== (idx after v)
              (if (== v u) true (idx before v)))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len before))))
  (ensures
    (== (occurrences (take after k) true)
      (+ (occurrences (take before k) true)
         (if (< u k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call mark_count_prefix before after u (- k 1))
        (call law_take_step before (- k 1))
        (call law_take_step after (- k 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take before (- k 1))
          (seq-lit (idx before (- k 1))) true)
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take after (- k 1))
          (seq-lit (idx after (- k 1))) true)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx before (- k 1)) true)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx after (- k 1)) true))
      (block
        (call law_occurrences_none before true)
        (call law_occurrences_none after true)))))

(lemma count_mark
  (params (before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool))
          (u int) (round int))
  (requires
    (== (occurrences before true) round)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len before)))
    (not (idx before u))
    (== (len after) (len before))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before)))
          (== (idx after v)
              (if (== v u) true (idx before v))))))
  (ensures (== (occurrences after true) (+ round 1)))
  (body
    (call mark_count_prefix before after u (len before))
    (call law_take_all before)
    (call law_take_all after)))

(lemma finish_vertex
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
          (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool))
          (res (seq (option i64))) (inf int) (v int))
  (requires
    (settled_ok g start dist used inf)
    (result_map dist res inf)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (idx used v))
  (ensures
    (match (idx res v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and (is_path g p)
                   (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                        (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (assert (vertex_answer g start dist v inf))
    (match (idx res v)
      (case (none) (block))
      (case (some d) (block)))))

(lemma finish_result
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int)
          (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool))
          (res (seq (option i64))) (inf int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len used) (len g))
    (settled_ok g start dist used inf)
    (result_map dist res inf)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len used))) (idx used v))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (== (len res) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (match (idx res v)
            (case (none)
              (forall ((p (seq int)))
                (=> (and (is_path g p)
                         (and (== (idx p 0) start)
                              (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                    false)))
            (case (some d)
              (is_shortest_dist g start v d)))))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call finish_vertex g start dist used res inf v))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let inf i64 10000000001)
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (init_index)
          (if (== init_index start) 0 inf))))
    (let-mut used (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (flag_index) false)))
    (call initial_state (view graph) start dist used inf)
    (let-mut round i64 0)
    (while (< round n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 round) (<= round n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len used) n))
      (invariant (== (occurrences used true) round))
      (invariant (tentative_ok (view graph) start dist inf))
      (invariant (settled_ok (view graph) start dist used inf))
      (invariant (closed (view graph) dist used))
      (decreases (- n round))
      (let-mut scan i64 0)
      (let-mut candidate i64 -1)
      (while (< scan n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 scan) (<= scan n)))
        (invariant (scan_min dist used scan candidate))
        (decreases (- n scan))
        (ghost-let old_choice int candidate)
        (if (not (idx used scan))
          (if (or (== candidate -1)
                  (< (idx dist scan) (idx dist candidate)))
            (set candidate scan)
            (block))
          (block))
        (call scan_step dist used scan old_choice candidate)
        (set scan (+ scan 1)))
      (call count_has_unused used round)
      (assert (!= candidate -1))
      (call scan_complete dist used candidate)
      (let du i64 (idx dist candidate))
      (let degree i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) candidate)))
      (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
      (while (< edge_index degree)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 edge_index) (<= edge_index degree)))
        (invariant (== (len dist) n))
        (invariant (== (len used) n))
        (invariant (not (idx used candidate)))
        (invariant (== (idx dist candidate) du))
        (invariant (selected_min dist used candidate))
        (invariant (settled_ok (view graph) start dist used inf))
        (invariant (closed (view graph) dist used))
        (invariant (tentative_ok (view graph) start dist inf))
        (invariant
          (partial_closed (view graph) dist candidate edge_index))
        (decreases (- degree edge_index))
        (let pair_value (tuple i64 i64)
          (idx (idx (field graph adj) candidate) edge_index))
        (let target i64 (get pair_value 0))
        (let weight i64 (get pair_value 1))
        (call edge_at graph candidate edge_index)
        (call edge_weight_sound
          (view graph) candidate target weight)
        (ghost-let before_dist (seq int) dist)
        (if (and
              (and (not (idx used target)) (< du inf))
              (< (+ du weight) (idx dist target)))
          (set-idx dist target (+ du weight))
          (block))
        (assert
          (relaxed before_dist dist used target du weight inf))
        (call relax_preserves_tentative
          (view graph) start before_dist dist used
          candidate target weight inf)
        (call relax_preserves_min
          before_dist dist used candidate target weight inf)
        (call relax_preserves_settled
          (view graph) start before_dist dist used
          target du weight inf)
        (call relax_preserves_closed
          (view graph) before_dist dist used
          target du weight inf)
        (call partial_step
          (view graph) before_dist dist used

    (== (get (idx row k) 1) w))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- k i))
  (body
    (if (< i k)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call find_weight row v w (+ i 1) k)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w)))))

(lemma canonical_weight
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (well_formed wg) (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and
        (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view wg))))
             (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
        (and (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 0) v)
             (== (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) k) 1) w))))
    (call wf_row wg u)
    (call find_weight (idx (view wg) u) v w 0 k)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight (view wg) u v) w))))

(lemma prefix_path
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (take p (- (len p) 1))
             (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
        (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
    (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
    (== (path_weight g p)
        (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
           (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                              (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) 0)
    (call law_idx_take p (- (len p) 1) (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight g p)
          (+ (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
             (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 2))
                                (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma extend_path
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (p (seq int)) (start int)
          (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (path_to (view wg) start u p)
    (has_edge (view wg) u v w))
  (ensures
    (path_to (view wg) start v (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))
  (body
    (call canonical_weight wg u v w)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (assert (> (len p) 0))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len p) 1))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) v))
    (assert
      (== (get_edge_weight
            (view wg)
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len p) 1))
            (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)))
          w))
    (assert (is_path (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start))
    (assert
      (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
               (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
          v))
    (assert
      (== (path_weight (view wg) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
          (+ (path_weight (view wg) p) w)))))

(lemma selected_path_lower
  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (u int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size wg)))
    (== (idx dist start) (some 0))
    (good_done (view wg) start dist done)
    (relaxed_done (view wg) dist done)
    (min_unfinished dist done u)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (path_to (view wg) start (idx p (- (len p) 1)) p)
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (match (idx dist u)
      (case (none) false)
      (case (some d) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) d))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (== (len p) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start))
        (assert (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist start)))
        (assert
          (match (idx dist u)
            (case (none) false)
            (case (some bd) (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) bd)))))
      (block
        (call prefix_path (view wg) p)
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let prev int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let lastv int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (> (len q) 0))
        (assert (path_to (view wg) start prev q))
        (obtain ((edgew int)) (has_edge (view wg) prev lastv edgew))
        (call canonical_weight wg prev lastv edgew)
        (assert (>= edgew 0))
        (if (idx done prev)
          (block
            (assert
              (and
                (and (and (<= 0 prev) (< prev (len dist)))
                     (idx done prev))
                (path_to (view wg) start prev q)))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist prev)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some pd)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) q) pd))))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist lastv)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ld)
                  (match (idx dist prev)
                    (case (none) false)
                    (case (some pd2) (<= ld (+ pd2 edgew)))))))
            (assert (opt_leq_g (idx dist u) (idx dist lastv)))
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud)))))
          (block
            (call selected_path_lower wg start dist done u q)
            (assert
              (match (idx dist u)
                (case (none) false)
                (case (some ud2)
                  (>= (path_weight (view wg) p) ud2))))))))))

        (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q n))

    (assert (active_partition done todo n n))))

  (params
    (wg weighted_graph) (start int)
    (dist (seq (option int))) (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))) (v int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (size wg))
    (== (len done) (size wg))
    (== (len wit) (size wg))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size wg)))
    (idx done v)

    (distance_witnesses (view wg) start dist wit))

    (match (idx dist v)

        (forall ((p (seq int)))

              false)))
      (case (some d)

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64))
      (seq-build n (fn (di) (if (== di start) (some 0) (none)))))
    (let-mut done (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (dj) false)))
    (let-mut todo (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (dk) dk)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (dw) (seq-lit start))))
    (assert (seed_dist dist n start))
    (assert (seed_done done n))
    (assert (seed_todo todo n))
    (assert (seed_wit wit n start))
    (call initial_state graph start dist done todo wit n)
    (let-mut rem i64 n)
    (while (> rem 0)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 rem) (<= rem n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant (== (len todo) n))
      (invariant (== (len wit) n))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) (some 0)))
      (invariant (active_partition done todo rem n))
      (invariant (good_done (view graph) start dist done))
      (invariant (relaxed_done (view graph) dist done))
      (invariant (distance_witnesses (view graph) start dist wit))
      (invariant (finite_bound dist (* (- n rem) 100000)))
      (decreases rem)
      (let-mut best i64 0)
      (let-mut scan i64 1)
      (assert (scan_min dist todo best scan))
      (while (< scan rem)
        (invariant (and (<= 1 scan) (<= scan rem)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 best) (< best scan)))
        (invariant (scan_min dist todo best scan))
        (decreases (- rem scan))
        (let candidate i64 (idx todo scan))
        (let incumbent i64 (idx todo best))
        (let candidate_value (option i64) (idx dist candidate))
        (let incumbent_value (option i64) (idx dist incumbent))
        (let ((take_candidate bool))
          (call option_leq candidate_value incumbent_value))

  (decreases (- j i))
  (body
    (if
      (== i j)
      (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx row i) 0) v))
        (call weight_from_hit row v w (+ i 1) j)
        (assert (== (weight_from row v i) w))))))

(lemma edge_lookup
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (call row_unique g u)
    (call weight_from_hit (idx g u) v w 0 i)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))))

(lemma path_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p)
    (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
    (>=
      (get_edge_weight g
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      0)
    (==
      (path_weight g p)
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (get_edge_weight g
          (idx p (- (len p) 2))
          (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
  (body
    (assert
      (connected g
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (obtain ((w int))
      (has_edge g
        (idx p (- (len p) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1))
        w))
    (call edge_lookup g
      (idx p (- (len p) 2))
      (idx p (- (len p) 1))
      w)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g p)
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
          (get_edge_weight g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma path_non_negative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (is_path g p))
  (ensures (>= (path_weight g p) 0))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (< (len p) 2)
      (assert (>= (path_weight g p) 0))
      (block
        (call path_step g p)
        (call path_non_negative g (take p (- (len p) 1)))))))

(lemma singleton_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (v int))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (seq-lit v))
    (== (path_weight g (seq-lit v)) 0))
  (body))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (is_path g p)
    (has_edge g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 2))
        (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
          (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v))
    (call edge_lookup g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v w)
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
        (+ (path_weight g p) w)))))

(lemma count_false
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
          (not (idx s i)))))
  (ensures (== (occurrences s true) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if
      (== (len s) 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call count_false (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (assert (not (idx s (- (len s) 1))))
        (assert
          (==
            s
            (concat
              (take s (- (len s) 1))
              (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1))))))
        (assert (== (occurrences s true) 0))))))

(lemma count_one
  (params
    (s (seq bool))
    (at int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len s)))
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
          (== (idx s i) (== i at)))))
  (ensures (== (occurrences s true) 1))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if
      (== at (- (len s) 1))
      (block
        (call count_false (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (assert (idx s at))
        (assert
          (==
            s
            (concat
              (take s (- (len s) 1))
              (seq-lit true))))
        (assert (== (occurrences s true) 1)))
      (block
        (assert (< at (- (len s) 1)))
        (call count_one (take s (- (len s) 1)) at)
        (assert (not (idx s (- (len s) 1))))
        (assert
          (==
            s
            (concat
              (take s (- (len s) 1))
              (seq-lit false))))
        (assert (== (occurrences s true) 1))))))

(lemma initial_facts
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len done) (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (== (idx dist v) (if (== v start) 0 -1))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (== (idx done v) (== v start)))))
  (ensures
    (witnessed g start dist)
    (solved g start dist done)
    (dist_range dist 0)
    (== (occurrences done true) 1)
    (row_prefix_closed g dist done start 0))
  (body
    (call singleton_path g start)
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call path_non_negative g p))
    (call count_one done start)
    (assert (is_shortest_dist g start start 0))
    (assert (witnessed g start dist))
    (assert (solved g start dist done))
    (assert (dist_range dist 0))
    (assert (== (occurrences done true) 1))
    (assert (old_closed g dist done start))
    (assert (prefix_pairs g dist done start 0))
    (assert (row_prefix_closed g dist done start 0))))

(lemma relax_witnessed
  (params

    (w int))

  (ensures (witnessed g start after))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (is_path g p)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) start)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)))
        (== (path_weight g p) (idx before u))))
    (call append_path g p v w)))

  (params

  (requires

    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g))))
  (ensures
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p)))
          (and (<= 0 (idx p i)) (< (idx p i) (len g))))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if
      (< (len p) 2)
      (block)
      (block
        (call path_endpoint_range g (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert
          (connected g
            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (obtain ((w int))

            (idx p (- (len p) 2))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))

(lemma path_lower_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (valid_targets g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len done) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (idx done start)
    (dist_range dist (* (len dist) 100000))
    (solved g start dist done)
    (closed g dist done)
    (best_choice dist done u)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (not (idx done (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (<= (idx dist u) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (call path_endpoint_range g p)
    (if
      (< (len p) 2)
      (assert false)
      (block
        (call path_step g p)
        (ghost-let end int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (ghost-let prev int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (assert
          (and (<= 0 prev) (< prev (len dist))))
        (assert
          (and (<= 0 end) (< end (len dist))))
        (if
          (idx done prev)
          (block
            (assert
              (==
                (idx
                  (take p (- (len p) 1))
                  (- (len (take p (- (len p) 1))) 1))
                prev))
            (assert
              (not (== (idx dist prev) -1)))
            (assert (>= (idx dist prev) 0))
            (assert
              (is_shortest_dist
                g start prev (idx dist prev)))
            (assert
              (<= (idx dist prev)
                  (path_weight g
                    (take p (- (len p) 1)))))
            (obtain ((w int))
              (has_edge g prev end w))
            (call edge_lookup g prev end w))
          (call path_lower_bound
            g start dist done u
            (take p (- (len p) 1))))))))

(lemma no_open_path
  (params

    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))

  (body

      (block
        (call path_step g p)

        (assert (and (<= 0 end) (< end (len dist))))

(lemma relaxed_prefix_pairs
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (prefix_pairs g before done u i)
    (relaxed_at before after
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (let_pair
      (idx (idx g u) i)
      after done u))
  (ensures
    (prefix_pairs g after done u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k i))
            (!=
              (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)

    (assert

(lemma relax_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (unique_rows g)
    (row_prefix_closed g before done u i)
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (relaxed_at before after
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (let_pair
      (idx (idx g u) i)
      after done u))
  (ensures
    (row_prefix_closed g after done u (+ i 1)))
  (body
    (call relaxed_old_closed
      g before after done u
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (call relaxed_prefix_pairs
      g before after done u i)
    (assert
      (row_prefix_closed g after done u (+ i 1)))))

  (params

    (== (len done) (len dist))

    (solved g start dist done)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
          (idx done v)))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len res)))
          (==
            (idx res v)
            (if
              (== (idx dist v) -1)
              (none)

  (body))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (unique_rows (view graph)))
    (assert (valid_targets (view graph)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (j)
          (if (== j start) 0 -1))))
    (let-mut done (vec bool)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (j2)
          (== j2 start))))
    (call initial_facts
      (view graph) start dist done)
    (call widen_range dist 0 100000)
    (let-mut first_i i64 0)
    (while
      (< first_i
        (len (idx (field graph adj) start)))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 first_i)
          (<= first_i
            (len (idx (field graph adj) start)))))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant
        (witnessed (view graph) start dist))
      (invariant
        (solved (view graph) start dist done))
      (invariant (dist_range dist 100000))
      (invariant
        (row_prefix_closed
          (view graph) dist done start first_i))
      (decreases
        (- (len (idx (field graph adj) start))
           first_i))
      (let first_v i64
        (get
          (idx
            (idx (field graph adj) start)
            first_i)
          0))
      (let first_w i64
        (get
          (idx
            (idx (field graph adj) start)
            first_i)
          1))
      (assert
        (has_edge
          (view graph) start first_v first_w))
      (assert
        (and (>= first_w 0) (<= first_w 100000)))
      (ghost-let prefix_before (seq int) dist)
      (if
        (idx done first_v)
        (block)
        (block
          (ghost-let before (seq int) dist)
          (set-idx dist first_v first_w)
          (assert
            (changed_at before dist first_v first_w))
          (call relax_witnessed
            (view graph) start before dist
            start first_v first_w)
          (call preserve_solved_dist
            (view graph) start before dist
            done first_v)
          (call preserve_range
            before dist first_v first_w 100000)))
      (assert
        (relaxed_at prefix_before dist first_v))
      (assert
        (let_pair
          (idx (idx (view graph) start) first_i)
          dist done start))
      (call relax_prefix
        (view graph) prefix_before dist
        done start first_i)
      (set first_i (+ first_i 1)))
    (call prefix_closed_done
      (view graph) dist done start)
    (let-mut count i64 1)
    (while (< count n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 1 count) (<= count n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant (idx done start))
      (invariant
