      (invariant (cap_upto g acc n u))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let dg i64 (len (idx (field cg adj) u)))
      (assert (== (deg g u) dg))
      (assert (== (len (idx g u)) dg))
      (let-mut row (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (a1) 0)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i dg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i dg)))
        (invariant (== (len row) n))
        (invariant (row_ok g row u n i))
        (decreases (- dg i))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx (field cg adj) u) i) 0))
        (let c i64 (get (idx (idx (field cg adj) u) i) 1))
        (assert (== v (nbr g u i)))
        (assert (== c (wgt g u i)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (ghost-let r0 (seq int) row)
        (set-idx row v c)
        (assert (upd r0 row v c))
        (call row_step g r0 row u n i)
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (ghost-let r1 (seq int) row)
      (ghost-let c0 (seq (seq int)) acc)
      (push acc row)
      (assert (appended_row c0 acc r1))
      (call upto_step g c0 acc n u r1)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (return acc)))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))

(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn dist_rng ((dist (seq int)) (top int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len dist)))
    (and (<= -1 (idx dist w)) (<= (idx dist w) top))))))
(ghost-fn in_q ((dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue)))
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) (len dist))) (>= (idx dist (idx queue k)) 0))))))
(ghost-fn positions ((dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (pos (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len dist))) (< w (len pos))) (>= (idx dist w) 0))
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx pos w)) (< (idx pos w) (len queue))) (== (idx queue (idx pos w)) w))))))
(ghost-fn closed_q ((cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int) (w int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k head)) (and (< k (len queue)) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len dist)))))
        (=> (> (res cap net (idx queue k) w) 0) (>= (idx dist w) 0))))))
(ghost-fn partial_u ((cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (dist (seq int)) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w i)) (< w (len dist)))
        (=> (> (res cap net u w) 0) (>= (idx dist w) 0))))))
(ghost-fn closed_cut ((cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (dist (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist))) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len dist))))
             (and (>= (idx dist x) 0) (< (idx dist w) 0)))
        (<= (res cap net x w) 0)))))
(ghost-fn tree_ok ((cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (s int) (n int) (dist (seq int)) (parent (seq int)) (amt (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (and (== (len dist) n) (== (len parent) n)) (and (== (len amt) n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))))
    (and (and (== (idx dist s) 0) (and (> (idx amt s) 0) (<= (idx amt s) 200000)))
      (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (!= x s) (>= (idx dist x) 0)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx parent x)) (< (idx parent x) n))
          (and (and (>= (idx dist (idx parent x)) 0) (== (idx dist x) (+ (idx dist (idx parent x)) 1)))
            (and (and (> (idx amt x) 0) (<= (idx amt x) 200000))
              (and (<= (idx amt x) (res cap net (idx parent x) x))
                   (=> (!= (idx parent x) s) (<= (idx amt x) (idx amt (idx parent x))))))))))))))

(lemma entry (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (square cap n) (square net n) (cap_range cap n) (net_ok net cap n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (== (get_flow cap u v) (idx (idx cap u) v))
    (== (get_flow net u v) (idx (idx net u) v))
    (== (res cap net u v) (- (idx (idx cap u) v) (idx (idx net u) v)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx (idx cap u) v)) (<= (idx (idx cap u) v) 100000))
    (and (<= -100000 (idx (idx net u) v)) (<= (idx (idx net u) v) (idx (idx cap u) v))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (idx cap u)) n))
    (assert (== (len (idx net u)) n))
    (assert (<= (get_flow net u v) (get_flow cap u v)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow net v u) (get_flow cap v u)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow cap v u) 100000))
    (assert (== (get_flow net u v) (neg (get_flow net v u))))))
(lemma amt_facts (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (s int) (n int) (dist (seq int)) (parent (seq int)) (amt (seq int)) (u int))
  (requires (tree_ok cap net s n dist parent amt) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (>= (idx dist u) 0))
  (ensures (and (> (idx amt u) 0) (<= (idx amt u) 200000)))
  (body))
(lemma tree_facts (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (s int) (n int) (dist (seq int)) (parent (seq int)) (amt (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (tree_ok cap net s n dist parent amt) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (!= x s) (>= (idx dist x) 0))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx parent x)) (< (idx parent x) n))
    (>= (idx dist (idx parent x)) 0)
    (== (idx dist x) (+ (idx dist (idx parent x)) 1))
    (and (> (idx amt x) 0) (<= (idx amt x) 200000))
    (<= (idx amt x) (res cap net (idx parent x) x))
    (=> (!= (idx parent x) s) (<= (idx amt x) (idx amt (idx parent x)))))
  (body))
(lemma step_rng (params (d0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int) (top int))
  (requires (dist_rng d0 top) (upd d0 d1 v x) (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (+ top 1))))
  (ensures (dist_rng d1 (+ top 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_in_q (params (d0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (in_q d0 q0) (appended q0 q1 v) (upd d0 d1 v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (in_q d1 q1))
  (body))
(lemma step_pos (params (d0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (pos0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (pos1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (positions d0 q0 pos0) (== (len pos0) (len d0)) (upd d0 d1 v x) (== (idx d0 v) -1)
            (appended q0 q1 v) (upd pos0 pos1 v (len q0)))
  (ensures (positions d1 q1 pos1))
  (body))
(lemma step_closed (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (d0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (head int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (closed_q cap net d0 q0 head) (<= head (len q0)) (upd d0 d1 v x) (>= x 0) (appended q0 q1 v))
  (ensures (closed_q cap net d1 q1 head))
  (body))
(lemma step_partial (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (d0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (x int))
  (requires (partial_u cap net d0 u i) (upd d0 d1 i x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (partial_u cap net d1 u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma partial_skip (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (dist (seq int)) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (partial_u cap net dist u i) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len dist)))
            (or (>= (idx dist i) 0) (<= (res cap net u i) 0)))
  (ensures (partial_u cap net dist u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_tree (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (s int) (n int)
                         (d0 (seq int)) (p0 (seq int)) (a0 (seq int)) (d1 (seq int)) (p1 (seq int)) (a1 (seq int))
                         (u int) (v int) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (tree_ok cap net s n d0 p0 a0)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (>= (idx d0 u) 0)
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (== (idx d0 v) -1)
            (== x (+ (idx d0 u) 1))
            (upd d0 d1 v x) (upd p0 p1 v u) (upd a0 a1 v m)
            (and (> m 0) (<= m 200000)) (<= m (res cap net u v)) (<= m (idx a0 u)))
  (ensures (tree_ok cap net s n d1 p1 a1))
  (body))
(lemma head_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (closed_q cap net dist queue head) (partial_u cap net dist u n) (== (len dist) n)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue))) (== (idx queue head) u))
  (ensures (closed_q cap net dist queue (+ head 1)))
  (body))
(lemma cut_closed_point (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (x int) (w int))
  (requires (== (len pos) (len dist)) (positions dist queue pos) (closed_q cap net dist queue (len queue))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len dist))) (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len dist)))
            (>= (idx dist x) 0) (< (idx dist w) 0))
  (ensures (<= (res cap net x w) 0))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (idx pos x)) (< (idx pos x) (len queue))))
    (assert (== (idx queue (idx pos x)) x))
    (assert (=> (> (res cap net (idx queue (idx pos x)) w) 0) (>= (idx dist w) 0)))))
(lemma cut_closed (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (net (seq (seq int))) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (pos (seq int)))
  (requires (== (len pos) (len dist)) (positions dist queue pos) (closed_q cap net dist queue (len queue)))
  (ensures (closed_cut cap net dist))
  (body (forall ((x int) (w int)) (call cut_closed_point cap net dist queue pos x w))))

(spec find_path
  (params (cap (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (net (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (s i64) (n i64))
  (returns (dist (vec i64)) (parent (vec i64)) (amt (vec i64)))
  (requires (square cap n) (square net n) (cap_range cap n) (net_ok net cap n)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (<= n 1000))
  (ensures (tree_ok cap net s n dist parent amt) (closed_cut cap net dist))
  (effects alloc))
(def find_path
  (body
    (let-mut dist (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j1) -1)))
    (set-idx dist s 0)
    (let-mut parent (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j2) -1)))
    (let-mut amt (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j3) 0)))
    (set-idx amt s 200000)
    (let-mut queue (vec i64) (vec-new))
    (push queue s)
    (ghost-let-mut pos (seq int) (seq-build n (fn (j4) 0)))
    (let-mut head i64 0)
    (while (< head (len queue))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 head) (<= head (len queue))))
      (invariant (and (== (len dist) n) (and (== (len parent) n) (== (len amt) n))))
      (invariant (== (+ (len queue) (occurrences dist -1)) n))
      (invariant (>= (occurrences dist -1) 0))
      (invariant (dist_rng dist (len queue)))
      (invariant (in_q dist queue))
      (invariant (== (len pos) n))
      (invariant (positions dist queue pos))
      (invariant (tree_ok cap net s n dist parent amt))
      (invariant (closed_q cap net dist queue head))
      (decreases (- n head))
      (let u i64 (idx queue head))
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
      (assert (>= (idx dist u) 0))
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue))))
        (invariant (== (idx queue head) u))
        (invariant (and (== (len dist) n) (and (== (len parent) n) (== (len amt) n))))
        (invariant (== (+ (len queue) (occurrences dist -1)) n))
        (invariant (>= (occurrences dist -1) 0))
        (invariant (dist_rng dist (len queue)))
        (invariant (in_q dist queue))
        (invariant (== (len pos) n))
        (invariant (positions dist queue pos))
        (invariant (tree_ok cap net s n dist parent amt))
        (invariant (closed_q cap net dist queue head))
        (invariant (>= (idx dist u) 0))
        (invariant (partial_u cap net dist u v))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (call entry cap net n u v)
        (let r i64 (- (idx (idx cap u) v) (idx (idx net u) v)))
        (assert (>= (idx dist v) -1))
        (if (and (== (idx dist v) -1) (> r 0))
          (block
            (call count_member dist v (len dist))
            (call amt_facts cap net s n dist parent amt u)
            (assert (<= (idx dist u) (len queue)))
            (let m i64 (if (< (idx amt u) r) (idx amt u) r))
            (let nd i64 (+ (idx dist u) 1))
            (ghost-let d0 (seq int) dist)
            (ghost-let p0 (seq int) parent)
            (ghost-let a0 (seq int) amt)
            (ghost-let q0 (seq int) queue)
            (ghost-let pos0 (seq int) pos)
            (ghost-set pos (seq-build n (fn (j5) (if (== j5 v) (len queue) (idx pos j5)))))
            (set-idx dist v nd)
            (set-idx parent v u)
            (set-idx amt v m)
            (push queue v)
            (assert (upd d0 dist v nd))
            (assert (upd p0 parent v u))
            (assert (upd a0 amt v m))
            (assert (appended q0 queue v))
            (assert (upd pos0 pos v (len q0)))
            (call step_rng d0 dist v nd (len q0))
            (call step_in_q d0 q0 dist queue v nd)
            (call step_pos d0 q0 pos0 dist queue pos v nd)
            (call step_closed cap net d0 q0 dist queue head v nd)
            (call step_partial cap net d0 dist u v nd)
            (call step_tree cap net s n d0 p0 a0 dist parent amt u v nd m))
          (call partial_skip cap net dist u v))
        (set v (+ v 1)))
      (call head_step cap net dist queue head u n)
      (set head (+ head 1)))
    (call cut_closed cap net dist queue pos)
    (return dist parent amt)))

(ghost-fn upd2 ((m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len m1) (len m0)) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len m0))))
    (and (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len m0))) (!= x a)) (== (idx m1 x) (idx m0 x))))
         (upd (idx m0 a) (idx m1 a) b e)))))
(ghost-fn bal ((s int) (t int) (total int) (cur int) (d int) (x int)) int
  (body (- (+ (if (== x s) total (if (== x t) (neg total) 0)) (if (== x cur) d 0)) (if (== x t) d 0))))
(ghost-fn balance ((net (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (total int) (cur int) (d int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (== (row_sum net x n) (bal s t total cur d x))))))
(ghost-fn same_on ((m (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq (seq int))) (dist (seq int)) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len dist))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len dist))))
             (and (== (idx dist b) (+ (idx dist a) 1)) (<= (idx dist b) lim)))
        (== (get_flow m a b) (get_flow m0 a b))))))
(ghost-fn all_zero ((m (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (== (get_flow m x y) 0)))))

(lemma upd2_point (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (upd2 m0 m1 a b e))
  (ensures (== (get_flow m1 x y) (if (and (== x a) (== y b)) e (get_flow m0 x y))))
  (body (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len m0)))
    (if (== x a)
      (assert (upd (idx m0 a) (idx m1 a) b e))
      (assert (== (idx m1 x) (idx m0 x))))
    (block))))
(lemma row_upd (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (upd2 m0 m1 a b e) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (row_sum m1 x k)
               (+ (row_sum m0 x k) (if (and (== x a) (< b k)) (- e (get_flow m0 a b)) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (upd (idx m0 a) (idx m1 a) b e))
    (assert (>= b 0))
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call row_upd m0 m1 a b e x (- k 1))
        (call upd2_point m0 m1 a b e x (- k 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma two_rows (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (p int) (c int) (d int) (x int))
  (requires (upd2 m0 m1 p c (+ (get_flow m0 p c) d)) (upd2 m1 m2 c p (- (get_flow m1 c p) d))
            (!= p c) (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 c) (< c n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum m2 x n) (+ (row_sum m0 x n) (- (if (== x p) d 0) (if (== x c) d 0)))))
  (body
    (call row_upd m0 m1 p c (+ (get_flow m0 p c) d) x n)
    (call row_upd m1 m2 c p (- (get_flow m1 c p) d) x n)))
(lemma square_upd2 (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int) (e int))
  (requires (square m0 n) (upd2 m0 m1 a b e))
  (ensures (square m1 n))
  (body))
(lemma step_net_point (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (p int) (c int) (d int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (net_ok m0 cap n) (upd2 m0 m1 p c (+ (get_flow m0 p c) d)) (upd2 m1 m2 c p (- (get_flow m1 c p) d))
            (!= p c) (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 c) (< c n)) (> d 0) (<= d (res cap m0 p c))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
  (ensures (and (== (get_flow m2 x y) (neg (get_flow m2 y x))) (<= (get_flow m2 x y) (get_flow cap x y))))
  (body
    (call upd2_point m0 m1 p c (+ (get_flow m0 p c) d) x y)
    (call upd2_point m1 m2 c p (- (get_flow m1 c p) d) x y)
    (call upd2_point m0 m1 p c (+ (get_flow m0 p c) d) y x)
    (call upd2_point m1 m2 c p (- (get_flow m1 c p) d) y x)
    (call upd2_point m0 m1 p c (+ (get_flow m0 p c) d) c p)
    (assert (== (get_flow m0 x y) (neg (get_flow m0 y x))))
    (assert (<= (get_flow m0 x y) (get_flow cap x y)))
    (assert (== (get_flow m0 p c) (neg (get_flow m0 c p))))
    (assert (<= (get_flow m0 c p) (get_flow cap c p)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow m0 p c) (get_flow cap p c)))))
(lemma same_point (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (net0 (seq (seq int))) (dist (seq int)) (p int) (c int) (d int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len dist))) (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len dist)))
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len dist))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len dist)))
            (same_on m0 net0 dist (idx dist c))
            (upd2 m0 m1 p c (+ (get_flow m0 p c) d)) (upd2 m1 m2 c p (- (get_flow m1 c p) d))
            (== (idx dist c) (+ (idx dist p) 1))
            (== (idx dist b) (+ (idx dist a) 1)) (<= (idx dist b) (idx dist p)))
  (ensures (== (get_flow m2 a b) (get_flow net0 a b)))
  (body
    (call upd2_point m0 m1 p c (+ (get_flow m0 p c) d) a b)
    (call upd2_point m1 m2 c p (- (get_flow m1 c p) d) a b)
    (assert (not (and (== a p) (== b c))))
    (assert (not (and (== a c) (== b p))))
    (assert (== (get_flow m0 a b) (get_flow net0 a b)))))
(lemma walk_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (net0 (seq (seq int)))
                         (s int) (t int) (n int) (total int) (dist (seq int)) (parent (seq int)) (amt (seq int)) (c int) (p int) (d int))
  (requires
    (square m0 n) (net_ok m0 cap n) (balance m0 n s t total c d)
    (tree_ok cap net0 s n dist parent amt)
    (and (<= 0 c) (< c n)) (!= c s) (>= (idx dist c) 0)
    (same_on m0 net0 dist (idx dist c))
    (<= d (idx amt c)) (> d 0)
    (== p (idx parent c))
    (upd2 m0 m1 p c (+ (get_flow m0 p c) d))
    (upd2 m1 m2 c p (- (get_flow m1 c p) d)))
  (ensures
    (square m2 n) (net_ok m2 cap n) (balance m2 n s t total p d)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (>= (idx dist p) 0) (== (idx dist c) (+ (idx dist p) 1))
    (same_on m2 net0 dist (idx dist p))
    (=> (!= p s) (<= d (idx amt p))))
  (body
    (call tree_facts cap net0 s n dist parent amt c)
    (assert (!= p c))
    (assert (== (get_flow m0 p c) (get_flow net0 p c)))
    (assert (== (res cap m0 p c) (res cap net0 p c)))
    (assert (<= d (res cap m0 p c)))
    (call square_upd2 m0 m1 n p c (+ (get_flow m0 p c) d))
    (call square_upd2 m1 m2 n c p (- (get_flow m1 c p) d))

             (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))) (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i)))))
        (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))))
(ghost-fn cap_sound ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (> (get_flow cap x y) 0))
        (has_capacity g x y (get_flow cap x y))))))
(ghost-fn mem_tgt ((a (seq (tuple int int))) (k int) (v int)) bool (decreases k)
  (body (if (or (<= k 0) (> k (len a))) false
          (or (== (get (idx a (- k 1)) 0) v) (mem_tgt a (- k 1) v)))))
(ghost-fn part_sum ((a (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0
          (+ (part_sum a h u k (- m 1)) (if (mem_tgt a k (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn row_off ((a (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int)) (=> (not (mem_tgt a (len a) v)) (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn row_tgt ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (x int) (y int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (mem_tgt (idx g x) (len (idx g x)) y))))
(ghost-fn support ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (!= (get_flow h x y) 0) (row_tgt g x y)))))
(ghost-fn out_rows ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (== (total_flow_out g h u) (row_sum h u (len g)))))))
(ghost-fn row_vis ((h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (u int) (k int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0
          (+ (row_vis h d u (- k 1)) (if (vis d (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn out_vis ((h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (m int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0
          (+ (out_vis h d (- a 1) m) (if (vis d (- a 1)) (row_sum h (- a 1) m) 0)))))
(ghost-fn rows_vis ((h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0
          (+ (rows_vis h d (- a 1) b) (row_vis h d (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn in_vis ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (b int) (a int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0
          (+ (in_vis g h d (- b 1) a) (if (vis d (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) 0)))))
(ghost-fn dom ((h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (and (=> (and (vis d u) (not (vis d v))) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow f u v)))
             (=> (and (not (vis d u)) (vis d v)) (<= (get_flow f u v) (get_flow h u v))))))))
(ghost-fn pos_mat ((p (seq (seq int)))) (seq (seq int))
  (body (seq-build (len p) (fn (a) (seq-build (len p) (fn (b) (if (> (get_flow p a b) 0) (get_flow p a b) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn pos_rel ((f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (square f n)
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
          (== (get_flow f a b) (if (> (get_flow p a b) 0) (get_flow p a b) 0)))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma step_ge (params (dist0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (ge_m1 dist0) (upd dist0 dist v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (ge_m1 dist))
  (body))
(lemma step_range (params (queue0 (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int) (n int))
  (requires (in_range queue0 n) (appended queue0 queue v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (in_range queue n))
  (body))
(lemma step_qvis (params (d0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (d (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (q_vis d0 queue0) (upd d0 d v x) (appended queue0 queue v) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (q_vis d queue))
  (body))
(lemma step_below (params (d0 (seq int)) (d (seq int)) (m int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (d_below d0 m) (upd d0 d v x) (<= x m))
  (ensures (d_below d (+ m 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_pos (params (dist0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (pos0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int))
                        (pos (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (positions dist0 queue0 pos0) (== (len pos0) (len dist0)) (upd dist0 dist v x) (== (idx dist0 v) -1)
            (appended queue0 queue v) (upd pos0 pos v (len queue0)))
  (ensures (positions dist queue pos))
  (body))
(lemma tree_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (d0 (seq int)) (par0 (seq int)) (bn0 (seq int))
                         (d (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (bn (seq int)) (s int) (n int) (u int) (v int) (x int) (b int))
  (requires (tree_ok cap phi d0 par0 bn0 s n) (upd d0 d v x) (upd par0 par v u) (upd bn0 bn v b)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (< (idx d0 v) 0) (>= (idx d0 u) 0) (== x (+ (idx d0 u) 1))
            (>= b 1) (<= b (res cap phi u v)) (<= b (idx bn0 u)))
  (ensures (tree_ok cap phi d par bn s n))
  (body))
(lemma step_closed (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (d0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int)) (d (seq int))
                           (queue (seq int)) (head int) (n int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (closed_q cap phi d0 queue0 head n) (<= head (len queue0)) (upd d0 d v x) (appended queue0 queue v) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (closed_q cap phi d queue head n))
  (body))
(lemma step_partial (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (d0 (seq int)) (d (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (partial_res cap phi d0 u v) (upd d0 d v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (partial_res cap phi d u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_seen (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (partial_res cap phi d u v) (or (vis d v) (<= (res cap phi u v) 0)))
  (ensures (partial_res cap phi d u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma step_head (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (closed_q cap phi d queue head n) (partial_res cap phi d u n)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue))) (== (idx queue head) u))
  (ensures (closed_q cap phi d queue (+ head 1) n))
  (body))
(lemma closed_at (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (pos (seq int))
                         (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (closed_q cap phi d queue (len queue) n) (positions d queue pos) (== (len pos) (len d))
            (vis d a) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (=> (> (res cap phi a b) 0) (vis d b)))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 (idx pos a)) (< (idx pos a) (len queue))) (== (idx queue (idx pos a)) a)))
    (assert (=> (> (res cap phi (idx queue (idx pos a)) b) 0) (vis d b)))))
(lemma closed_final (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (closed_q cap phi d queue (len queue) n) (positions d queue pos) (== (len pos) (len d)))
  (ensures (cut_closed cap phi d n))
  (body (forall ((a1 int) (b1 int)) (call closed_at cap phi d queue pos n a1 b1))))

(lemma res_range (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (square cap n) (cap_range cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (and (<= -100000 (get_flow phi a b)) (<= (get_flow phi a b) 100000))
           (and (<= 0 (get_flow cap a b)) (<= (get_flow cap a b) 100000))
           (== (idx (idx phi a) b) (get_flow phi a b))
           (== (idx (idx cap a) b) (get_flow cap a b)))
  (body
    (assert (square phi n))
    (assert (== (get_flow phi a b) (neg (get_flow phi b a))))
    (assert (<= (get_flow phi a b) (get_flow cap a b)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow phi b a) (get_flow cap b a)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow cap a b)) (<= (get_flow cap a b) 100000)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow cap b a)) (<= (get_flow cap b a) 100000)))))
(lemma pushed_cells (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (p2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int)
                            (x1 int) (y1 int) (n int))
  (requires (cell_set p0 p1 a b x1 n) (cell_set p1 p2 b a y1 n) (!= a b)
            (== x1 (+ (get_flow p0 a b) e)) (== y1 (- (get_flow p0 b a) e)))
  (ensures (pushed p0 p2 a b e n))
  (body))
(lemma inv_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int) (n int))
  (requires (flow_inv cap p0 n) (square p1 n) (pushed p0 p1 a b e n) (!= a b)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (>= e 0) (<= e (res cap p0 a b)))
  (ensures (flow_inv cap p1 n))
  (body
    (assert (skew p1 n))
    (assert (le_cap p1 cap n))))
(lemma low_step (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (base (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int))
                        (a int) (b int) (e int) (lim int) (n int))
  (requires (same_low p0 base d lim n) (pushed p0 p1 a b e n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (== lim (idx d b)) (< (idx d a) lim))
  (ensures (same_low p1 base d (idx d a) n))
  (body))
(lemma row_diff (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (w int) (b int) (e int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (row_rel p0 p1 w b e n) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum p1 w k) (+ (row_sum p0 w k) (if (and (<= 0 b) (< b k)) e 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call row_diff p0 p1 w b e (- k 1) n)
        (assert (== (get_flow p1 w (- k 1)) (+ (get_flow p0 w (- k 1)) (if (== (- k 1) b) e 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma pushed_row (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int) (n int) (w int))
  (requires (pushed p0 p1 a b e n) (!= a b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum p1 w n) (+ (row_sum p0 w n) (- (if (== w a) e 0) (if (== w b) e 0)))))
  (body
    (if (== w a)
      (block (assert (row_rel p0 p1 a b e n)) (call row_diff p0 p1 a b e n n))
      (if (== w b)
        (block (assert (row_rel p0 p1 b a (neg e) n)) (call row_diff p0 p1 b a (neg e) n n))
        (block (assert (row_rel p0 p1 w b 0 n)) (call row_diff p0 p1 w b 0 n n))))))
(lemma excess_step (params (base (seq (seq int))) (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (cur int) (t int) (e int) (n int))
  (requires (excess base p0 cur t e n) (pushed p0 p1 a cur e n) (!= a cur)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur n)))
  (ensures (excess base p1 a t e n))
  (body (forall ((w1 int)) (call pushed_row p0 p1 a cur e n w1))))
(lemma cons_step (params (base (seq (seq int))) (p (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (e int) (n int))
  (requires (cons_all base s t n) (excess base p s t e n))
  (ensures (cons_all p s t n))
  (body))
(lemma row_bound (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (p (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (flow_inv cap p n) (cap_range cap n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (row_sum p u k) (* 100000 k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call row_bound cap p u (- k 1) n)
        (assert (<= (get_flow p u (- k 1)) (get_flow cap u (- k 1))))
        (assert (<= (get_flow cap u (- k 1)) 100000)))
      (block))))
(lemma zero_row (params (z (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (zero_mat z n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum z u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call zero_row z u (- k 1) n)
        (assert (== (get_flow z u (- k 1)) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma zero_inv (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (z (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (square z n) (zero_mat z n) (cap_range cap n))
  (ensures (flow_inv cap z n))
  (body
    (assert (skew z n))
    (assert (le_cap z cap n))))
(lemma zero_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (zero_mat cap n))
  (ensures (cap_sound g cap n) (cap_range cap n))
  (body))

(lemma wf_from (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (wf_g (view cg)))
  (body))
(lemma cap_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma cap_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int)
                        (u int) (i int) (tg int) (c int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== tg (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (== c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
            (cap_part g c0 u i) (cap_sound g c0 n) (cap_range c0 n) (cell_set c0 c1 u tg c n))
  (ensures (cap_part g c1 u (+ i 1)) (cap_sound g c1 n) (cap_range c1 n))
  (body
    (call cap_wit g u i)
    (assert (has_capacity g u tg c))
    (assert (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000)))
    (assert (distinct_t (idx g u)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 tg) (< tg n)))))
(lemma cap_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (cap_part g cap u i) (== i (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (cap_part g cap (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma cap_exact_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int) (y int) (c int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (cap_part g cap n 0) (has_capacity g x y c))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cap x y) c))
  (body
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1) c))))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1)))))

(lemma mem_intro (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len a))))
  (ensures (mem_tgt a k (get (idx a i) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (< i (- k 1)) (call mem_intro a (- k 1) i) (block))))
(lemma not_mem (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_t a) (and (and (<= 0 j) (<= j k)) (< k (len a))))
  (ensures (not (mem_tgt a j (get (idx a k) 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0) (call not_mem a (- j 1) k) (block))))
(lemma part_zero (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (ensures (== (part_sum a h u 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call part_zero a h u (- m 1))
        (assert (not (mem_tgt a 0 (- m 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma part_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (distinct_t a) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (part_sum a h u (+ k 1) m)
               (+ (part_sum a h u k m)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx a k) 0)) (< (get (idx a k) 0) m)) (get_flow h u (get (idx a k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call part_step a h u k (- m 1))
        (call not_mem a k k)
        (assert (== (mem_tgt a (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (or (== (get (idx a k) 0) (- m 1)) (mem_tgt a k (- m 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma part_all (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (row_off a h u) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (part_sum a h u (len a) m) (row_sum h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call part_all a h u (- m 1))
        (assert (=> (not (mem_tgt a (len a) (- m 1))) (== (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
      (block))))
(lemma out_part (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (part_sum (idx g u) h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call out_part g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (distinct_t (idx g u)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
        (call part_step (idx g u) h u (- k 1) (len g)))
      (call part_zero (idx g u) h u (len g)))))
(lemma out_is_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (support g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (row_sum h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_part g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (assert (row_off (idx g u) h u))
    (call part_all (idx g u) h u (len g))))
(lemma out_rows_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf_g g) (support g h))
  (ensures (out_rows g h))
  (body (forall ((u1 int)) (call out_is_row g h u1))))
(lemma cap_tgt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (x int) (y int) (c int))
  (requires (has_capacity g x y c))
  (ensures (row_tgt g x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y)))
    (call mem_intro (idx g x) (len (idx g x)) i)))
(lemma valid_cell (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow h x y) 0)
           (=> (> (get_flow h x y) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (get_flow h x y) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len h))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx h x)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow h x y) (idx (idx h x) y)))
      (assert (== (get_flow h x y) 0)))))
(lemma valid_support_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow h x y) 0) (row_tgt g x y)))
  (body
    (call valid_cell g h s t x y)
    (if (> (get_flow h x y) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (get_flow h x y) c)))
        (call cap_tgt g x y c))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_support (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (support g h))
  (body (forall ((x1 int) (y1 int)) (call valid_support_at g h s t x1 y1))))

(lemma rows_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int))
  (ensures (== (rows_vis h d a 0) 0))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call rows_zero h d (- a 1))
        (assert (== (row_vis h d (- a 1) 0) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma rows_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rows_vis h d a (+ b 1))
               (+ (rows_vis h d a b) (if (vis d b) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h b a) 0))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call rows_step g h d (- a 1) b)
        (assert (== (row_vis h d (- a 1) (+ b 1))
                    (+ (row_vis h d (- a 1) b) (if (vis d b) (get_flow h (- a 1) b) 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma fubini (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))

        (call rows_step g h d a (- b 1))

                    (+ (in_vis g h d (- b 1) a) (if (vis d (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) 0)))))
      (call rows_zero h d a))))
(lemma row_cmp (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (dom h f d n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (- (if (vis d u) (row_sum h u k) 0) (row_vis h d u k))

  (decreases k)

    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call row_cmp h f d n u (- k 1))
        (assert (=> (and (vis d u) (not (vis d (- k 1)))) (<= (get_flow h u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (- k 1)))))
        (assert (=> (and (not (vis d u)) (vis d (- k 1))) (<= (get_flow f u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1))))))

(lemma sum_cmp (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (dom h f d n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (<= (- (out_vis h d a n) (rows_vis h d a n)) (- (out_vis f d a n) (rows_vis f d a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call sum_cmp h f d n (- a 1))
        (call row_cmp h f d n (- a 1) n))
      (block))))
(lemma val_sum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (out_rows g h) (is_conserved g h s t) (vis d s) (not (vis d t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (== (- (out_vis h d a n) (in_vis g h d a n)) (if (< s a) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call val_sum g h d s t n (- a 1))
        (assert (== (total_flow_out g h (- a 1)) (row_sum h (- a 1) n)))

(lemma flow_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (dom h f d n)
            (vis d s) (not (vis d t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g h s) (flow_val g f s)))
  (body

    (call valid_support g h s t)
    (call valid_support g f s t)
    (call out_rows_all g h)

    (call val_sum g h d s t n n)

  (requires (skew phi n) (pos_rel f phi n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))

(lemma f_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))

  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (cap_sound g cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (cons_all phi s t n) (pos_rel f phi n))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))

    (forall ((u1 int) (v1 int)) (call f_nonneg_at f phi n u1 v1))
    (forall ((u2 int) (v2 int)) (call f_resp_at g cap phi f n u2 v2))
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (call f_support g cap phi f n)
    (forall ((u3 int)) (call f_net g phi f n u3))

(lemma dom_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                      (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (cap_part g cap n 0) (cap_range cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (cut_closed cap phi d n)
            (pos_rel f phi n) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (=> (and (vis d u) (not (vis d v))) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow f u v)))

(lemma f_best (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                      (d (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (cap_part g cap n 0) (cap_range cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (cut_closed cap phi d n)
            (pos_rel f phi n) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (vis d s) (not (vis d t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g other s)))
  (body
    (forall ((u1 int) (v1 int)) (call dom_at g cap phi f other d n s t u1 v1))
    (assert (dom other f d n))

(lemma final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                     (d (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (cap_part g cap n 0) (cap_sound g cap n) (cap_range cap n)
            (flow_inv cap phi n) (cons_all phi s t n) (cut_closed cap phi d n) (pos_rel f phi n)
            (vis d s) (not (vis d t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (row_sum phi s n)))
  (body
    (call f_valid g cap phi f n s t)
    (call f_support g cap phi f n)
    (call f_net g phi f n s)
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call f_best g cap phi f d n s t other))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))))

(spec search
  (params (cap (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (phi (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (n i64) (s i64))
  (returns (d (vec i64)) (par (vec i64)) (bn (vec i64)))
  (requires (<= n 1000) (square cap n) (cap_range cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (== (len d) n) (== (len par) n) (== (len bn) n)
           (== (idx d s) 0)
           (tree_ok cap phi d par bn s n)
           (cut_closed cap phi d n))
  (effects alloc))
(def search
  (body
    (let-mut d (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j0) -1)))
    (let-mut par (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j1) 0)))
    (let-mut bn (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j2) 0)))
    (set-idx d s 0)
    (set-idx bn s 1000000)
    (let-mut queue (vec i64) (vec-new))
    (push queue s)
    (ghost-let-mut pos (seq int) (seq-build n (fn (j3) 0)))
    (let-mut head i64 0)
    (while (< head (len queue))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 head) (<= head (len queue))))
      (invariant (== (len d) n))
      (invariant (== (+ (len queue) (occurrences d -1)) n))
      (invariant (>= (occurrences d -1) 0))
      (invariant (ge_m1 d))
      (invariant (in_range queue n))
      (invariant (q_vis d queue))
      (invariant (d_below d (len queue)))
      (invariant (== (idx d s) 0))
      (invariant (and (== (len pos) n) (and (== (len par) n) (== (len bn) n))))
      (invariant (>= (idx bn s) 1))
      (invariant (positions d queue pos))
      (invariant (tree_ok cap phi d par bn s n))
      (invariant (closed_q cap phi d queue head n))
      (decreases (+ (* 2 (occurrences d -1)) (- (len queue) head)))
      (let u i64 (idx queue head))
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
      (assert (vis d u))
      (let du i64 (idx d u))
      (let bu i64 (idx bn u))
      (assert (>= du 0))
      (assert (>= bu 1))
      (let q0 i64 (len queue))
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
        (invariant (and (>= du 0) (>= bu 1)))
        (invariant (< head (len queue)))
        (invariant (>= (len queue) q0))
        (invariant (== (idx queue head) u))
        (invariant (== (len d) n))
        (invariant (== (+ (len queue) (occurrences d -1)) n))
        (invariant (>= (occurrences d -1) 0))
        (invariant (ge_m1 d))
        (invariant (in_range queue n))
        (invariant (q_vis d queue))
        (invariant (d_below d (len queue)))
        (invariant (== (idx d s) 0))
        (invariant (and (== (len pos) n) (and (== (len par) n) (== (len bn) n))))
        (invariant (>= (idx bn s) 1))
        (invariant (positions d queue pos))
        (invariant (tree_ok cap phi d par bn s n))
        (invariant (== (idx d u) du))
        (invariant (== (idx bn u) bu))
        (invariant (closed_q cap phi d queue head n))
        (invariant (partial_res cap phi d u v))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (call res_range cap phi n u v)
        (let r i64 (- (idx (idx cap u) v) (idx (idx phi u) v)))
        (assert (== r (res cap phi u v)))
        (if (and (== (idx d v) -1) (> r 0))
          (block
            (assert (< du (len queue)))
            (call count_member d v (len d))
            (ghost-let d0 (seq int) d)
            (ghost-let par0 (seq int) par)
            (ghost-let bn0 (seq int) bn)
            (ghost-let queue0 (seq int) queue)
            (ghost-let pos0 (seq int) pos)
            (let nb i64 (if (< bu r) bu r))
            (ghost-set pos (seq-build n (fn (j4) (if (== j4 v) (len queue) (idx pos j4)))))
            (set-idx d v (+ du 1))
            (set-idx par v u)
            (set-idx bn v nb)
            (push queue v)
            (assert (upd d0 d v (+ du 1)))
            (assert (upd par0 par v u))
            (assert (upd bn0 bn v nb))
            (assert (appended queue0 queue v))
            (assert (upd pos0 pos v (len queue0)))
            (call step_ge d0 d v (+ du 1))
            (call step_range queue0 queue v n)
            (call step_qvis d0 queue0 d queue v (+ du 1))
            (call step_below d0 d (len queue0) v (+ du 1))
            (call step_pos d0 queue0 pos0 d queue pos v (+ du 1))
            (call tree_step cap phi d0 par0 bn0 d par bn s n u v (+ du 1) nb)
            (call step_closed cap phi d0 queue0 d queue head n v (+ du 1))
            (call step_partial cap phi d0 d u v (+ du 1)))
          (call step_seen cap phi d u v))
        (set v (+ v 1)))
      (call step_head cap phi d queue head u n)
      (set head (+ head 1)))
    (call closed_final cap phi d queue pos n)
    (return d par bn)))

(spec augment
  (params (phi0 (vec (vec i64))) (cap (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (d (ref (slice i64))) (par (ref (slice i64)))
          (bn (ref (slice i64))) (n i64) (s i64) (t i64))

  (body
    (assert (>= (idx bn t) 1))

    (let-mut p (vec (vec i64)) phi0)
    (let-mut cur i64 t)
    (while (!= cur s)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur n)))
      (invariant (>= (idx d cur) 0))
      (invariant (>= delta 1))
      (invariant (<= delta (idx bn cur)))
      (invariant (flow_inv cap p n))
      (invariant (same_low p phi0 d (idx d cur) n))
      (invariant (excess phi0 p cur t delta n))
      (decreases (idx d cur))
      (let a i64 (idx par cur))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (>= (idx d a) 0) (< (idx d a) (idx d cur)))))
      (assert (<= (idx bn cur) (res cap phi0 a cur)))

      (ghost-let p0 (seq (seq int)) p)

      (call res_range cap p n cur a)
      (let x i64 (+ (idx (idx p a) cur) delta))
      (let y i64 (- (idx (idx p cur) a) delta))

      (call low_step p0 p2 phi0 d a cur delta (idx d cur) n)

(def max_flow_value
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call wf_from graph)
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (assert (capacities_bounded g))
    (assert (<= n 1000))
    (let-mut cap (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (a0) (seq-build n (fn (b0) 0)))))
    (assert (square cap n))
    (assert (zero_mat cap n))
    (call zero_cap g cap n)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (square cap n))
      (invariant (cap_part g cap u 0))
      (invariant (cap_sound g cap n))
      (invariant (cap_range cap n))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
        (invariant (== deg (len (idx g u))))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (square cap n))
        (invariant (cap_part g cap u i))
        (invariant (cap_sound g cap n))
        (invariant (cap_range cap n))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
        (let tg i64 (get e 0))
        (let c i64 (get e 1))
        (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) tg))
        (assert (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))
        (assert (and (<= 0 tg) (< tg n)))
        (ghost-let c0 (seq (seq int)) cap)
        (let ((c1 (vec (vec i64)))) (call bump cap n u tg c))
        (call cap_step g c0 c1 n u i tg c)
        (set cap c1)
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (call cap_next g cap u i)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (let capm (vec (vec i64)) cap)
    (let-mut flow (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (a1) (seq-build n (fn (b1) 0)))))
    (assert (square flow n))
    (assert (zero_mat flow n))
    (call zero_inv capm flow n)
    (call zero_row flow s n n)
    (forall ((u4 int)) (call zero_row flow u4 n n))
    (let-mut total i64 0)
    (while true
      (invariant (<= n 1000))
      (invariant (square capm n))
      (invariant (cap_part g capm n 0))
      (invariant (cap_sound g capm n))
      (invariant (cap_range capm n))
      (invariant (flow_inv capm flow n))
      (invariant (cons_all flow s t n))

            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (and (<= -100000 (get_flow phi a b)) (<= (get_flow phi a b) 100000))
           (and (<= 0 (get_flow cap a b)) (<= (get_flow cap a b) 100000))
           (== (idx (idx phi a) b) (get_flow phi a b))
           (== (idx (idx cap a) b) (get_flow cap a b)))
  (body
    (assert (square phi n))
    (assert (== (get_flow phi a b) (neg (get_flow phi b a))))
    (assert (<= (get_flow phi a b) (get_flow cap a b)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow phi b a) (get_flow cap b a)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow cap a b)) (<= (get_flow cap a b) 100000)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow cap b a)) (<= (get_flow cap b a) 100000)))))
(lemma pushed_cells (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (p2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int)
                            (x1 int) (y1 int) (n int))
  (requires (cell_set p0 p1 a b x1 n) (cell_set p1 p2 b a y1 n) (!= a b)
            (== x1 (+ (get_flow p0 a b) e)) (== y1 (- (get_flow p0 b a) e)))
  (ensures (pushed p0 p2 a b e n))
  (body))
(lemma inv_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int) (n int))
  (requires (flow_inv cap p0 n) (square p1 n) (pushed p0 p1 a b e n) (!= a b)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (>= e 0) (<= e (res cap p0 a b)))
  (ensures (flow_inv cap p1 n))
  (body
    (assert (skew p1 n))
    (assert (le_cap p1 cap n))))
(lemma low_step (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (base (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int))
                        (a int) (b int) (e int) (lim int) (n int))
  (requires (same_low p0 base d lim n) (pushed p0 p1 a b e n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (== lim (idx d b)) (< (idx d a) lim))
  (ensures (same_low p1 base d (idx d a) n))
  (body))
(lemma row_diff (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (w int) (b int) (e int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (row_rel p0 p1 w b e n) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum p1 w k) (+ (row_sum p0 w k) (if (and (<= 0 b) (< b k)) e 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call row_diff p0 p1 w b e (- k 1) n)
        (assert (== (get_flow p1 w (- k 1)) (+ (get_flow p0 w (- k 1)) (if (== (- k 1) b) e 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma pushed_row (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int) (n int) (w int))
  (requires (pushed p0 p1 a b e n) (!= a b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum p1 w n) (+ (row_sum p0 w n) (- (if (== w a) e 0) (if (== w b) e 0)))))
  (body
    (if (== w a)
      (block (assert (row_rel p0 p1 a b e n)) (call row_diff p0 p1 a b e n n))
      (if (== w b)
        (block (assert (row_rel p0 p1 b a (neg e) n)) (call row_diff p0 p1 b a (neg e) n n))
        (block (assert (row_rel p0 p1 w b 0 n)) (call row_diff p0 p1 w b 0 n n))))))
(lemma excess_step (params (base (seq (seq int))) (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (cur int) (t int) (e int) (n int))
  (requires (excess base p0 cur t e n) (pushed p0 p1 a cur e n) (!= a cur)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur n)))
  (ensures (excess base p1 a t e n))
  (body (forall ((w1 int)) (call pushed_row p0 p1 a cur e n w1))))
(lemma cons_step (params (base (seq (seq int))) (p (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (e int) (n int))
  (requires (cons_all base s t n) (excess base p s t e n))
  (ensures (cons_all p s t n))
  (body))
(lemma row_bound (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (p (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (flow_inv cap p n) (cap_range cap n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (row_sum p u k) (* 100000 k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call row_bound cap p u (- k 1) n)
        (assert (<= (get_flow p u (- k 1)) (get_flow cap u (- k 1))))
        (assert (<= (get_flow cap u (- k 1)) 100000)))
      (block))))
(lemma zero_row (params (z (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (zero_mat z n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum z u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call zero_row z u (- k 1) n)
        (assert (== (get_flow z u (- k 1)) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma zero_inv (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (z (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (square z n) (zero_mat z n) (cap_range cap n))
  (ensures (flow_inv cap z n))
  (body
    (assert (skew z n))
    (assert (le_cap z cap n))))
(lemma zero_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (zero_mat cap n))
  (ensures (cap_sound g cap n) (cap_range cap n))
  (body))

(lemma wf_from (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (wf_g (view cg)))
  (body))
(lemma cap_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma cap_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int)
                        (u int) (i int) (tg int) (c int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== tg (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (== c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
            (cap_part g c0 u i) (cap_sound g c0 n) (cap_range c0 n) (cell_set c0 c1 u tg c n))
  (ensures (cap_part g c1 u (+ i 1)) (cap_sound g c1 n) (cap_range c1 n))
  (body
    (call cap_wit g u i)
    (assert (has_capacity g u tg c))
    (assert (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000)))
    (assert (distinct_t (idx g u)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 tg) (< tg n)))))
(lemma cap_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (cap_part g cap u i) (== i (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (cap_part g cap (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma cap_exact_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int) (y int) (c int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (cap_part g cap n 0) (has_capacity g x y c))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cap x y) c))
  (body
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1) c))))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1)))))

(lemma mem_intro (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len a))))
  (ensures (mem_tgt a k (get (idx a i) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (< i (- k 1)) (call mem_intro a (- k 1) i) (block))))
(lemma not_mem (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_t a) (and (and (<= 0 j) (<= j k)) (< k (len a))))
  (ensures (not (mem_tgt a j (get (idx a k) 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0) (call not_mem a (- j 1) k) (block))))
(lemma part_zero (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (ensures (== (part_sum a h u 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call part_zero a h u (- m 1))
        (assert (not (mem_tgt a 0 (- m 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma part_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (distinct_t a) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (part_sum a h u (+ k 1) m)
               (+ (part_sum a h u k m)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx a k) 0)) (< (get (idx a k) 0) m)) (get_flow h u (get (idx a k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call part_step a h u k (- m 1))
        (call not_mem a k k)
        (assert (== (mem_tgt a (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (or (== (get (idx a k) 0) (- m 1)) (mem_tgt a k (- m 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma part_all (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (row_off a h u) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (part_sum a h u (len a) m) (row_sum h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call part_all a h u (- m 1))
        (assert (=> (not (mem_tgt a (len a) (- m 1))) (== (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
      (block))))
(lemma out_part (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (part_sum (idx g u) h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call out_part g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (distinct_t (idx g u)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
        (call part_step (idx g u) h u (- k 1) (len g)))
      (call part_zero (idx g u) h u (len g)))))
(lemma out_is_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (support g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (row_sum h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_part g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (assert (row_off (idx g u) h u))
    (call part_all (idx g u) h u (len g))))
(lemma out_rows_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf_g g) (support g h))
  (ensures (out_rows g h))
  (body (forall ((u1 int)) (call out_is_row g h u1))))
(lemma cap_tgt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (x int) (y int) (c int))
  (requires (has_capacity g x y c))
  (ensures (row_tgt g x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y)))
    (call mem_intro (idx g x) (len (idx g x)) i)))
(lemma valid_cell (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow h x y) 0)
           (=> (> (get_flow h x y) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (get_flow h x y) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len h))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx h x)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow h x y) (idx (idx h x) y)))
      (assert (== (get_flow h x y) 0)))))
(lemma valid_support_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow h x y) 0) (row_tgt g x y)))
  (body
    (call valid_cell g h s t x y)
    (if (> (get_flow h x y) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (get_flow h x y) c)))
        (call cap_tgt g x y c))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_support (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (support g h))
  (body (forall ((x1 int) (y1 int)) (call valid_support_at g h s t x1 y1))))

(lemma rows_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int))
  (ensures (== (rows_vis h d a 0) 0))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call rows_zero h d (- a 1))
        (assert (== (row_vis h d (- a 1) 0) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma rows_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rows_vis h d a (+ b 1))
               (+ (rows_vis h d a b) (if (vis d b) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h b a) 0))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call rows_step g h d (- a 1) b)
        (assert (== (row_vis h d (- a 1) (+ b 1))
                    (+ (row_vis h d (- a 1) b) (if (vis d b) (get_flow h (- a 1) b) 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma fubini (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rows_vis h d a b) (in_vis g h d b a)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call fubini g h d a (- b 1))
        (call rows_step g h d a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (in_vis g h d b a)
                    (+ (in_vis g h d (- b 1) a) (if (vis d (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) 0)))))
      (call rows_zero h d a))))
(lemma row_cmp (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (dom h f d n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (- (if (vis d u) (row_sum h u k) 0) (row_vis h d u k))
               (- (if (vis d u) (row_sum f u k) 0) (row_vis f d u k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call row_cmp h f d n u (- k 1))
        (assert (=> (and (vis d u) (not (vis d (- k 1)))) (<= (get_flow h u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (- k 1)))))
        (assert (=> (and (not (vis d u)) (vis d (- k 1))) (<= (get_flow f u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma sum_cmp (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (dom h f d n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (<= (- (out_vis h d a n) (rows_vis h d a n)) (- (out_vis f d a n) (rows_vis f d a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call sum_cmp h f d n (- a 1))
        (call row_cmp h f d n (- a 1) n))
      (block))))
(lemma val_sum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (out_rows g h) (is_conserved g h s t) (vis d s) (not (vis d t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (== (- (out_vis h d a n) (in_vis g h d a n)) (if (< s a) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call val_sum g h d s t n (- a 1))
        (assert (== (total_flow_out g h (- a 1)) (row_sum h (- a 1) n)))
        (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- a 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) n))))
      (block))))
(lemma flow_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (dom h f d n)
            (vis d s) (not (vis d t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g h s) (flow_val g f s)))
  (body
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (call valid_support g h s t)
    (call valid_support g f s t)
    (call out_rows_all g h)
    (call out_rows_all g f)
    (call val_sum g h d s t n n)
    (call val_sum g f d s t n n)
    (call fubini g h d n n)
    (call fubini g f d n n)
    (call sum_cmp h f d n n)))

(lemma pos_mat_at (params (p (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (square p n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (== (get_flow (pos_mat p) a b) (if (> (get_flow p a b) 0) (get_flow p a b) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (pos_mat p)) n))
    (assert (== (len (idx (pos_mat p) a)) n))
    (assert (== (idx (idx (pos_mat p) a) b) (if (> (get_flow p a b) 0) (get_flow p a b) 0)))))
(lemma pos_mat_rel (params (p (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (square p n))
  (ensures (pos_rel (pos_mat p) p n))
  (body
    (assert (square (pos_mat p) n))
    (forall ((a1 int) (b1 int)) (call pos_mat_at p n a1 b1))))
(lemma f_nonneg_at (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (pos_rel f p n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))))
(lemma f_resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                         (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (pos_rel f phi n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (assert (== (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow f u v)))
    (if (> (get_flow phi u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= (get_flow phi u v) (get_flow cap u v)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v))))
      (block))))
(lemma f_support_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                            (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (pos_rel f phi n))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow f x y) 0) (row_tgt g x y)))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
      (if (> (get_flow phi x y) 0)
        (block
          (assert (<= (get_flow phi x y) (get_flow cap x y)))
          (assert (has_capacity g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
          (call cap_tgt g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f x y) 0)))
      (assert (== (get_flow f x y) 0)))))
(lemma f_support (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (pos_rel f phi n))
  (ensures (support g f))
  (body (forall ((x1 int) (y1 int)) (call f_support_at g cap phi f n x1 y1))))
(lemma f_row_diff (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (skew phi n) (pos_rel f phi n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (- (row_sum f u k) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k)) (row_sum phi u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call f_row_diff g phi f n u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u (- k 1)) (if (> (get_flow phi u (- k 1)) 0) (get_flow phi u (- k 1)) 0)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f (- k 1) u) (if (> (get_flow phi (- k 1) u) 0) (get_flow phi (- k 1) u) 0)))
        (assert (== (get_flow phi u (- k 1)) (neg (get_flow phi (- k 1) u)))))
      (block))))
(lemma f_net (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (support g f) (skew phi n) (pos_rel f phi n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g f u) (total_flow_in g f u)) (row_sum phi u n)))
  (body
    (call out_is_row g f u)
    (call f_row_diff g phi f n u n)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u n)))))
