  (ensures (and (<= -100000 (get_flow phi a b)) (<= (get_flow phi a b) 100000))
           (and (<= 0 (get_flow cap a b)) (<= (get_flow cap a b) 100000))
           (== (idx (idx phi a) b) (get_flow phi a b))
           (== (idx (idx cap a) b) (get_flow cap a b)))
  (body
    (assert (square phi n))
    (assert (== (get_flow phi a b) (neg (get_flow phi b a))))
    (assert (<= (get_flow phi a b) (get_flow cap a b)))
    (assert (<= (get_flow phi b a) (get_flow cap b a)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow cap a b)) (<= (get_flow cap a b) 100000)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow cap b a)) (<= (get_flow cap b a) 100000)))))
(lemma pushed_cells (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (p2 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int)
                            (x1 int) (y1 int) (n int))
  (requires (cell_set p0 p1 a b x1 n) (cell_set p1 p2 b a y1 n) (!= a b)
            (== x1 (+ (get_flow p0 a b) e)) (== y1 (- (get_flow p0 b a) e)))
  (ensures (pushed p0 p2 a b e n))
  (body))
(lemma inv_step (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int) (n int))
  (requires (flow_inv cap p0 n) (square p1 n) (pushed p0 p1 a b e n) (!= a b)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (>= e 0) (<= e (res cap p0 a b)))
  (ensures (flow_inv cap p1 n))
  (body
    (assert (skew p1 n))
    (assert (le_cap p1 cap n))))
(lemma low_step (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (base (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int))
                        (a int) (b int) (e int) (lim int) (n int))
  (requires (same_low p0 base d lim n) (pushed p0 p1 a b e n)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (== lim (idx d b)) (< (idx d a) lim))
  (ensures (same_low p1 base d (idx d a) n))
  (body))
(lemma row_diff (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (w int) (b int) (e int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (row_rel p0 p1 w b e n) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum p1 w k) (+ (row_sum p0 w k) (if (and (<= 0 b) (< b k)) e 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call row_diff p0 p1 w b e (- k 1) n)
        (assert (== (get_flow p1 w (- k 1)) (+ (get_flow p0 w (- k 1)) (if (== (- k 1) b) e 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma pushed_row (params (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (e int) (n int) (w int))
  (requires (pushed p0 p1 a b e n) (!= a b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum p1 w n) (+ (row_sum p0 w n) (- (if (== w a) e 0) (if (== w b) e 0)))))
  (body
    (if (== w a)
      (block (assert (row_rel p0 p1 a b e n)) (call row_diff p0 p1 a b e n n))
      (if (== w b)
        (block (assert (row_rel p0 p1 b a (neg e) n)) (call row_diff p0 p1 b a (neg e) n n))
        (block (assert (row_rel p0 p1 w b 0 n)) (call row_diff p0 p1 w b 0 n n))))))
(lemma excess_step (params (base (seq (seq int))) (p0 (seq (seq int))) (p1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (cur int) (t int) (e int) (n int))
  (requires (excess base p0 cur t e n) (pushed p0 p1 a cur e n) (!= a cur)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur n)))
  (ensures (excess base p1 a t e n))
  (body (forall ((w1 int)) (call pushed_row p0 p1 a cur e n w1))))
(lemma cons_step (params (base (seq (seq int))) (p (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (e int) (n int))
  (requires (cons_all base s t n) (excess base p s t e n))
  (ensures (cons_all p s t n))
  (body))
(lemma row_bound (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (p (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (flow_inv cap p n) (cap_range cap n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (row_sum p u k) (* 100000 k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call row_bound cap p u (- k 1) n)
        (assert (<= (get_flow p u (- k 1)) (get_flow cap u (- k 1))))
        (assert (<= (get_flow cap u (- k 1)) 100000)))
      (block))))
(lemma zero_row (params (z (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (n int))
  (requires (zero_mat z n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (row_sum z u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call zero_row z u (- k 1) n)
        (assert (== (get_flow z u (- k 1)) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma zero_inv (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (z (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (square z n) (zero_mat z n) (cap_range cap n))
  (ensures (flow_inv cap z n))
  (body
    (assert (skew z n))
    (assert (le_cap z cap n))))
(lemma zero_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (zero_mat cap n))
  (ensures (cap_sound g cap n) (cap_range cap n))
  (body))

(lemma wf_from (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (wf_g (view cg)))
  (body))
(lemma cap_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma cap_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq (seq int))) (c1 (seq (seq int))) (n int)
                        (u int) (i int) (tg int) (c int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== tg (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (== c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
            (cap_part g c0 u i) (cap_sound g c0 n) (cap_range c0 n) (cell_set c0 c1 u tg c n))
  (ensures (cap_part g c1 u (+ i 1)) (cap_sound g c1 n) (cap_range c1 n))
  (body
    (call cap_wit g u i)
    (assert (has_capacity g u tg c))
    (assert (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000)))
    (assert (distinct_t (idx g u)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 tg) (< tg n)))))
(lemma cap_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (cap_part g cap u i) (== i (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (cap_part g cap (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma cap_exact_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int) (y int) (c int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (cap_part g cap n 0) (has_capacity g x y c))
  (ensures (== (get_flow cap x y) c))
  (body
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1) c))))
    (assert (== (get_flow cap x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1)))))

(lemma mem_intro (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (k int) (i int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len a))))
  (ensures (mem_tgt a k (get (idx a i) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (< i (- k 1)) (call mem_intro a (- k 1) i) (block))))
(lemma not_mem (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (distinct_t a) (and (and (<= 0 j) (<= j k)) (< k (len a))))
  (ensures (not (mem_tgt a j (get (idx a k) 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body (if (> j 0) (call not_mem a (- j 1) k) (block))))
(lemma part_zero (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (ensures (== (part_sum a h u 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call part_zero a h u (- m 1))
        (assert (not (mem_tgt a 0 (- m 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma part_step (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (distinct_t a) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (part_sum a h u (+ k 1) m)
               (+ (part_sum a h u k m)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx a k) 0)) (< (get (idx a k) 0) m)) (get_flow h u (get (idx a k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call part_step a h u k (- m 1))
        (call not_mem a k k)
        (assert (== (mem_tgt a (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (or (== (get (idx a k) 0) (- m 1)) (mem_tgt a k (- m 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma part_all (params (a (seq (tuple int int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (row_off a h u) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (part_sum a h u (len a) m) (row_sum h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call part_all a h u (- m 1))
        (assert (=> (not (mem_tgt a (len a) (- m 1))) (== (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
      (block))))
(lemma out_part (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (part_sum (idx g u) h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call out_part g h u (- k 1))
        (assert (distinct_t (idx g u)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
        (call part_step (idx g u) h u (- k 1) (len g)))
      (call part_zero (idx g u) h u (len g)))))
(lemma out_is_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (support g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (row_sum h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_part g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (assert (row_off (idx g u) h u))
    (call part_all (idx g u) h u (len g))))
(lemma out_rows_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf_g g) (support g h))
  (ensures (out_rows g h))
  (body (forall ((u1 int)) (call out_is_row g h u1))))
(lemma cap_tgt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (x int) (y int) (c int))
  (requires (has_capacity g x y c))
  (ensures (row_tgt g x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
           (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y)))
    (call mem_intro (idx g x) (len (idx g x)) i)))
(lemma valid_cell (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow h x y) 0)
           (=> (> (get_flow h x y) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (get_flow h x y) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len h))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx h x)))))
      (assert (== (get_flow h x y) (idx (idx h x) y)))
      (assert (== (get_flow h x y) 0)))))
(lemma valid_support_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow h x y) 0) (row_tgt g x y)))
  (body
    (call valid_cell g h s t x y)
    (if (> (get_flow h x y) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g x y c) (<= (get_flow h x y) c)))
        (call cap_tgt g x y c))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_support (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (support g h))
  (body (forall ((x1 int) (y1 int)) (call valid_support_at g h s t x1 y1))))

(lemma rows_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int))
  (ensures (== (rows_vis h d a 0) 0))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call rows_zero h d (- a 1))
        (assert (== (row_vis h d (- a 1) 0) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma rows_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rows_vis h d a (+ b 1))
               (+ (rows_vis h d a b) (if (vis d b) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h b a) 0))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call rows_step g h d (- a 1) b)
        (assert (== (row_vis h d (- a 1) (+ b 1))
                    (+ (row_vis h d (- a 1) b) (if (vis d b) (get_flow h (- a 1) b) 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma fubini (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rows_vis h d a b) (in_vis g h d b a)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call fubini g h d a (- b 1))
        (call rows_step g h d a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (in_vis g h d b a)
                    (+ (in_vis g h d (- b 1) a) (if (vis d (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) 0)))))
      (call rows_zero h d a))))
(lemma row_cmp (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (dom h f d n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (- (if (vis d u) (row_sum h u k) 0) (row_vis h d u k))
               (- (if (vis d u) (row_sum f u k) 0) (row_vis f d u k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call row_cmp h f d n u (- k 1))
        (assert (=> (and (vis d u) (not (vis d (- k 1)))) (<= (get_flow h u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (- k 1)))))
        (assert (=> (and (not (vis d u)) (vis d (- k 1))) (<= (get_flow f u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (- k 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma sum_cmp (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (dom h f d n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (<= (- (out_vis h d a n) (rows_vis h d a n)) (- (out_vis f d a n) (rows_vis f d a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call sum_cmp h f d n (- a 1))
        (call row_cmp h f d n (- a 1) n))
      (block))))
(lemma val_sum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (n int) (a int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (out_rows g h) (is_conserved g h s t) (vis d s) (not (vis d t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (== (- (out_vis h d a n) (in_vis g h d a n)) (if (< s a) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call val_sum g h d s t n (- a 1))
        (assert (== (total_flow_out g h (- a 1)) (row_sum h (- a 1) n)))
        (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- a 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) n))))
      (block))))
(lemma flow_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (d (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf_g g) (== (len g) n) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (dom h f d n)
            (vis d s) (not (vis d t)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g h s) (flow_val g f s)))
  (body
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (assert (is_conserved g f s t))
    (call valid_support g h s t)
    (call valid_support g f s t)
    (call out_rows_all g h)
    (call out_rows_all g f)
    (call val_sum g h d s t n n)
    (call val_sum g f d s t n n)
    (call fubini g h d n n)
    (call fubini g f d n n)
    (call sum_cmp h f d n n)))

(lemma pos_mat_at (params (p (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (square p n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (== (get_flow (pos_mat p) a b) (if (> (get_flow p a b) 0) (get_flow p a b) 0)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (pos_mat p)) n))
    (assert (== (len (idx (pos_mat p) a)) n))
    (assert (== (idx (idx (pos_mat p) a) b) (if (> (get_flow p a b) 0) (get_flow p a b) 0)))))
(lemma pos_mat_rel (params (p (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (square p n))
  (ensures (pos_rel (pos_mat p) p n))
  (body
    (assert (square (pos_mat p) n))
    (forall ((a1 int) (b1 int)) (call pos_mat_at p n a1 b1))))
(lemma f_nonneg_at (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (pos_rel f p n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))))
(lemma f_nonneg (params (f (seq (seq int))) (p (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (pos_rel f p n))
  (ensures (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
        (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (forall ((u1 int) (v1 int)) (call f_nonneg_at f p n u1 v1))))
(lemma f_resp_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                         (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (pos_rel f phi n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
               (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (assert (== (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow f u v)))
    (if (> (get_flow phi u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (<= (get_flow phi u v) (get_flow cap u v)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cap u v))))
      (block))))
(lemma f_resp_cell (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                           (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (pos_rel f phi n))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
               (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
                   (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c))))))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len f) n))
        (assert (== (len (idx f u)) n))
        (call f_resp_at g cap phi f n u v))
      (block))))
(lemma f_resp (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (pos_rel f phi n))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body (forall ((u2 int) (v2 int)) (call f_resp_cell g cap phi f n u2 v2))))
(lemma f_support_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                            (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (pos_rel f phi n))
  (ensures (=> (!= (get_flow f x y) 0) (row_tgt g x y)))
  (body
    (assert (square f n))
    (if (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
      (if (> (get_flow phi x y) 0)
        (block
          (assert (<= (get_flow phi x y) (get_flow cap x y)))
          (assert (has_capacity g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
          (call cap_tgt g x y (get_flow cap x y)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f x y) 0)))
      (assert (== (get_flow f x y) 0)))))
(lemma f_support (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (phi (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (cap_sound g cap n) (flow_inv cap phi n) (pos_rel f phi n))
  (ensures (support g f))

      (and (and (> (len p0) 0) (and (== (idx p0 0) x) (== (idx p0 (- (len p0) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges t p0)))
    (call simple_ex t p0)
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (simple_path t p x y))
    (assert (in_s m (idx p 0)))
    (assert (not (in_s m (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (call first_cross m p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (and (in_s m (idx p j)) (not (in_s m (idx p (+ j 1)))))))
    (assert (cross_path t m x y p j))))
(lemma simple_ne (params (p (seq int)) (s int) (h int))
  (requires (simple p) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len p))) (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len p))) (!= s h))
  (ensures (!= (idx p s) (idx p h)))
  (body (if (< s h)
    (assert (!= (idx p s) (idx p h)))
    (assert (!= (idx p h) (idx p s))))))
(lemma pair_differs (params (p (seq int)) (j int) (h int))
  (requires (simple p) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (and (<= 0 h) (< h (- (len p) 1))) (!= h j))
  (ensures (not (or (and (== (idx p h) (idx p j)) (== (idx p (+ h 1)) (idx p (+ j 1))))
                    (and (== (idx p h) (idx p (+ j 1))) (== (idx p (+ h 1)) (idx p j))))))
  (body
    (call simple_ne p h j)
    (if (== h (+ j 1))
      (call simple_ne p (+ h 1) j)
      (call simple_ne p h (+ j 1)))))

(lemma total_concat (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat a b)) (+ (total_weight a) (total_weight b))))
  (decreases (len a))
  (body (if (== (len a) 0)
    (block
      (assert (== (concat a b) b))
      (assert (== (total_weight a) 0)))
    (block
      (ghost-let s (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat a b))
      (assert (> (len s) 0))
      (assert (== (idx s 0) (idx a 0)))
      (assert (== (drop s 1) (concat (drop a 1) b)))
      (call total_concat (drop a 1) b)
      (assert (== (total_weight a) (+ (get (idx a 0) 2) (total_weight (drop a 1)))))
      (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))))))
(lemma total_unit (params (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (seq-lit e)) (get e 2)))
  (body
    (ghost-let s (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit e))
    (assert (== (len s) 1))
    (assert (== (idx s 0) e))
    (assert (== (len (drop s 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (drop s 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (get e 2)))))
(lemma total_remove (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight r) (+ (get (idx r i) 2) (total_weight (remove_at r i)))))
  (decreases i)
  (body (if (== i 0)
    (block
      (assert (== (remove_at r i) (drop r 1)))
      (assert (== (total_weight r) (+ (get (idx r 0) 2) (total_weight (drop r 1))))))
    (block
      (ghost-let r1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop r 1))
      (ghost-let s (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove_at r i))
      (assert (== (len s) (- (len r) 1)))
      (assert (== (idx s 0) (idx r 0)))
      (assert (== (drop s 1) (remove_at r1 (- i 1))))
      (call total_remove r1 (- i 1))
      (assert (== (idx r1 (- i 1)) (idx r i)))
      (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))
      (assert (== (total_weight r) (+ (get (idx r 0) 2) (total_weight r1))))))))
(lemma t2_weight (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r))) (<= (get e 2) (get (idx r i) 2)))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight (t_new f e r i)) (total_weight (concat f r))))
  (body
    (assert (== (t_new f e r i) (concat (concat f (seq-lit e)) (remove_at r i))))
    (call total_concat f r)
    (call total_remove r i)
    (call total_concat (concat f (seq-lit e)) (remove_at r i))
    (call total_concat f (seq-lit e))
    (call total_unit e)))

(lemma t2_len (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r))))
  (ensures (== (len (t_new f e r i)) (+ (len f) (len r))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (remove_at r i)) (- (len r) 1)))
    (assert (== (t_new f e r i) (concat (concat f (seq-lit e)) (remove_at r i))))
    (assert (== (len (concat f (seq-lit e))) (+ (len f) 1)))))
(lemma t2_idx (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (l int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (== (len (t_new f e r i)) (+ (len f) (len r)))
    (and (<= 0 l) (< l (+ (len f) (len r)))))
  (ensures (== (idx (t_new f e r i) l)
               (if (< l (len f)) (idx f l)
                 (if (== l (len f)) e
                   (if (<= l (+ (len f) i)) (idx r (- l (+ (len f) 1))) (idx r (- l (len f))))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let f2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f (seq-lit e)))
    (ghost-let s (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove_at r i))
    (assert (== (t_new f e r i) (concat f2 s)))
    (assert (== (len f2) (+ (len f) 1)))
    (assert (== (len s) (- (len r) 1)))
    (if (<= l (len f))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat f2 s) l) (idx f2 l)))
        (if (< l (len f))
          (assert (== (idx f2 l) (idx f l)))
          (assert (== (idx f2 l) e))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat f2 s) l) (idx s (- l (+ (len f) 1)))))
        (assert (== (idx s (- l (+ (len f) 1)))
                    (if (< (- l (+ (len f) 1)) i)
                      (idx r (- l (+ (len f) 1)))
                      (idx r (+ (- l (+ (len f) 1)) 1)))))))))
(lemma t2_edge (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len f) (len r))))
    (!= k (+ (len f) i)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (t_new f e r i) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 0) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 1)))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f r))
    (ghost-let t2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (t_new f e r i))
    (ghost-let l int (if (< k (len f)) k (if (< k (+ (len f) i)) (+ k 1) k)))
    (call t2_len f e r i)
    (call t2_idx f e r i l)
    (if (< k (len f))
      (assert (== (idx t k) (idx f k)))
      (assert (== (idx t k) (idx r (- k (len f))))))
    (assert (== (idx t2 l) (idx t k)))
    (call edge_ends t2 l (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1))))
(lemma valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (l int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g (concat f r))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (== (len (t_new f e r i)) (+ (len f) (len r)))
    (and (<= 0 l) (< l (+ (len f) (len r)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (t_new f e r i) l) 0) (get (idx (t_new f e r i) l) 1) (get (idx (t_new f e r i) l) 2)))
  (body
    (call t2_idx f e r i l)
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f r))
    (ghost-let q int (if (< l (len f)) l (if (<= l (+ (len f) i)) (- l 1) l)))
    (if (== l (len f))
      (assert (== (idx (t_new f e r i) l) e))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t q) (idx (t_new f e r i) l)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t q) 0) (get (idx t q) 1) (get (idx t q) 2)))))))
(lemma t_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g (concat f r))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r))))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (t_new f e r i)))
  (body
    (call t2_len f e r i)
    (forall ((l int)) (call valid_at g f e r i l))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g (t_new f e r i)))))
(lemma step_kept (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (p (seq int)) (j int) (h int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (path_follows_edges (concat f r) p)
    (simple p)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
    (ends (idx (concat f r) (+ (len f) i)) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (- (len p) 1)))
    (!= h j))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (t_new f e r i) (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f r))
    (ghost-let a int (idx p h))
    (ghost-let b int (idx p (+ h 1)))
    (call path_step t p h)
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t)))
           (or (and (== (get (idx t k) 0) a) (== (get (idx t k) 1) b))
               (and (== (get (idx t k) 0) b) (== (get (idx t k) 1) a)))))
    (call pair_differs p j h)
    (assert (!= k (+ (len f) i)))
    (call t2_edge f e r i k)
    (if (and (== (get (idx t k) 0) a) (== (get (idx t k) 1) b))
      (block)
      (call edge_sym (t_new f e r i) b a))))
(lemma bridge (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (p (seq int)) (j int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (simple_path (concat f r) p x y)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
    (ends (idx (concat f r) (+ (len f) i)) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))
    (ends e x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (t_new f e r i) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let t2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (t_new f e r i))
    (assert (path_follows_edges (concat f r) p))
    (assert (simple p))
    (forall ((h int)) (call step_kept f e r i p j h))
    (assert (steps_in t2 p 0 j))
    (assert (steps_in t2 p (+ j 1) (- (len p) 1)))
    (call seg_conn t2 p 0 j)
    (call seg_conn t2 p (+ j 1) (- (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))
    (call t2_len f e r i)
    (call t2_idx f e r i (len f))
    (assert (== (idx t2 (len f)) e))
    (call edge_ends t2 (len f) x y)
    (call edge_conn t2 x y)
    (call conn_sym t2 x (idx p j))
    (call conn_sym t2 (idx p (+ j 1)) y)
    (call conn_trans t2 (idx p j) x y)
    (call conn_trans t2 (idx p j) y (idx p (+ j 1)))))
(lemma maps_t2_at (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len f) (len r))))
    (edges_connected (t_new f e r i)
      (get (idx (concat f r) (+ (len f) i)) 0)
      (get (idx (concat f r) (+ (len f) i)) 1)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (t_new f e r i) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 0) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 1)))
  (body (if (== k (+ (len f) i))
    (block)
    (block
      (call t2_edge f e r i k)
      (call edge_conn (t_new f e r i) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 0) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 1))))))
(lemma span_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g t) (maps_conn t t2) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t2 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected t u v))
    (call conn_mono t t2 u v)))
(lemma span_lift (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning g t) (maps_conn t t2))
  (ensures (is_spanning g t2))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_at g t t2 u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g t2))))
(lemma not_inner (params (m (seq int)) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (c int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (inside m f)
    (and (<= 0 c) (< c (+ (len f) (len r))))
    (ends (idx (concat f r) c) a b)
    (not (in_s m b)))
  (ensures (>= c (len f)))
  (body (if (< c (len f))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx (concat f r) c) (idx f c)))
      (assert (in_s m (get (idx f c) 0)))
      (assert (in_s m (get (idx f c) 1))))
    (block))))
(lemma cross_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (m (seq int)) (w int) (c int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g t)
    (min_cross g m w)
    (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len t)))
    (ends (idx t c) a b)
    (in_s m a)
    (not (in_s m b)))
  (ensures (<= w (get (idx t c) 2)))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t c) 0) (get (idx t c) 1) (get (idx t c) 2)))
    (assert (!= (in_s m (get (idx t c) 0)) (in_s m (get (idx t c) 1))))))
(lemma exch_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g (concat f2 r2)) (<= (total_weight (concat f2 r2)) (total_weight other)))
  (ensures (exch g f2 other))
  (body))
(lemma exch_core (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (m (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning_tree g (concat f r))
    (inside m f)
    (in_s m x)
    (not (in_s m y))
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (ends e x y)
    (min_cross g m (get e 2)))
  (ensures (exch g (concat f (seq-lit e)) (concat f r)))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f r))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g t))
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (edges_connected t x y))
    (call find_cross t m x y)
    (obtain ((p (seq int)) (j int)) (cross_path t m x y p j))
    (assert (simple_path t p x y))
    (assert (path_follows_edges t p))
    (call path_step t p j)
    (ghost-let a int (idx p j))
    (ghost-let b int (idx p (+ j 1)))
    (assert (in_s m a))
    (assert (not (in_s m b)))
    (obtain ((c int))
      (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len t)))
           (or (and (== (get (idx t c) 0) a) (== (get (idx t c) 1) b))
               (and (== (get (idx t c) 0) b) (== (get (idx t c) 1) a)))))
    (assert (ends (idx t c) a b))
    (call not_inner m f r c a b)
    (ghost-let i int (- c (len f)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r))))
    (assert (== (idx t c) (idx r i)))
    (call cross_weight g t m (get e 2) c a b)
    (ghost-let t2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (t_new f e r i))
    (call t2_len f e r i)
    (call t_valid g f e r i)
    (call bridge f e r i p j x y)
    (if (and (== (get (idx t c) 0) a) (== (get (idx t c) 1) b))
      (block)
      (call conn_sym t2 a b))
    (forall ((k int)) (call maps_t2_at f e r i k))
    (assert (maps_conn t t2))
    (call span_lift g t t2)
    (assert (== (len t2) (len t)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g t2))
    (call t2_weight f e r i)
    (assert (== t2 (concat (concat f (seq-lit e)) (remove_at r i))))
    (call exch_intro g (concat f (seq-lit e)) (remove_at r i) t)))
(lemma exch_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (m (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (optimal_ext g f0)
    (is_spanning_tree g other)
    (inside m f0)
    (in_s m x)
    (not (in_s m y))
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (ends e x y)
    (min_cross g m (get e 2)))
  (ensures (exch g (concat f0 (seq-lit e)) other))
  (body
    (assert (exch g f0 other))
    (obtain ((r (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat f0 r)) (<= (total_weight (concat f0 r)) (total_weight other))))
    (call exch_core g f0 r e m x y)
    (assert (exch g (concat f0 (seq-lit e)) (concat f0 r)))
    (obtain ((r2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat (concat f0 (seq-lit e)) r2))
           (<= (total_weight (concat (concat f0 (seq-lit e)) r2)) (total_weight (concat f0 r)))))
    (call exch_intro g (concat f0 (seq-lit e)) r2 other)))

(lemma valid_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (l int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g f0)
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (== f1 (concat f0 (seq-lit e)))
    (and (<= 0 l) (< l (len f1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx f1 l) 0) (get (idx f1 l) 1) (get (idx f1 l) 2)))
  (body (if (< l (len f0))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx f1 l) (idx f0 l)))
      (assert (has_edge g (get (idx f0 l) 0) (get (idx f0 l) 1) (get (idx f0 l) 2))))
    (assert (== (idx f1 l) e)))))
(lemma step_inside (params (m0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (f0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (k int))
  (requires
    (inside m0 f0)
    (upd m0 m1 y 1)
    (== f1 (concat f0 (seq-lit e)))
    (ends e x y)
    (in_s m0 x)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len f1))))
  (ensures (and (in_s m1 (get (idx f1 k) 0)) (in_s m1 (get (idx f1 k) 1))))
  (body (if (< k (len f0))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx f1 k) (idx f0 k)))
      (assert (and (in_s m0 (get (idx f0 k) 0)) (in_s m0 (get (idx f0 k) 1))))
      (call in_s_up m0 m1 y (get (idx f0 k) 0))
      (call in_s_up m0 m1 y (get (idx f0 k) 1)))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx f1 k) e))
      (call in_s_up m0 m1 y x)
      (assert (in_s m1 y))))))
(lemma push_at (params (f0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (== f1 (concat f0 (seq-lit e))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len f0))))
  (ensures (edges_connected f1 (get (idx f0 k) 0) (get (idx f0 k) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len f1) (+ (len f0) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx f1 k) (idx f0 k)))
    (call edge_ends f1 k (get (idx f0 k) 0) (get (idx f0 k) 1))
    (call edge_conn f1 (get (idx f0 k) 0) (get (idx f0 k) 1))))
(lemma push_maps (params (f0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (== f1 (concat f0 (seq-lit e))))
  (ensures (maps_conn f0 f1))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call push_at f0 f1 e k))
    (assert (maps_conn f0 f1))))
(lemma step_linked (params (m0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (f0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires
    (linked m0 f0)
    (upd m0 m1 y 1)
    (== f1 (concat f0 (seq-lit e)))
    (ends e x y)
    (in_s m0 x)
    (in_s m1 z))
  (ensures (edges_connected f1 0 z))
  (body
    (call push_maps f0 f1 e)
    (if (== z y)
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected f0 0 x))
        (call conn_mono f0 f1 0 x)
        (assert (== (len f1) (+ (len f0) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx f1 (len f0)) e))
        (call edge_ends f1 (len f0) x y)
        (call conn_step f1 0 x y))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx m1 z) (idx m0 z)))
        (assert (in_s m0 z))
        (assert (edges_connected f0 0 z))
        (call conn_mono f0 f1 0 z)))))
(lemma prim_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m0 (seq int)) (m1 (seq int)) (f0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (prim_ok g m0 f0)
    (upd m0 m1 y 1)
    (== f1 (concat f0 (seq-lit e)))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (ends e x y)
    (in_s m0 x)
    (not (in_s m0 y))
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))

  (requires (edge_in_set t a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected t a b))
  (body (call conn_refl t a) (call conn_step t a a b)))
(lemma trans_seg (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (q (seq int)) (h int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges t q) (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len q))) (edges_connected t a (idx q 0)))
  (ensures (edges_connected t a (idx q h)))
  (decreases h)
  (body (if (> h 0)
    (block
      (call trans_seg t a q (- h 1))
      (call path_step t q (- h 1))
      (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q (- h 1)) (idx q h)))
      (call conn_step t a (idx q (- h 1)) (idx q h)))
    (block))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected t a b) (edges_connected t b c))
  (ensures (edges_connected t a c))
  (body
    (obtain ((q (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) b) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) c))) (path_follows_edges t q)))
    (call trans_seg t a q (- (len q) 1))))
(lemma rev_seg (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (h int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges t p) (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t (idx p h) (idx p 0)))
  (decreases h)
  (body (if (> h 0)
    (block
      (call rev_seg t p (- h 1))
      (call path_step t p (- h 1))
      (assert (edge_in_set t (idx p (- h 1)) (idx p h)))
      (call edge_sym t (idx p (- h 1)) (idx p h))
      (call edge_conn t (idx p h) (idx p (- h 1)))
      (call conn_trans t (idx p h) (idx p (- h 1)) (idx p 0)))
    (call conn_refl t (idx p 0)))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edges_connected t a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected t b a))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (call rev_seg t p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma edge_lift (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (maps_conn t t2) (edge_in_set t a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected t2 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t)))
           (or (and (== (get (idx t k) 0) a) (== (get (idx t k) 1) b))
               (and (== (get (idx t k) 0) b) (== (get (idx t k) 1) a)))))
    (assert (edges_connected t2 (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1)))
    (if (and (== (get (idx t k) 0) a) (== (get (idx t k) 1) b))
      (block)
      (call conn_sym t2 b a))))
(lemma conn_lift (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (h int))
  (requires (maps_conn t t2) (path_follows_edges t p) (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t2 (idx p 0) (idx p h)))
  (decreases h)
  (body (if (> h 0)
    (block
      (call conn_lift t t2 p (- h 1))
      (call path_step t p (- h 1))
      (assert (edge_in_set t (idx p (- h 1)) (idx p h)))
      (call edge_lift t t2 (idx p (- h 1)) (idx p h))
      (call conn_trans t2 (idx p 0) (idx p (- h 1)) (idx p h)))
    (call conn_refl t2 (idx p 0)))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (maps_conn t t2) (edges_connected t a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected t2 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (call conn_lift t t2 p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma seg_conn (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires (steps_in t p lo hi) (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo hi)) (< hi (len p)))
  (ensures (edges_connected t (idx p lo) (idx p hi)))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body (if (< lo hi)
    (block
      (assert (steps_in t p lo (- hi 1)))
      (call seg_conn t p lo (- hi 1))
      (assert (edge_in_set t (idx p (- hi 1)) (idx p hi)))
      (call conn_step t (idx p lo) (idx p (- hi 1)) (idx p hi)))
    (call conn_refl t (idx p lo)))))

(lemma cut_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (r (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges t p)
    (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p)))
    (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
    (== (len r) (- (len p) (- j i)))
    (forall ((h int)) (=> (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len r)))
      (== (idx r h) (if (<= h i) (idx p h) (idx p (+ h (- j i)))))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len r) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t (idx r k) (idx r (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (if (< k i)
      (block
        (call path_step t p k)
        (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== k i)
        (block
          (call path_step t p j)
          (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p j)))
          (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
        (block
          (call path_step t p (+ k (- j i)))
          (assert (== (idx r k) (idx p (+ k (- j i)))))
          (assert (== (idx r (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ (+ k (- j i)) 1)))))))))
(lemma simple_ex (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (path_follows_edges t p))
  (ensures (exists ((q (seq int))) (simple_path t q (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body (if (simple p)
    (assert (simple_path t p (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (block
      (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i) (idx p j))))
      (ghost-let r (seq int) (seq-build (- (len p) (- j i)) (fn (h) (if (<= h i) (idx p h) (idx p (+ h (- j i)))))))
      (forall ((k int)) (call cut_at t p i j r k))
      (assert (path_follows_edges t r))
      (assert (== (idx r 0) (idx p 0)))
      (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
      (call simple_ex t r)))))
(lemma first_cross (params (m (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (h int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len p))) (in_s m (idx p 0)) (not (in_s m (idx p h))))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j h)) (and (in_s m (idx p j)) (not (in_s m (idx p (+ j 1))))))))
  (decreases h)
  (body (if (in_s m (idx p (- h 1)))
    (assert (not (in_s m (idx p (+ (- h 1) 1)))))
    (call first_cross m p (- h 1)))))
(lemma find_cross (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (m (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_connected t x y) (in_s m x) (not (in_s m y)))
  (ensures (exists ((p (seq int)) (j int)) (cross_path t m x y p j)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p0 (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p0) 0) (and (== (idx p0 0) x) (== (idx p0 (- (len p0) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges t p0)))
    (call simple_ex t p0)
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (simple_path t p x y))
    (assert (in_s m (idx p 0)))
    (assert (not (in_s m (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (call first_cross m p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (and (in_s m (idx p j)) (not (in_s m (idx p (+ j 1)))))))
    (assert (cross_path t m x y p j))))
(lemma simple_ne (params (p (seq int)) (s int) (h int))
  (requires (simple p) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len p))) (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len p))) (!= s h))
  (ensures (!= (idx p s) (idx p h)))
  (body (if (< s h)
    (assert (!= (idx p s) (idx p h)))
    (assert (!= (idx p h) (idx p s))))))
(lemma pair_differs (params (p (seq int)) (j int) (h int))
  (requires (simple p) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (and (<= 0 h) (< h (- (len p) 1))) (!= h j))
  (ensures (not (or (and (== (idx p h) (idx p j)) (== (idx p (+ h 1)) (idx p (+ j 1))))
                    (and (== (idx p h) (idx p (+ j 1))) (== (idx p (+ h 1)) (idx p j))))))
  (body
    (call simple_ne p h j)
    (if (== h (+ j 1))
      (call simple_ne p (+ h 1) j)
      (call simple_ne p h (+ j 1)))))

(lemma total_concat (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat a b)) (+ (total_weight a) (total_weight b))))
  (decreases (len a))
  (body (if (== (len a) 0)
    (block
      (assert (== (concat a b) b))
      (assert (== (total_weight a) 0)))
    (block
      (ghost-let s (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat a b))
      (assert (> (len s) 0))
      (assert (== (idx s 0) (idx a 0)))
      (assert (== (drop s 1) (concat (drop a 1) b)))
      (call total_concat (drop a 1) b)
      (assert (== (total_weight a) (+ (get (idx a 0) 2) (total_weight (drop a 1)))))
      (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))))))
(lemma total_unit (params (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (seq-lit e)) (get e 2)))
  (body
    (ghost-let s (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-lit e))
    (assert (== (len s) 1))
    (assert (== (idx s 0) e))
    (assert (== (len (drop s 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (drop s 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (get e 2)))))
(lemma total_remove (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight r) (+ (get (idx r i) 2) (total_weight (remove_at r i)))))
  (decreases i)
  (body (if (== i 0)
    (block
      (assert (== (remove_at r i) (drop r 1)))
      (assert (== (total_weight r) (+ (get (idx r 0) 2) (total_weight (drop r 1))))))
    (block
      (ghost-let r1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop r 1))
      (ghost-let s (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove_at r i))
      (assert (== (len s) (- (len r) 1)))
      (assert (== (idx s 0) (idx r 0)))
      (assert (== (drop s 1) (remove_at r1 (- i 1))))
      (call total_remove r1 (- i 1))
      (assert (== (idx r1 (- i 1)) (idx r i)))
      (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))
      (assert (== (total_weight r) (+ (get (idx r 0) 2) (total_weight r1))))))))
(lemma t2_weight (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r))) (<= (get e 2) (get (idx r i) 2)))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight (t_new f e r i)) (total_weight (concat f r))))
  (body
    (assert (== (t_new f e r i) (concat (concat f (seq-lit e)) (remove_at r i))))
    (call total_concat f r)
    (call total_remove r i)
    (call total_concat (concat f (seq-lit e)) (remove_at r i))
    (call total_concat f (seq-lit e))
    (call total_unit e)))

(lemma t2_len (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r))))
  (ensures (== (len (t_new f e r i)) (+ (len f) (len r))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (remove_at r i)) (- (len r) 1)))
    (assert (== (t_new f e r i) (concat (concat f (seq-lit e)) (remove_at r i))))
    (assert (== (len (concat f (seq-lit e))) (+ (len f) 1)))))
(lemma t2_idx (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (l int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (== (len (t_new f e r i)) (+ (len f) (len r)))
    (and (<= 0 l) (< l (+ (len f) (len r)))))
  (ensures (== (idx (t_new f e r i) l)
               (if (< l (len f)) (idx f l)
                 (if (== l (len f)) e
                   (if (<= l (+ (len f) i)) (idx r (- l (+ (len f) 1))) (idx r (- l (len f))))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let f2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f (seq-lit e)))
    (ghost-let s (seq (tuple int int int)) (remove_at r i))
    (assert (== (t_new f e r i) (concat f2 s)))
    (assert (== (len f2) (+ (len f) 1)))
    (assert (== (len s) (- (len r) 1)))
    (if (<= l (len f))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat f2 s) l) (idx f2 l)))
        (if (< l (len f))
          (assert (== (idx f2 l) (idx f l)))
          (assert (== (idx f2 l) e))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat f2 s) l) (idx s (- l (+ (len f) 1)))))
        (assert (== (idx s (- l (+ (len f) 1)))
                    (if (< (- l (+ (len f) 1)) i)
                      (idx r (- l (+ (len f) 1)))
                      (idx r (+ (- l (+ (len f) 1)) 1)))))))))
(lemma t2_edge (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len f) (len r))))
    (!= k (+ (len f) i)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (t_new f e r i) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 0) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 1)))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f r))
    (ghost-let t2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (t_new f e r i))
    (ghost-let l int (if (< k (len f)) k (if (< k (+ (len f) i)) (+ k 1) k)))
    (call t2_len f e r i)
    (call t2_idx f e r i l)
    (if (< k (len f))
      (assert (== (idx t k) (idx f k)))
      (assert (== (idx t k) (idx r (- k (len f))))))
    (assert (== (idx t2 l) (idx t k)))
    (call edge_ends t2 l (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1))))
(lemma valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (l int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g (concat f r))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (== (len (t_new f e r i)) (+ (len f) (len r)))
    (and (<= 0 l) (< l (+ (len f) (len r)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (t_new f e r i) l) 0) (get (idx (t_new f e r i) l) 1) (get (idx (t_new f e r i) l) 2)))
  (body
    (call t2_idx f e r i l)
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f r))
    (ghost-let q int (if (< l (len f)) l (if (<= l (+ (len f) i)) (- l 1) l)))
    (if (== l (len f))
      (assert (== (idx (t_new f e r i) l) e))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t q) (idx (t_new f e r i) l)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t q) 0) (get (idx t q) 1) (get (idx t q) 2)))))))
(lemma t_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g (concat f r))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r))))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (t_new f e r i)))
  (body
    (call t2_len f e r i)
    (forall ((l int)) (call valid_at g f e r i l))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g (t_new f e r i)))))
(lemma step_kept (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (p (seq int)) (j int) (h int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (path_follows_edges (concat f r) p)
    (simple p)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
    (ends (idx (concat f r) (+ (len f) i)) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))
    (and (<= 0 h) (< h (- (len p) 1)))
    (!= h j))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (t_new f e r i) (idx p h) (idx p (+ h 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f r))
    (ghost-let a int (idx p h))
    (ghost-let b int (idx p (+ h 1)))
    (call path_step t p h)
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t)))
           (or (and (== (get (idx t k) 0) a) (== (get (idx t k) 1) b))
               (and (== (get (idx t k) 0) b) (== (get (idx t k) 1) a)))))
    (call pair_differs p j h)
    (assert (!= k (+ (len f) i)))
    (call t2_edge f e r i k)
    (if (and (== (get (idx t k) 0) a) (== (get (idx t k) 1) b))
      (block)
      (call edge_sym (t_new f e r i) b a))))
(lemma bridge (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (p (seq int)) (j int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (simple_path (concat f r) p x y)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
    (ends (idx (concat f r) (+ (len f) i)) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))
    (ends e x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (t_new f e r i) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let t2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (t_new f e r i))
    (assert (path_follows_edges (concat f r) p))
    (assert (simple p))
    (forall ((h int)) (call step_kept f e r i p j h))
    (assert (steps_in t2 p 0 j))
    (assert (steps_in t2 p (+ j 1) (- (len p) 1)))
    (call seg_conn t2 p 0 j)
    (call seg_conn t2 p (+ j 1) (- (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))
    (call t2_len f e r i)
    (call t2_idx f e r i (len f))
    (assert (== (idx t2 (len f)) e))
    (call edge_ends t2 (len f) x y)
    (call edge_conn t2 x y)
    (call conn_sym t2 x (idx p j))
    (call conn_sym t2 (idx p (+ j 1)) y)
    (call conn_trans t2 (idx p j) x y)
    (call conn_trans t2 (idx p j) y (idx p (+ j 1)))))
(lemma maps_t2_at (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (k int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len f) (len r))))
    (edges_connected (t_new f e r i)
      (get (idx (concat f r) (+ (len f) i)) 0)
      (get (idx (concat f r) (+ (len f) i)) 1)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (t_new f e r i) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 0) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 1)))
  (body (if (== k (+ (len f) i))
    (block)
    (block
      (call t2_edge f e r i k)
      (call edge_conn (t_new f e r i) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 0) (get (idx (concat f r) k) 1))))))
(lemma span_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g t) (maps_conn t t2) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t2 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected t u v))
    (call conn_mono t t2 u v)))
(lemma span_lift (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning g t) (maps_conn t t2))
  (ensures (is_spanning g t2))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_at g t t2 u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g t2))))
(lemma not_inner (params (m (seq int)) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (c int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (inside m f)
    (and (<= 0 c) (< c (+ (len f) (len r))))
    (ends (idx (concat f r) c) a b)
    (not (in_s m b)))
  (ensures (>= c (len f)))
  (body (if (< c (len f))
    (block
      (assert (== (idx (concat f r) c) (idx f c)))
      (assert (in_s m (get (idx f c) 0)))
      (assert (in_s m (get (idx f c) 1))))
    (block))))
(lemma cross_weight (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (m (seq int)) (w int) (c int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g t)
    (min_cross g m w)
    (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len t)))
    (ends (idx t c) a b)
    (in_s m a)
    (not (in_s m b)))
  (ensures (<= w (get (idx t c) 2)))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t c) 0) (get (idx t c) 1) (get (idx t c) 2)))
    (assert (!= (in_s m (get (idx t c) 0)) (in_s m (get (idx t c) 1))))))
(lemma exch_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g (concat f2 r2)) (<= (total_weight (concat f2 r2)) (total_weight other)))
  (ensures (exch g f2 other))
  (body))
(lemma exch_core (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (m (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires
    (is_spanning_tree g (concat f r))
    (inside m f)
    (in_s m x)
    (not (in_s m y))
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))
    (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2))

  (params

    (candidate_ok bool) (candidate_value int) (has_next bool))
  (requires

    (==

        (counter_code new (* n n))

        (counter_limit (* n n)))))
  (ensures
    (search_witness g n source sink new_best)

    (if (and candidate_ok (> candidate_value old_best))

      (block))
    (forall ((candidate (seq int)))

        g old candidate n source sink old_best new_best

    (if has_next

(ghost-fn pick_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (found bool) (bu int) (bv int) (bw int)) bool
  (body (=> found (and (has_edge g bu bv bw) (crosses l bu bv)))))
(ghost-fn dominated ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
    (=> (is_spanning_tree g o)
        (or (== (cnt_gt r t) 0)
            (>= (cnt_gt o t) (+ (cnt_gt r t) (- (- (len g) 1) (len r)))))))))

(lemma wf_view (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures (gwf (view wg)))
  (body))
(lemma roots_nonneg (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))))
  (ensures (>= (roots l k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call roots_nonneg l (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma roots_id (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l)))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x k)) (== (idx l x) x))))
  (ensures (== (roots l k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call roots_id l (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma root_counted (params (l (seq int)) (k int) (r int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))) (and (<= 0 r) (< r k)) (== (idx l r) r))
  (ensures (>= (roots l k) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ r 1))
      (call root_counted l (- k 1) r)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))
        (call roots_nonneg l (- k 1))))))
(lemma two_roots (params (l (seq int)) (k int) (r1 int) (r2 int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))) (and (<= 0 r1) (< r1 r2)) (< r2 k)
            (== (idx l r1) r1) (== (idx l r2) r2))
  (ensures (>= (roots l k) 2))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ r2 1))
      (call two_roots l (- k 1) r1 r2)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))
        (call root_counted l (- k 1) r1)))))
(lemma same_roots (params (l (seq int)) (k int) (c int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l)))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x k)) (== (idx l x) c))))
  (ensures (<= (roots l k) (if (and (<= 0 c) (< c k)) 1 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call same_roots l (- k 1) c) (block))))
(lemma merged_is_merge (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (is_merge l (merged l a b) a b))
  (body))
(lemma merge_ok (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (lab_ok l0) (is_merge l0 l1 a b)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len l0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len l0)))
            (!= a b) (== (idx l0 a) a) (== (idx l0 b) b))
  (ensures (lab_ok l1))
  (body))
(lemma roots_merge (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (k int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len l0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len l0)))
            (!= a b) (== (idx l0 a) a) (== (idx l0 b) b)
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l0))))
  (ensures (== (roots l1 k) (- (roots l0 k) (if (< b k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call roots_merge l0 l1 a b (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx l1 (- k 1)) (if (== (idx l0 (- k 1)) b) a (idx l0 (- k 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma one_root (params (l (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (lab_ok l) (== (roots l (len l)) 1)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len l))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l y)))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (idx l x)) (< (idx l x) (len l))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (idx l y)) (< (idx l y) (len l))))
    (assert (== (idx l (idx l x)) (idx l x)))
    (assert (== (idx l (idx l y)) (idx l y)))
    (if (< (idx l x) (idx l y))
      (call two_roots l (len l) (idx l x) (idx l y))
      (if (< (idx l y) (idx l x))
        (call two_roots l (len l) (idx l y) (idx l x))
        (block)))))

(lemma conn_refl (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u u))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit u))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))))
(lemma conn_edge (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a b))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit a b))
    (assert (== (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx p 1) b))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))))
(lemma trans_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (> (len p1) 0) (> (len p2) 0) (== (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1)) (idx p2 0))
            (path_follows_edges es p1) (path_follows_edges es p2)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (+ (len p1) (- (len p2) 1)))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (concat p1 (drop p2 1)) k) (idx (concat p1 (drop p2 1)) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (concat p1 (drop p2 1)))
    (assert (== (len p) (+ (len p1) (- (len p2) 1))))
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p1))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p k) (idx p1 k)))
        (assert (== (idx p (+ k 1)) (idx p1 (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p1 k) (idx p1 (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== (+ k 1) (len p1))
        (block
          (assert (== k (- (len p1) 1)))
          (assert (== (idx p k) (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1))))
          (assert (== (idx p (+ k 1)) (idx (drop p2 1) 0)))
          (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) 0) (idx p2 1)))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p2 0) (idx p2 1))))
        (block
          (ghost-let j int (+ (- k (len p1)) 1))
          (assert (>= j 1))
          (assert (== (idx p k) (idx (drop p2 1) (- k (len p1)))))
          (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) (- k (len p1))) (idx p2 j)))
          (assert (== (idx p (+ k 1)) (idx (drop p2 1) j)))
          (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) j) (idx p2 (+ j 1))))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p2 j) (idx p2 (+ j 1)))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (edges_connected es u v) (edges_connected es v w))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u w))
  (body
    (obtain ((p1 (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p1) 0) (and (== (idx p1 0) u) (== (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges es p1)))
    (obtain ((p2 (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p2) 0) (and (== (idx p2 0) v) (== (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges es p2)))
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (concat p1 (drop p2 1)))
    (assert (== (len p) (+ (len p1) (- (len p2) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (if (> (len p2) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) (- (len p2) 2)) (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx (drop p2 1) (- (len p2) 2)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len p2) 1))
        (assert (== (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1)) (idx p2 0)))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1))))))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) w))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_step es p1 p2 k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))))
(lemma eis_mono (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (extends r0 r1 tup) (edge_in_set r0 a b))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r1 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len r0)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx r0 e) 0) a) (== (get (idx r0 e) 1) b))
          (and (== (get (idx r0 e) 0) b) (== (get (idx r0 e) 1) a)))))
    (assert (== (idx r1 e) (idx r0 e)))))
(lemma eis_new (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (extends r0 r1 tup))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r1 (get tup 0) (get tup 1)) (edge_in_set r1 (get tup 1) (get tup 0)))
  (body (assert (== (idx r1 (len r0)) tup))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (extends r0 r1 tup) (edges_connected r0 u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected r1 u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges r0 p)))
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call eis_mono r0 r1 tup a b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r1 p))))
(lemma conn_point (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (lab_conn l0 r0) (extends r0 r1 tup)
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 0)) (< (get tup 0) (len l0)))
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 1)) (< (get tup 1) (len l0)))
            (is_merge l0 l1 (idx l0 (get tup 0)) (idx l0 (get tup 1)))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l0))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len l0)))
            (== (idx l1 x) (idx l1 y)))
  (ensures (edges_connected r1 x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let p0 int (get tup 0))
    (ghost-let q0 int (get tup 1))
    (assert (== (idx l1 x) (if (== (idx l0 x) (idx l0 q0)) (idx l0 p0) (idx l0 x))))
    (assert (== (idx l1 y) (if (== (idx l0 y) (idx l0 q0)) (idx l0 p0) (idx l0 y))))
    (call eis_new r0 r1 tup)
    (if (== (idx l0 x) (idx l0 y))
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected r0 x y))
        (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup x y))
      (if (== (idx l0 x) (idx l0 p0))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 x p0))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 q0 y))
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup x p0)
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup q0 y)
          (call conn_edge r1 p0 q0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x p0 q0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x q0 y))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 x q0))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 p0 y))
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup x q0)
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup p0 y)
          (call conn_edge r1 q0 p0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x q0 p0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x p0 y))))))
(lemma conn_step (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (lab_conn l0 r0) (extends r0 r1 tup)
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 0)) (< (get tup 0) (len l0)))
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 1)) (< (get tup 1) (len l0)))
            (is_merge l0 l1 (idx l0 (get tup 0)) (idx l0 (get tup 1))))
  (ensures (lab_conn l1 r1))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call conn_point l0 l1 r0 r1 tup x y))))
(lemma lab_conn_init (params (l (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (== (idx l x) x))))
  (ensures (lab_conn l r))
  (body (forall ((z int)) (call conn_refl r z))))
(lemma ext_concat (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (extends r0 (concat r0 (seq-lit tup)) tup))
  (body (assert (== (len (concat r0 (seq-lit tup))) (+ (len r0) 1)))))
(lemma valid_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g r0) (extends r0 r1 tup) (has_edge g (get tup 0) (get tup 1) (get tup 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g r1))
  (body))

(lemma path_same (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (edges_in es (len l)) (no_cross es l) (path_follows_edges es p)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len l)))
           (== (idx l (idx p j)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call path_same es l p (- j 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (- j 1)) (idx p j)))
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) (idx p (- j 1))) (== (get (idx es e) 1) (idx p j)))
              (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) (idx p j)) (== (get (idx es e) 1) (idx p (- j 1)))))))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 0)) (< (get (idx es e) 0) (len l)))
                     (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 1)) (< (get (idx es e) 1) (len l)))))
        (assert (not (crosses l (get (idx es e) 0) (get (idx es e) 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma same_point (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (is_spanning g es) (edges_in es (len l)) (no_cross es l)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (call path_same es l p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma g_path_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (gwf g) (== (len l) (len g)) (g_no_cross g l) (path_follows_graph g p)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len l)))
           (== (idx l (idx p j)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call g_path_same g l p (- j 1))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- j 1)) (idx p j)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- j 1))) (< (idx p (- j 1)) (len g)))
                                    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- j 1)))))))
                               (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0) (idx p j))))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0) (len g))))
        (assert (not (crosses l (idx p (- j 1)) (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma g_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (gwf g) (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (graph_is_connected g) (g_no_cross g l)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))
  (body
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call g_path_same g l p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma g_roots (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (gwf g) (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (graph_is_connected g) (g_no_cross g l))
  (ensures (<= (roots l (len l)) 1))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call g_same g l x))
    (call same_roots l (len l) (idx l 0))))

(lemma cross_nonneg (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (ensures (>= (cross_cnt es l) 0))
  (decreases (len es))
  (body (if (> (len es) 0) (call cross_nonneg (drop es 1) l) (block))))
(lemma crosses_merge_point (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b))
  (ensures (=> (crosses l1 x y) (crosses l0 x y)))
  (body
    (if (crosses l1 x y)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx l1 x) (if (== (idx l0 x) b) a (idx l0 x))))
        (assert (== (idx l1 y) (if (== (idx l0 y) b) a (idx l0 y)))))
      (block))))
(lemma cross_merge_le (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b))
  (ensures (<= (cross_cnt es l1) (cross_cnt es l0)))
  (decreases (len es))
  (body
    (if (> (len es) 0)
      (block
        (call cross_merge_le (drop es 1) l0 l1 a b)
        (call crosses_merge_point l0 l1 a b (get (idx es 0) 0) (get (idx es 0) 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma cross_merge_lt (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (k int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
            (crosses l0 (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1))
            (not (crosses l1 (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1))))
  (ensures (< (cross_cnt es l1) (cross_cnt es l0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call crosses_merge_point l0 l1 a b (get (idx es 0) 0) (get (idx es 0) 1))
    (if (== k 0)
      (call cross_merge_le (drop es 1) l0 l1 a b)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (drop es 1) (- k 1)) (idx es k)))
        (call cross_merge_lt (drop es 1) l0 l1 a b (- k 1))))))
(lemma tree_count (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (lab_ok l) (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (is_spanning g o) (edges_in o (len l)))
  (ensures (<= (- (roots l (len l)) 1) (cross_cnt o l)))
  (decreases (cross_cnt o l))
  (body
    (call cross_nonneg o l)
    (if (no_cross o l)
      (block
        (forall ((x int)) (call same_point g o l x))
        (call same_roots l (len l) (idx l 0)))
      (block
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o)))
          (crosses l (get (idx o e) 0) (get (idx o e) 1))))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx l (get (idx o e) 0))) (< (idx l (get (idx o e) 0)) (len l))))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx l (get (idx o e) 1))) (< (idx l (get (idx o e) 1)) (len l))))
        (ghost-let a int (idx l (get (idx o e) 0)))
        (ghost-let b int (idx l (get (idx o e) 1)))
        (assert (!= a b))
        (assert (== (idx l a) a))
        (assert (== (idx l b) b))
        (ghost-let l1 (seq int) (merged l a b))
        (call merged_is_merge l a b)
        (assert (is_merge l l1 a b))
        (call merge_ok l l1 a b)
        (call roots_merge l l1 a b (len l))
        (assert (== (idx l1 (get (idx o e) 0)) a))
        (assert (== (idx l1 (get (idx o e) 1)) a))
        (call cross_merge_lt o l l1 a b e)
        (call cross_nonneg o l1)
        (call tree_count g o l1)))))

(lemma cnt_nonneg (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (ensures (>= (cnt_gt es t) 0))
  (decreases (len es))
  (body (if (> (len es) 0) (call cnt_nonneg (drop es 1) t) (block))))
(lemma cnt_concat (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (ensures (== (cnt_gt (concat s (seq-lit x)) t) (+ (cnt_gt s t) (if (> (get x 2) t) 1 0))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (ghost-let c (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat s (seq-lit x)))
    (assert (== (len c) (+ (len s) 1)))
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx s 0)))
        (assert (== (drop c 1) (concat (drop s 1) (seq-lit x))))
        (call cnt_concat (drop s 1) x t))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx c 0) x))
        (assert (== (len (drop c 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (cnt_gt (drop c 1) t) 0))))))
(lemma cross_le_gt (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (heavy es l t))
  (ensures (<= (cross_cnt es l) (cnt_gt es t)))
  (decreases (len es))
  (body
    (if (> (len es) 0)
      (block
        (assert (=> (crosses l (get (idx es 0) 0) (get (idx es 0) 1)) (> (get (idx es 0) 2) t)))
        (assert (heavy (drop es 1) l t))
        (call cross_le_gt (drop es 1) l t))
      (block))))
(lemma has_edge_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (gwf g) (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (body
