  (body (forall ((a int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g a)))))
        (not (crosses l a (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn cross_cnt ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int))) int (decreases (len es))
  (body (if (== (len es) 0) 0
    (+ (if (crosses l (get (idx es 0) 0) (get (idx es 0) 1)) 1 0) (cross_cnt (drop es 1) l)))))
(ghost-fn cnt_gt ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int)) int (decreases (len es))
  (body (if (== (len es) 0) 0
    (+ (if (> (get (idx es 0) 2) t) 1 0) (cnt_gt (drop es 1) t)))))
(ghost-fn clamp_sum ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int)) int (decreases (len es))
  (body (if (== (len es) 0) 0
    (+ (if (< (get (idx es 0) 2) t) (get (idx es 0) 2) t) (clamp_sum (drop es 1) t)))))
(ghost-fn w_ok ((es (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((e int)) (=> (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
    (and (>= (get (idx es e) 2) -100000) (<= (get (idx es e) 2) 100000))))))
(ghost-fn heavy ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (t int)) bool
  (body (forall ((e int)) (=> (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
    (=> (crosses l (get (idx es e) 0) (get (idx es e) 1)) (> (get (idx es e) 2) t))))))
(ghost-fn min_cross ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (w int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g a)))))
             (crosses l a (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0)))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) e) 1))))))
(ghost-fn scan_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (found bool) (bw int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g a)))))
             (and (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< e i))) (crosses l a (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0))))
        (and found (<= bw (get (idx (idx g a) e) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn pick_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (found bool) (bu int) (bv int) (bw int)) bool
  (body (=> found (and (has_edge g bu bv bw) (crosses l bu bv)))))
(ghost-fn dominated ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
    (=> (is_spanning_tree g o)
        (or (== (cnt_gt r t) 0)
            (>= (cnt_gt o t) (+ (cnt_gt r t) (- (- (len g) 1) (len r)))))))))

(lemma wf_view (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures (gwf (view wg)))
  (body))
(lemma roots_nonneg (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))))
  (ensures (>= (roots l k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call roots_nonneg l (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma roots_id (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l)))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x k)) (== (idx l x) x))))
  (ensures (== (roots l k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call roots_id l (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma root_counted (params (l (seq int)) (k int) (r int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))) (and (<= 0 r) (< r k)) (== (idx l r) r))
  (ensures (>= (roots l k) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ r 1))
      (call root_counted l (- k 1) r)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))
        (call roots_nonneg l (- k 1))))))
(lemma two_roots (params (l (seq int)) (k int) (r1 int) (r2 int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))) (and (<= 0 r1) (< r1 r2)) (< r2 k)
            (== (idx l r1) r1) (== (idx l r2) r2))
  (ensures (>= (roots l k) 2))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ r2 1))
      (call two_roots l (- k 1) r1 r2)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))
        (call root_counted l (- k 1) r1)))))
(lemma same_roots (params (l (seq int)) (k int) (c int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l)))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x k)) (== (idx l x) c))))
  (ensures (<= (roots l k) (if (and (<= 0 c) (< c k)) 1 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call same_roots l (- k 1) c) (block))))
(lemma merged_is_merge (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (is_merge l (merged l a b) a b))
  (body))
(lemma merge_ok (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (lab_ok l0) (is_merge l0 l1 a b)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len l0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len l0)))
            (!= a b) (== (idx l0 a) a) (== (idx l0 b) b))
  (ensures (lab_ok l1))
  (body))
(lemma roots_merge (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (k int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len l0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len l0)))
            (!= a b) (== (idx l0 a) a) (== (idx l0 b) b)
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l0))))
  (ensures (== (roots l1 k) (- (roots l0 k) (if (< b k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call roots_merge l0 l1 a b (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx l1 (- k 1)) (if (== (idx l0 (- k 1)) b) a (idx l0 (- k 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma one_root (params (l (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (lab_ok l) (== (roots l (len l)) 1)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len l))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l y)))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 (idx l x)) (< (idx l x) (len l))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (idx l y)) (< (idx l y) (len l))))
    (assert (== (idx l (idx l x)) (idx l x)))
    (assert (== (idx l (idx l y)) (idx l y)))
    (if (< (idx l x) (idx l y))
      (call two_roots l (len l) (idx l x) (idx l y))
      (if (< (idx l y) (idx l x))
        (call two_roots l (len l) (idx l y) (idx l x))
        (block)))))

(lemma conn_refl (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u u))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit u))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))))
(lemma conn_edge (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a b))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit a b))
    (assert (== (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx p 1) b))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))))
(lemma trans_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (> (len p1) 0) (> (len p2) 0) (== (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1)) (idx p2 0))
            (path_follows_edges es p1) (path_follows_edges es p2)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (+ (len p1) (- (len p2) 1)))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (concat p1 (drop p2 1)) k) (idx (concat p1 (drop p2 1)) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (concat p1 (drop p2 1)))
    (assert (== (len p) (+ (len p1) (- (len p2) 1))))
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p1))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p k) (idx p1 k)))
        (assert (== (idx p (+ k 1)) (idx p1 (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p1 k) (idx p1 (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== (+ k 1) (len p1))
        (block
          (assert (== k (- (len p1) 1)))
          (assert (== (idx p k) (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1))))
          (assert (== (idx p (+ k 1)) (idx (drop p2 1) 0)))
          (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) 0) (idx p2 1)))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p2 0) (idx p2 1))))
        (block
          (ghost-let j int (+ (- k (len p1)) 1))
          (assert (>= j 1))
          (assert (== (idx p k) (idx (drop p2 1) (- k (len p1)))))
          (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) (- k (len p1))) (idx p2 j)))
          (assert (== (idx p (+ k 1)) (idx (drop p2 1) j)))
          (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) j) (idx p2 (+ j 1))))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p2 j) (idx p2 (+ j 1)))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (edges_connected es u v) (edges_connected es v w))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u w))
  (body
    (obtain ((p1 (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p1) 0) (and (== (idx p1 0) u) (== (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges es p1)))
    (obtain ((p2 (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p2) 0) (and (== (idx p2 0) v) (== (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges es p2)))
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (concat p1 (drop p2 1)))
    (assert (== (len p) (+ (len p1) (- (len p2) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (if (> (len p2) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) (- (len p2) 2)) (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx (drop p2 1) (- (len p2) 2)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len p2) 1))
        (assert (== (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1)) (idx p2 0)))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1))))))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) w))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_step es p1 p2 k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))))
(lemma eis_mono (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (extends r0 r1 tup) (edge_in_set r0 a b))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r1 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len r0)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx r0 e) 0) a) (== (get (idx r0 e) 1) b))
          (and (== (get (idx r0 e) 0) b) (== (get (idx r0 e) 1) a)))))
    (assert (== (idx r1 e) (idx r0 e)))))
(lemma eis_new (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (extends r0 r1 tup))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r1 (get tup 0) (get tup 1)) (edge_in_set r1 (get tup 1) (get tup 0)))
  (body (assert (== (idx r1 (len r0)) tup))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (extends r0 r1 tup) (edges_connected r0 u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected r1 u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges r0 p)))
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call eis_mono r0 r1 tup a b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r1 p))))
(lemma conn_point (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (lab_conn l0 r0) (extends r0 r1 tup)
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 0)) (< (get tup 0) (len l0)))
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 1)) (< (get tup 1) (len l0)))
            (is_merge l0 l1 (idx l0 (get tup 0)) (idx l0 (get tup 1)))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l0))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len l0)))
            (== (idx l1 x) (idx l1 y)))
  (ensures (edges_connected r1 x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let p0 int (get tup 0))
    (ghost-let q0 int (get tup 1))
    (assert (== (idx l1 x) (if (== (idx l0 x) (idx l0 q0)) (idx l0 p0) (idx l0 x))))
    (assert (== (idx l1 y) (if (== (idx l0 y) (idx l0 q0)) (idx l0 p0) (idx l0 y))))
    (call eis_new r0 r1 tup)
    (if (== (idx l0 x) (idx l0 y))
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected r0 x y))
        (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup x y))
      (if (== (idx l0 x) (idx l0 p0))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 x p0))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 q0 y))
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup x p0)
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup q0 y)
          (call conn_edge r1 p0 q0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x p0 q0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x q0 y))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 x q0))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 p0 y))
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup x q0)
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup p0 y)
          (call conn_edge r1 q0 p0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x q0 p0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x p0 y))))))
(lemma conn_step (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (lab_conn l0 r0) (extends r0 r1 tup)
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 0)) (< (get tup 0) (len l0)))
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 1)) (< (get tup 1) (len l0)))
            (is_merge l0 l1 (idx l0 (get tup 0)) (idx l0 (get tup 1))))
  (ensures (lab_conn l1 r1))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call conn_point l0 l1 r0 r1 tup x y))))
(lemma lab_conn_init (params (l (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (== (idx l x) x))))
  (ensures (lab_conn l r))
  (body (forall ((z int)) (call conn_refl r z))))
(lemma ext_concat (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (extends r0 (concat r0 (seq-lit tup)) tup))
  (body (assert (== (len (concat r0 (seq-lit tup))) (+ (len r0) 1)))))
(lemma valid_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g r0) (extends r0 r1 tup) (has_edge g (get tup 0) (get tup 1) (get tup 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g r1))
  (body))

(lemma path_same (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (edges_in es (len l)) (no_cross es l) (path_follows_edges es p)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len l)))
           (== (idx l (idx p j)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call path_same es l p (- j 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (- j 1)) (idx p j)))
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) (idx p (- j 1))) (== (get (idx es e) 1) (idx p j)))
              (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) (idx p j)) (== (get (idx es e) 1) (idx p (- j 1)))))))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 0)) (< (get (idx es e) 0) (len l)))
                     (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 1)) (< (get (idx es e) 1) (len l)))))
        (assert (not (crosses l (get (idx es e) 0) (get (idx es e) 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma same_point (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (is_spanning g es) (edges_in es (len l)) (no_cross es l)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (call path_same es l p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma g_path_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (gwf g) (== (len l) (len g)) (g_no_cross g l) (path_follows_graph g p)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len l)))
           (== (idx l (idx p j)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call g_path_same g l p (- j 1))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- j 1)) (idx p j)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- j 1))) (< (idx p (- j 1)) (len g)))
                                    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- j 1)))))))
                               (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0) (idx p j))))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0) (len g))))
        (assert (not (crosses l (idx p (- j 1)) (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma g_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (gwf g) (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (graph_is_connected g) (g_no_cross g l)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))
  (body
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call g_path_same g l p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma g_roots (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (gwf g) (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (graph_is_connected g) (g_no_cross g l))
  (ensures (<= (roots l (len l)) 1))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call g_same g l x))
    (call same_roots l (len l) (idx l 0))))

(lemma cross_nonneg (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (ensures (>= (cross_cnt es l) 0))
  (decreases (len es))
  (body (if (> (len es) 0) (call cross_nonneg (drop es 1) l) (block))))
(lemma crosses_merge_point (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b))
  (ensures (=> (crosses l1 x y) (crosses l0 x y)))
  (body
    (if (crosses l1 x y)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx l1 x) (if (== (idx l0 x) b) a (idx l0 x))))
        (assert (== (idx l1 y) (if (== (idx l0 y) b) a (idx l0 y)))))
      (block))))
(lemma cross_merge_le (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b))
  (ensures (<= (cross_cnt es l1) (cross_cnt es l0)))
  (decreases (len es))
  (body
    (if (> (len es) 0)
      (block
        (call cross_merge_le (drop es 1) l0 l1 a b)
        (call crosses_merge_point l0 l1 a b (get (idx es 0) 0) (get (idx es 0) 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma cross_merge_lt (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (k int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
            (crosses l0 (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1))
            (not (crosses l1 (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1))))
  (ensures (< (cross_cnt es l1) (cross_cnt es l0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call crosses_merge_point l0 l1 a b (get (idx es 0) 0) (get (idx es 0) 1))
    (if (== k 0)
      (call cross_merge_le (drop es 1) l0 l1 a b)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (drop es 1) (- k 1)) (idx es k)))
        (call cross_merge_lt (drop es 1) l0 l1 a b (- k 1))))))
(lemma tree_count (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (lab_ok l) (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (is_spanning g o) (edges_in o (len l)))
  (ensures (<= (- (roots l (len l)) 1) (cross_cnt o l)))
  (decreases (cross_cnt o l))
  (body
    (call cross_nonneg o l)
    (if (no_cross o l)
      (block
        (forall ((x int)) (call same_point g o l x))
        (call same_roots l (len l) (idx l 0)))
      (block
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o)))
          (crosses l (get (idx o e) 0) (get (idx o e) 1))))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx l (get (idx o e) 0))) (< (idx l (get (idx o e) 0)) (len l))))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (idx l (get (idx o e) 1))) (< (idx l (get (idx o e) 1)) (len l))))
        (ghost-let a int (idx l (get (idx o e) 0)))
        (ghost-let b int (idx l (get (idx o e) 1)))
        (assert (!= a b))
        (assert (== (idx l a) a))
        (assert (== (idx l b) b))
        (ghost-let l1 (seq int) (merged l a b))
        (call merged_is_merge l a b)

(ghost-fn canon ((l (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l)))
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx l v)) (< (idx l v) (len l))) (== (idx l (idx l v)) (idx l v)))))))
(ghost-fn is_ident ((l (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))) (== (idx l v) v)))))
(ghost-fn uniform ((l (seq int)) (r int)) bool
  (body (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))) (== (idx l v) r)))))
(ghost-fn all_same ((l (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
    (not (cross l (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn es_range ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx es k) 0)) (< (get (idx es k) 0) n))
         (and (<= 0 (get (idx es k) 1)) (< (get (idx es k) 1) n)))))))
(ghost-fn g_range ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))))
(ghost-fn conn_labels ((f (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len l))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
        (=> (not (cross l u v)) (edges_connected f u v))))))
(ghost-fn comp ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (and (and (are_valid_edges g x) (== (len x) (- (nc l) 1)))
             (and (== (nc (fold l x)) 1) (<= (+ (total_weight f) (total_weight x)) (total_weight s))))))
(ghost-fn opt ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (f (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((s (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (=> (is_spanning_tree g s) (exists ((x (seq (tuple int int int)))) (comp g l f s x))))))
(ghost-fn scanned ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (found bool) (bw int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx g x)))))
             (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< y i))))
        (=> (cross l x (get (idx (idx g x) y) 0))
            (and found (<= bw (get (idx (idx g x) y) 1))))))))
(ghost-fn best ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (found bool) (u int) (v int) (w int)) bool
  (body (=> found (and (has_edge g u v w) (cross l u v)))))
(ghost-fn merged ((l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (j int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len l1) (len l0))
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l0)))
      (== (idx l1 v) (if (< v j) (rl (idx l0 v) x y) (idx l0 v))))))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x)
                  (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn ex_ys ((l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (xs (seq (tuple int int int)))) (seq (tuple int int int))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body (if (== (len xs) 0)
    xs
    (if (cross (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) a b)
      (concat (seq-lit (idx xs 0)) (ex_ys (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) a b (drop xs 1)))
      (drop xs 1)))))
(ghost-fn ex_e ((l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (xs (seq (tuple int int int)))) (tuple int int int)
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body (if (== (len xs) 0)
    (tuple 0 0 0)
    (if (cross (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) a b)
      (ex_e (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) a b (drop xs 1))
      (idx xs 0)))))

(lemma rl_comm (params (c int) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (!= a b) (!= p q) (!= (rl a p q) (rl b p q)))
  (ensures (!= (rl p a b) (rl q a b))
           (== (rl (rl c a b) (rl p a b) (rl q a b)) (rl (rl c p q) (rl a p q) (rl b p q))))
  (body))
(lemma rl_same (params (c int) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (!= a b) (!= p q) (== (rl a p q) (rl b p q)))
  (ensures (== (rl c a b) (rl c p q)))
  (body))
(lemma join_len (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (len (join l a b)) (len l)))
  (body (if (cross l a b) (assert (== (len (mrg l (lab l a) (lab l b))) (len l))) (block))))
(lemma join_at (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (== (len (join l a b)) (len l))
           (== (idx (join l a b) v) (if (cross l a b) (rl (idx l v) (lab l a) (lab l b)) (idx l v))))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (if (cross l a b)
      (assert (== (join l a b) (mrg l (lab l a) (lab l b))))
      (assert (== (join l a b) l)))))
(lemma join_self (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (not (cross (join l a b) a b)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (if (cross l a b)
      (block (call join_at l a b a) (call join_at l a b b))
      (assert (== (join l a b) l)))))
(lemma join_down (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (u int) (v int))
  (ensures (=> (cross (join l a b) u v) (cross l u v)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len l))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
      (block (call join_at l a b u) (call join_at l a b v))
      (block))))
(lemma canon_at (params (l (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (canon l) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx l v)) (< (idx l v) (len l))) (== (idx l (idx l v)) (idx l v)))
  (body))
(lemma join_canon_at (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (v int))
  (requires (canon l) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (== (len (join l a b)) (len l))
           (and (<= 0 (idx (join l a b) v)) (< (idx (join l a b) v) (len l)))
           (== (idx (join l a b) (idx (join l a b) v)) (idx (join l a b) v)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call canon_at l v)
    (call join_at l a b v)
    (call join_at l a b (idx l v))
    (if (cross l a b)
      (block
        (call canon_at l a)
        (call canon_at l b)
        (call join_at l a b (idx l a))
        (call join_at l a b (idx l b)))
      (block))))
(lemma join_canon (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (canon l))
  (ensures (canon (join l a b)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (forall ((v int)) (call join_canon_at l a b v))))
(lemma cnt_nonneg (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (ensures (>= (cnt l k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cnt_nonneg l (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma cnt_ge1 (params (l (seq int)) (r int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r k)) (<= k (len l)) (== (idx l r) r))
  (ensures (>= (cnt l k) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ r 1))
      (call cnt_ge1 l r (- k 1))
      (block
        (call cnt_nonneg l (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))
        (assert (== (lab l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))))))
(lemma cnt_mrg (params (l (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len l))) (!= x y)
            (== (idx l x) x) (== (idx l y) y) (<= k (len l)))
  (ensures (== (cnt (mrg l x y) k) (- (cnt l k) (if (< (if (< x y) y x) k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call cnt_mrg l x y (- k 1))
        (assert (== (len (mrg l x y)) (len l)))
        (assert (== (lab l (- k 1)) (idx l (- k 1))))
        (assert (== (lab (mrg l x y) (- k 1)) (rl (idx l (- k 1)) x y))))
      (block))))
(lemma nc_join (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (canon l) (cross l a b))
  (ensures (== (nc (join l a b)) (- (nc l) 1)))
  (body
    (call canon_at l a)
    (call canon_at l b)
    (call cnt_mrg l (idx l a) (idx l b) (len l))
    (assert (== (join l a b) (mrg l (idx l a) (idx l b))))
    (assert (== (len (mrg l (idx l a) (idx l b))) (len l)))))
(lemma nc_ge1 (params (l (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (canon l) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (>= (nc l) 1))
  (body
    (call canon_at l v)
    (call cnt_ge1 l (idx l v) (len l))))
(lemma cross_nc (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (canon l) (cross l a b))
  (ensures (>= (nc l) 2))
  (body
    (call nc_join l a b)
    (call join_canon l a b)
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call nc_ge1 (join l a b) a)))
(lemma nc_any (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (canon l))
  (ensures (>= (nc (join l a b)) (- (nc l) 1)))
  (body
    (if (cross l a b)
      (call nc_join l a b)
      (assert (== (join l a b) l)))))
(lemma fold_len (params (l (seq int)) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (len (fold l xs)) (len l)))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (if (> (len xs) 0)
      (block
        (call join_len l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1))
        (call fold_len (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) (drop xs 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma fold_canon (params (l (seq int)) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (canon l))
  (ensures (canon (fold l xs)))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (if (> (len xs) 0)
      (block
        (call join_canon l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1))
        (call fold_canon (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) (drop xs 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma fold_nc (params (l (seq int)) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (canon l))
  (ensures (>= (nc (fold l xs)) (- (nc l) (len xs))))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (if (> (len xs) 0)
      (block
        (ghost-let j (seq int) (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)))
        (call join_canon l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1))
        (call nc_any l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1))
        (call fold_nc j (drop xs 1))
        (assert (== (fold l xs) (fold j (drop xs 1)))))
      (assert (== (fold l xs) l)))))
(lemma fold_nocross (params (l (seq int)) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (not (cross l u v)))
  (ensures (not (cross (fold l xs) u v)))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (if (> (len xs) 0)
      (block
        (call join_down l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1) u v)
        (call fold_nocross (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) (drop xs 1) u v))
      (block))))
(lemma fold_member (params (l (seq int)) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len xs))))
  (ensures (not (cross (fold l xs) (get (idx xs k) 0) (get (idx xs k) 1))))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (ghost-let j (seq int) (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)))
    (assert (== (fold l xs) (fold j (drop xs 1))))
    (if (== k 0)
      (block
        (call join_self l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1))
        (call fold_nocross j (drop xs 1) (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)))
      (block
        (call fold_member j (drop xs 1) (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx (drop xs 1) (- k 1)) (idx xs k)))))))
(lemma cnt_uniform (params (l (seq int)) (r int) (k int))
  (requires (uniform l r) (<= 0 r) (<= k (len l)))
  (ensures (<= (cnt l k) (if (< r k) 1 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call cnt_uniform l r (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) r))
        (assert (== (lab l (- k 1)) r)))
      (block))))
(lemma nc_uniform (params (l (seq int)))
  (requires (canon l) (> (len l) 0) (uniform l (idx l 0)))
  (ensures (== (nc l) 1))
  (body
    (call canon_at l 0)
    (call cnt_uniform l (idx l 0) (len l))
    (call nc_ge1 l 0)))
(lemma cnt_ident (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_ident l) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))))
  (ensures (== (cnt l k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call cnt_ident l (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))
        (assert (== (lab l (- k 1)) (- k 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma nc_ident (params (l (seq int)))
  (requires (is_ident l))
  (ensures (== (nc l) (len l)))
  (body (call cnt_ident l (len l))))
(lemma ident_canon_at (params (l (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_ident l) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx l v)) (< (idx l v) (len l))) (== (idx l (idx l v)) (idx l v)))
  (body (assert (== (idx l v) v))))
(lemma ident_canon (params (l (seq int)))
  (requires (is_ident l))
  (ensures (canon l))
  (body (forall ((v int)) (call ident_canon_at l v))))
(lemma join_comm_at (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int) (v int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (cross (join l p q) a b) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (== (len (join (join l a b) p q)) (len l))
           (== (len (join (join l p q) a b)) (len l))
           (== (idx (join (join l a b) p q) v) (idx (join (join l p q) a b) v)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (call join_len (join l a b) p q)
    (call join_len (join l p q) a b)
    (call join_at l a b p)
    (call join_at l a b q)
    (call join_at l p q a)
    (call join_at l p q b)
    (call join_at l a b v)
    (call join_at l p q v)
    (call rl_comm (idx l v) (idx l a) (idx l b) (idx l p) (idx l q))
    (assert (cross (join l a b) p q))
    (call join_at (join l a b) p q v)
    (call join_at (join l p q) a b v)))
(lemma join_comm (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (cross (join l p q) a b))
  (ensures (== (join (join l a b) p q) (join (join l p q) a b)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (call join_len (join l a b) p q)
    (call join_len (join l p q) a b)
    (forall ((v int)) (call join_comm_at l a b p q v))))
(lemma join_same_at (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int) (v int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (not (cross (join l p q) a b)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (== (len (join l a b)) (len l))
           (== (len (join l p q)) (len l))
           (== (idx (join l a b) v) (idx (join l p q) v)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (call join_at l p q a)
    (call join_at l p q b)
    (call join_at l a b v)
    (call join_at l p q v)
    (call rl_same (idx l v) (idx l a) (idx l b) (idx l p) (idx l q))))
(lemma join_same (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (not (cross (join l p q) a b)))
  (ensures (== (join l a b) (join l p q)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (forall ((v int)) (call join_same_at l a b p q v))))
(lemma valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len xs))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx xs k) 0) (get (idx xs k) 1) (get (idx xs k) 2)))
  (body))
(lemma valid_tail_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len xs) 1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 0) (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 1) (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call valid_at g xs (+ k 1))
    (assert (== (idx (drop xs 1) k) (idx xs (+ k 1))))))
(lemma valid_tail (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (> (len xs) 0))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (drop xs 1))
           (has_edge g (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1) (get (idx xs 0) 2)))
  (body
    (call valid_at g xs 0)
    (forall ((k int)) (call valid_tail_at g xs k))))
(lemma valid_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (has_edge g (get h 0) (get h 1) (get h 2)) (are_valid_edges g r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ 1 (len r)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 0) (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 1) (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) 0) h))
      (block
        (call valid_at g r (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) (idx r (- k 1))))))))
(lemma valid_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (has_edge g (get h 0) (get h 1) (get h 2)) (are_valid_edges g r))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat (seq-lit h) r)))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_cons_at g h r k))))
(lemma valid_snoc_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g f) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len f) 1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 0) (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 1) (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k (len f))
      (block
        (call valid_at g f k)
        (assert (== (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) (idx f k))))
      (assert (== (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) e)))))
(lemma valid_snoc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g f) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat f (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_snoc_at g f e k))))
(lemma total_snoc (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat f (seq-lit e))) (+ (total_weight f) (get e 2))))
  (decreases (len f))
  (body
    (ghost-let c (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f (seq-lit e)))
    (if (> (len f) 0)
      (block
        (call total_snoc (drop f 1) e)
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx f 0)))
        (assert (== (drop c 1) (concat (drop f 1) (seq-lit e)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len c) 1))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) e))
        (assert (== (len (drop c 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop c 1)) 0))))))
(lemma exch (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (canon l) (cross l a b) (== (len xs) (- (nc l) 1)) (== (nc (fold l xs)) 1))
  (ensures
    (== (len (ex_ys l a b xs)) (- (len xs) 1))
    (== (nc (fold (join l a b) (ex_ys l a b xs))) 1)
    (cross l (get (ex_e l a b xs) 0) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 1))
    (== (total_weight xs) (+ (get (ex_e l a b xs) 2) (total_weight (ex_ys l a b xs))))
    (=> (are_valid_edges g xs)
        (and (are_valid_edges g (ex_ys l a b xs))
             (has_edge g (get (ex_e l a b xs) 0) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 1) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 2)))))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (call cross_nc l a b)
    (ghost-let h (tuple int int int) (idx xs 0))
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop xs 1))
    (ghost-let p int (get h 0))
    (ghost-let q int (get h 1))
    (ghost-let j (seq int) (join l p q))
    (assert (== (fold l xs) (fold j t)))
    (call join_canon l p q)
    (call fold_nc j t)
    (assert (cross l p q))
    (call nc_join l p q)
    (assert (== (total_weight xs) (+ (get h 2) (total_weight t))))
    (if (cross j a b)
      (block

    (call nc_ge1 l 0)))
(lemma cnt_ident (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_ident l) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))))
  (ensures (== (cnt l k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call cnt_ident l (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))
        (assert (== (lab l (- k 1)) (- k 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma nc_ident (params (l (seq int)))
  (requires (is_ident l))
  (ensures (== (nc l) (len l)))
  (body (call cnt_ident l (len l))))
(lemma ident_canon_at (params (l (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_ident l) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx l v)) (< (idx l v) (len l))) (== (idx l (idx l v)) (idx l v)))
  (body (assert (== (idx l v) v))))
(lemma ident_canon (params (l (seq int)))
  (requires (is_ident l))
  (ensures (canon l))
  (body (forall ((v int)) (call ident_canon_at l v))))
(lemma join_comm_at (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int) (v int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (cross (join l p q) a b) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (== (len (join (join l a b) p q)) (len l))
           (== (len (join (join l p q) a b)) (len l))
           (== (idx (join (join l a b) p q) v) (idx (join (join l p q) a b) v)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (call join_len (join l a b) p q)
    (call join_len (join l p q) a b)
    (call join_at l a b p)
    (call join_at l a b q)
    (call join_at l p q a)
    (call join_at l p q b)
    (call join_at l a b v)
    (call join_at l p q v)
    (call rl_comm (idx l v) (idx l a) (idx l b) (idx l p) (idx l q))
    (assert (cross (join l a b) p q))
    (call join_at (join l a b) p q v)
    (call join_at (join l p q) a b v)))
(lemma join_comm (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (cross (join l p q) a b))
  (ensures (== (join (join l a b) p q) (join (join l p q) a b)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (call join_len (join l a b) p q)
    (call join_len (join l p q) a b)
    (forall ((v int)) (call join_comm_at l a b p q v))))
(lemma join_same_at (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int) (v int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (not (cross (join l p q) a b)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (== (len (join l a b)) (len l))
           (== (len (join l p q)) (len l))
           (== (idx (join l a b) v) (idx (join l p q) v)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (call join_at l p q a)
    (call join_at l p q b)
    (call join_at l a b v)
    (call join_at l p q v)
    (call rl_same (idx l v) (idx l a) (idx l b) (idx l p) (idx l q))))
(lemma join_same (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (not (cross (join l p q) a b)))
  (ensures (== (join l a b) (join l p q)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (forall ((v int)) (call join_same_at l a b p q v))))
(lemma valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len xs))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx xs k) 0) (get (idx xs k) 1) (get (idx xs k) 2)))
  (body))
(lemma valid_tail_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len xs) 1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 0) (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 1) (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call valid_at g xs (+ k 1))
    (assert (== (idx (drop xs 1) k) (idx xs (+ k 1))))))
(lemma valid_tail (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (> (len xs) 0))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (drop xs 1))
           (has_edge g (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1) (get (idx xs 0) 2)))
  (body
    (call valid_at g xs 0)
    (forall ((k int)) (call valid_tail_at g xs k))))
(lemma valid_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (has_edge g (get h 0) (get h 1) (get h 2)) (are_valid_edges g r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ 1 (len r)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 0) (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 1) (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) 0) h))
      (block
        (call valid_at g r (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) (idx r (- k 1))))))))
(lemma valid_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (has_edge g (get h 0) (get h 1) (get h 2)) (are_valid_edges g r))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat (seq-lit h) r)))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_cons_at g h r k))))
(lemma valid_snoc_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g f) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len f) 1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 0) (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 1) (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k (len f))
      (block
        (call valid_at g f k)
        (assert (== (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) (idx f k))))
      (assert (== (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) e)))))
(lemma valid_snoc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g f) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat f (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_snoc_at g f e k))))
(lemma total_snoc (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat f (seq-lit e))) (+ (total_weight f) (get e 2))))
  (decreases (len f))
  (body
    (ghost-let c (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f (seq-lit e)))
    (if (> (len f) 0)
      (block
        (call total_snoc (drop f 1) e)
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx f 0)))
        (assert (== (drop c 1) (concat (drop f 1) (seq-lit e)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len c) 1))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) e))
        (assert (== (len (drop c 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop c 1)) 0))))))
(lemma exch (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (canon l) (cross l a b) (== (len xs) (- (nc l) 1)) (== (nc (fold l xs)) 1))
  (ensures
    (== (len (ex_ys l a b xs)) (- (len xs) 1))
    (== (nc (fold (join l a b) (ex_ys l a b xs))) 1)
    (cross l (get (ex_e l a b xs) 0) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 1))
    (== (total_weight xs) (+ (get (ex_e l a b xs) 2) (total_weight (ex_ys l a b xs))))
    (=> (are_valid_edges g xs)
        (and (are_valid_edges g (ex_ys l a b xs))
             (has_edge g (get (ex_e l a b xs) 0) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 1) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 2)))))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (call cross_nc l a b)
    (ghost-let h (tuple int int int) (idx xs 0))
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop xs 1))
    (ghost-let p int (get h 0))
    (ghost-let q int (get h 1))
    (ghost-let j (seq int) (join l p q))
    (assert (== (fold l xs) (fold j t)))
    (call join_canon l p q)
    (call fold_nc j t)
    (assert (cross l p q))
    (call nc_join l p q)
    (assert (== (total_weight xs) (+ (get h 2) (total_weight t))))
    (if (cross j a b)
      (block
        (call exch g j a b t)
        (call join_comm l a b p q)
        (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (ex_ys j a b t))
        (ghost-let ys (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (seq-lit h) r))
        (assert (== (ex_ys l a b xs) ys))
        (assert (== (ex_e l a b xs) (ex_e j a b t)))
        (assert (== (idx ys 0) h))
        (assert (== (drop ys 1) r))
        (assert (== (fold (join l a b) ys) (fold (join j a b) r)))
        (assert (== (total_weight ys) (+ (get h 2) (total_weight r))))
        (call join_down l p q (get (ex_e j a b t) 0) (get (ex_e j a b t) 1))
        (if (are_valid_edges g xs)
          (block
            (call valid_tail g xs)
            (call valid_cons g h r))
          (block)))
      (block
        (call join_same l a b p q)
        (assert (== (ex_ys l a b xs) t))
        (assert (== (ex_e l a b xs) h))
        (if (are_valid_edges g xs)
          (call valid_tail g xs)
          (block))))))
(lemma has_edge_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (g_range g) (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (call g_range_at g u i)))
(lemma g_range_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (g_range g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g))))
  (body))
(lemma edge_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma valid_range_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (g_range g) (are_valid_edges g s) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx s k) 0)) (< (get (idx s k) 0) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 (get (idx s k) 1)) (< (get (idx s k) 1) (len g)))))
  (body
    (call valid_at g s k)
    (call has_edge_range g (get (idx s k) 0) (get (idx s k) 1) (get (idx s k) 2))))
(lemma valid_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (g_range g) (are_valid_edges g s))
  (ensures (es_range s (len g)))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_range_at g s k))))
(lemma edge_same (params (l (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (all_same l es) (es_range es (len l)) (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len l))) (== (idx l x) (idx l y)))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int))
      (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
           (or (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) x) (== (get (idx es e) 1) y))
               (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) y) (== (get (idx es e) 1) x)))))
    (assert (not (cross l (get (idx es e) 0) (get (idx es e) 1))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 0)) (< (get (idx es e) 0) (len l))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 1)) (< (get (idx es e) 1) (len l))))))
(lemma path_same (params (l (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (all_same l es) (es_range es (len l)) (path_follows_edges es p)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))) (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len l))) (== (idx l (idx p k)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call path_same l es p (- k 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (call edge_same l es (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
      (block))))
(lemma tree_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (m (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g s) (all_same m s) (es_range s (len m)) (== (len m) (len g)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len m))))
  (ensures (== (idx m v) (idx m 0)))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected s 0 v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
    (call path_same m s p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma tree_nc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (g_range g) (is_spanning_tree g s) (canon l) (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0))
  (ensures (== (nc (fold l s)) 1))
  (body
    (ghost-let m (seq int) (fold l s))
    (call fold_len l s)
    (call fold_canon l s)
    (call valid_range g s)
    (forall ((k int)) (call fold_member l s k))
    (assert (all_same m s))
    (assert (is_spanning g s))
    (forall ((v int)) (call tree_same g s m v))
    (assert (uniform m (idx m 0)))
    (call nc_uniform m)))
(lemma conn_refl (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (edges_connected f u u))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit u))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges f p))))
(lemma path_concat_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (path_follows_edges es q) (> (len p) 0) (> (len q) 0)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx q 0))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (+ (len p) (- (len q) 1)) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (block
        (ghost-let t int (- (+ k 1) (len p)))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx q t) (idx q (+ t 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ t 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx q t)))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (edges_connected es u v) (edges_connected es v w))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u w))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) v) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges es q)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat p (drop q 1)))
    (assert (== (len r) (+ (len p) (- (len q) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) w))
    (forall ((k int)) (call path_concat_at es p q k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es r))))
(lemma edge_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es y x))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int))
      (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
           (or (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) x) (== (get (idx es e) 1) y))
               (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) y) (== (get (idx es e) 1) x)))))))
(lemma path_two_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (== (len p) 2) (edge_in_set es (idx p 0) (idx p 1)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k 1)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body (assert (== k 0))))
(lemma conn_edge (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit x y))
    (assert (== (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx p 1) y))
    (forall ((k int)) (call path_two_at es p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))))
(lemma conn_new (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (w int))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat f (seq-lit (tuple a b w))) a b)
           (edges_connected (concat f (seq-lit (tuple a b w))) b a))
  (body
    (ghost-let es (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f (seq-lit (tuple a b w))))
    (assert (== (get (idx es (len f)) 0) a))
    (assert (== (get (idx es (len f)) 1) b))
    (assert (edge_in_set es a b))
    (call edge_sym es a b)
    (call conn_edge es a b)
    (call conn_edge es b a)))
(lemma edge_mono (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edge_in_set f x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (concat f (seq-lit e)) x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len f)))
           (or (and (== (get (idx f k) 0) x) (== (get (idx f k) 1) y))
               (and (== (get (idx f k) 0) y) (== (get (idx f k) 1) x)))))
    (assert (< k (len (concat f (seq-lit e)))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) (idx f k)))))
(lemma path_mono_at (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges f p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (concat f (seq-lit e)) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set f (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_mono f e (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edges_connected f u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat f (seq-lit e)) u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges f p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call path_mono_at f e p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges (concat f (seq-lit e)) p))))
(lemma conn_init_at (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_ident l) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len l))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))) (not (cross l u v)))
  (ensures (edges_connected f u v))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx l u) u))
    (assert (== (idx l v) v))
    (assert (== u v))
    (call conn_refl f u)))
(lemma conn_init (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (is_ident l))
  (ensures (conn_labels f l))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call conn_init_at f l u v))))
(lemma conn_step_at (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (w int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (conn_labels f l) (cross l a b)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len l))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l)))
            (not (cross (join l a b) u v)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat f (seq-lit (tuple a b w))) u v))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_at l a b u)
    (call join_at l a b v)
    (ghost-let es (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f (seq-lit (tuple a b w))))
    (call conn_new f a b w)
    (if (not (cross l u v))
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected f u v))
        (call conn_mono f (tuple a b w) u v))
      (if (== (idx l u) (idx l a))
        (block
          (assert (not (cross l u a)))
          (assert (not (cross l b v)))
          (assert (edges_connected f u a))
          (assert (edges_connected f b v))
          (call conn_mono f (tuple a b w) u a)
          (call conn_mono f (tuple a b w) b v)
          (call conn_trans es u a b)
          (call conn_trans es u b v))
        (block
          (assert (not (cross l u b)))
          (assert (not (cross l a v)))
          (assert (edges_connected f u b))
          (assert (edges_connected f a v))
          (call conn_mono f (tuple a b w) u b)
          (call conn_mono f (tuple a b w) a v)
          (call conn_trans es u b a)
          (call conn_trans es u a v))))))
(lemma conn_step (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (w int))
  (requires (conn_labels f l) (cross l a b))
  (ensures (conn_labels (concat f (seq-lit (tuple a b w))) (join l a b)))
  (body

  (body (forall ((e int)) (=> (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
    (not (crosses l (get (idx es e) 0) (get (idx es e) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn edges_in ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((e int)) (=> (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
    (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 0)) (< (get (idx es e) 0) n))
         (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 1)) (< (get (idx es e) 1) n)))))))
(ghost-fn g_no_cross ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g a)))))
        (not (crosses l a (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn cross_cnt ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int))) int (decreases (len es))
  (body (if (== (len es) 0) 0
    (+ (if (crosses l (get (idx es 0) 0) (get (idx es 0) 1)) 1 0) (cross_cnt (drop es 1) l)))))
(ghost-fn cnt_gt ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int)) int (decreases (len es))
  (body (if (== (len es) 0) 0
    (+ (if (> (get (idx es 0) 2) t) 1 0) (cnt_gt (drop es 1) t)))))
(ghost-fn clamp_sum ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int)) int (decreases (len es))
  (body (if (== (len es) 0) 0
    (+ (if (< (get (idx es 0) 2) t) (get (idx es 0) 2) t) (clamp_sum (drop es 1) t)))))
(ghost-fn w_ok ((es (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((e int)) (=> (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
    (and (>= (get (idx es e) 2) -100000) (<= (get (idx es e) 2) 100000))))))
(ghost-fn heavy ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (t int)) bool
  (body (forall ((e int)) (=> (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
    (=> (crosses l (get (idx es e) 0) (get (idx es e) 1)) (> (get (idx es e) 2) t))))))
(ghost-fn min_cross ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (w int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g a)))))
             (crosses l a (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0)))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) e) 1))))))
(ghost-fn scan_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (found bool) (bw int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (e int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g a)))))
             (and (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< e i))) (crosses l a (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0))))
        (and found (<= bw (get (idx (idx g a) e) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn pick_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (found bool) (bu int) (bv int) (bw int)) bool
  (body (=> found (and (has_edge g bu bv bw) (crosses l bu bv)))))
(ghost-fn dominated ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
    (=> (is_spanning_tree g o)
        (or (== (cnt_gt r t) 0)
            (>= (cnt_gt o t) (+ (cnt_gt r t) (- (- (len g) 1) (len r)))))))))

(lemma wf_view (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures (gwf (view wg)))
  (body))
(lemma lab_at (params (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (lab_ok l) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx l x)) (< (idx l x) (len l)))
           (== (idx l (idx l x)) (idx l x)))
  (body))
(lemma crosses_lab (params (l (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (lab_ok l) (crosses l x y))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l)))
           (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len l)))
           (and (<= 0 (idx l x)) (< (idx l x) (len l)))
           (and (<= 0 (idx l y)) (< (idx l y) (len l)))
           (!= (idx l x) (idx l y))
           (== (idx l (idx l x)) (idx l x))
           (== (idx l (idx l y)) (idx l y)))
  (body
    (call lab_at l x)
    (call lab_at l y)))
(lemma roots_nonneg (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))))
  (ensures (>= (roots l k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call roots_nonneg l (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma roots_id (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l)))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x k)) (== (idx l x) x))))
  (ensures (== (roots l k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call roots_id l (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma root_counted (params (l (seq int)) (k int) (r int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))) (and (<= 0 r) (< r k)) (== (idx l r) r))
  (ensures (>= (roots l k) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ r 1))
      (call root_counted l (- k 1) r)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))
        (call roots_nonneg l (- k 1))))))
(lemma two_roots (params (l (seq int)) (k int) (r1 int) (r2 int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))) (and (<= 0 r1) (< r1 r2)) (< r2 k)
            (== (idx l r1) r1) (== (idx l r2) r2))
  (ensures (>= (roots l k) 2))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ r2 1))
      (call two_roots l (- k 1) r1 r2)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))
        (call root_counted l (- k 1) r1)))))
(lemma same_roots (params (l (seq int)) (k int) (c int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l)))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x k)) (== (idx l x) c))))
  (ensures (<= (roots l k) (if (and (<= 0 c) (< c k)) 1 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call same_roots l (- k 1) c) (block))))
(lemma merged_is_merge (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (is_merge l (merged l a b) a b))
  (body))
(lemma merge_ok (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (lab_ok l0) (is_merge l0 l1 a b)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len l0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len l0)))
            (!= a b) (== (idx l0 a) a) (== (idx l0 b) b))
  (ensures (lab_ok l1))
  (body))
(lemma roots_merge (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (k int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len l0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len l0)))
            (!= a b) (== (idx l0 a) a) (== (idx l0 b) b)
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l0))))
  (ensures (== (roots l1 k) (- (roots l0 k) (if (< b k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call roots_merge l0 l1 a b (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx l1 (- k 1)) (if (== (idx l0 (- k 1)) b) a (idx l0 (- k 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma one_root (params (l (seq int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (lab_ok l) (== (roots l (len l)) 1)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len l))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l y)))
  (body
    (call lab_at l x)
    (call lab_at l y)
    (if (< (idx l x) (idx l y))
      (call two_roots l (len l) (idx l x) (idx l y))
      (if (< (idx l y) (idx l x))
        (call two_roots l (len l) (idx l y) (idx l x))
        (block)))))

(lemma conn_refl (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u u))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit u))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))))
(lemma conn_edge (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a b))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit a b))
    (assert (== (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx p 1) b))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))))
(lemma trans_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (> (len p1) 0) (> (len p2) 0) (== (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1)) (idx p2 0))
            (path_follows_edges es p1) (path_follows_edges es p2)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (+ (len p1) (- (len p2) 1)))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (concat p1 (drop p2 1)) k) (idx (concat p1 (drop p2 1)) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (concat p1 (drop p2 1)))
    (assert (== (len p) (+ (len p1) (- (len p2) 1))))
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p1))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p k) (idx p1 k)))
        (assert (== (idx p (+ k 1)) (idx p1 (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p1 k) (idx p1 (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== (+ k 1) (len p1))
        (block
          (assert (== k (- (len p1) 1)))
          (assert (== (idx p k) (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1))))
          (assert (== (idx p (+ k 1)) (idx (drop p2 1) 0)))
          (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) 0) (idx p2 1)))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p2 0) (idx p2 1))))
        (block
          (ghost-let j int (+ (- k (len p1)) 1))
          (assert (>= j 1))
          (assert (== (idx p k) (idx (drop p2 1) (- k (len p1)))))
          (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) (- k (len p1))) (idx p2 j)))
          (assert (== (idx p (+ k 1)) (idx (drop p2 1) j)))
          (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) j) (idx p2 (+ j 1))))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p2 j) (idx p2 (+ j 1)))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (edges_connected es u v) (edges_connected es v w))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u w))
  (body
    (obtain ((p1 (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p1) 0) (and (== (idx p1 0) u) (== (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges es p1)))
    (obtain ((p2 (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p2) 0) (and (== (idx p2 0) v) (== (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges es p2)))
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (concat p1 (drop p2 1)))
    (assert (== (len p) (+ (len p1) (- (len p2) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (if (> (len p2) 1)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (drop p2 1) (- (len p2) 2)) (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx (drop p2 1) (- (len p2) 2)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len p2) 1))
        (assert (== (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1)) (idx p2 0)))
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1))))))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) w))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_step es p1 p2 k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))))
(lemma eis_mono (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (extends r0 r1 tup) (edge_in_set r0 a b))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r1 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len r0)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx r0 e) 0) a) (== (get (idx r0 e) 1) b))
          (and (== (get (idx r0 e) 0) b) (== (get (idx r0 e) 1) a)))))
    (assert (== (idx r1 e) (idx r0 e)))))
(lemma eis_new (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (extends r0 r1 tup))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r1 (get tup 0) (get tup 1)) (edge_in_set r1 (get tup 1) (get tup 0)))
  (body (assert (== (idx r1 (len r0)) tup))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (extends r0 r1 tup) (edges_connected r0 u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected r1 u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges r0 p)))
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call eis_mono r0 r1 tup a b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r1 p))))
(lemma conn_point (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (lab_conn l0 r0) (extends r0 r1 tup)
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 0)) (< (get tup 0) (len l0)))
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 1)) (< (get tup 1) (len l0)))
            (is_merge l0 l1 (idx l0 (get tup 0)) (idx l0 (get tup 1)))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l0))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len l0)))
            (== (idx l1 x) (idx l1 y)))
  (ensures (edges_connected r1 x y))
  (body
    (ghost-let p0 int (get tup 0))
    (ghost-let q0 int (get tup 1))
    (assert (== (idx l1 x) (if (== (idx l0 x) (idx l0 q0)) (idx l0 p0) (idx l0 x))))
    (assert (== (idx l1 y) (if (== (idx l0 y) (idx l0 q0)) (idx l0 p0) (idx l0 y))))
    (call eis_new r0 r1 tup)
    (if (== (idx l0 x) (idx l0 y))
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected r0 x y))
        (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup x y))
      (if (== (idx l0 x) (idx l0 p0))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 x p0))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 q0 y))
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup x p0)
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup q0 y)
          (call conn_edge r1 p0 q0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x p0 q0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x q0 y))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 x q0))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 p0 y))
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup x q0)
          (call conn_mono r0 r1 tup p0 y)
          (call conn_edge r1 q0 p0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x q0 p0)
          (call conn_trans r1 x p0 y))))))
(lemma conn_step (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (lab_conn l0 r0) (extends r0 r1 tup)
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 0)) (< (get tup 0) (len l0)))
            (and (<= 0 (get tup 1)) (< (get tup 1) (len l0)))
            (is_merge l0 l1 (idx l0 (get tup 0)) (idx l0 (get tup 1))))
  (ensures (lab_conn l1 r1))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call conn_point l0 l1 r0 r1 tup x y))))
(lemma lab_conn_init (params (l (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (== (idx l x) x))))
  (ensures (lab_conn l r))
  (body (forall ((z int)) (call conn_refl r z))))
(lemma ext_concat (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (extends r0 (concat r0 (seq-lit tup)) tup))
  (body (assert (== (len (concat r0 (seq-lit tup))) (+ (len r0) 1)))))
(lemma valid_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (tup (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g r0) (extends r0 r1 tup) (has_edge g (get tup 0) (get tup 1) (get tup 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g r1))
  (body))

(lemma path_same (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (edges_in es (len l)) (no_cross es l) (path_follows_edges es p)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len l)))
           (== (idx l (idx p j)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call path_same es l p (- j 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (- j 1)) (idx p j)))
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) (idx p (- j 1))) (== (get (idx es e) 1) (idx p j)))
              (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) (idx p j)) (== (get (idx es e) 1) (idx p (- j 1)))))))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 0)) (< (get (idx es e) 0) (len l)))
                     (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 1)) (< (get (idx es e) 1) (len l)))))
        (assert (not (crosses l (get (idx es e) 0) (get (idx es e) 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma same_point (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (is_spanning g es) (edges_in es (len l)) (no_cross es l)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (call path_same es l p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma g_path_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (gwf g) (== (len l) (len g)) (g_no_cross g l) (path_follows_graph g p)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len l)))
           (== (idx l (idx p j)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call g_path_same g l p (- j 1))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- j 1)) (idx p j)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- j 1))) (< (idx p (- j 1)) (len g)))
                                    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- j 1)))))))
                               (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0) (idx p j))))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0) (len g))))
        (assert (not (crosses l (idx p (- j 1)) (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- j 1))) i) 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma g_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (gwf g) (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (graph_is_connected g) (g_no_cross g l)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))
  (body
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call g_path_same g l p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma g_roots (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (gwf g) (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (graph_is_connected g) (g_no_cross g l))
  (ensures (<= (roots l (len l)) 1))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call g_same g l x))
    (call same_roots l (len l) (idx l 0))))

(lemma cross_nonneg (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (ensures (>= (cross_cnt es l) 0))
  (decreases (len es))
  (body (if (> (len es) 0) (call cross_nonneg (drop es 1) l) (block))))
(lemma crosses_merge_point (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b))
  (ensures (=> (crosses l1 x y) (crosses l0 x y)))
  (body
    (if (crosses l1 x y)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx l1 x) (if (== (idx l0 x) b) a (idx l0 x))))
        (assert (== (idx l1 y) (if (== (idx l0 y) b) a (idx l0 y)))))
      (block))))
(lemma cross_merge_le (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b))
  (ensures (<= (cross_cnt es l1) (cross_cnt es l0)))
  (decreases (len es))
  (body
    (if (> (len es) 0)
      (block
        (call cross_merge_le (drop es 1) l0 l1 a b)
        (call crosses_merge_point l0 l1 a b (get (idx es 0) 0) (get (idx es 0) 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma cross_merge_lt (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (k int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
            (crosses l0 (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1))
            (not (crosses l1 (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1))))
  (ensures (< (cross_cnt es l1) (cross_cnt es l0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call crosses_merge_point l0 l1 a b (get (idx es 0) 0) (get (idx es 0) 1))
    (if (== k 0)
      (call cross_merge_le (drop es 1) l0 l1 a b)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (drop es 1) (- k 1)) (idx es k)))
