      (== (idx l1 v) (if (< v j) (rl (idx l0 v) x y) (idx l0 v))))))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x)
                  (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn ex_ys ((l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (xs (seq (tuple int int int)))) (seq (tuple int int int))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body (if (== (len xs) 0)
    xs
    (if (cross (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) a b)
      (concat (seq-lit (idx xs 0)) (ex_ys (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) a b (drop xs 1)))
      (drop xs 1)))))
(ghost-fn ex_e ((l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (xs (seq (tuple int int int)))) (tuple int int int)
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body (if (== (len xs) 0)
    (tuple 0 0 0)
    (if (cross (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) a b)
      (ex_e (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) a b (drop xs 1))
      (idx xs 0)))))

(lemma rl_comm (params (c int) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (!= a b) (!= p q) (!= (rl a p q) (rl b p q)))
  (ensures (!= (rl p a b) (rl q a b))
           (== (rl (rl c a b) (rl p a b) (rl q a b)) (rl (rl c p q) (rl a p q) (rl b p q))))
  (body))
(lemma rl_same (params (c int) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (!= a b) (!= p q) (== (rl a p q) (rl b p q)))
  (ensures (== (rl c a b) (rl c p q)))
  (body))
(lemma join_len (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (== (len (join l a b)) (len l)))
  (body (if (cross l a b) (assert (== (len (mrg l (lab l a) (lab l b))) (len l))) (block))))
(lemma join_at (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (== (len (join l a b)) (len l))
           (== (idx (join l a b) v) (if (cross l a b) (rl (idx l v) (lab l a) (lab l b)) (idx l v))))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (if (cross l a b)
      (assert (== (join l a b) (mrg l (lab l a) (lab l b))))
      (assert (== (join l a b) l)))))
(lemma join_self (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (ensures (not (cross (join l a b) a b)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (if (cross l a b)
      (block (call join_at l a b a) (call join_at l a b b))
      (assert (== (join l a b) l)))))
(lemma join_down (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (u int) (v int))
  (ensures (=> (cross (join l a b) u v) (cross l u v)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len l))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
      (block (call join_at l a b u) (call join_at l a b v))
      (block))))
(lemma canon_at (params (l (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (canon l) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx l v)) (< (idx l v) (len l))) (== (idx l (idx l v)) (idx l v)))
  (body))
(lemma join_canon_at (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (v int))
  (requires (canon l) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (== (len (join l a b)) (len l))
           (and (<= 0 (idx (join l a b) v)) (< (idx (join l a b) v) (len l)))
           (== (idx (join l a b) (idx (join l a b) v)) (idx (join l a b) v)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call canon_at l v)
    (call join_at l a b v)
    (call join_at l a b (idx l v))
    (if (cross l a b)
      (block
        (call canon_at l a)
        (call canon_at l b)
        (call join_at l a b (idx l a))
        (call join_at l a b (idx l b)))
      (block))))
(lemma join_canon (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (canon l))
  (ensures (canon (join l a b)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (forall ((v int)) (call join_canon_at l a b v))))
(lemma cnt_nonneg (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (ensures (>= (cnt l k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cnt_nonneg l (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma cnt_ge1 (params (l (seq int)) (r int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r k)) (<= k (len l)) (== (idx l r) r))
  (ensures (>= (cnt l k) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ r 1))
      (call cnt_ge1 l r (- k 1))
      (block
        (call cnt_nonneg l (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))
        (assert (== (lab l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))))))
(lemma cnt_mrg (params (l (seq int)) (x int) (y int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len l))) (!= x y)
            (== (idx l x) x) (== (idx l y) y) (<= k (len l)))
  (ensures (== (cnt (mrg l x y) k) (- (cnt l k) (if (< (if (< x y) y x) k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call cnt_mrg l x y (- k 1))
        (assert (== (len (mrg l x y)) (len l)))
        (assert (== (lab l (- k 1)) (idx l (- k 1))))
        (assert (== (lab (mrg l x y) (- k 1)) (rl (idx l (- k 1)) x y))))
      (block))))
(lemma nc_join (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (canon l) (cross l a b))
  (ensures (== (nc (join l a b)) (- (nc l) 1)))
  (body
    (call canon_at l a)
    (call canon_at l b)
    (call cnt_mrg l (idx l a) (idx l b) (len l))
    (assert (== (join l a b) (mrg l (idx l a) (idx l b))))
    (assert (== (len (mrg l (idx l a) (idx l b))) (len l)))))
(lemma nc_ge1 (params (l (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (canon l) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (>= (nc l) 1))
  (body
    (call canon_at l v)
    (call cnt_ge1 l (idx l v) (len l))))
(lemma cross_nc (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (canon l) (cross l a b))
  (ensures (>= (nc l) 2))
  (body
    (call nc_join l a b)
    (call join_canon l a b)
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call nc_ge1 (join l a b) a)))
(lemma nc_any (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (canon l))
  (ensures (>= (nc (join l a b)) (- (nc l) 1)))
  (body
    (if (cross l a b)
      (call nc_join l a b)
      (assert (== (join l a b) l)))))
(lemma fold_len (params (l (seq int)) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (len (fold l xs)) (len l)))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (if (> (len xs) 0)
      (block
        (call join_len l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1))
        (call fold_len (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) (drop xs 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma fold_canon (params (l (seq int)) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (canon l))
  (ensures (canon (fold l xs)))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (if (> (len xs) 0)
      (block
        (call join_canon l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1))
        (call fold_canon (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) (drop xs 1)))
      (block))))
(lemma fold_nc (params (l (seq int)) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (canon l))
  (ensures (>= (nc (fold l xs)) (- (nc l) (len xs))))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (if (> (len xs) 0)
      (block
        (ghost-let j (seq int) (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)))
        (call join_canon l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1))
        (call nc_any l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1))
        (call fold_nc j (drop xs 1))
        (assert (== (fold l xs) (fold j (drop xs 1)))))
      (assert (== (fold l xs) l)))))
(lemma fold_nocross (params (l (seq int)) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (not (cross l u v)))
  (ensures (not (cross (fold l xs) u v)))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (if (> (len xs) 0)
      (block
        (call join_down l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1) u v)
        (call fold_nocross (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)) (drop xs 1) u v))
      (block))))
(lemma fold_member (params (l (seq int)) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len xs))))
  (ensures (not (cross (fold l xs) (get (idx xs k) 0) (get (idx xs k) 1))))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (ghost-let j (seq int) (join l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)))
    (assert (== (fold l xs) (fold j (drop xs 1))))
    (if (== k 0)
      (block
        (call join_self l (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1))
        (call fold_nocross j (drop xs 1) (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1)))
      (block
        (call fold_member j (drop xs 1) (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx (drop xs 1) (- k 1)) (idx xs k)))))))
(lemma cnt_uniform (params (l (seq int)) (r int) (k int))
  (requires (uniform l r) (<= 0 r) (<= k (len l)))
  (ensures (<= (cnt l k) (if (< r k) 1 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call cnt_uniform l r (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) r))
        (assert (== (lab l (- k 1)) r)))
      (block))))
(lemma nc_uniform (params (l (seq int)))
  (requires (canon l) (> (len l) 0) (uniform l (idx l 0)))
  (ensures (== (nc l) 1))
  (body
    (call canon_at l 0)
    (call cnt_uniform l (idx l 0) (len l))
    (call nc_ge1 l 0)))
(lemma cnt_ident (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (is_ident l) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))))
  (ensures (== (cnt l k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call cnt_ident l (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)))
        (assert (== (lab l (- k 1)) (- k 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma nc_ident (params (l (seq int)))
  (requires (is_ident l))
  (ensures (== (nc l) (len l)))
  (body (call cnt_ident l (len l))))
(lemma ident_canon_at (params (l (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_ident l) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx l v)) (< (idx l v) (len l))) (== (idx l (idx l v)) (idx l v)))
  (body (assert (== (idx l v) v))))
(lemma ident_canon (params (l (seq int)))
  (requires (is_ident l))
  (ensures (canon l))
  (body (forall ((v int)) (call ident_canon_at l v))))
(lemma join_comm_at (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int) (v int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (cross (join l p q) a b) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (== (len (join (join l a b) p q)) (len l))
           (== (len (join (join l p q) a b)) (len l))
           (== (idx (join (join l a b) p q) v) (idx (join (join l p q) a b) v)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (call join_len (join l a b) p q)
    (call join_len (join l p q) a b)
    (call join_at l a b p)
    (call join_at l a b q)
    (call join_at l p q a)
    (call join_at l p q b)
    (call join_at l a b v)
    (call join_at l p q v)
    (call rl_comm (idx l v) (idx l a) (idx l b) (idx l p) (idx l q))
    (assert (cross (join l a b) p q))
    (call join_at (join l a b) p q v)
    (call join_at (join l p q) a b v)))
(lemma join_comm (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (cross (join l p q) a b))
  (ensures (== (join (join l a b) p q) (join (join l p q) a b)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (call join_len (join l a b) p q)
    (call join_len (join l p q) a b)
    (forall ((v int)) (call join_comm_at l a b p q v))))
(lemma join_same_at (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int) (v int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (not (cross (join l p q) a b)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l))))
  (ensures (== (len (join l a b)) (len l))
           (== (len (join l p q)) (len l))
           (== (idx (join l a b) v) (idx (join l p q) v)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (call join_at l p q a)
    (call join_at l p q b)
    (call join_at l a b v)
    (call join_at l p q v)
    (call rl_same (idx l v) (idx l a) (idx l b) (idx l p) (idx l q))))
(lemma join_same (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (not (cross (join l p q) a b)))
  (ensures (== (join l a b) (join l p q)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (forall ((v int)) (call join_same_at l a b p q v))))
(lemma valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len xs))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx xs k) 0) (get (idx xs k) 1) (get (idx xs k) 2)))
  (body))
(lemma valid_tail_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len xs) 1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 0) (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 1) (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call valid_at g xs (+ k 1))
    (assert (== (idx (drop xs 1) k) (idx xs (+ k 1))))))
(lemma valid_tail (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (> (len xs) 0))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (drop xs 1))
           (has_edge g (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1) (get (idx xs 0) 2)))
  (body
    (call valid_at g xs 0)
    (forall ((k int)) (call valid_tail_at g xs k))))
(lemma valid_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (has_edge g (get h 0) (get h 1) (get h 2)) (are_valid_edges g r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ 1 (len r)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 0) (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 1) (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) 0) h))
      (block
        (call valid_at g r (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) (idx r (- k 1))))))))
(lemma valid_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (has_edge g (get h 0) (get h 1) (get h 2)) (are_valid_edges g r))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat (seq-lit h) r)))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_cons_at g h r k))))
(lemma valid_snoc_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g f) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len f) 1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 0) (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 1) (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k (len f))
      (block
        (call valid_at g f k)
        (assert (== (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) (idx f k))))
      (assert (== (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) e)))))
(lemma valid_snoc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g f) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat f (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_snoc_at g f e k))))
(lemma total_snoc (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat f (seq-lit e))) (+ (total_weight f) (get e 2))))
  (decreases (len f))
  (body
    (ghost-let c (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f (seq-lit e)))
    (if (> (len f) 0)
      (block
        (call total_snoc (drop f 1) e)
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx f 0)))
        (assert (== (drop c 1) (concat (drop f 1) (seq-lit e)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len c) 1))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) e))
        (assert (== (len (drop c 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop c 1)) 0))))))
(lemma exch (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (canon l) (cross l a b) (== (len xs) (- (nc l) 1)) (== (nc (fold l xs)) 1))
  (ensures
    (== (len (ex_ys l a b xs)) (- (len xs) 1))
    (== (nc (fold (join l a b) (ex_ys l a b xs))) 1)
    (cross l (get (ex_e l a b xs) 0) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 1))
    (== (total_weight xs) (+ (get (ex_e l a b xs) 2) (total_weight (ex_ys l a b xs))))
    (=> (are_valid_edges g xs)
        (and (are_valid_edges g (ex_ys l a b xs))
             (has_edge g (get (ex_e l a b xs) 0) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 1) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 2)))))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (call cross_nc l a b)
    (ghost-let h (tuple int int int) (idx xs 0))
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop xs 1))
    (ghost-let p int (get h 0))
    (ghost-let q int (get h 1))
    (ghost-let j (seq int) (join l p q))
    (assert (== (fold l xs) (fold j t)))
    (call join_canon l p q)
    (call fold_nc j t)
    (assert (cross l p q))
    (call nc_join l p q)
    (assert (== (total_weight xs) (+ (get h 2) (total_weight t))))
    (if (cross j a b)
      (block
        (call exch g j a b t)
        (call join_comm l a b p q)
        (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (ex_ys j a b t))
        (ghost-let ys (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (seq-lit h) r))
        (assert (== (ex_ys l a b xs) ys))
        (assert (== (ex_e l a b xs) (ex_e j a b t)))
        (assert (== (idx ys 0) h))
        (assert (== (drop ys 1) r))
        (assert (== (fold (join l a b) ys) (fold (join j a b) r)))
        (assert (== (total_weight ys) (+ (get h 2) (total_weight r))))
        (call join_down l p q (get (ex_e j a b t) 0) (get (ex_e j a b t) 1))
        (if (are_valid_edges g xs)
          (block
            (call valid_tail g xs)
            (call valid_cons g h r))
          (block)))
      (block
        (call join_same l a b p q)
        (assert (== (ex_ys l a b xs) t))
        (assert (== (ex_e l a b xs) h))
        (if (are_valid_edges g xs)
          (call valid_tail g xs)
          (block))))))
(lemma has_edge_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (g_range g) (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (call g_range_at g u i)))
(lemma g_range_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (g_range g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g))))
  (body))
(lemma edge_intro (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma valid_range_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (g_range g) (are_valid_edges g s) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx s k) 0)) (< (get (idx s k) 0) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 (get (idx s k) 1)) (< (get (idx s k) 1) (len g)))))
  (body
    (call valid_at g s k)
    (call has_edge_range g (get (idx s k) 0) (get (idx s k) 1) (get (idx s k) 2))))
(lemma valid_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (g_range g) (are_valid_edges g s))
  (ensures (es_range s (len g)))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_range_at g s k))))

           (== (idx (join l a b) v) (idx (join l p q) v)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (call join_at l p q a)
    (call join_at l p q b)
    (call join_at l a b v)
    (call join_at l p q v)
    (call rl_same (idx l v) (idx l a) (idx l b) (idx l p) (idx l q))))
(lemma join_same (params (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (cross l a b) (cross l p q) (not (cross (join l p q) a b)))
  (ensures (== (join l a b) (join l p q)))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_len l p q)
    (forall ((v int)) (call join_same_at l a b p q v))))
(lemma valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len xs))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx xs k) 0) (get (idx xs k) 1) (get (idx xs k) 2)))
  (body))
(lemma valid_tail_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len xs) 1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 0) (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 1) (get (idx (drop xs 1) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call valid_at g xs (+ k 1))
    (assert (== (idx (drop xs 1) k) (idx xs (+ k 1))))))
(lemma valid_tail (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g xs) (> (len xs) 0))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (drop xs 1))
           (has_edge g (get (idx xs 0) 0) (get (idx xs 0) 1) (get (idx xs 0) 2)))
  (body
    (call valid_at g xs 0)
    (forall ((k int)) (call valid_tail_at g xs k))))
(lemma valid_cons_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (has_edge g (get h 0) (get h 1) (get h 2)) (are_valid_edges g r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ 1 (len r)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 0) (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 1) (get (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (assert (== (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) 0) h))
      (block
        (call valid_at g r (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx (concat (seq-lit h) r) k) (idx r (- k 1))))))))
(lemma valid_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (has_edge g (get h 0) (get h 1) (get h 2)) (are_valid_edges g r))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat (seq-lit h) r)))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_cons_at g h r k))))
(lemma valid_snoc_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g f) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len f) 1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 0) (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 1) (get (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< k (len f))
      (block
        (call valid_at g f k)
        (assert (== (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) (idx f k))))
      (assert (== (idx (concat f (seq-lit e)) k) e)))))
(lemma valid_snoc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g f) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat f (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_snoc_at g f e k))))
(lemma total_snoc (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat f (seq-lit e))) (+ (total_weight f) (get e 2))))
  (decreases (len f))
  (body
    (ghost-let c (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f (seq-lit e)))
    (if (> (len f) 0)
      (block
        (call total_snoc (drop f 1) e)
        (assert (== (idx c 0) (idx f 0)))
        (assert (== (drop c 1) (concat (drop f 1) (seq-lit e)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len c) 1))
        (assert (== (idx c 0) e))
        (assert (== (len (drop c 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight (drop c 1)) 0))))))
(lemma exch (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (xs (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (canon l) (cross l a b) (== (len xs) (- (nc l) 1)) (== (nc (fold l xs)) 1))
  (ensures
    (== (len (ex_ys l a b xs)) (- (len xs) 1))
    (== (nc (fold (join l a b) (ex_ys l a b xs))) 1)
    (cross l (get (ex_e l a b xs) 0) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 1))
    (== (total_weight xs) (+ (get (ex_e l a b xs) 2) (total_weight (ex_ys l a b xs))))
    (=> (are_valid_edges g xs)
        (and (are_valid_edges g (ex_ys l a b xs))
             (has_edge g (get (ex_e l a b xs) 0) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 1) (get (ex_e l a b xs) 2)))))
  (decreases (len xs))
  (body
    (call cross_nc l a b)
    (ghost-let h (tuple int int int) (idx xs 0))
    (ghost-let t (seq (tuple int int int)) (drop xs 1))
    (ghost-let p int (get h 0))
    (ghost-let q int (get h 1))
    (ghost-let j (seq int) (join l p q))
    (assert (== (fold l xs) (fold j t)))
    (call join_canon l p q)
    (call fold_nc j t)
    (assert (cross l p q))
    (call nc_join l p q)
    (assert (== (total_weight xs) (+ (get h 2) (total_weight t))))
    (if (cross j a b)
      (block
        (call exch g j a b t)
        (call join_comm l a b p q)
        (ghost-let r (seq (tuple int int int)) (ex_ys j a b t))
        (ghost-let ys (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat (seq-lit h) r))
        (assert (== (ex_ys l a b xs) ys))
        (assert (== (ex_e l a b xs) (ex_e j a b t)))
        (assert (== (idx ys 0) h))
        (assert (== (drop ys 1) r))
        (assert (== (fold (join l a b) ys) (fold (join j a b) r)))
        (assert (== (total_weight ys) (+ (get h 2) (total_weight r))))
        (call join_down l p q (get (ex_e j a b t) 0) (get (ex_e j a b t) 1))
        (if (are_valid_edges g xs)
          (block
            (call valid_tail g xs)
            (call valid_cons g h r))
          (block)))
      (block
        (call join_same l a b p q)
        (assert (== (ex_ys l a b xs) t))
        (assert (== (ex_e l a b xs) h))
        (if (are_valid_edges g xs)
          (call valid_tail g xs)
          (block))))))
(lemma has_edge_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (g_range g) (has_edge g u v w))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))

  (requires (g_range g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))

(lemma valid_range_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (g_range g) (are_valid_edges g s) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))))

  (requires (all_same l es) (es_range es (len l)) (edge_in_set es x y))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len l))) (== (idx l x) (idx l y)))

    (obtain ((e int))
      (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
           (or (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) x) (== (get (idx es e) 1) y))
               (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) y) (== (get (idx es e) 1) x)))))
    (assert (not (cross l (get (idx es e) 0) (get (idx es e) 1))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 0)) (< (get (idx es e) 0) (len l))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx es e) 1)) (< (get (idx es e) 1) (len l))))))
(lemma path_same (params (l (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (all_same l es) (es_range es (len l)) (path_follows_edges es p)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))) (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len l))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len l))) (== (idx l (idx p k)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call path_same l es p (- k 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (call edge_same l es (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))

(lemma tree_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (m (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_spanning g s) (all_same m s) (es_range s (len m)) (== (len m) (len g)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len m))))
  (ensures (== (idx m v) (idx m 0)))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected s 0 v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
    (call path_same m s p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma tree_nc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (g_range g) (is_spanning_tree g s) (canon l) (== (len l) (len g)) (> (len g) 0))
  (ensures (== (nc (fold l s)) 1))
  (body
    (ghost-let m (seq int) (fold l s))
    (call fold_len l s)
    (call fold_canon l s)
    (call valid_range g s)
    (forall ((k int)) (call fold_member l s k))
    (assert (all_same m s))
    (assert (is_spanning g s))
    (forall ((v int)) (call tree_same g s m v))
    (assert (uniform m (idx m 0)))
    (call nc_uniform m)))

    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))

(lemma path_concat_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))

            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (+ (len p) (- (len q) 1)) 1))))

    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))

        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))

        (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))

        (ghost-let t int (- (+ k 1) (len p)))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx q t) (idx q (+ t 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ t 1))))

(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int))

    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) v) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges es q)))

    (assert (== (idx r 0) u))

(lemma path_two_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))

    (obtain ((k int))

  (requires (path_follows_edges f p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (concat f (seq-lit e)) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))

    (assert (edge_in_set f (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))

(lemma conn_mono (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))

  (ensures (edges_connected f u v))

(lemma conn_step_at (params (f (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (w int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (conn_labels f l) (cross l a b)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len l))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len l)))
            (not (cross (join l a b) u v)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat f (seq-lit (tuple a b w))) u v))
  (body
    (call join_len l a b)
    (call join_at l a b u)
    (call join_at l a b v)
    (ghost-let es (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat f (seq-lit (tuple a b w))))
    (call conn_new f a b w)
    (if (not (cross l u v))
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected f u v))
        (call conn_mono f (tuple a b w) u v))
      (if (== (idx l u) (idx l a))
        (block
          (assert (not (cross l u a)))
          (assert (not (cross l b v)))
          (assert (edges_connected f u a))
          (assert (edges_connected f b v))
          (call conn_mono f (tuple a b w) u a)
          (call conn_mono f (tuple a b w) b v)
          (call conn_trans es u a b)
          (call conn_trans es u b v))
        (block
          (assert (not (cross l u b)))
          (assert (not (cross l a v)))
          (assert (edges_connected f u b))
          (assert (edges_connected f a v))
          (call conn_mono f (tuple a b w) u b)
          (call conn_mono f (tuple a b w) a v)
          (call conn_trans es u b a)
          (call conn_trans es u a v))))))

        (concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w))))
    (path_follows_edges edges0 p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures
    (edge_in_set edges1 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert
      (edge_in_set edges0 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_in_append_old
      edges0 edges1 u v
      (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)) w)))

(lemma connected_monotone_append
  (params

      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) a)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b)))
        (path_follows_edges edges0 p)))
    (forall ((k int))
      (call path_append_monotone_point
        edges0 edges1 p u v w k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges edges1 p))
    (assert
      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) a)

        (path_follows_edges edges1 p)))))

(lemma connected_reflexive
  (params

(ghost-fn reverse_path
  ((p (seq int)))

(lemma reverse_path_length

    (assert (reverse_path p))))

(lemma reverse_path_index
  (params (p (seq int)) (i int))

    (assert (reverse_path p))))

(lemma reverse_path_step
  (params
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (path_follows_edges edges p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures
    (edge_in_set
      edges
      (idx (reverse_path p) k)

  (body
    (call reverse_path_length p)
    (call reverse_path_index p k)
    (call reverse_path_index p (+ k 1))
    (assert
      (edge_in_set
        edges
        (idx p (- (- (len p) 2) k))
        (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) k))))
    (assert
      (edge_in_set

(lemma connected_symmetric
  (params
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires (edges_connected edges u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected edges v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) u)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (path_follows_edges edges p)))
    (forall ((k int))
      (call reverse_path_step edges p k))
    (call reverse_path_length p)
    (call reverse_path_index p 0)
    (call reverse_path_index p (- (len p) 1))
    (assert (path_follows_edges edges (reverse_path p)))
    (assert

        (and
          (> (len (reverse_path p)) 0)

            (== (idx (reverse_path p) 0) v)

        (path_follows_edges edges (reverse_path p))))))

(lemma connected_transitive
  (params

  (requires

    (obtain ((p (seq int)))

            (== (idx q 0) v)

    (forall ((k int))
      (call join_path_step edges p q k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges edges (join_paths p q)))
    (assert
      (and
        (and
          (> (len (join_paths p q)) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx (join_paths p q) 0) u)
            (== (idx (join_paths p q)
                     (- (len (join_paths p q)) 1))

        (path_follows_edges edges (join_paths p q))))))

(lemma relabel_path_point
  (params
    (components0 (seq int))
    (components1 (seq int))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (old_component int)
    (new_component int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (same_components components0 edges0 n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (!= (idx components0 u) (idx components0 v))
    (== old_component (idx components0 v))
    (== new_component (idx components0 u))
    (== edges1 (concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w))))
    (== (len components1) n)
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
        (==
          (idx components1 x)
          (if
            (== (idx components0 x) old_component)
            new_component
            (idx components0 x)))))
    (path_follows_edges edges1 p)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (<= j k))
        (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) n))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (idx components1 (idx p 0))
      (idx components1 (idx p k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call relabel_path_point
          components0 components1 edges0 edges1 n
          u v w old_component new_component p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (edge_in_set edges1
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((e int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len edges1)))
            (or
              (and
                (== (get (idx edges1 e) 0) (idx p (- k 1)))
                (== (get (idx edges1 e) 1) (idx p k)))
              (and
                (== (get (idx edges1 e) 0) (idx p k))
                (== (get (idx edges1 e) 1) (idx p (- k 1)))))))
        (if (< e (len edges0))
          (block
            (assert
              (edge_in_set edges0
                (idx p (- k 1))
                (idx p k)))
            (assert
              (edges_connected edges0
                (idx p (- k 1))
                (idx p k)))
            (assert
              (==
                (idx components0 (idx p (- k 1)))
                (idx components0 (idx p k)))))
          (block
            (assert (== e (len edges0)))
            (assert
              (or
                (and
                  (== (idx p (- k 1)) u)
                  (== (idx p k) v))
                (and
                  (== (idx p (- k 1)) v)
                  (== (idx p k) u))))))
        (assert
          (==
            (idx components1 (idx p (- k 1)))
            (idx components1 (idx p k)))))
      (block))))

(lemma relabel_connectivity_point
  (params
    (components0 (seq int))
    (components1 (seq int))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (old_component int)
    (new_component int)
    (x int)
    (y int))
  (requires
    (same_components components0 edges0 n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (!= (idx components0 u) (idx components0 v))
    (== old_component (idx components0 v))
    (== new_component (idx components0 u))
    (== edges1 (concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w))))
    (== (len components1) n)
    (forall ((z int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 z) (< z n))
        (==
          (idx components1 z)
          (if
            (== (idx components0 z) old_component)
            new_component
            (idx components0 z)))))
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (== (idx components1 x) (idx components1 y))
      (edges_connected edges1 x y)))
  (body
    (if (edges_connected edges1 x y)
      (block
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and
              (> (len p) 0)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) x)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y)))
            (path_follows_edges edges1 p)))
        (forall ((j int))
          (call relabel_path_point
            components0 components1 edges0 edges1 n
            u v w old_component new_component p j))
        (call relabel_path_point
          components0 components1 edges0 edges1 n
          u v w old_component new_component p
          (- (len p) 1))
        (assert
          (==
            (idx components1 x)
            (idx components1 y))))
      (if (== (idx components1 x) (idx components1 y))
        (block
          (if
            (==
              (idx components0 x)
              (idx components0 y))
            (block
              (assert (edges_connected edges0 x y))
              (call connected_monotone_append
                edges0 edges1 u v x y w))
            (if
              (==
                (idx components0 x)
                old_component)
              (block
                (assert
                  (==
                    (idx components0 y)
                    new_component))
                (assert (edges_connected edges0 x v))
                (assert (edges_connected edges0 u y))
                (call connected_monotone_append
                  edges0 edges1 u v x v w)
                (call connected_monotone_append
                  edges0 edges1 u v u y w)
                (call appended_edge_connected edges0 edges1 u v w)
                (call connected_transitive edges1 x v u)
                (call connected_transitive edges1 x u y))
              (block
                (assert
                  (==
                    (idx components0 y)
                    old_component))
                (assert
                  (==
                    (idx components0 x)
                    new_component))
                (assert (edges_connected edges0 x u))
                (assert (edges_connected edges0 v y))
                (call connected_monotone_append
                  edges0 edges1 u v x u w)
                (call connected_monotone_append
                  edges0 edges1 u v v y w)
                (call appended_edge_connected edges0 edges1 u v w)
                (call connected_symmetric edges1 u v)
                (call connected_transitive edges1 x u v)
                (call connected_transitive edges1 x v y)))))
        (block)))))

(lemma relabel_components
  (params
    (components0 (seq int))
    (components1 (seq int))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (n int)

  (requires

    (!= (idx components0 u) (idx components0 v))
    (== old_component (idx components0 v))
    (== new_component (idx components0 u))
    (== edges1 (concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w))))
    (== (len components1) n)
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
        (==
          (idx components1 x)
          (if

(lemma greedy_forest_extension_point
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (components (seq int))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (== n (len g))
    (same_components components edges0 n)
    (greedy_prefix g edges0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (!= (idx components u) (idx components v))
    (== edges1 (concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len edges1))))
  (ensures
    (not
      (edges_connected
        (take edges1 k)
        (get (idx edges1 k) 0)
        (get (idx edges1 k) 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit (tuple u v w))
    (call law_len_concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w)))
    (if (< k (len edges0))
      (block
        (assert (== (take edges1 k) (take edges0 k)))
        (assert (== (idx edges1 k) (idx edges0 k)))
        (assert
          (not
            (edges_connected
              (take edges0 k)
              (get (idx edges0 k) 0)
              (get (idx edges0 k) 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== k (len edges0)))
        (assert (== (take edges1 k) edges0))
        (assert (== (idx edges1 k) (tuple u v w)))
        (assert (not (edges_connected edges0 u v)))))))

(lemma greedy_minimum_extension_point
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (components (seq int))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (k int)
    (x int)
    (y int)
    (weight int))
  (requires
    (== n (len g))
    (endpoints_bounded g)
    (same_components components edges0 n)
    (greedy_prefix g edges0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (!= (idx components u) (idx components v))
    (forall ((a int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a))))
            (!= (idx components a)
                (idx components (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0)))))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1))))
    (== edges1 (concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w))))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len edges1)))
    (has_edge g x y weight)
    (not (edges_connected (take edges1 k) x y)))
  (ensures (<= (get (idx edges1 k) 2) weight))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit (tuple u v w))
    (call law_len_concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w)))
    (if (< k (len edges0))
      (block
        (assert (== (take edges1 k) (take edges0 k)))
        (assert (== (idx edges1 k) (idx edges0 k)))
        (assert (not (edges_connected (take edges0 k) x y)))
        (assert (<= (get (idx edges0 k) 2) weight)))
      (block
        (assert (== k (len edges0)))
        (assert (== (take edges1 k) edges0))
        (assert (== (idx edges1 k) (tuple u v w)))
        (assert (not (edges_connected edges0 x y)))
        (assert
          (!= (idx components x) (idx components y)))
        (obtain ((i int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0) y)
              (== (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1) weight))))
        (assert (<= w weight))))))

(lemma greedy_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (components (seq int))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (== n (len g))
    (endpoints_bounded g)
    (same_components components edges0 n)
    (greedy_prefix g edges0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (!= (idx components u) (idx components v))
    (forall ((x int) (i int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g x))))
            (!= (idx components x)
                (idx components (get (idx (idx g x) i) 0)))))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g x) i) 1))))
    (== edges1 (concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w)))))
  (ensures (greedy_prefix g edges1))
  (body
    (forall ((k int))
      (call greedy_forest_extension_point
        g edges0 edges1 components n u v w k))
    (forall ((k2 int) (x int) (y int) (weight int))
      (call greedy_minimum_extension_point
        g edges0 edges1 components n u v w
        k2 x y weight))
    (assert (greedy_prefix g edges1))))

(lemma spanning_from_components
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (components (seq int))
    (n int))
  (requires
    (== n (len g))
    (> n 0)
    (same_components components edges n)
    (forall ((x int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
        (== (idx components x) (idx components 0)))))
  (ensures (is_spanning g edges))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((u int) (v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
          (edges_connected edges u v))))
    (assert (is_spanning g edges))))

(lemma greedy_exchange_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (> (len g) 0)
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (are_valid_edges g edges)
    (is_spanning g edges)
    (== (len edges) (- (len g) 1))
    (greedy_prefix g edges)
    (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures
    (<= (total_weight edges) (total_weight other)))
  (decreases (len edges))
  (body
    (if (== (len edges) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (len g) 1))
        (assert (== (len other) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight edges) 0))
        (assert (== (total_weight other) 0)))
      (block
        (let k int (- (len edges) 1))
        (let e (tuple int int int) (idx edges k))
        (let prefix (seq (tuple int int int)) (take edges k))
        (assert
          (not
            (edges_connected
              prefix
              (get e 0)
              (get e 1))))
        (assert
          (edges_connected
            other
            (get e 0)
            (get e 1)))
        (obtain ((p (seq int)))
          (and
            (and
              (> (len p) 0)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) (get e 0))
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (get e 1))))
            (path_follows_edges other p)))
        (assert
          (exists ((j int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
              (not
                (edges_connected
                  prefix
                  (idx p j)
                  (idx p (+ j 1)))))))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
            (not
              (edges_connected
                prefix
                (idx p j)
                (idx p (+ j 1))))))
        (assert
          (edge_in_set
            other
            (idx p j)
            (idx p (+ j 1))))
        (obtain ((q int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len other)))
            (or
              (and
                (== (get (idx other q) 0) (idx p j))
                (== (get (idx other q) 1) (idx p (+ j 1))))
              (and
                (== (get (idx other q) 0) (idx p (+ j 1)))
                (== (get (idx other q) 1) (idx p j))))))
        (assert
          (has_edge
            g
            (get (idx other q) 0)
            (get (idx other q) 1)
            (get (idx other q) 2)))
        (assert
          (<=
            (get e 2)
            (get (idx other q) 2)))
        (assert
          (<=
            (total_weight edges)
            (total_weight other)))))))

(lemma greedy_spanning_tree_is_mst
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (> (len g) 0)
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (are_valid_edges g edges)
    (is_spanning g edges)
    (== (len edges) (- (len g) 1))
    (greedy_prefix g edges))
  (ensures (is_mst g edges))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g edges))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (call greedy_exchange_bound g edges other))
    (assert (is_mst g edges))))

(def kruskal_mst
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (endpoints_bounded (view graph)))
    (let-mut components (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (vertex) vertex)))
    (let-mut result (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (call initial_components components n)
    (let-mut selected i64 0)
    (while (< selected (- n 1))
      (invariant
        (and
          (<= 0 selected)
          (<= selected (- n 1))))
      (invariant (== (len components) n))

  (ensures (edge_in_set (concat a (seq-lit e)) o z))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit e)) (len a)) e))
    (call edge_wit (concat a (seq-lit e)) (len a) o z)))
(lemma conn_covers (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (covers t c) (edges_connected t u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected c u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (call walk c p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma span_covers (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_spanning g t) (covers t c))
  (ensures (is_spanning g c))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call conn_covers t c u v))))

(lemma total_unit (params (x (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (seq-lit x)) (get x 2)))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit x) 0) x))
    (assert (== (len (drop (seq-lit x) 1)) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight (drop (seq-lit x) 1)) 0))))
(lemma total_concat (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat s t)) (+ (total_weight s) (total_weight t))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat s t) t))
        (assert (== (total_weight s) 0)))
      (block
        (call total_concat (drop s 1) t)
        (assert (== (drop (concat s t) 1) (concat (drop s 1) t)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat s t) 0) (idx s 0)))))))
(lemma without_facts (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len r))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (without r t)) (- (len r) 1))
    (forall ((m int)) (=> (and (<= 0 m) (< m t)) (== (idx (without r t) m) (idx r m))))
    (forall ((m int)) (=> (and (<= t m) (< m (- (len r) 1))) (== (idx (without r t) m) (idx r (+ m 1))))))
  (body))
(lemma swapped_facts (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len r))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (swapped a e r t)) (+ (len a) (len r)))
    (forall ((m int)) (=> (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len a))) (== (idx (swapped a e r t) m) (idx a m))))
    (forall ((m int)) (=> (and (<= 0 m) (< m t)) (== (idx (swapped a e r t) (+ (+ (len a) 1) m)) (idx r m))))
    (forall ((m int)) (=> (and (< t m) (< m (len r))) (== (idx (swapped a e r t) (+ (len a) m)) (idx r m)))))
  (body (call without_facts r t)))
(lemma total_without (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len r))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight r) (+ (total_weight (without r t)) (get (idx r t) 2))))
  (body
    (assert (== r (concat (take r t) (concat (seq-lit (idx r t)) (drop r (+ t 1))))))
    (call total_concat (take r t) (concat (seq-lit (idx r t)) (drop r (+ t 1))))
    (call total_concat (seq-lit (idx r t)) (drop r (+ t 1)))
    (call total_concat (take r t) (drop r (+ t 1)))
    (call total_unit (idx r t))))
(lemma valid_without_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len r))) (are_valid_edges g r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len r) 1))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (without r t) k) 0) (get (idx (without r t) k) 1) (get (idx (without r t) k) 2)))
  (body
    (call without_facts r t)
    (if (< k t)
      (assert (== (idx (without r t) k) (idx r k)))
      (assert (== (idx (without r t) k) (idx r (+ k 1)))))))
(lemma valid_without (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len r))) (are_valid_edges g r))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (without r t)))
  (body
    (call without_facts r t)
    (forall ((k int)) (call valid_without_one g r t k))))

(lemma first_exit (params (s (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (not (mem s (idx p 0))) (mem s (idx p m)))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (first_at s p j)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (exists ((k int)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k m)) (mem s (idx p k))))
      (block
        (obtain ((k1 int)) (and (and (<= 0 k1) (< k1 m)) (mem s (idx p k1))))
        (call first_exit s p k1))
      (assert (first_at s p (- m 1))))))
(lemma transfer (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len r))) (edge_in_set (concat a r) u v))
  (ensures (or (edge_in_set (swapped a e r t) u v) (links (idx r t) u v)))
  (body
    (call swapped_facts a e r t)
    (obtain ((q int)) (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len (concat a r)))) (links (idx (concat a r) q) u v)))
    (if (< q (len a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat a r) q) (idx a q)))
        (assert (== (idx (swapped a e r t) q) (idx a q)))
        (call edge_wit (swapped a e r t) q u v))
      (block
        (ghost-let m int (- q (len a)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat a r) q) (idx r m)))
        (if (< m t)
          (block
            (assert (== (idx (swapped a e r t) (+ (+ (len a) 1) m)) (idx r m)))
            (call edge_wit (swapped a e r t) (+ (+ (len a) 1) m) u v))
          (if (== m t)
            (block)
            (block
              (assert (== (idx (swapped a e r t) (+ (len a) m)) (idx r m)))
              (call edge_wit (swapped a e r t) (+ (len a) m) u v))))))))
(lemma prefix_step (params (s (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int) (o int) (z int) (p (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len r))) (bridge_ok s a e r t o z p j) (and (<= 0 k) (< k j)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped a e r t) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (first_at s p j))
    (assert (edge_in_set (concat a r) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (call transfer a e r t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))
    (assert (not (mem s (idx p k))))
    (assert (not (mem s (idx p (+ k 1)))))
    (assert (mem s (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (assert (links (idx r t) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (assert (not (links (idx r t) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
    (call conn_edge (swapped a e r t) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma bridge (params (s (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int) (o int) (z int) (p (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len r))) (bridge_ok s a e r t o z p j))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped a e r t) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
  (body
    (assert (first_at s p j))
    (forall ((k int)) (call prefix_step s a e r t o z p j k))
    (call walk (swapped a e r t) p j)
    (call conn_sym (swapped a e r t) (idx p 0) (idx p j))
    (assert (== (swapped a e r t) (concat (concat a (seq-lit e)) (without r t))))
    (call edge_new a e o z)
    (call sub_prefix (concat a (seq-lit e)) (without r t))
    (call sub_prefix a (seq-lit e))
    (assert (edge_in_set (swapped a e r t) o z))
    (call conn_edge (swapped a e r t) o z)
    (assert (mem s (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (assert (edges_connected a z (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (call conn_mono a (concat a (seq-lit e)) z (idx p (+ j 1)))
    (call conn_mono (concat a (seq-lit e)) (swapped a e r t) z (idx p (+ j 1)))
    (call conn_trans (swapped a e r t) (idx p j) o z)
    (call conn_trans (swapped a e r t) (idx p j) z (idx p (+ j 1)))))
(lemma edge_to_conn (params (s (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int) (o int) (z int) (p (seq int)) (j int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len r))) (bridge_ok s a e r t o z p j) (edge_in_set (concat a r) u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped a e r t) u v))
  (body
    (call transfer a e r t u v)
    (if (edge_in_set (swapped a e r t) u v)
      (call conn_edge (swapped a e r t) u v)
      (block
        (assert (first_at s p j))
        (assert (not (mem s (idx p j))))
        (assert (mem s (idx p (+ j 1))))
        (assert (links (idx r t) u v))
        (assert (links (idx r t) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
        (call bridge s a e r t o z p j)
        (if (== u (idx p j))
          (assert (== v (idx p (+ j 1))))
          (block
            (assert (== u (idx p (+ j 1))))
            (assert (== v (idx p j)))
            (call conn_sym (swapped a e r t) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))))))))
(lemma exchange_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o int) (z int) (w int))
  (requires (== (len s) (len g)) (inside s a) (joined s a) (are_valid_edges g r) (is_spanning g (concat a r))
            (cut_min g s w) (links e o z) (mem s z) (not (mem s o)) (and (<= 0 o) (< o (len g))))
  (ensures (exists ((t1 int)) (swap_good g a e r t1 w)))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected (concat a r) o z))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) o) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges (concat a r) p)))
    (call first_exit s p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (first_at s p j))
    (assert (not (mem s (idx p j))))
    (assert (mem s (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (assert (edge_in_set (concat a r) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((q int)) (and (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len (concat a r)))) (links (idx (concat a r) q) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (if (< q (len a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat a r) q) (idx a q)))
        (assert (mem s (get (idx a q) 0)))
        (assert (mem s (get (idx a q) 1)))
        (assert false))
      (block))
    (ghost-let t int (- q (len a)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len r))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat a r) q) (idx r t)))
    (assert (links (idx r t) (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx r t) 0) (get (idx r t) 1) (get (idx r t) 2)))
    (assert (!= (mem s (get (idx r t) 0)) (mem s (get (idx r t) 1))))
    (assert (<= w (get (idx r t) 2)))
    (assert (bridge_ok s a e r t o z p j))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call edge_to_conn s a e r t o z p j u v))
    (assert (covers (concat a r) (swapped a e r t)))
    (call span_covers g (concat a r) (swapped a e r t))
    (assert (swap_good g a e r t w))))
(lemma step_beats (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o int) (z int) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (optimal g a) (is_spanning_tree g other) (== (len s) (len g)) (inside s a) (joined s a)
            (cut_min g s (get e 2)) (links e o z) (mem s z) (not (mem s o)) (and (<= 0 o) (< o (len g))))
  (ensures (beats g (concat a (seq-lit e)) other))
  (body
    (assert (beats g a other))
    (obtain ((r (seq (tuple int int int)))) (beats_with g a r other))
    (call exchange_one g s a r e o z (get e 2))
    (obtain ((t int)) (swap_good g a e r t (get e 2)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len r))))
    (call without_facts r t)
    (call valid_without g r t)
    (call total_without r t)
    (call total_concat a (seq-lit e))
    (call total_unit e)
    (assert (== (swapped a e r t) (concat (concat a (seq-lit e)) (without r t))))
    (assert (is_spanning g (concat (concat a (seq-lit e)) (without r t))))
    (assert (== (+ (len (concat a (seq-lit e))) (len (without r t))) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (beats_with g (concat a (seq-lit e)) (without r t) other))))
(lemma step_opt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o int) (z int))
  (requires (optimal g a) (== (len s) (len g)) (inside s a) (joined s a)
            (cut_min g s (get e 2)) (links e o z) (mem s z) (not (mem s o)) (and (<= 0 o) (< o (len g))))
  (ensures (optimal g (concat a (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call step_beats g s a e o z other))))
(lemma init_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len a) 0) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (beats g a other))
  (body
    (assert (== (concat a other) other))
    (assert (== (total_weight a) 0))
    (assert (is_spanning g (concat a other)))
    (assert (beats_with g a other other))))
(lemma opt_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len a) 0))
  (ensures (optimal g a))
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call init_one g a other))))
(lemma joined_init (params (s (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))) (!= k 0)) (== (idx s k) -1))))
  (ensures (joined s a))
  (body (call conn_refl a 0)))
(lemma finish_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (optimal g a) (== (+ (len a) 1) (len g)) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight a) (total_weight other)))
  (body
    (assert (beats g a other))
    (obtain ((r (seq (tuple int int int)))) (beats_with g a r other))
    (assert (== (len r) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight r) 0))))
(lemma span_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (== (len s) (len g)) (joined s a)
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s))) (mem s x)))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected a u v))
  (body
    (assert (mem s u))
    (assert (mem s v))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len s) (len g)) (== (+ (len a) 1) (len g)) (are_valid_edges g a) (joined s a)
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s))) (mem s x)))
            (optimal g a))
  (ensures (is_mst g a))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_one g s a u v))
    (assert (is_spanning g a))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g a))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call finish_one g a other))))

(lemma upd_mono (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (o int) (x int))
  (requires (upd s0 s1 o) (mem s0 x))
  (ensures (mem s1 x))
  (body))
(lemma inside_one (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o int) (z int) (k int))
  (requires (inside s0 a) (upd s0 s1 o) (mem s0 z) (links e o z) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len a) 1))))
  (ensures (and (mem s1 (get (idx (concat a (seq-lit e)) k) 0)) (mem s1 (get (idx (concat a (seq-lit e)) k) 1))))
  (body
    (call upd_mono s0 s1 o z)
    (assert (mem s1 o))
    (if (< k (len a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit e)) k) (idx a k)))
        (call upd_mono s0 s1 o (get (idx a k) 0))
        (call upd_mono s0 s1 o (get (idx a k) 1)))
      (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit e)) k) e)))))
(lemma step_inside (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o int) (z int))
  (requires (inside s0 a) (upd s0 s1 o) (mem s0 z) (links e o z))
  (ensures (inside s1 (concat a (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call inside_one s0 s1 a e o z k))))
(lemma to_z (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o int) (z int) (x int))
  (requires (joined s0 a) (upd s0 s1 o) (mem s0 z) (links e o z) (mem s1 x))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat a (seq-lit e)) x z))
  (body
    (if (== x o)
      (block
        (call edge_new a e o z)
        (call conn_edge (concat a (seq-lit e)) o z))
      (block
        (assert (mem s0 x))
        (assert (edges_connected a x z))
        (call sub_prefix a (seq-lit e))
        (call conn_mono a (concat a (seq-lit e)) x z)))))
(lemma joined_pair (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o int) (z int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (joined s0 a) (upd s0 s1 o) (mem s0 z) (links e o z) (mem s1 u) (mem s1 v))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat a (seq-lit e)) u v))
  (body
    (call to_z s0 s1 a e o z u)
    (call to_z s0 s1 a e o z v)
    (call conn_sym (concat a (seq-lit e)) v z)
    (call conn_trans (concat a (seq-lit e)) u z v)))
(lemma step_joined (params (s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o int) (z int))
  (requires (joined s0 a) (upd s0 s1 o) (mem s0 z) (links e o z))
  (ensures (joined s1 (concat a (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call joined_pair s0 s1 a e o z u v))))
(lemma step_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g a) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat a (seq-lit e))))
  (body))

(lemma edge_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma scan_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (f0 bool) (w0 int) (f1 bool) (w1 int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
            (scanned g s f0 w0 u i)
            (=> f0 (and f1 (<= w1 w0)))
            (=> (!= (mem s u) (mem s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))) (and f1 (<= w1 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
  (ensures (scanned g s f1 w1 u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma scan_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (f bool) (w int) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (scanned g s f w u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (scanned g s f w (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma scan_cut_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (w int) (u int) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (scanned g s true w (len g) 0) (has_edge g u v c) (!= (mem s u) (mem s v)))
  (ensures (<= w c))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
    (assert (!= (mem s u) (mem s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))))))
(lemma scan_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (w int))
  (requires (scanned g s true w (len g) 0))
  (ensures (cut_min g s w))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int) (c int)) (call scan_cut_one g s w u v c))))
(lemma cross_path (params (s (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (mem s (idx p 0)) (not (mem s (idx p m))))
  (ensures (exists ((k1 int)) (and (and (<= 0 k1) (< (+ k1 1) (len p))) (and (mem s (idx p k1)) (not (mem s (idx p (+ k1 1))))))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (mem s (idx p (- m 1)))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- m 1)) (< (+ (- m 1) 1) (len p)))
                   (and (mem s (idx p (- m 1))) (not (mem s (idx p (+ (- m 1) 1)))))))
      (call cross_path s p (- m 1)))))
(lemma must_find (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (f bool) (w int))
  (requires (scanned g s f w (len g) 0) (graph_is_connected g) (== (len s) (len g)) (mem s 0) (> (occurrences s -1) 0))
  (ensures f)
  (body
    (call some_outside s)
    (obtain ((v int)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))) (== (idx s v) -1)))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert (not (mem s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (call cross_path s p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((k int)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len p))) (and (mem s (idx p k)) (not (mem s (idx p (+ k 1)))))))
