  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len es))))
  (body (seq-build (len es) (fn (j) (if (== j i) x (idx es j))))))
(ghost-fn swapped ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int))) (seq (tuple int int int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))))
  (body (eupd (eupd es r (idx es k)) k ne)))
(ghost-fn fz ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (j int)) (seq (tuple int int int))
  (body (seq-build (len es) (fn (i) (if (and (>= i j) (crosses s (idx es i))) (tuple a a 0) (idx es i))))))
(ghost-fn cut_ok ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (z int) (r int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es)))
    (and (crosses s (idx es r))
         (edges_connected (eupd es r (tuple a b z)) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1))))))
(ghost-fn prefix_of ((t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (and (<= (len t) (len o))
    (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len t))) (== (idx t i) (idx o i)))))))
(ghost-fn good ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (w (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (and (is_spanning_tree g w) (and (prefix_of t w) (<= (total_weight w) (total_weight o))))))
(ghost-fn safe_for ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (exists ((w (seq (tuple int int int)))) (good g t o w))))
(ghost-fn safe ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (safe_for g t o)))))
(ghost-fn inside ((s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len t)))
    (and (ins s (get (idx t i) 0)) (ins s (get (idx t i) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int))) bool
  (body (and (== (len t) (+ (len t0) 1))
    (and (== (idx t (len t0)) e)
         (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len t0))) (== (idx t i) (idx t0 i))))))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn tree_conn ((s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((v int)) (=> (ins s v) (edges_connected t 0 v)))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma count_all (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s)))
            (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (== (idx s i) x))))
  (ensures (== (occurrences (take s k) x) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call count_all s x (- k 1))
        (call law_take_step s (- k 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))) x)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- k 1)) x))
      (call law_occurrences_none s x))))
(lemma count_absent (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s)))
            (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (!= (idx s i) x))))
  (ensures (== (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call count_absent s x (- k 1))
        (call law_take_step s (- k 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))) x)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- k 1)) x))
      (call law_occurrences_none s x))))
(lemma member_count (params (s (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences s (idx s v)) 1))
  (body (call count_member s v (len s)) (call law_take_all s)))
(lemma all_in_one (params (s (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (== (occurrences s 0) 0) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))))
  (ensures (ins s v))
  (body (if (== (idx s v) 0) (call member_count s v) (block))))

(lemma wf_ranged (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures (ranged (view wg)))
  (body (assert (== (view wg) (field wg adj)))))
(lemma edge_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (z int))
  (requires (ranged g) (has_edge g u v z))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) z))))))

(lemma scan_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (ok0 bool) (c0 int) (ok1 bool) (c1 int))
  (requires (scan_ok g s u i ok0 c0)
            (=> ok0 (and ok1 (<= c1 c0)))
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
            (=> (crossing s u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (and ok1 (<= c1 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
  (ensures (scan_ok g s u (+ i 1) ok1 c1))
  (body))
(lemma scan_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (u int) (ok bool) (c int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (scan_ok g s u (len (idx g u)) ok c))
  (ensures (scan_ok g s (+ u 1) 0 ok c))
  (body))
(lemma scan_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (ok bool) (c int) (u int) (v int) (z int))
  (requires (scan_ok g s (len g) 0 ok c) (has_edge g u v z) (crossing s u v))
  (ensures ok (<= c z))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) z))))
    (assert (crossing s u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
(lemma scan_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (ok bool) (c int))
  (requires (scan_ok g s (len g) 0 ok c))
  (ensures (=> ok (is_min g s c)) (=> (not ok) (no_cross g s)))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int) (z int)) (call scan_one g s ok c u v z))))

(spec find_best
  (params (a (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (s (ref (slice i64))))
  (returns (found bool) (bu i64) (bv i64) (bw i64))
  (requires (== (len s) (len a)) (ranged a))
  (ensures
    (=> found (has_edge a bu bv bw))
    (=> found (crossing s bu bv))
    (=> found (is_min a s bw))
    (=> (not found) (no_cross a s)))
  (effects))
(def find_best
  (body
    (let n i64 (len a))
    (let-mut ok bool false)
    (let-mut cu i64 0)
    (let-mut cv i64 0)
    (let-mut cw i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (=> ok (has_edge a cu cv cw)))
      (invariant (=> ok (crossing s cu cv)))
      (invariant (scan_ok a s u 0 ok cw))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx a u)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (=> ok (has_edge a cu cv cw)))
        (invariant (=> ok (crossing s cu cv)))
        (invariant (scan_ok a s u i ok cw))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx a u) i) 0))
        (let w i64 (get (idx (idx a u) i) 1))
        (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (ghost-let ok0 bool ok)
        (ghost-let c0 int cw)
        (if (!= (!= (idx s u) 0) (!= (idx s v) 0))
          (if (or (not ok) (< w cw))
            (block
              (assert (has_edge a u v w))
              (assert (crossing s u v))
              (set ok true)
              (set cu u)
              (set cv v)
              (set cw w))
            (block))
          (block))
        (call scan_step a s u i ok0 c0 ok cw)
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (call scan_row a s u ok cw)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call scan_final a s ok cw)
    (return ok cu cv cw)))

(lemma conn_refl (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u u))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit u))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (assert (edges_connected es u u))))
(lemma snoc_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (w int) (k int))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (path_follows_edges es p) (edge_in_set es (idx p (- (len p) 1)) w)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (concat p (seq-lit w)) k) (idx (concat p (seq-lit w)) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit w)))
    (assert (== (idx q k) (idx p k)))
    (if (< k (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (assert (== (idx q (+ k 1)) w)))))
(lemma conn_snoc (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (edges_connected es u v) (edge_in_set es v w))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u w))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call snoc_one es p w k))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit w)))
    (assert (== (len q) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) w))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es q))
    (assert (edges_connected es u w))))
(lemma edge_conn (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected es a b))
  (body (call conn_refl es a) (call conn_snoc es a a b)))
(lemma trans_walk (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (q (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len q))) (edges_connected es u (idx q 0)) (path_follows_edges es q))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u (idx q m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call trans_walk es u q (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m)))
        (call conn_snoc es u (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m)))
      (block))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (edges_connected es u v) (edges_connected es v w))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u w))
  (body
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) v) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges es q)))
    (call trans_walk es u q (- (len q) 1))))
(lemma edge_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es a b))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es b a))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) a) (== (get (idx es e) 1) b))
          (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) b) (== (get (idx es e) 1) a)))))))
(lemma sym_walk (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (path_follows_edges es p))
  (ensures (edges_connected es (idx p m) (idx p 0)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call sym_walk es p (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call edge_sym es (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))
        (call edge_conn es (idx p m) (idx p (- m 1)))
        (call conn_trans es (idx p m) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p 0)))
      (call conn_refl es (idx p 0)))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edges_connected es u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected es v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (call sym_walk es p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma lift_walk (params (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (sub_conn e1 e2) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (path_follows_edges e1 p))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 (idx p 0) (idx p m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call lift_walk e1 e2 p (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set e1 (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (assert (edges_connected e2 (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call conn_trans e2 (idx p 0) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
      (call conn_refl e2 (idx p 0)))))
(lemma lift_conn (params (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (sub_conn e1 e2) (edges_connected e1 u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges e1 p)))
    (call lift_walk e1 e2 p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma bridge (params (h (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int) (d int))
  (requires (edges_connected h a c) (edges_connected h b d) (edges_connected h a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected h c d))
  (body
    (call conn_sym h a c)
    (call conn_trans h c a b)
    (call conn_trans h c b d)))

(lemma total_upd (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len es))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (eupd es i x)) (+ (- (total_weight es) (get (idx es i) 2)) (get x 2))))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd es i x))
    (assert (== (len h) (len es)))
    (assert (== (total_weight h) (+ (get (idx h 0) 2) (total_weight (drop h 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight es) (+ (get (idx es 0) 2) (total_weight (drop es 1)))))
    (if (> i 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (drop h 1) (eupd (drop es 1) (- i 1) x)))
        (call total_upd (drop es 1) (- i 1) x)
        (assert (== (idx (drop es 1) (- i 1)) (idx es i)))
        (assert (== (idx h 0) (idx es 0))))
      (block
        (assert (== (drop h 1) (drop es 1)))
        (assert (== (idx h 0) x))))))
(lemma swapped_idx (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len es))))
  (ensures (== (len (swapped es r k ne)) (len es))
           (== (idx (swapped es r k ne) i) (if (== i k) ne (if (== i r) (idx es k) (idx es i)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd es r (idx es k)))
    (assert (== (len a1) (len es)))
    (assert (== (idx a1 i) (if (== i r) (idx es k) (idx es i))))
    (ghost-let a2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd a1 k ne))
    (assert (== (idx a2 i) (if (== i k) ne (idx a1 i))))
    (assert (== a2 (swapped es r k ne)))))
(lemma swap_edge (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))) (edge_in_set (eupd es r ne) p q))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (swapped es r k ne) p q))
  (body
    (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd es r ne))
    (ghost-let o3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es r k ne))
    (assert (== (len h) (len es)))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len h)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx h e) 0) p) (== (get (idx h e) 1) q))
          (and (== (get (idx h e) 0) q) (== (get (idx h e) 1) p)))))
    (if (== e r)
      (block
        (call swapped_idx es r k ne k)
        (assert (== (idx o3 k) ne))
        (assert (== (idx h r) ne))
        (assert (edge_in_set o3 p q)))
      (if (== e k)
        (block
          (call swapped_idx es r k ne r)
          (assert (== (idx o3 r) (idx es k)))
          (assert (== (idx h k) (idx es k)))
          (assert (edge_in_set o3 p q)))
        (block
          (call swapped_idx es r k ne e)
          (assert (== (idx o3 e) (idx es e)))
          (assert (== (idx h e) (idx es e)))
          (assert (edge_in_set o3 p q)))))))
(lemma swap_sub_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))) (edge_in_set (eupd es r ne) p q))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped es r k ne) p q))
  (body
    (call swap_edge es r k ne p q)
    (call edge_conn (swapped es r k ne) p q)))
(lemma swap_sub (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))))
  (ensures (sub_conn (eupd es r ne) (swapped es r k ne)))
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call swap_sub_one es r k ne p q))))
(lemma es_o3_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
            (edges_connected (swapped es r k ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1))
            (edge_in_set es p q))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped es r k ne) p q))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) p) (== (get (idx es e) 1) q))
          (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) q) (== (get (idx es e) 1) p)))))
    (if (== e r)
      (if (and (== p (get (idx es r) 0)) (== q (get (idx es r) 1)))
        (block)
        (call conn_sym (swapped es r k ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
      (block
        (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd es r ne))
        (assert (== (idx h e) (idx es e)))
        (assert (edge_in_set h p q))
        (call swap_sub_one es r k ne p q)))))
(lemma es_o3 (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
            (edges_connected (swapped es r k ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
  (ensures (sub_conn es (swapped es r k ne)))
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call es_o3_one es r k ne p q))))
(lemma span_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (sub_conn e1 e2) (is_spanning g e1) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected e1 u v))
    (call lift_conn e1 e2 u v)))
(lemma span_lift (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (sub_conn e1 e2) (is_spanning g e1))
  (ensures (is_spanning g e2))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_one g e1 e2 u v))))
(lemma swap_span (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (is_spanning g es) (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
            (edges_connected (eupd es r ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
  (ensures (is_spanning g (swapped es r k ne)))
  (body
    (call swap_sub es r k ne)
    (call lift_conn (eupd es r ne) (swapped es r k ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1))
    (call es_o3 es r k ne)
    (call span_lift g es (swapped es r k ne))))
(lemma valid_upd_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)) (j int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len es))) (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len es))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (eupd es i x) j) 0) (get (idx (eupd es i x) j) 1) (get (idx (eupd es i x) j) 2)))
  (body
    (if (== j i)
      (assert (== (idx (eupd es i x) j) x))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (eupd es i x) j) (idx es j)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx es j) 0) (get (idx es j) 1) (get (idx es j) 2)))))))
(lemma valid_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len es))) (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (eupd es i x)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (eupd es i x)) (len es)))
    (forall ((j int)) (call valid_upd_one g es i x j))))
(lemma swap_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
            (has_edge g (get ne 0) (get ne 1) (get ne 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (swapped es r k ne)))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1) (get (idx es k) 2)))
    (call valid_upd g es r (idx es k))
    (assert (== (len (eupd es r (idx es k))) (len es)))
    (call valid_upd g (eupd es r (idx es k)) k ne)
    (assert (== (swapped es r k ne) (eupd (eupd es r (idx es k)) k ne)))))
(lemma swap_total (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (swapped es r k ne)) (+ (- (total_weight es) (get (idx es r) 2)) (get ne 2))))
  (body
    (call total_upd es r (idx es k))
    (assert (== (len (eupd es r (idx es k))) (len es)))
    (assert (== (idx (eupd es r (idx es k)) k) (idx es k)))
    (call total_upd (eupd es r (idx es k)) k ne)
    (assert (== (swapped es r k ne) (eupd (eupd es r (idx es k)) k ne)))))
(lemma prefix_one (params (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (prefix_of t0 es) (appended t0 t ne) (== k (len t0)) (>= r k) (< r (len es)) (< k (len es))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len t))))
  (ensures (== (idx t i) (idx (swapped es r k ne) i)))
  (body
    (call swapped_idx es r k ne i)
    (if (< i k)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t i) (idx t0 i)))
        (assert (== (idx t0 i) (idx es i))))
      (assert (== (idx t i) ne)))))
(lemma prefix_swapped (params (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (prefix_of t0 es) (appended t0 t ne) (== k (len t0)) (>= r k) (< r (len es)) (< k (len es)))
  (ensures (prefix_of t (swapped es r k ne)))
  (body
    (call swapped_idx es r k ne k)
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_one t0 t es r k ne i))))

(lemma fz_edge_zero (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (edge_in_set (fz es s a 0) p q))
  (ensures (not (crossing s p q)))
  (body
    (ghost-let f (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a 0))
    (assert (== (len f) (len es)))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len f)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) p) (== (get (idx f e) 1) q))
          (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) q) (== (get (idx f e) 1) p)))))
    (if (crosses s (idx es e))
      (assert (== (idx f e) (tuple a a 0)))
      (assert (== (idx f e) (idx es e))))))
(lemma fz_walk_zero (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (path_follows_edges (fz es s a 0) p))
  (ensures (not (crossing s (idx p 0) (idx p m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call fz_walk_zero es s a p (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set (fz es s a 0) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call fz_edge_zero es s a (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
      (block))))
(lemma fz_zero (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edges_connected (fz es s a 0) a b))
  (ensures (not (crossing s a b)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges (fz es s a 0) p)))
    (call fz_walk_zero es s a p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma fz_full (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int))
  (ensures (== (fz es s a (len es)) es))
  (body))
(lemma fz_same (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (r int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (not (crosses s (idx es r))))
  (ensures (== (fz es s a (+ r 1)) (fz es s a r)))
  (body))
(lemma fz_more_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (r int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (edge_in_set (fz es s a (+ r 1)) p q))
  (ensures (or (edge_in_set (fz es s a r) p q)
               (or (and (== p (get (idx es r) 0)) (== q (get (idx es r) 1)))
                   (and (== p (get (idx es r) 1)) (== q (get (idx es r) 0))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let f1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a (+ r 1)))
    (ghost-let f0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a r))
    (assert (== (len f1) (len es)))
    (assert (== (len f0) (len es)))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len f1)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx f1 e) 0) p) (== (get (idx f1 e) 1) q))
          (and (== (get (idx f1 e) 0) q) (== (get (idx f1 e) 1) p)))))
    (if (== e r)
      (assert (== (idx f1 r) (idx es r)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx f1 e) (idx f0 e)))
        (assert (edge_in_set f0 p q))))))
(lemma fz_more (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (r int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))))
  (ensures (one_more (fz es s a (+ r 1)) (fz es s a r) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call fz_more_one es s a r p q))))
(lemma leave (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (c int) (d int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (one_more f1 f0 c d) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (== (idx p 0) a) (path_follows_edges f1 p))
  (ensures (or (edges_connected f0 a (idx p m)) (or (edges_connected f0 a c) (edges_connected f0 a d))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call leave f1 f0 a c d p (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set f1 (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (if (and (edges_connected f0 a (idx p (- m 1))) (edge_in_set f0 (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
          (call conn_snoc f0 a (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))
          (block)))
      (call conn_refl f0 a))))
(lemma leave_top (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int) (d int))
  (requires (one_more f1 f0 c d) (edges_connected f1 a b) (not (edges_connected f0 a b)))
  (ensures (or (edges_connected f0 a c) (edges_connected f0 a d)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges f1 p)))
    (call leave f1 f0 a c d p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma f0_h_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (z int) (r int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (crosses s (idx es r)) (edge_in_set (fz es s a r) p q))
  (ensures (edges_connected (eupd es r (tuple a b z)) p q))
  (body
    (ghost-let f (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a r))
    (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd es r (tuple a b z)))
    (assert (== (len f) (len es)))
    (assert (== (len h) (len es)))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len f)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) p) (== (get (idx f e) 1) q))
          (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) q) (== (get (idx f e) 1) p)))))
    (if (and (>= e r) (crosses s (idx es e)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx f e) (tuple a a 0)))
        (call conn_refl h a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx f e) (idx es e)))
        (assert (!= e r))
        (assert (== (idx h e) (idx es e)))
        (assert (edge_in_set h p q))
        (call edge_conn h p q)))))
(lemma f0_h (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (z int) (r int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (crosses s (idx es r)))
  (ensures (sub_conn (fz es s a r) (eupd es r (tuple a b z))))
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call f0_h_one es s a b z r p q))))
(lemma cut_found (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (z int) (r int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (crosses s (idx es r))
            (edges_connected (fz es s a (+ r 1)) a b)
            (not (edges_connected (fz es s a r) a b)))
  (ensures (cut_ok es s a b z r))
  (body
    (ghost-let c int (get (idx es r) 0))
    (ghost-let d int (get (idx es r) 1))
    (ghost-let f1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a (+ r 1)))
    (ghost-let f0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a r))
    (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd es r (tuple a b z)))
    (call fz_more es s a r)
    (call leave_top f1 f0 a b c d)
    (call conn_sym f1 a b)
    (if (edges_connected f0 b a) (call conn_sym f0 b a) (block))
    (call leave_top f1 f0 b a c d)
    (call f0_h es s a b z r)
    (assert (== (idx h r) (tuple a b z)))
    (assert (edge_in_set h a b))
    (call edge_conn h a b)
    (if (and (edges_connected f0 a c) (edges_connected f0 b d))
      (block
        (call lift_conn f0 h a c)
        (call lift_conn f0 h b d)
        (call bridge h a b c d))
      (if (and (edges_connected f0 a d) (edges_connected f0 b c))
        (block
          (call lift_conn f0 h a d)
          (call lift_conn f0 h b c)
          (call conn_sym h a b)
          (call bridge h b a c d))
        (if (edges_connected f0 a c)
          (block
            (call conn_sym f0 b c)
            (call conn_trans f0 a c b))
          (block
            (call conn_sym f0 b d)
            (call conn_trans f0 a d b)))))))
(lemma find_r (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (z int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len es))) (crossing s a b) (edges_connected (fz es s a j) a b))
  (ensures (exists ((r int)) (cut_ok es s a b z r)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (if (crosses s (idx es (- j 1)))
        (if (edges_connected (fz es s a (- j 1)) a b)
          (call find_r es s a b z (- j 1))
          (call cut_found es s a b z (- j 1)))
        (block
          (call fz_same es s a (- j 1))
          (call find_r es s a b z (- j 1))))
      (call fz_zero es s a b))))

(lemma exchange (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))
                        (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (z int))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g es) (prefix_of t0 es) (inside s t0)
            (has_edge g a b z) (crossing s a b) (is_min g s z)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
            (appended t0 t (tuple a b z))
            (< (len t0) (- (len g) 1)))
  (ensures (safe_for g t es))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning g es))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g es))
    (assert (== (len es) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (edges_connected es a b))
    (call fz_full es s a)
    (call find_r es s a b z (len es))
    (obtain ((r int)) (cut_ok es s a b z r))
    (ghost-let k int (len t0))
    (if (< r k)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t0 r) (idx es r)))
        (assert (ins s (get (idx t0 r) 0)))
        (assert (ins s (get (idx t0 r) 1))))
      (block))
    (assert (>= r k))
    (ghost-let ne (tuple int int int) (tuple a b z))
    (ghost-let o3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es r k ne))
    (assert (edges_connected (eupd es r ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
    (call swap_span g es r k ne)
    (assert (has_edge g (get ne 0) (get ne 1) (get ne 2)))
    (call swap_valid g es r k ne)
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1) (get (idx es r) 2)))
    (assert (crossing s (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
    (assert (<= z (get (idx es r) 2)))
    (call swap_total es r k ne)
    (assert (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight es)))
    (call prefix_swapped t0 t es r k ne)
    (call swapped_idx es r k ne k)
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o3))
    (assert (good g t es o3))))
(lemma step_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))
                        (a int) (b int) (z int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (safe g t0) (is_spanning_tree g o) (inside s t0)
            (has_edge g a b z) (crossing s a b) (is_min g s z)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
            (appended t0 t (tuple a b z))
            (< (len t0) (- (len g) 1)))
  (ensures (safe_for g t o))
  (body
    (assert (safe_for g t0 o))
    (obtain ((w (seq (tuple int int int)))) (good g t0 o w))
    (call exchange g s t0 t w a b z)
    (obtain ((v (seq (tuple int int int)))) (good g t w v))
    (assert (good g t o v))))
(lemma step_safe (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))
                         (a int) (b int) (z int))
  (requires (safe g t0) (inside s t0)
            (has_edge g a b z) (crossing s a b) (is_min g s z)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
            (appended t0 t (tuple a b z))
            (< (len t0) (- (len g) 1)))
  (ensures (safe g t))
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call step_one g s t0 t a b z o))))
(lemma init_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0) (is_spanning_tree g o))
  (ensures (safe_for g t o))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_of t o))
    (assert (good g t o o))))
(lemma init_safe (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0))
  (ensures (safe g t))
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call init_one g t o))))
(lemma init_conn (params (s (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))) (!= i 0)) (== (idx s i) 0))))
  (ensures (tree_conn s t))
  (body (call conn_refl t 0)))

(lemma ins_keep (params (s0 (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (y int) (u int))
  (requires (upd s0 s y 1) (ins s0 u))
  (ensures (ins s u))
  (body (if (!= u y) (assert (== (idx s u) (idx s0 u))) (block))))
(lemma step_inside_one (params (s0 (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (z int) (y int) (i int))
  (requires (inside s0 t0) (appended t0 t (tuple a b z)) (upd s0 s y 1) (ins s a) (ins s b)
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len t))))
  (ensures (and (ins s (get (idx t i) 0)) (ins s (get (idx t i) 1))))
  (body
    (if (< i (len t0))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t i) (idx t0 i)))
        (assert (ins s0 (get (idx t0 i) 0)))
        (assert (ins s0 (get (idx t0 i) 1)))
        (call ins_keep s0 s y (get (idx t0 i) 0))
        (call ins_keep s0 s y (get (idx t0 i) 1)))
      (assert (== (idx t i) (tuple a b z))))))
(lemma step_inside (params (s0 (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (z int) (y int))
  (requires (inside s0 t0) (appended t0 t (tuple a b z)) (upd s0 s y 1) (ins s a) (ins s b))
  (ensures (inside s t))
  (body (forall ((i int)) (call step_inside_one s0 s t0 t a b z y i))))
(lemma step_valid_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (z int) (i int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g t0) (appended t0 t (tuple a b z)) (has_edge g a b z)
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len t))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx t i) 0) (get (idx t i) 1) (get (idx t i) 2)))
  (body
    (if (< i (len t0))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t i) (idx t0 i)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t0 i) 0) (get (idx t0 i) 1) (get (idx t0 i) 2))))
      (assert (== (idx t i) (tuple a b z))))))
(lemma step_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (z int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g t0) (appended t0 t (tuple a b z)) (has_edge g a b z))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g t))
  (body (forall ((i int)) (call step_valid_one g t0 t a b z i))))
(lemma append_sub_one (params (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (appended t0 t e) (edge_in_set t0 p q))
  (ensures (edges_connected t p q))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len t0)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx t0 i) 0) p) (== (get (idx t0 i) 1) q))
          (and (== (get (idx t0 i) 0) q) (== (get (idx t0 i) 1) p)))))
    (assert (== (idx t i) (idx t0 i)))
    (assert (edge_in_set t p q))
    (call edge_conn t p q)))
(lemma append_sub (params (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (appended t0 t e))
  (ensures (sub_conn t0 t))
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call append_sub_one t0 t e p q))))
(lemma step_conn_one (params (s0 (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (z int) (x int) (y int) (v int))
  (requires (tree_conn s0 t0) (appended t0 t (tuple a b z))
            (or (and (== x a) (== y b)) (and (== x b) (== y a)))
            (ins s0 x) (upd s0 s y 1) (ins s v))
  (ensures (edges_connected t 0 v))
  (body
    (call append_sub t0 t (tuple a b z))
    (assert (edges_connected t0 0 x))
    (call lift_conn t0 t 0 x)
    (if (== v y)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t (len t0)) (tuple a b z)))
        (assert (edge_in_set t x y))
        (call conn_snoc t 0 x y))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s v) (idx s0 v)))
        (assert (ins s0 v))
        (assert (edges_connected t0 0 v))
        (call lift_conn t0 t 0 v)))))
(lemma step_conn (params (s0 (seq int)) (s (seq int)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (z int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (tree_conn s0 t0) (appended t0 t (tuple a b z))
            (or (and (== x a) (== y b)) (and (== x b) (== y a)))
            (ins s0 x) (upd s0 s y 1))
  (ensures (tree_conn s t))
  (body (forall ((v int)) (call step_conn_one s0 s t0 t a b z x y v))))

(lemma stay (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (no_cross g s) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (path_follows_graph g p) (ins s (idx p 0)))
  (ensures (ins s (idx p m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call stay g s p (- m 1))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- m 1))) (< (idx p (- m 1)) (len g)))
                                    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- m 1)))))))
                               (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) i) 0) (idx p m))))
        (assert (has_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m) (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) i) 1)))
        (assert (not (crossing s (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))))

    (assert (== (len h) (len es)))
    (assert (== (total_weight h) (+ (get (idx h 0) 2) (total_weight (drop h 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight es) (+ (get (idx es 0) 2) (total_weight (drop es 1)))))
    (if (> i 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (drop h 1) (eupd (drop es 1) (- i 1) x)))
        (call total_upd (drop es 1) (- i 1) x)
        (assert (== (idx (drop es 1) (- i 1)) (idx es i)))
        (assert (== (idx h 0) (idx es 0))))
      (block
        (assert (== (drop h 1) (drop es 1)))
        (assert (== (idx h 0) x))))))
(lemma swapped_idx (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len es))))
  (ensures (== (len (swapped es r k ne)) (len es))
           (== (idx (swapped es r k ne) i) (if (== i k) ne (if (== i r) (idx es k) (idx es i)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd es r (idx es k)))
    (assert (== (len a1) (len es)))
    (assert (== (idx a1 i) (if (== i r) (idx es k) (idx es i))))
    (ghost-let a2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd a1 k ne))
    (assert (== (idx a2 i) (if (== i k) ne (idx a1 i))))
    (assert (== a2 (swapped es r k ne)))))
(lemma swap_edge (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))) (edge_in_set (eupd es r ne) p q))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (swapped es r k ne) p q))
  (body
    (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd es r ne))
    (ghost-let o3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es r k ne))
    (assert (== (len h) (len es)))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len h)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx h e) 0) p) (== (get (idx h e) 1) q))
          (and (== (get (idx h e) 0) q) (== (get (idx h e) 1) p)))))
    (if (== e r)
      (block
        (call swapped_idx es r k ne k)
        (assert (== (idx o3 k) ne))
        (assert (== (idx h r) ne))
        (assert (edge_in_set o3 p q)))
      (if (== e k)
        (block
          (call swapped_idx es r k ne r)
          (assert (== (idx o3 r) (idx es k)))
          (assert (== (idx h k) (idx es k)))
          (assert (edge_in_set o3 p q)))
        (block
          (call swapped_idx es r k ne e)
          (assert (== (idx o3 e) (idx es e)))
          (assert (== (idx h e) (idx es e)))
          (assert (edge_in_set o3 p q)))))))
(lemma swap_sub_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))) (edge_in_set (eupd es r ne) p q))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped es r k ne) p q))
  (body
    (call swap_edge es r k ne p q)
    (call edge_conn (swapped es r k ne) p q)))
(lemma swap_sub (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))))
  (ensures (sub_conn (eupd es r ne) (swapped es r k ne)))
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call swap_sub_one es r k ne p q))))
(lemma es_o3_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
            (edges_connected (swapped es r k ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1))
            (edge_in_set es p q))
  (ensures (edges_connected (swapped es r k ne) p q))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) p) (== (get (idx es e) 1) q))
          (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) q) (== (get (idx es e) 1) p)))))
    (if (== e r)
      (if (and (== p (get (idx es r) 0)) (== q (get (idx es r) 1)))
        (block)
        (call conn_sym (swapped es r k ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
      (block
        (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd es r ne))
        (assert (== (idx h e) (idx es e)))
        (assert (edge_in_set h p q))
        (call swap_sub_one es r k ne p q)))))
(lemma es_o3 (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
            (edges_connected (swapped es r k ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
  (ensures (sub_conn es (swapped es r k ne)))
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call es_o3_one es r k ne p q))))
(lemma span_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (sub_conn e1 e2) (is_spanning g e1) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected e2 u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected e1 u v))
    (call lift_conn e1 e2 u v)))
(lemma span_lift (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (sub_conn e1 e2) (is_spanning g e1))
  (ensures (is_spanning g e2))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_one g e1 e2 u v))))
(lemma swap_span (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (is_spanning g es) (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
            (edges_connected (eupd es r ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
  (ensures (is_spanning g (swapped es r k ne)))
  (body
    (call swap_sub es r k ne)
    (call lift_conn (eupd es r ne) (swapped es r k ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1))
    (call es_o3 es r k ne)
    (call span_lift g es (swapped es r k ne))))
(lemma valid_upd_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)) (j int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len es))) (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len es))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx (eupd es i x) j) 0) (get (idx (eupd es i x) j) 1) (get (idx (eupd es i x) j) 2)))
  (body
    (if (== j i)
      (assert (== (idx (eupd es i x) j) x))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (eupd es i x) j) (idx es j)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx es j) 0) (get (idx es j) 1) (get (idx es j) 2)))))))
(lemma valid_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len es))) (has_edge g (get x 0) (get x 1) (get x 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (eupd es i x)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (eupd es i x)) (len es)))
    (forall ((j int)) (call valid_upd_one g es i x j))))
(lemma swap_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
            (has_edge g (get ne 0) (get ne 1) (get ne 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (swapped es r k ne)))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx es k) 0) (get (idx es k) 1) (get (idx es k) 2)))
    (call valid_upd g es r (idx es k))
    (assert (== (len (eupd es r (idx es k))) (len es)))
    (call valid_upd g (eupd es r (idx es k)) k ne)
    (assert (== (swapped es r k ne) (eupd (eupd es r (idx es k)) k ne)))))
(lemma swap_total (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (swapped es r k ne)) (+ (- (total_weight es) (get (idx es r) 2)) (get ne 2))))
  (body
    (call total_upd es r (idx es k))
    (assert (== (len (eupd es r (idx es k))) (len es)))
    (assert (== (idx (eupd es r (idx es k)) k) (idx es k)))
    (call total_upd (eupd es r (idx es k)) k ne)
    (assert (== (swapped es r k ne) (eupd (eupd es r (idx es k)) k ne)))))
(lemma prefix_one (params (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)) (i int))
  (requires (prefix_of t0 es) (appended t0 t ne) (== k (len t0)) (>= r k) (< r (len es)) (< k (len es))
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len t))))
  (ensures (== (idx t i) (idx (swapped es r k ne) i)))
  (body
    (call swapped_idx es r k ne i)
    (if (< i k)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t i) (idx t0 i)))
        (assert (== (idx t0 i) (idx es i))))
      (assert (== (idx t i) ne)))))
(lemma prefix_swapped (params (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (r int) (k int) (ne (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (prefix_of t0 es) (appended t0 t ne) (== k (len t0)) (>= r k) (< r (len es)) (< k (len es)))
  (ensures (prefix_of t (swapped es r k ne)))
  (body
    (call swapped_idx es r k ne k)
    (forall ((i int)) (call prefix_one t0 t es r k ne i))))

(lemma fz_edge_zero (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (edge_in_set (fz es s a 0) p q))
  (ensures (not (crossing s p q)))
  (body
    (ghost-let f (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a 0))
    (assert (== (len f) (len es)))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len f)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) p) (== (get (idx f e) 1) q))
          (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) q) (== (get (idx f e) 1) p)))))
    (if (crosses s (idx es e))
      (assert (== (idx f e) (tuple a a 0)))
      (assert (== (idx f e) (idx es e))))))
(lemma fz_walk_zero (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (path_follows_edges (fz es s a 0) p))
  (ensures (not (crossing s (idx p 0) (idx p m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call fz_walk_zero es s a p (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set (fz es s a 0) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call fz_edge_zero es s a (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
      (block))))
(lemma fz_zero (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edges_connected (fz es s a 0) a b))
  (ensures (not (crossing s a b)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges (fz es s a 0) p)))
    (call fz_walk_zero es s a p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma fz_full (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int))
  (ensures (== (fz es s a (len es)) es))
  (body))
(lemma fz_same (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (r int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (not (crosses s (idx es r))))
  (ensures (== (fz es s a (+ r 1)) (fz es s a r)))
  (body))
(lemma fz_more_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (r int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (edge_in_set (fz es s a (+ r 1)) p q))
  (ensures (or (edge_in_set (fz es s a r) p q)
               (or (and (== p (get (idx es r) 0)) (== q (get (idx es r) 1)))
                   (and (== p (get (idx es r) 1)) (== q (get (idx es r) 0))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let f1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a (+ r 1)))
    (ghost-let f0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a r))
    (assert (== (len f1) (len es)))
    (assert (== (len f0) (len es)))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len f1)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx f1 e) 0) p) (== (get (idx f1 e) 1) q))
          (and (== (get (idx f1 e) 0) q) (== (get (idx f1 e) 1) p)))))
    (if (== e r)
      (assert (== (idx f1 r) (idx es r)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx f1 e) (idx f0 e)))
        (assert (edge_in_set f0 p q))))))
(lemma fz_more (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (r int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))))
  (ensures (one_more (fz es s a (+ r 1)) (fz es s a r) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call fz_more_one es s a r p q))))
(lemma leave (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (c int) (d int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (one_more f1 f0 c d) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (== (idx p 0) a) (path_follows_edges f1 p))
  (ensures (or (edges_connected f0 a (idx p m)) (or (edges_connected f0 a c) (edges_connected f0 a d))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call leave f1 f0 a c d p (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set f1 (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (if (and (edges_connected f0 a (idx p (- m 1))) (edge_in_set f0 (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
          (call conn_snoc f0 a (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))
          (block)))
      (call conn_refl f0 a))))
(lemma leave_top (params (f1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (f0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int) (d int))
  (requires (one_more f1 f0 c d) (edges_connected f1 a b) (not (edges_connected f0 a b)))
  (ensures (or (edges_connected f0 a c) (edges_connected f0 a d)))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges f1 p)))
    (call leave f1 f0 a c d p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma f0_h_one (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (z int) (r int) (p int) (q int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (crosses s (idx es r)) (edge_in_set (fz es s a r) p q))
  (ensures (edges_connected (eupd es r (tuple a b z)) p q))
  (body
    (ghost-let f (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a r))
    (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd es r (tuple a b z)))
    (assert (== (len f) (len es)))
    (assert (== (len h) (len es)))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len f)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) p) (== (get (idx f e) 1) q))
          (and (== (get (idx f e) 0) q) (== (get (idx f e) 1) p)))))
    (if (and (>= e r) (crosses s (idx es e)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx f e) (tuple a a 0)))
        (call conn_refl h a))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx f e) (idx es e)))
        (assert (!= e r))
        (assert (== (idx h e) (idx es e)))
        (assert (edge_in_set h p q))
        (call edge_conn h p q)))))
(lemma f0_h (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (z int) (r int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (crosses s (idx es r)))
  (ensures (sub_conn (fz es s a r) (eupd es r (tuple a b z))))
  (body (forall ((p int) (q int)) (call f0_h_one es s a b z r p q))))
(lemma cut_found (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (z int) (r int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len es))) (crosses s (idx es r))
            (edges_connected (fz es s a (+ r 1)) a b)
            (not (edges_connected (fz es s a r) a b)))
  (ensures (cut_ok es s a b z r))
  (body
    (ghost-let c int (get (idx es r) 0))
    (ghost-let d int (get (idx es r) 1))
    (ghost-let f1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a (+ r 1)))
    (ghost-let f0 (seq (tuple int int int)) (fz es s a r))
    (ghost-let h (seq (tuple int int int)) (eupd es r (tuple a b z)))
    (call fz_more es s a r)
    (call leave_top f1 f0 a b c d)
    (call conn_sym f1 a b)
    (if (edges_connected f0 b a) (call conn_sym f0 b a) (block))
    (call leave_top f1 f0 b a c d)
    (call f0_h es s a b z r)
    (assert (== (idx h r) (tuple a b z)))
    (assert (edge_in_set h a b))
    (call edge_conn h a b)
    (if (and (edges_connected f0 a c) (edges_connected f0 b d))
      (block
        (call lift_conn f0 h a c)
        (call lift_conn f0 h b d)
        (call bridge h a b c d))
      (if (and (edges_connected f0 a d) (edges_connected f0 b c))
        (block
          (call lift_conn f0 h a d)
          (call lift_conn f0 h b c)
          (call conn_sym h a b)
          (call bridge h b a c d))
        (if (edges_connected f0 a c)
          (block
            (call conn_sym f0 b c)
            (call conn_trans f0 a c b))
          (block
            (call conn_sym f0 b d)
            (call conn_trans f0 a d b)))))))
(lemma find_r (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (z int) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len es))) (crossing s a b) (edges_connected (fz es s a j) a b))
  (ensures (exists ((r int)) (cut_ok es s a b z r)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (if (crosses s (idx es (- j 1)))
        (if (edges_connected (fz es s a (- j 1)) a b)
          (call find_r es s a b z (- j 1))
          (call cut_found es s a b z (- j 1)))
        (block
          (call fz_same es s a (- j 1))
          (call find_r es s a b z (- j 1))))
      (call fz_zero es s a b))))

(lemma exchange (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))
                        (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (z int))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g es) (prefix_of t0 es) (inside s t0)
            (has_edge g a b z) (crossing s a b) (is_min g s z)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
            (appended t0 t (tuple a b z))
            (< (len t0) (- (len g) 1)))
  (ensures (safe_for g t es))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning g es))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g es))
    (assert (== (len es) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (edges_connected es a b))
    (call fz_full es s a)
    (call find_r es s a b z (len es))
    (obtain ((r int)) (cut_ok es s a b z r))
    (ghost-let k int (len t0))
    (if (< r k)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t0 r) (idx es r)))
        (assert (ins s (get (idx t0 r) 0)))
        (assert (ins s (get (idx t0 r) 1))))
      (block))
    (assert (>= r k))
    (ghost-let ne (tuple int int int) (tuple a b z))
    (ghost-let o3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (swapped es r k ne))
    (assert (edges_connected (eupd es r ne) (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
    (call swap_span g es r k ne)
    (assert (has_edge g (get ne 0) (get ne 1) (get ne 2)))
    (call swap_valid g es r k ne)
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1) (get (idx es r) 2)))
    (assert (crossing s (get (idx es r) 0) (get (idx es r) 1)))
    (assert (<= z (get (idx es r) 2)))
    (call swap_total es r k ne)
    (assert (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight es)))
    (call prefix_swapped t0 t es r k ne)
    (call swapped_idx es r k ne k)
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o3))
    (assert (good g t es o3))))
(lemma step_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))
                        (a int) (b int) (z int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (safe g t0) (is_spanning_tree g o) (inside s t0)
            (has_edge g a b z) (crossing s a b) (is_min g s z)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
            (appended t0 t (tuple a b z))
            (< (len t0) (- (len g) 1)))
  (ensures (safe_for g t o))
  (body
    (assert (safe_for g t0 o))
    (obtain ((w (seq (tuple int int int)))) (good g t0 o w))
    (call exchange g s t0 t w a b z)
    (obtain ((v (seq (tuple int int int)))) (good g t w v))
    (assert (good g t o v))))
(lemma step_safe (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))
                         (a int) (b int) (z int))
  (requires (safe g t0) (inside s t0)
            (has_edge g a b z) (crossing s a b) (is_min g s z)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
            (appended t0 t (tuple a b z))
            (< (len t0) (- (len g) 1)))

(lemma cut_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p)
            (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len p)))
            (== (idx p i) (idx p j))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (+ i (- (len p) j)))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (cut_seq p i j) k) (idx (cut_seq p i j) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (call cut_idx p i j k)
    (call cut_idx p i j (+ k 1))
    (if (< (+ k 1) i)
      (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
      (if (< k i)
        (block
          (assert (== (+ k 1) i))
          (assert (== (+ (- (+ k 1) i) j) j))
          (assert (== (idx (cut_seq p i j) (+ k 1)) (idx p i)))
          (assert (== (idx (cut_seq p i j) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
        (block
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p (+ (- k i) j)) (idx p (+ (+ (- k i) j) 1))))
          (assert (== (+ (+ (- k i) j) 1) (+ (- (+ k 1) i) j))))))))
(lemma simplify_walk (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b) (path_follows_edges es p))
  (ensures (exists ((q (seq int)))
    (and (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges es q))
         (simple_path q))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (simple_path p)
      (assert (and (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges es p))
                   (simple_path p)))
      (block
        (obtain ((i int)) (exists ((j0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j0)) (< j0 (len p))) (!= (idx p i) (+ (idx p j0) 1)))))
        (obtain ((i2 int)) (exists ((j1 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 j1)) (< j1 (len p))) (== (idx p i2) (idx p j1)))))
        (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i2) (< i2 j)) (< j (len p))) (== (idx p i2) (idx p j))))
        (call cut_idx p i2 j 0)
        (call cut_idx p i2 j (- (+ i2 (- (len p) j)) 1))
        (forall ((k int)) (call cut_at es p i2 j k))
        (assert (== (idx (cut_seq p i2 j) 0) a))
        (assert (== (idx (cut_seq p i2 j) (- (len (cut_seq p i2 j)) 1)) b))
        (assert (path_follows_edges es (cut_seq p i2 j)))
        (call simplify_walk es (cut_seq p i2 j) a b)))))
(lemma simple_ne (params (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (simple_path q) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len q))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len q))) (!= i j))
  (ensures (!= (idx q i) (idx q j)))
  (body))
(lemma find_cross (params (ins (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (in_s ins (idx p 0)) (not (in_s ins (idx p m))))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j m)) (and (in_s ins (idx p j)) (not (in_s ins (idx p (+ j 1))))))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (block)
      (if (in_s ins (idx p (- m 1)))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- m 1)) (< (- m 1) m))
                     (and (in_s ins (idx p (- m 1))) (not (in_s ins (idx p (+ (- m 1) 1)))))))
        (call find_cross ins p (- m 1))))))

(lemma tw_change (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (s2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (== (len s2) (len s)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
            (forall ((n int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 n) (< n (len s))) (!= n i)) (== (idx s n) (idx s2 n)))))
  (ensures (== (- (total_weight s2) (get (idx s2 i) 2)) (- (total_weight s) (get (idx s i) 2))))
  (decreases i)
  (body
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight s2) (+ (get (idx s2 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s2 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (drop s 1) (drop s2 1)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx s 0) (idx s2 0)))
        (assert (== (idx (drop s 1) (- i 1)) (idx s i)))
        (assert (== (idx (drop s2 1) (- i 1)) (idx s2 i)))
        (call tw_change (drop s 1) (drop s2 1) (- i 1))))))
(lemma swap_weight (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (la int) (r int) (d (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (is_swap t t2 la r d))
  (ensures (== (total_weight t2) (+ (- (total_weight t) (get (idx t r) 2)) (get d 2))))
  (body
    (ghost-let t1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-build (len t) (fn (n) (if (== n r) (idx t la) (idx t n)))))
    (assert (== (len t1) (len t)))
    (assert (== (idx t1 r) (idx t la)))
    (assert (== (idx t1 la) (idx t la)))
    (assert (== (idx t2 la) d))
    (call tw_change t t1 r)
    (call tw_change t1 t2 la)))
(lemma swap_valid_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (la int) (r int) (d (tuple int int int)) (n int))
  (requires (is_swap t t2 la r d) (are_valid_edges g t) (has_edge g (get d 0) (get d 1) (get d 2))
            (and (<= 0 n) (< n (len t2))))
  (ensures (has_edge g (get (idx t2 n) 0) (get (idx t2 n) 1) (get (idx t2 n) 2)))
  (body
    (if (== n la)
      (assert (== (idx t2 n) d))
      (if (== n r)
        (block
          (assert (== (idx t2 n) (idx t la)))
          (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t la) 0) (get (idx t la) 1) (get (idx t la) 2))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx t2 n) (idx t n)))
          (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t n) 0) (get (idx t n) 1) (get (idx t n) 2))))))))
(lemma keep_edge (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (la int) (r int) (d (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (n int))
  (requires (is_swap t t2 la r d) (and (<= 0 n) (< n (len t))) (!= n r) (joins (idx t n) x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t2 x y))
  (body
    (if (== n la)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t2 r) (idx t la)))
        (call edge_intro t2 r x y))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t2 n) (idx t n)))
        (call edge_intro t2 n x y)))))
(lemma step_kept (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (la int) (r int) (d (tuple int int int)) (q (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (is_swap t t2 la r d) (path_follows_edges t q) (simple_path q)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< (+ j 1) (len q)))
            (joins (idx t r) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len q))) (!= k j))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t2 (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((n int)) (and (and (<= 0 n) (< n (len t)))
                           (or (and (== (get (idx t n) 0) (idx q k)) (== (get (idx t n) 1) (idx q (+ k 1))))
                               (and (== (get (idx t n) 0) (idx q (+ k 1))) (== (get (idx t n) 1) (idx q k))))))
    (call simple_ne q k j)
    (if (== k (+ j 1))
      (call simple_ne q (+ k 1) j)
      (call simple_ne q k (+ j 1)))
    (assert (!= n r))
    (call keep_edge t t2 la r d (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)) n)))
(lemma reroute (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (la int) (r int) (d (tuple int int int)) (q (seq int)) (j int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_swap t t2 la r d) (path_follows_edges t q) (simple_path q)
            (> (len q) 0) (== (idx q 0) x) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< (+ j 1) (len q)))
            (joins (idx t r) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
            (joins d x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected t2 (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((k int)) (call step_kept t t2 la r d q j k))
    (assert (== (idx t2 la) d))
    (call edge_intro t2 la x y)
    (call conn_step t2 x y)
    (call conn_refl t2 (idx q 0))
    (call conn_along t2 (idx q 0) q 0 j)
    (call conn_sym t2 (idx q 0) (idx q j))
    (call conn_refl t2 (idx q (+ j 1)))
    (call conn_along t2 (idx q (+ j 1)) q (+ j 1) (- (len q) 1))
    (call conn_sym t2 (idx q (+ j 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1)))
    (call conn_trans t2 (idx q j) x y)
    (call conn_trans t2 (idx q j) y (idx q (+ j 1)))))
(lemma edge_lift (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (la int) (r int) (d (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int) (c int) (e int))
  (requires (is_swap t t2 la r d) (edges_connected t2 a b) (joins (idx t r) a b) (edge_in_set t c e))
  (ensures (edges_connected t2 c e))
  (body
    (obtain ((n int)) (and (and (<= 0 n) (< n (len t)))
                           (or (and (== (get (idx t n) 0) c) (== (get (idx t n) 1) e))
                               (and (== (get (idx t n) 0) e) (== (get (idx t n) 1) c)))))
    (if (== n r)
      (call conn_sym t2 a b)
      (block
        (call keep_edge t t2 la r d c e n)
        (call conn_step t2 c e)))))
(lemma swap_tree (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (la int) (r int) (d (tuple int int int)) (q (seq int)) (j int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g t) (is_swap t t2 la r d) (path_follows_edges t q) (simple_path q)
            (> (len q) 0) (== (idx q 0) x) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< (+ j 1) (len q)))
            (joins (idx t r) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)))
            (joins d x y)
            (has_edge g (get d 0) (get d 1) (get d 2)))
  (ensures (is_spanning_tree g t2))
  (body
    (call reroute t t2 la r d q j x y)
    (forall ((c int) (e int)) (call edge_lift t t2 la r d (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1)) c e))
    (assert (lifted t t2))
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g t))
    (call span_lift g t t2)
    (forall ((n int)) (call swap_valid_at g t t2 la r d n))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g t2))
    (assert (is_spanning g t2))
    (assert (== (len t2) (- (len g) 1)))))
(lemma swap_agrees_at (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (la int) (r int) (d (tuple int int int)) (n int))
  (requires (is_swap t t2 la r d) (agrees t a) (== la (len a)) (and (<= 0 n) (< n (+ la 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx t2 n) (idx (concat a (seq-lit d)) n)))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit d) 0) d))
    (assert (== (len (concat a (seq-lit d))) (+ la 1)))
    (if (== n la)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t2 n) d))
        (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit d)) n) d)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t2 n) (idx t n)))
        (assert (== (idx t n) (idx a n)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat a (seq-lit d)) n) (idx a n)))))))
(lemma swap_agrees (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (la int) (r int) (d (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (is_swap t t2 la r d) (agrees t a) (== la (len a)))
  (ensures (agrees t2 (concat a (seq-lit d))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat a (seq-lit d))) (+ la 1)))
    (assert (<= (+ la 1) (len t2)))
    (forall ((n int)) (call swap_agrees_at t t2 a la r d n))))
(lemma exchange (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (ins (seq int)) (d (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (is_spanning_tree g t) (agrees t a) (inside a ins) (min_cross g ins (get d 2))
            (has_edge g (get d 0) (get d 1) (get d 2))
            (joins d x y) (in_s ins x) (not (in_s ins y))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
  (ensures (exists ((t3 (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g t3)
         (and (agrees t3 (concat a (seq-lit d))) (<= (total_weight t3) (total_weight t))))))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning g t))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g t))
    (assert (edges_connected t x y))
    (obtain ((p0 (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p0) 0) (and (== (idx p0 0) x) (== (idx p0 (- (len p0) 1)) y)))
                                  (path_follows_edges t p0)))
    (call simplify_walk t p0 x y)
    (obtain ((q (seq int)))
      (and (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) x) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges t q))
           (simple_path q)))
    (call find_cross ins q (- (len q) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len q) 1)))
                           (and (in_s ins (idx q j)) (not (in_s ins (idx q (+ j 1)))))))
    (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((r int)) (and (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len t)))
                           (or (and (== (get (idx t r) 0) (idx q j)) (== (get (idx t r) 1) (idx q (+ j 1))))
                               (and (== (get (idx t r) 0) (idx q (+ j 1))) (== (get (idx t r) 1) (idx q j))))))
    (assert (joins (idx t r) (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
    (ghost-let la int (len a))
    (if (< r la)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx t r) (idx a r)))
        (assert (in_s ins (get (idx a r) 0)))
        (assert (in_s ins (get (idx a r) 1))))
      (block))
    (assert (>= r la))
    (ghost-let t2 (seq (tuple int int int))
      (seq-build (len t) (fn (n) (if (== n la) d (if (== n r) (idx t la) (idx t n))))))
    (assert (is_swap t t2 la r d))
    (call swap_tree g t t2 la r d q j x y)
    (call swap_weight t t2 la r d)
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t r) 0) (get (idx t r) 1) (get (idx t r) 2)))
    (assert (!= (in_s ins (get (idx t r) 0)) (in_s ins (get (idx t r) 1))))
    (assert (<= (get d 2) (get (idx t r) 2)))
    (call swap_agrees t t2 a la r d)
    (assert (<= (total_weight t2) (total_weight t)))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g t2)
                 (and (agrees t2 (concat a (seq-lit d))) (<= (total_weight t2) (total_weight t)))))))
(lemma ext_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (ins (seq int)) (d (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (extendable g a) (inside a ins) (min_cross g ins (get d 2))
            (has_edge g (get d 0) (get d 1) (get d 2))
            (joins d x y) (in_s ins x) (not (in_s ins y))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))
            (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (exists ((t4 (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g t4)
         (and (agrees t4 (concat a (seq-lit d))) (<= (total_weight t4) (total_weight other))))))
  (body
    (obtain ((t (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g t) (and (agrees t a) (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight other)))))
    (call exchange g t a ins d x y)
    (obtain ((t3 (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g t3)
           (and (agrees t3 (concat a (seq-lit d))) (<= (total_weight t3) (total_weight t)))))
    (assert (<= (total_weight t3) (total_weight other)))))
(lemma ext_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (ins (seq int)) (d (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (extendable g a) (inside a ins) (min_cross g ins (get d 2))
            (has_edge g (get d 0) (get d 1) (get d 2))
            (joins d x y) (in_s ins x) (not (in_s ins y))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
  (ensures (extendable g (concat a (seq-lit d))))
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_at g a ins d x y other))))
(lemma ext_init_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len a) 0) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (exists ((t (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g t) (and (agrees t a) (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight other))))))
  (body
    (assert (agrees other a))
    (assert (and (is_spanning_tree g other) (and (agrees other a) (<= (total_weight other) (total_weight other)))))))
(lemma ext_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len a) 0))
  (ensures (extendable g a))
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_init_at g a other))))
(lemma ext_final_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (extendable g a) (is_spanning_tree g a) (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight a) (total_weight other)))
  (body
    (obtain ((t (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and (is_spanning_tree g t) (and (agrees t a) (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight other)))))
    (assert (== (len t) (len a)))
    (assert (== t a))))
(lemma ext_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (extendable g a) (is_spanning_tree g a))
  (ensures (is_mst g a))
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call ext_final_at g a other))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma out_scan (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len s))) (> (occurrences (take s m) x) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((v int)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v m)) (== (idx s v) x))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (call law_occurrences_none s x)
      (block
        (call law_take_step s (- m 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat (take s (- m 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- m 1))) x)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- m 1)) x)
        (if (== (idx s (- m 1)) x)
          (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- m 1)) (< (- m 1) m)) (== (idx s (- m 1)) x)))
          (call out_scan s x (- m 1)))))))
(lemma no_out_at (params (ins (seq int)) (w int))

    (call law_take_all ins)))
(lemma must_find (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (found bool) (bw int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (> (len g) 0) (== (len ins) (len g)) (in_s ins 0)
            (> (occurrences ins -1) 0) (lower g ins (len g) 0 found bw))
  (ensures found)
  (body
    (call law_take_all ins)
    (call out_scan ins -1 (len ins))
    (obtain ((v int)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len ins))) (== (idx ins v) -1)))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                                 (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert (not (in_s ins v)))
    (call find_cross ins p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
                           (and (in_s ins (idx p j)) (not (in_s ins (idx p (+ j 1)))))))
    (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len g)))
                                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p j))))))
                           (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p j)) i) 0) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (assert (!= (in_s ins (idx p j)) (in_s ins (get (idx (idx g (idx p j)) i) 0))))))
(lemma edge_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))

(lemma lower_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (ins (seq int)) (cu int) (ci int) (found bool) (bw int) (found2 bool) (bw2 int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 cu) (< cu (len g))) (and (<= 0 ci) (< ci (len (idx g cu))))
            (lower g ins cu ci found bw)
            (=> found (and found2 (<= bw2 bw)))
            (=> (!= (in_s ins cu) (in_s ins (get (idx (idx g cu) ci) 0)))
                (and found2 (<= bw2 (get (idx (idx g cu) ci) 1)))))
