              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a))))
              (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< j i)))))
          (=>
            (crossing g chosen
              a
              (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
            (and
              found
              (<= best_w (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn bool_changed
  ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len after) (len before))
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (not (idx before at))
        (and
          (idx after at)
          (forall ((k int))
            (=>
              (and
                (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
                (!= k at))
              (== (idx after k) (idx before k)))))))))

(ghost-fn edges_appended
  ((before (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (after (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (edge (tuple int int int)))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== after (concat before (seq-lit edge)))
      (== (len after) (+ (len before) 1)))))

(ghost-fn endpoints_chosen
  ((chosen (seq bool)) (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  bool
  (body
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len edges)))
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 (get (idx edges k) 0))
            (< (get (idx edges k) 0) (len chosen)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx edges k) 1))
              (< (get (idx edges k) 1) (len chosen)))
            (and
              (idx chosen (get (idx edges k) 0))
              (idx chosen (get (idx edges k) 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn spans_chosen
  ((chosen (seq bool)) (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  bool
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len chosen)))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len chosen)))
            (and (idx chosen u) (idx chosen v))))
        (edges_connected edges u v)))))

(ghost-fn is_partial_tree
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (chosen (seq bool))
   (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (count int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len chosen) (len g))
        (and
          (== (occurrences chosen true) count)
          (== (len edges) (- count 1))))
      (and
        (are_valid_edges g edges)
        (and
          (endpoints_chosen chosen edges)
          (spans_chosen chosen edges))))))

(ghost-fn is_partial_mst
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (chosen (seq bool))
   (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (count int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (is_partial_tree g chosen edges count)
      (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
        (=>
          (is_partial_tree g chosen other count)
          (<= (total_weight edges) (total_weight other)))))))

(ghost-fn prim_ok
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (chosen (seq bool))
   (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (count int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (is_partial_mst g chosen edges count)
      (and
        (<= 1 count)
        (and
          (<= count (len g))
          (idx chosen 0))))))

(lemma bool_count_bound
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (occurrences s true))
      (<= (occurrences s true) (len s))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (ghost-let k int (- (len s) 1))
        (assert (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))))
        (assert
          (==
            s
            (concat
              (take s k)
              (seq-lit (idx s k)))))
        (assert
          (==
            (occurrences s true)
            (+
              (occurrences (take s k) true)
              (if (idx s k) 1 0))))
        (call bool_count_bound (take s k)))
      (block
        (assert (== (occurrences s true) 0))))))

(lemma missing_false
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (< (occurrences s true) (len s)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((k int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
        (not (idx s k)))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (assert (> (len s) 0))
    (ghost-let k int (- (len s) 1))
    (assert (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))))
    (if (not (idx s k))
      (obtain ((w int))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s)))
          (not (idx s w))))
      (block
        (assert
          (==
            s
            (concat
              (take s k)
              (seq-lit (idx s k)))))
        (assert
          (==
            (occurrences s true)
            (+ (occurrences (take s k) true) 1)))
        (assert (== (len (take s k)) k))
        (assert
          (<
            (occurrences (take s k) true)
            (len (take s k))))
        (call missing_false (take s k))
        (obtain ((w int))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 w)
              (< w (len (take s k))))
            (not (idx (take s k) w))))
        (assert
          (and
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s)))
            (not (idx s w))))))))

(lemma all_true
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (occurrences s true) (len s)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
        (idx s k))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (ghost-let last_index int (- (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 last_index)
            (< last_index (len s))))
        (assert
          (==
            s
            (concat
              (take s last_index)
              (seq-lit (idx s last_index)))))
        (assert
          (==
            (occurrences s true)
            (+
              (occurrences (take s last_index) true)
              (if (idx s last_index) 1 0))))
        (assert
          (==
            (len (take s last_index))
            last_index))
        (call bool_count_bound (take s last_index))
        (assert (idx s last_index))
        (assert
          (==
            (occurrences (take s last_index) true)
            (len (take s last_index))))
        (call all_true (take s last_index))
        (assert
          (forall ((k int))
            (=>
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
              (idx s k)))))
      (block))))

(lemma scan_keep
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (found bool)
    (best_u int)
    (best_v int)
    (best_w int))
  (requires
    (scan_ok g chosen u i found best_u best_v best_w)
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
    (or
      (not
        (crossing g chosen
          u
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
      (and
        found
        (<= best_w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (scan_ok g chosen u (+ i 1)
      found best_u best_v best_w))
  (body))

(lemma scan_better
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (found bool)
    (best_u int)
    (best_v int)
    (best_w int))
  (requires
    (scan_ok g chosen u i found best_u best_v best_w)
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
    (crossing g chosen
      u
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (or
      (not found)
      (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) best_w)))
  (ensures
    (scan_ok g chosen u (+ i 1) true
      u
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_row
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (found bool)
    (best_u int)
    (best_v int)
    (best_w int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (scan_ok g chosen u (len (idx g u))
      found best_u best_v best_w))
  (ensures
    (scan_ok g chosen (+ u 1) 0
      found best_u best_v best_w))
  (body))

(lemma scan_finish
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (found bool)
    (best_u int)
    (best_v int)
    (best_w int))
  (requires
    (scan_ok g chosen (len g) 0
      found best_u best_v best_w)
    found)
  (ensures
    (cut_min g chosen best_u best_v best_w))
  (body))

(lemma path_has_crossing
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (== (len chosen) (len g))
    (> (len p) 0)
    (path_follows_graph g p)
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p 0))
      (< (idx p 0) (len chosen)))
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len chosen)))
    (idx chosen (idx p 0))
    (not (idx chosen (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p k))
          (< (idx p k) (len chosen))))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (crossing g chosen u v w)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (assert (> (len p) 1))
    (if (not (idx chosen (idx p 1)))
      (block
        (assert
          (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p 0) (idx p 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx p 0))
                (< (idx p 0) (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index (len (idx g (idx p 0))))))
            (==
              (get (idx (idx g (idx p 0)) edge_index) 0)
              (idx p 1))))
        (ghost-let edge_weight int
          (get (idx (idx g (idx p 0)) edge_index) 1))
        (assert
          (has_edge g (idx p 0) (idx p 1) edge_weight))
        (assert
          (crossing g chosen
            (idx p 0) (idx p 1) edge_weight)))
      (block
        (assert (> (len (drop p 1)) 0))
        (assert
          (path_follows_graph g (drop p 1)))
        (assert
          (== (idx (drop p 1) 0) (idx p 1)))
        (assert
          (==
            (idx (drop p 1) (- (len (drop p 1)) 1))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (call path_has_crossing g chosen (drop p 1))))))

(lemma frontier_exists
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (== (len chosen) (len g))
    (> (len g) 0)
    (idx chosen 0)
    (< (occurrences chosen true) (len chosen)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (crossing g chosen u v w)))
  (body
    (call missing_false chosen)
    (obtain ((outside int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 outside) (< outside (len chosen)))
        (not (idx chosen outside))))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 outside))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) 0)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) outside)))
        (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (len chosen))))))
    (call path_has_crossing g chosen p)))

(lemma singleton_connected
  (params
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (== (len edges) 0)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
        (== (idx chosen k) (== k 0))))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len chosen)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len chosen)))
    (idx chosen u)
    (idx chosen v))
  (ensures (edges_connected edges u v))
  (body
    (assert (== u 0))
    (assert (== v 0))
    (assert (> (len (seq-lit u)) 0))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit u) 0) u))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (seq-lit u) (- (len (seq-lit u)) 1))
        u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges edges (seq-lit u)))))

(lemma singleton_spans
  (params
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (== (len edges) 0)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
        (== (idx chosen k) (== k 0)))))
  (ensures (spans_chosen chosen edges))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call singleton_connected chosen edges u v))))

(lemma empty_partial_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_partial_tree g chosen other 1))
  (ensures (== (total_weight other) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (len other) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight other) 0))))

(lemma partial_start
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (> (len g) 0)
    (== (len chosen) (len g))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
        (== (idx chosen k) (== k 0))))
    (== (occurrences chosen true) 1)
    (== (len edges) 0))
  (ensures
    (prim_ok g chosen edges 1))
  (body
    (assert (idx chosen 0))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g edges))
    (assert (endpoints_chosen chosen edges))
    (call singleton_spans chosen edges)
    (assert (is_partial_tree g chosen edges 1))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (call empty_partial_weight g chosen other))))

(lemma partial_tree_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen_before (seq bool))
    (chosen_after (seq bool))
    (edges_before (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges_after (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (new_vertex int))
  (requires
    (is_partial_tree g chosen_before edges_before count)
    (crossing g chosen_before u v w)
    (or
      (and
        (idx chosen_before u)
        (and (not (idx chosen_before v)) (== new_vertex v)))
      (and
        (not (idx chosen_before u))
        (and (idx chosen_before v) (== new_vertex u))))
    (bool_changed chosen_before chosen_after new_vertex)
    (edges_appended edges_before edges_after (tuple u v w)))
  (ensures
    (is_partial_tree g chosen_after edges_after (+ count 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len chosen_after) (len g)))
    (assert
      (==
        (occurrences chosen_after true)
        (+ (occurrences chosen_before true) 1)))
    (assert (== (len edges_after) count))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g edges_after))
    (assert (endpoints_chosen chosen_after edges_after))
    (assert (spans_chosen chosen_after edges_after))))

(lemma partial_exchange
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen_before (seq bool))
    (chosen_after (seq bool))
    (edges_before (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges_after (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (other (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (new_vertex int))
  (requires
    (is_partial_mst g chosen_before edges_before count)
    (cut_min g chosen_before u v w)
    (or
      (and
        (idx chosen_before u)
        (and (not (idx chosen_before v)) (== new_vertex v)))
      (and
        (not (idx chosen_before u))
        (and (idx chosen_before v) (== new_vertex u))))
    (bool_changed chosen_before chosen_after new_vertex)
    (edges_appended edges_before edges_after (tuple u v w))
    (is_partial_tree g chosen_after other (+ count 1)))
  (ensures
    (<= (total_weight edges_after) (total_weight other)))
  (body))

(lemma partial_mst_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen_before (seq bool))
    (chosen_after (seq bool))
    (edges_before (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges_after (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (new_vertex int))
  (requires
    (is_partial_mst g chosen_before edges_before count)
    (< count (len g))
    (cut_min g chosen_before u v w)
    (or
      (and
        (idx chosen_before u)
        (and (not (idx chosen_before v)) (== new_vertex v)))
      (and
        (not (idx chosen_before u))
        (and (idx chosen_before v) (== new_vertex u))))
    (bool_changed chosen_before chosen_after new_vertex)
    (edges_appended edges_before edges_after (tuple u v w)))
  (ensures
    (is_partial_mst g chosen_after edges_after (+ count 1)))
  (body
    (call partial_tree_extend
      g chosen_before chosen_after
      edges_before edges_after count
      u v w new_vertex)
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (call partial_exchange
        g chosen_before chosen_after
        edges_before edges_after other count
        u v w new_vertex))))

(lemma prim_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen_before (seq bool))
    (chosen_after (seq bool))
    (edges_before (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges_after (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (new_vertex int))
  (requires
    (prim_ok g chosen_before edges_before count)
    (< count (len g))
    (cut_min g chosen_before u v w)
    (or
      (and
        (idx chosen_before u)
        (and (not (idx chosen_before v)) (== new_vertex v)))
      (and
        (not (idx chosen_before u))
        (and (idx chosen_before v) (== new_vertex u))))
    (bool_changed chosen_before chosen_after new_vertex)
    (edges_appended edges_before edges_after (tuple u v w)))
  (ensures
    (prim_ok g chosen_after edges_after (+ count 1)))
  (body
    (call partial_mst_extend
      g chosen_before chosen_after
      edges_before edges_after count
      u v w new_vertex)
    (assert (<= 1 (+ count 1)))
    (assert (<= (+ count 1) (len g)))
    (assert (idx chosen_after 0))))

(lemma spanning_is_partial
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (other (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (len chosen) (len g))
    (== count (len g))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
        (idx chosen k)))
    (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures
    (is_partial_tree g chosen other count))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g other))
    (assert (is_spanning g other))
    (assert (== (len other) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (== (occurrences chosen true) (len chosen)))
    (assert (endpoints_chosen chosen other))
    (assert (spans_chosen chosen other))))

(lemma partial_done
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int))
  (requires
    (prim_ok g chosen edges count)
    (== count (len g)))
  (ensures
    (is_mst g edges))
  (body
    (call all_true chosen)
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
          (idx chosen k))))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g edges))
    (assert (is_spanning g edges))
    (assert (== (len edges) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g edges))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (call spanning_is_partial g chosen other count))))

(def prim_mst
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut chosen (vec bool) (vec-new))
    (push chosen true)
    (let-mut build_index i64 1)
    (while (< build_index n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 1 build_index) (<= build_index n)))
      (invariant (== (len chosen) build_index))
      (invariant (== (occurrences chosen true) 1))
      (invariant
        (forall ((k int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
            (== (idx chosen k) (== k 0)))))
      (decreases (- n build_index))
      (push chosen false)
      (set build_index (+ build_index 1)))
    (let-mut result_edges
      (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64))
      (vec-new))
    (let-mut count i64 1)
    (call partial_start (view graph) chosen result_edges)
    (while (< count n)
      (invariant
        (prim_ok (view graph) chosen result_edges count))
      (decreases (- n count))
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut best_u i64 0)
      (let-mut best_v i64 0)
      (let-mut best_w i64 0)
      (let-mut scan_u i64 0)
      (while (< scan_u n)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 scan_u) (<= scan_u n)))
        (invariant
          (scan_ok (view graph) chosen scan_u 0
            found best_u best_v best_w))
        (decreases (- n scan_u))
        (let degree i64
          (len (idx (field graph adj) scan_u)))
        (let-mut scan_i i64 0)
        (while (< scan_i degree)
          (invariant
            (and (<= 0 scan_i) (<= scan_i degree)))
          (invariant
            (scan_ok (view graph) chosen scan_u scan_i
              found best_u best_v best_w))
          (decreases (- degree scan_i))
          (let arc (tuple i64 i64)
            (idx (idx (field graph adj) scan_u) scan_i))
          (let destination i64 (get arc 0))
          (let weight i64 (get arc 1))
          (assert
            (and (<= 0 destination) (< destination n)))
          (if
            (or
              (and
                (idx chosen scan_u)
                (not (idx chosen destination)))
              (and
                (not (idx chosen scan_u))
                (idx chosen destination)))
            (if
              (or (not found) (< weight best_w))
              (block
                (call scan_better
                  (view graph) chosen scan_u scan_i
                  found best_u best_v best_w)
                (set found true)
                (set best_u scan_u)
                (set best_v destination)
                (set best_w weight))
              (call scan_keep
                (view graph) chosen scan_u scan_i
                found best_u best_v best_w))
            (call scan_keep
              (view graph) chosen scan_u scan_i
              found best_u best_v best_w))
          (set scan_i (+ scan_i 1)))
        (call scan_row
          (view graph) chosen scan_u
          found best_u best_v best_w)
        (set scan_u (+ scan_u 1)))
      (call frontier_exists (view graph) chosen)
      (assert found)
      (call scan_finish
        (view graph) chosen
        found best_u best_v best_w)
      (let new_vertex i64
        (if (idx chosen best_u) best_v best_u))
      (ghost-let chosen_before (seq bool) chosen)
      (ghost-let edges_before
        (seq (tuple int int int))
        result_edges)
      (push result_edges
        (tuple best_u best_v best_w))
      (set-idx chosen new_vertex true)
      (assert
        (bool_changed
          chosen_before chosen new_vertex))
      (assert
        (edges_appended
          edges_before

   (best_u int) (best_v int) (best_w int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (=> found (crossing g chosen best_u best_v best_w))
      (forall ((a int) (j int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a))))
              (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< j i)))))
          (=>
            (crossing g chosen
              a
              (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1))
            (and
              found
              (<= best_w (get (idx (idx g a) j) 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn bool_changed
  ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len after) (len before))
        (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (not (idx before at))
        (and
          (idx after at)
          (forall ((k int))
            (=>
              (and
                (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len before)))
                (!= k at))
              (== (idx after k) (idx before k)))))))))

(ghost-fn edges_appended
  ((before (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (after (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (edge (tuple int int int)))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== after (concat before (seq-lit edge)))
      (== (len after) (+ (len before) 1)))))

(ghost-fn endpoints_chosen
  ((chosen (seq bool)) (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  bool
  (body
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len edges)))
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 (get (idx edges k) 0))
            (< (get (idx edges k) 0) (len chosen)))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx edges k) 1))
              (< (get (idx edges k) 1) (len chosen)))
            (and
              (idx chosen (get (idx edges k) 0))
              (idx chosen (get (idx edges k) 1)))))))))

(ghost-fn spans_chosen
  ((chosen (seq bool)) (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  bool
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len chosen)))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len chosen)))
            (and (idx chosen u) (idx chosen v))))
        (edges_connected edges u v)))))

(ghost-fn is_partial_tree
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (chosen (seq bool))
   (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (count int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (== (len chosen) (len g))
        (and
          (== (occurrences chosen true) count)
          (== (len edges) (- count 1))))
      (and
        (are_valid_edges g edges)
        (and
          (endpoints_chosen chosen edges)
          (spans_chosen chosen edges))))))

(ghost-fn is_partial_mst
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (chosen (seq bool))
   (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (count int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (is_partial_tree g chosen edges count)
      (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
        (=>
          (is_partial_tree g chosen other count)
          (<= (total_weight edges) (total_weight other)))))))

(ghost-fn prim_ok
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (chosen (seq bool))
   (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (count int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (is_partial_mst g chosen edges count)
      (and
        (<= 1 count)
        (and
          (<= count (len g))
          (idx chosen 0))))))

(lemma bool_count_bound
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (occurrences s true))
      (<= (occurrences s true) (len s))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (ghost-let k int (- (len s) 1))
        (assert (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))))
        (assert
          (==
            s
            (concat
              (take s k)
              (seq-lit (idx s k)))))
        (assert
          (==
            (occurrences s true)
            (+
              (occurrences (take s k) true)
              (if (idx s k) 1 0))))
        (call bool_count_bound (take s k)))
      (block
        (assert (== (occurrences s true) 0))))))

(lemma missing_false
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (< (occurrences s true) (len s)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((k int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
        (not (idx s k)))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (assert (> (len s) 0))
    (ghost-let k int (- (len s) 1))
    (assert (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))))
    (if (not (idx s k))
      (obtain ((w_direct int))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 w_direct) (< w_direct (len s)))
          (not (idx s w_direct))))
      (block
        (assert
          (==
            s
            (concat
              (take s k)
              (seq-lit (idx s k)))))
        (assert
          (==
            (occurrences s true)
            (+ (occurrences (take s k) true) 1)))
        (assert (== (len (take s k)) k))
        (assert
          (<
            (occurrences (take s k) true)
            (len (take s k))))
        (call missing_false (take s k))
        (obtain ((w_prefix int))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 w_prefix)
              (< w_prefix (len (take s k))))
            (not (idx (take s k) w_prefix))))
        (assert
          (and
            (and (<= 0 w_prefix) (< w_prefix (len s)))
            (not (idx s w_prefix))))))))

(lemma all_true
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (occurrences s true) (len s)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
        (idx s k))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (ghost-let last_index int (- (len s) 1))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 last_index)
            (< last_index (len s))))
        (assert
          (==
            s
            (concat
              (take s last_index)
              (seq-lit (idx s last_index)))))
        (assert
          (==
            (occurrences s true)
            (+
              (occurrences (take s last_index) true)
              (if (idx s last_index) 1 0))))
        (assert
          (==
            (len (take s last_index))
            last_index))
        (call bool_count_bound (take s last_index))
        (assert (idx s last_index))
        (assert
          (==
            (occurrences (take s last_index) true)
            (len (take s last_index))))
        (call all_true (take s last_index))
        (assert
          (forall ((k int))
            (=>
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s)))
              (idx s k)))))
      (block))))

(lemma scan_keep
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (found bool)
    (best_u int)
    (best_v int)
    (best_w int))
  (requires
    (scan_ok g chosen u i found best_u best_v best_w)
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
    (or
      (not
        (crossing g chosen
          u
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
      (and
        found
        (<= best_w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (scan_ok g chosen u (+ i 1)
      found best_u best_v best_w))
  (body))

(lemma scan_better
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (found bool)
    (best_u int)
    (best_v int)
    (best_w int))
  (requires
    (scan_ok g chosen u i found best_u best_v best_w)
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
    (crossing g chosen
      u
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
    (or
      (not found)
      (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) best_w)))
  (ensures
    (scan_ok g chosen u (+ i 1) true
      u
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_row
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (found bool)
    (best_u int)
    (best_v int)
    (best_w int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (scan_ok g chosen u (len (idx g u))
      found best_u best_v best_w))
  (ensures
    (scan_ok g chosen (+ u 1) 0
      found best_u best_v best_w))
  (body))

(lemma scan_finish
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (found bool)
    (best_u int)
    (best_v int)
    (best_w int))
  (requires
    (scan_ok g chosen (len g) 0
      found best_u best_v best_w)
    found)
  (ensures
    (cut_min g chosen best_u best_v best_w))
  (body))

(lemma path_has_crossing
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (== (len chosen) (len g))
    (> (len p) 0)
    (path_follows_graph g p)
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p 0))
      (< (idx p 0) (len chosen)))
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
      (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len chosen)))
    (idx chosen (idx p 0))
    (not (idx chosen (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p k))
          (< (idx p k) (len chosen))))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (crossing g chosen u v w)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (assert (> (len p) 1))
    (if (not (idx chosen (idx p 1)))
      (block
        (assert
          (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p 0) (idx p 1)))
        (obtain ((edge_index int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx p 0))
                (< (idx p 0) (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (< edge_index (len (idx g (idx p 0))))))
            (==
              (get (idx (idx g (idx p 0)) edge_index) 0)
              (idx p 1))))
        (ghost-let edge_weight int
          (get (idx (idx g (idx p 0)) edge_index) 1))
        (assert
          (has_edge g (idx p 0) (idx p 1) edge_weight))
        (assert
          (crossing g chosen
            (idx p 0) (idx p 1) edge_weight)))
      (block
        (assert (> (len (drop p 1)) 0))
        (assert
          (path_follows_graph g (drop p 1)))
        (assert
          (== (idx (drop p 1) 0) (idx p 1)))
        (assert
          (==
            (idx (drop p 1) (- (len (drop p 1)) 1))
            (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (call path_has_crossing g chosen (drop p 1))))))

(lemma frontier_exists
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (== (len chosen) (len g))
    (> (len g) 0)
    (idx chosen 0)
    (< (occurrences chosen true) (len chosen)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (crossing g chosen u v w)))
  (body
    (call missing_false chosen)
    (obtain ((outside int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 outside) (< outside (len chosen)))
        (not (idx chosen outside))))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 outside))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) 0)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) outside)))
        (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (len chosen))))))
    (call path_has_crossing g chosen p)))

(lemma singleton_connected
  (params
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (== (len edges) 0)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
        (== (idx chosen k) (== k 0))))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len chosen)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len chosen)))
    (idx chosen u)
    (idx chosen v))
  (ensures (edges_connected edges u v))
  (body
    (assert (== u 0))
    (assert (== v 0))
    (assert (> (len (seq-lit u)) 0))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit u) 0) u))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (seq-lit u) (- (len (seq-lit u)) 1))
        u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges edges (seq-lit u)))))

(lemma singleton_spans
  (params
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (== (len edges) 0)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
        (== (idx chosen k) (== k 0)))))
  (ensures (spans_chosen chosen edges))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call singleton_connected chosen edges u v))))

(lemma empty_partial_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (is_partial_tree g chosen other 1))
  (ensures (== (total_weight other) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (len other) 0))
    (assert (== (total_weight other) 0))))

(lemma partial_start
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (> (len g) 0)
    (== (len chosen) (len g))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
        (== (idx chosen k) (== k 0))))
    (== (occurrences chosen true) 1)
    (== (len edges) 0))
  (ensures
    (prim_ok g chosen edges 1))
  (body
    (assert (idx chosen 0))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g edges))
    (assert (endpoints_chosen chosen edges))
    (call singleton_spans chosen edges)
    (assert (is_partial_tree g chosen edges 1))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (call empty_partial_weight g chosen other))))

(lemma partial_tree_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen_before (seq bool))
    (chosen_after (seq bool))
    (edges_before (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges_after (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (new_vertex int))
  (requires
    (is_partial_tree g chosen_before edges_before count)
    (crossing g chosen_before u v w)
    (or
      (and
        (idx chosen_before u)
        (and (not (idx chosen_before v)) (== new_vertex v)))
      (and
        (not (idx chosen_before u))
        (and (idx chosen_before v) (== new_vertex u))))
    (bool_changed chosen_before chosen_after new_vertex)
    (edges_appended edges_before edges_after (tuple u v w)))
  (ensures
    (is_partial_tree g chosen_after edges_after (+ count 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len chosen_after) (len g)))
    (assert
      (==
        (occurrences chosen_after true)
        (+ (occurrences chosen_before true) 1)))
    (assert (== (len edges_after) count))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g edges_after))
    (assert (endpoints_chosen chosen_after edges_after))
    (assert (spans_chosen chosen_after edges_after))))

(lemma partial_exchange
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen_before (seq bool))
    (chosen_after (seq bool))
    (edges_before (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges_after (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (other (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (new_vertex int))
  (requires
    (is_partial_mst g chosen_before edges_before count)
    (cut_min g chosen_before u v w)
    (or
      (and
        (idx chosen_before u)
        (and (not (idx chosen_before v)) (== new_vertex v)))
      (and
        (not (idx chosen_before u))
        (and (idx chosen_before v) (== new_vertex u))))
    (bool_changed chosen_before chosen_after new_vertex)
    (edges_appended edges_before edges_after (tuple u v w))
    (is_partial_tree g chosen_after other (+ count 1)))
  (ensures
    (<= (total_weight edges_after) (total_weight other)))
  (body))

(lemma partial_mst_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen_before (seq bool))
    (chosen_after (seq bool))
    (edges_before (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges_after (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (new_vertex int))
  (requires
    (is_partial_mst g chosen_before edges_before count)
    (< count (len g))
    (cut_min g chosen_before u v w)
    (or
      (and
        (idx chosen_before u)
        (and (not (idx chosen_before v)) (== new_vertex v)))
      (and
        (not (idx chosen_before u))
        (and (idx chosen_before v) (== new_vertex u))))
    (bool_changed chosen_before chosen_after new_vertex)
    (edges_appended edges_before edges_after (tuple u v w)))
  (ensures
    (is_partial_mst g chosen_after edges_after (+ count 1)))
  (body
    (call partial_tree_extend
      g chosen_before chosen_after
      edges_before edges_after count
      u v w new_vertex)
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (call partial_exchange
        g chosen_before chosen_after
        edges_before edges_after other count
        u v w new_vertex))))

(lemma prim_extend
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen_before (seq bool))
    (chosen_after (seq bool))
    (edges_before (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (edges_after (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (new_vertex int))
  (requires
    (prim_ok g chosen_before edges_before count)
    (< count (len g))
    (cut_min g chosen_before u v w)
    (or
      (and
        (idx chosen_before u)
        (and (not (idx chosen_before v)) (== new_vertex v)))
      (and
        (not (idx chosen_before u))
        (and (idx chosen_before v) (== new_vertex u))))
    (bool_changed chosen_before chosen_after new_vertex)
    (edges_appended edges_before edges_after (tuple u v w)))
  (ensures
    (prim_ok g chosen_after edges_after (+ count 1)))
  (body
    (call partial_mst_extend
      g chosen_before chosen_after
      edges_before edges_after count
      u v w new_vertex)
    (assert (<= 1 (+ count 1)))
    (assert (<= (+ count 1) (len g)))
    (assert (idx chosen_after 0))))

(lemma spanning_is_partial
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (other (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int))
  (requires
    (== (len chosen) (len g))
    (== count (len g))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
        (idx chosen k)))
    (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures
    (is_partial_tree g chosen other count))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g other))
    (assert (is_spanning g other))
    (assert (== (len other) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (== (occurrences chosen true) (len chosen)))
    (assert (endpoints_chosen chosen other))
    (assert (spans_chosen chosen other))))

(lemma partial_done
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (chosen (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int))
  (requires
    (prim_ok g chosen edges count)
    (== count (len g)))
  (ensures
    (is_mst g edges))
  (body
    (call all_true chosen)
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
          (idx chosen k))))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g edges))
    (assert (is_spanning g edges))
    (assert (== (len edges) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g edges))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (call spanning_is_partial g chosen other count))))

(def prim_mst
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut chosen (vec bool) (vec-new))
    (push chosen true)
    (let-mut build_index i64 1)
    (while (< build_index n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 1 build_index) (<= build_index n)))
      (invariant (== (len chosen) build_index))
      (invariant (== (occurrences chosen true) 1))
      (invariant
        (forall ((k int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len chosen)))
            (== (idx chosen k) (== k 0)))))
      (decreases (- n build_index))
      (push chosen false)
      (set build_index (+ build_index 1)))
    (let-mut result_edges
      (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64))
      (vec-new))
    (let-mut count i64 1)
    (call partial_start (view graph) chosen result_edges)
    (while (< count n)
      (invariant
        (prim_ok (view graph) chosen result_edges count))
      (decreases (- n count))
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut best_u i64 0)
      (let-mut best_v i64 0)
      (let-mut best_w i64 0)
      (let-mut scan_u i64 0)
      (while (< scan_u n)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 scan_u) (<= scan_u n)))
        (invariant
          (scan_ok (view graph) chosen scan_u 0
            found best_u best_v best_w))
        (decreases (- n scan_u))
        (let degree i64
          (len (idx (field graph adj) scan_u)))
        (let-mut scan_i i64 0)
        (while (< scan_i degree)
          (invariant
            (and (<= 0 scan_i) (<= scan_i degree)))
          (invariant
            (scan_ok (view graph) chosen scan_u scan_i
              found best_u best_v best_w))
          (decreases (- degree scan_i))
          (let arc (tuple i64 i64)
            (idx (idx (field graph adj) scan_u) scan_i))
          (let destination i64 (get arc 0))
          (let weight i64 (get arc 1))
          (assert
            (and (<= 0 destination) (< destination n)))
          (if
            (or
              (and
                (idx chosen scan_u)
                (not (idx chosen destination)))
              (and
                (not (idx chosen scan_u))
                (idx chosen destination)))
            (if
              (or (not found) (< weight best_w))
              (block
                (call scan_better
                  (view graph) chosen scan_u scan_i
                  found best_u best_v best_w)
                (set found true)
                (set best_u scan_u)
                (set best_v destination)
                (set best_w weight))
              (call scan_keep
                (view graph) chosen scan_u scan_i
                found best_u best_v best_w))
            (call scan_keep
              (view graph) chosen scan_u scan_i
              found best_u best_v best_w))
          (set scan_i (+ scan_i 1)))
        (call scan_row
          (view graph) chosen scan_u
          found best_u best_v best_w)
        (set scan_u (+ scan_u 1)))
      (call frontier_exists (view graph) chosen)
      (assert found)
      (call scan_finish
        (view graph) chosen

          (or (mem lab (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0))

    (forall ((a int) (w int))

(lemma dom_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (other (seq (seq int))) (lab (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))

  (ensures (and (=> (and (mem lab u) (not (mem lab v))) (<= (get_flow other u v) (get_flow f u v)))

    (call cut_value g other lab s t)

    (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (call out_upd g f0 f a b d i u (len (idx g u))) (block))

  (requires (step_ok g f0 par pi pos c) (== (idx par c) p)
            (trail g f0 s par pi pos (idx pos c)) (mupd f0 f a b d)
            (or (and (== a p) (== b c)) (and (== a c) (== b p)))
            (mem par w) (< w (len pos)))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx pos w)) (<= (idx pos w) (len g)))
                (=> (and (!= w s) (<= (idx pos w) (idx pos p))) (step_ok g f par pi pos w))))

      (call gf_upd f0 f a b d w (idx par w))

  (requires (step_ok g f0 par pi pos c) (== (idx par c) p)
            (trail g f0 s par pi pos (idx pos c)) (mupd f0 f a b d)
            (or (and (== a p) (== b c)) (and (== a c) (== b p))))

(lemma fwd_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (par (seq int)) (pi (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (c int) (p int) (e int))
  (requires (wf g) (shape f0 (len g)) (== (len par) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len g))) (!= c s)
            (step_ok g f0 par pi pos c) (== (idx par c) p) (== (idx pi c) e) (>= e 0)
            (trail g f0 s par pi pos (idx pos c))
            (respects_capacity g f0) (nonneg_f f0) (balanced g f0 s t c)
            (mupd f0 f p c 1))
  (ensures (shape f (len g)) (trail g f s par pi pos (idx pos p))
           (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (balanced g f s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f s) (+ (flow_val g f0 s) (if (== p s) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_ok g f0 c p e))
    (assert (has_capacity g p c (get (idx (idx g p) e) 1)))
    (assert (== (get_flow f0 p c) (idx (idx f0 p) c)))
    (call shape_upd f0 f p c 1 (len g))
    (call trail_keep g f0 f s par pi pos c p p c 1)
    (call resp_upd g f0 f p c 1 (get (idx (idx g p) e) 1))
    (call nonneg_upd f0 f p c 1)
    (call bal_upd g f0 f s t c p p c 1 e)))
(lemma bwd_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (par (seq int)) (pi (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (c int) (p int))
  (requires (wf g) (shape f0 (len g)) (== (len par) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len g))) (!= c s)
            (step_ok g f0 par pi pos c) (== (idx par c) p) (< (idx pi c) 0)
            (trail g f0 s par pi pos (idx pos c))
            (respects_capacity g f0) (nonneg_f f0) (balanced g f0 s t c)
            (mupd f0 f c p -1))
  (ensures (shape f (len g)) (trail g f s par pi pos (idx pos p))
           (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (balanced g f s t p)
           (== (flow_val g f s) (+ (flow_val g f0 s) (if (== p s) 1 0))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_ok g f0 c p (idx pi c)))
    (assert (> (get_flow f0 c p) 0))
    (assert (== (get_flow f0 c p) (idx (idx f0 c) p)))
    (obtain ((cc int)) (and (has_capacity g c p cc) (<= (idx (idx f0 c) p) cc)))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g c)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g c) i) 0) p) (== (get (idx (idx g c) i) 1) cc))))
    (call shape_upd f0 f c p -1 (len g))
    (call trail_keep g f0 f s par pi pos c p c p -1)
    (call resp_upd g f0 f c p -1 0)
    (call nonneg_upd f0 f c p -1)
    (call bal_upd g f0 f s t c p c p -1 i)))
(lemma start_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (ensures (balanced g f s t t) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f))
  (body))
(lemma end_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_f f) (balanced g f s t s))

(spec augment
  (params (adj (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64))))) (flow0 (vec (vec i64))) (par (ref (slice i64))) (pi (ref (slice i64))) (pos (ref (slice i64))) (s i64) (t i64))
  (returns (res (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (wf adj) (shape flow0 (len adj)) (is_valid_flow adj flow0 s t)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len adj))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len adj))) (!= s t)
            (== (len par) (len adj)) (== (len pi) (len adj)) (== (len pos) (len adj))
            (mem par t) (trail adj flow0 s par pi pos (len adj)))
  (ensures (shape res (len adj)) (is_valid_flow adj res s t)
           (== (flow_val adj res s) (+ (flow_val adj flow0 s) 1)))
  (effects))
(def augment
  (body
    (let-mut fl (vec (vec i64)) flow0)
    (let-mut cur i64 t)
    (call start_walk adj flow0 s t)
    (assert (trail adj fl s par pi pos (idx pos cur)))
    (while (!= cur s)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur (len adj))))
      (invariant (mem par cur))
      (invariant (shape fl (len adj)))
      (invariant (trail adj fl s par pi pos (idx pos cur)))
      (invariant (respects_capacity adj fl))
      (invariant (nonneg_f fl))
      (invariant (balanced adj fl s t cur))
      (invariant (== (flow_val adj fl s) (+ (flow_val adj flow0 s) (if (== cur s) 1 0))))
      (decreases (idx pos cur))
      (assert (step_ok adj fl par pi pos cur))
      (let p i64 (idx par cur))
      (let e i64 (idx pi cur))
      (assert (edge_ok adj fl cur p e))
      (ghost-let f0 (seq (seq int)) fl)
      (if (>= e 0)
        (block
          (let c i64 (get (idx (idx adj p) e) 1))
          (let x i64 (idx (idx fl p) cur))
          (assert (< x c))
          (set-idx (idx fl p) cur (+ x 1))
          (assert (mupd f0 fl p cur 1))
          (call fwd_step adj f0 fl s t par pi pos cur p e))
        (block
          (let x2 i64 (idx (idx fl cur) p))
          (assert (> x2 0))
          (set-idx (idx fl cur) p (- x2 1))
          (assert (mupd f0 fl cur p -1))
          (call bwd_step adj f0 fl s t par pi pos cur p)))
      (set cur p))
    (call end_walk adj fl s t)
    (return fl)))
(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))

  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))

  (body
    (let-mut fl (vec (vec i64)) flow0)
    (let-mut cur i64 t)
    (call start_walk adj flow0 s t)
    (assert (trail adj fl s par pi pos (idx pos cur)))
    (while (!= cur s)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur (len adj))))
      (invariant (mem par cur))
      (invariant (shape fl (len adj)))
      (invariant (trail adj fl s par pi pos (idx pos cur)))
