               (and (and (>= (idx ord (idx parent w)) 0) (< (idx ord (idx parent w)) (idx ord w)))
                    (> (get_flow r (idx parent w) w) 0))))))))
(ghost-fn done_ok ((r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (head int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k head)) (< k (len q)))
             (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len ord))) (> (get_flow r (idx q k) b) 0)))
        (>= (idx ord b) 0)))))
(ghost-fn partial_ok ((r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body (forall ((b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b v)) (and (< b (len ord)) (> (get_flow r u b) 0)))
        (>= (idx ord b) 0)))))
(ghost-fn closed_cut ((r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (ins ord a) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len ord)))) (> (get_flow r a b) 0))
        (ins ord b)))))
(ghost-fn wrow ((h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0
          (+ (wrow h ord u (- b 1)) (if (ins ord (- b 1)) (get_flow h u (- b 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn wlhs ((h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (wlhs h ord (- a 1) b) (wrow h ord (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn wrhs ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0
          (+ (wrhs g h ord a (- b 1)) (if (ins ord (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) 0)))))
(ghost-fn urow ((h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0
          (+ (urow h ord (- a 1) n) (if (ins ord (- a 1)) (rowf h (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn cterm ((h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (if (ins ord u)
          (if (ins ord v) 0 (get_flow h u v))
          (if (ins ord v) (neg (get_flow h u v)) 0))))
(ghost-fn crow ((h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (crow h ord u (- b 1)) (cterm h ord u (- b 1))))))
(ghost-fn csum ((h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (csum h ord (- a 1) n) (crow h ord (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn cut_le ((h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
        (<= (cterm h ord a b) (cterm f ord a b))))))

(lemma wf_view (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (wf (view cg)))
  (body))
(lemma in_adj_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (w int))
  (ensures (not (in_adj g u 0 w)))
  (body))
(lemma in_adj_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (w int))
  (requires (> k 0))
  (ensures (== (in_adj g u k w) (or (== (dst g u (- k 1)) w) (in_adj g u (- k 1) w))))
  (body))
(lemma adj_member (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (i int) (w int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (== (dst g u i) w))
  (ensures (in_adj g u k w))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (call in_adj_step g u k w)
    (if (> k (+ i 1)) (call adj_member g u (- k 1) i w) (block))))
(lemma rs_zero (params (a (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w b)) (== (at a w) 0))))
  (ensures (== (rs a b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call rs_zero a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (at a (- b 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (rs a b) (+ (rs a (- b 1)) (at a (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma rs_update (params (a (seq int)) (a1 (seq int)) (p int) (b int))
  (requires (zeroed a a1 p) (<= 0 p) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rs a1 b) (- (rs a b) (if (< p b) (at a p) 0))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call rs_update a a1 p (- b 1))
        (assert (== (at a1 (- b 1)) (if (== (- b 1) p) 0 (at a (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rs a1 b) (+ (rs a1 (- b 1)) (at a1 (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rs a b) (+ (rs a (- b 1)) (at a (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma adjsum_update (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (a1 (seq int)) (p int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (zeroed a a1 p) (>= k 0)
            (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (!= (dst g u i) p))))
  (ensures (== (adjsum g a1 u k) (adjsum g a u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call adjsum_update g a a1 p u (- k 1))
        (assert (!= (dst g u (- k 1)) p))
        (assert (== (at a1 (dst g u (- k 1))) (at a (dst g u (- k 1)))))
        (assert (== (adjsum g a1 u k) (+ (adjsum g a1 u (- k 1)) (at a1 (dst g u (- k 1))))))
        (assert (== (adjsum g a u k) (+ (adjsum g a u (- k 1)) (at a (dst g u (- k 1)))))))
      (block))))
(lemma adj_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))) (== (len a) (len g))
            (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g))) (!= (at a w) 0)) (in_adj g u k w))))
  (ensures (== (adjsum g a u k) (rs a (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (block
        (forall ((w1 int)) (call in_adj_zero g u w1))
        (call rs_zero a (len g)))
      (block
        (ghost-let p int (dst g u (- k 1)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g))))
        (ghost-let a1 (seq int) (seq-build (len a) (fn (j) (if (== j p) 0 (idx a j)))))
        (assert (zeroed a a1 p))
        (assert (== (len a1) (len g)))
        (call rs_update a a1 p (len g))
        (call adjsum_update g a a1 p u (- k 1))
        (forall ((w2 int)) (call in_adj_step g u k w2))
        (call adj_row g a1 u (- k 1))
        (assert (== (adjsum g a u k) (+ (adjsum g a u (- k 1)) (at a p))))))))
(lemma rs_row (params (a (seq int)) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires (row_is a h u n) (and (<= 0 b) (<= b n)))
  (ensures (== (rs a b) (rowf h u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call rs_row a h u (- b 1) n)
        (assert (== (at a (- b 1)) (get_flow h u (- b 1))))
        (assert (== (rs a b) (+ (rs a (- b 1)) (at a (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rowf h u b) (+ (rowf h u (- b 1)) (get_flow h u (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma adj_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (row_is a h u (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (adjsum g a u k) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call adj_out g a h u (- k 1))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (dst g u (- k 1))) (< (dst g u (- k 1)) (len g))))
        (assert (== (at a (dst g u (- k 1))) (get_flow h u (dst g u (- k 1)))))
        (assert (== (dst g u (- k 1)) (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))
        (assert (== (adjsum g a u k) (+ (adjsum g a u (- k 1)) (at a (dst g u (- k 1))))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k)
                    (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))
      (block))))
(lemma flow_in_adj (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (w int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_any h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g))) (!= (get_flow h u w) 0))
               (in_adj g u (len (idx g u)) w)))
  (body
    (if (!= (get_flow h u w) 0)
      (block
        (assert (> (idx (idx h u) w) 0))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u w c) (<= (idx (idx h u) w) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) w) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
        (assert (== (dst g u i) w))
        (call adj_member g u (len (idx g u)) i w))
      (block))))
(lemma out_is_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_any h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rowf h u (len g))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a (seq int) (seq-build (len g) (fn (j) (get_flow h u j))))
    (assert (row_is a h u (len g)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call flow_in_adj g h u w))
    (call adj_row g a u (len (idx g u)))
    (call rs_row a h u (len g) (len g))
    (call adj_out g a h u (len (idx g u)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g h u) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (len (idx g u)))))))

(lemma wrhs_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (wrhs g h ord 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call wrhs_zero g h ord (- b 1))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) 0) 0))
        (assert (== (wrhs g h ord 0 b)
                    (+ (wrhs g h ord 0 (- b 1)) (if (ins ord (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) 0) 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma swap_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (wrhs g h ord (+ a 1) b) (+ (wrhs g h ord a b) (wrow h ord a b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call swap_step g h ord a (- b 1))
        (assert (== (wrhs g h ord (+ a 1) b)
                    (+ (wrhs g h ord (+ a 1) (- b 1)) (if (ins ord (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) (+ a 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (wrhs g h ord a b)
                    (+ (wrhs g h ord a (- b 1)) (if (ins ord (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) 0))))
        (assert (== (wrow h ord a b)
                    (+ (wrow h ord a (- b 1)) (if (ins ord (- b 1)) (get_flow h a (- b 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) (+ a 1))
                    (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) a) (get_flow h a (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma flip_sums (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (wlhs h ord a b) (wrhs g h ord a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call flip_sums g h ord (- a 1) b)
        (call swap_step g h ord (- a 1) b)
        (assert (== (wlhs h ord a b) (+ (wlhs h ord (- a 1) b) (wrow h ord (- a 1) b)))))
      (call wrhs_zero g h ord b))))
(lemma rowsplit (params (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (- (if (ins ord u) (rowf h u b) 0) (wrow h ord u b)) (crow h ord u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call rowsplit h ord u (- b 1))
        (assert (== (rowf h u b) (+ (rowf h u (- b 1)) (get_flow h u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (wrow h ord u b)
                    (+ (wrow h ord u (- b 1)) (if (ins ord (- b 1)) (get_flow h u (- b 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (crow h ord u b) (+ (crow h ord u (- b 1)) (cterm h ord u (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma splitsum (params (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (- (urow h ord a n) (wlhs h ord a n)) (csum h ord a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call splitsum h ord (- a 1) n)
        (call rowsplit h ord (- a 1) n)
        (assert (== (urow h ord a n) (+ (urow h ord (- a 1) n) (if (ins ord (- a 1)) (rowf h (- a 1) n) 0))))
        (assert (== (wlhs h ord a n) (+ (wlhs h ord (- a 1) n) (wrow h ord (- a 1) n))))
        (assert (== (csum h ord a n) (+ (csum h ord (- a 1) n) (crow h ord (- a 1) n)))))
      (block))))
(lemma dsum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (a int))
  (requires (row_out g h) (is_conserved g h s t) (ins ord s) (not (ins ord t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (== (len ord) (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (urow h ord a (len g)) (wrhs g h ord (len g) a)) (if (< s a) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call dsum g h ord s t (- a 1))
        (assert (== (urow h ord a (len g))
                    (+ (urow h ord (- a 1) (len g)) (if (ins ord (- a 1)) (rowf h (- a 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (wrhs g h ord (len g) a)
                    (+ (wrhs g h ord (len g) (- a 1)) (if (ins ord (- a 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- a 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) (len g))))
        (assert (== (total_flow_out g h (- a 1)) (rowf h (- a 1) (len g))))
        (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
        (assert (=> (and (ins ord (- a 1)) (!= (- a 1) s))
                    (== (total_flow_in g h (- a 1)) (total_flow_out g h (- a 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma value_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (== (len ord) (len g)) (ins ord s) (not (ins ord t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (csum h ord (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (assert (nonneg_any h))
    (forall ((u int)) (call out_is_row g h u))
    (assert (row_out g h))
    (call dsum g h ord s t (len g))
    (call flip_sums g h ord (len g) (len g))
    (call splitsum h ord (len g) (len g))))
(lemma crow_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (cut_le h f ord n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 b) (<= b n)))
  (ensures (<= (crow h ord u b) (crow f ord u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call crow_mono h f ord n u (- b 1))
        (assert (<= (cterm h ord u (- b 1)) (cterm f ord u (- b 1))))
        (assert (== (crow h ord u b) (+ (crow h ord u (- b 1)) (cterm h ord u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (crow f ord u b) (+ (crow f ord u (- b 1)) (cterm f ord u (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma csum_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (cut_le h f ord n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (<= (csum h ord a n) (csum f ord a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call csum_mono h f ord (- a 1) n)
        (call crow_mono h f ord n (- a 1) n)
        (assert (== (csum h ord a n) (+ (csum h ord (- a 1) n) (crow h ord (- a 1) n))))
        (assert (== (csum f ord a n) (+ (csum f ord (- a 1) n) (crow f ord (- a 1) n)))))
      (block))))
(lemma flow_le_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (built g cap (len g) 0) (respects_capacity g h)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (>= (get_flow cap a b) 0))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h a b) (get_flow cap a b)))
  (body
    (if (> (get_flow h a b) 0)
      (block
        (assert (> (idx (idx h a) b) 0))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (idx (idx h a) b) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) c))))
        (assert (== (dst g a i) b))
        (assert (== (get_flow cap a (dst g a i)) (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1)))
        (assert (<= (get_flow h a b) c)))
      (block))))
(lemma point_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                        (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (== n (len g)) (== (len ord) n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (built g cap n 0) (entries_in cap n) (nonneg r n) (same_pairs cap r n) (closed_cut r ord)
            (is_mk f cap r n) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_any h))
  (ensures (<= (cterm h ord a b) (cterm f ord a b)))
  (body
    (assert (and (>= (get_flow cap a b) 0) (>= (get_flow cap b a) 0)))
    (assert (and (>= (get_flow r a b) 0) (>= (get_flow r b a) 0)))
    (call flow_le_cap g cap h a b)
    (assert (>= (get_flow h a b) 0))
    (assert (== (get_flow f a b) (pos_part (- (get_flow cap a b) (get_flow r a b)))))
    (assert (== (+ (get_flow r a b) (get_flow r b a)) (+ (get_flow cap a b) (get_flow cap b a))))
    (assert (=> (and (ins ord a) (> (get_flow r a b) 0)) (ins ord b)))
    (assert (=> (and (ins ord b) (> (get_flow r b a) 0)) (ins ord a)))))
(lemma optimal_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                           (ord (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf g) (== n (len g)) (== (len ord) n) (ins ord s) (not (ins ord t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
            (built g cap n 0) (entries_in cap n) (nonneg r n) (same_pairs cap r n) (closed_cut r ord)
            (is_mk f cap r n) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (nonneg_any h))
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call point_le g cap r f h ord n a b))
    (assert (cut_le h f ord n))
    (call value_cut g h ord s t)
    (call value_cut g f ord s t)
    (call csum_mono h f ord n n)))
(lemma f_resp_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                          (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (== n (len g)) (only g cap) (nonneg r n) (is_mk f cap r n))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f a)))))
               (=> (> (idx (idx f a) b) 0)
                   (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (idx (idx f a) b) c))))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (idx f a) b) (get_flow f a b)))
        (assert (>= (get_flow r a b) 0))
        (if (> (get_flow f a b) 0)
          (block
            (assert (> (- (get_flow cap a b) (get_flow r a b)) 0))
            (assert (has_capacity g a b (get_flow cap a b)))
            (assert (<= (get_flow f a b) (get_flow cap a b))))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma f_respects (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (== n (len g)) (only g cap) (nonneg r n) (is_mk f cap r n))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call f_resp_one g cap r f n a b))))
(lemma f_nonneg_one (params (f (seq (seq int))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_mk f cap r n))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f a))))) (>= (idx (idx f a) b) 0)))
  (body (assert (>= (get_flow f a b) 0))))
(lemma f_nonneg (params (f (seq (seq int))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (is_mk f cap r n))
  (ensures (nonneg_any f))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call f_nonneg_one f cap r n a b))))
(lemma f_net (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                     (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (is_mk f cap r n) (same_pairs cap r n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 b) (<= b n)))
  (ensures (== (- (rowf f u b) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u b)) (- (rowf cap u b) (rowf r u b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call f_net g cap r f n u (- b 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u (- b 1)) (pos_part (- (get_flow cap u (- b 1)) (get_flow r u (- b 1))))))
        (assert (== (get_flow f (- b 1) u) (pos_part (- (get_flow cap (- b 1) u) (get_flow r (- b 1) u)))))
        (assert (== (+ (get_flow r u (- b 1)) (get_flow r (- b 1) u)) (+ (get_flow cap u (- b 1)) (get_flow cap (- b 1) u))))
        (assert (== (- (get_flow f u (- b 1)) (get_flow f (- b 1) u)) (- (get_flow cap u (- b 1)) (get_flow r u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rowf f u b) (+ (rowf f u (- b 1)) (get_flow f u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u b) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u (- b 1)) (get_flow f (- b 1) u))))
        (assert (== (rowf cap u b) (+ (rowf cap u (- b 1)) (get_flow cap u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rowf r u b) (+ (rowf r u (- b 1)) (get_flow r u (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma f_balance (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (== n (len g)) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_any f) (is_mk f cap r n) (same_pairs cap r n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g f u) (total_flow_in g f u)) (- (rowf cap u n) (rowf r u n))))
  (body
    (call out_is_row g f u)
    (call f_net g cap r f n u n)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u (len g))))))
(lemma flow_is_max (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int))
                           (n int) (s int) (t int) (total int))
  (requires (wf g) (== n (len g)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
            (built g cap n 0) (only g cap) (entries_in cap n)
            (nonneg r n) (same_pairs cap r n) (balance cap r n s t)
            (== (- (rowf cap s n) (rowf r s n)) total)
            (== (len ord) n) (ins ord s) (not (ins ord t)) (closed_cut r ord))
  (ensures (exists ((f (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) total))))
  (body
    (ghost-let f0 (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (i) (seq-build n (fn (j) (pos_part (- (get_flow cap i j) (get_flow r i j))))))))
    (assert (is_mk f0 cap r n))
    (call f_respects g cap r f0 n)
    (call f_nonneg f0 cap r n)
    (forall ((u int)) (call f_balance g cap r f0 n u))
    (call f_balance g cap r f0 n s)
    (assert (is_conserved g f0 s t))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f0 s t))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f0 s) total))
    (forall ((h (seq (seq int)))) (call optimal_one g cap r f0 ord n s t h))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f0 s t))
    (assert (and (is_max_flow g f0 s t) (== (flow_val g f0 s) total)))))

(lemma rowf_single (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (a0 int) (b0 int) (e int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (single m0 m1 a0 b0 e) (<= 0 b0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rowf m1 u b)
               (+ (rowf m0 u b) (if (and (== u a0) (< b0 b)) (- e (get_flow m0 a0 b0)) 0))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call rowf_single m0 m1 a0 b0 e u (- b 1))
        (assert (== (rowf m1 u b) (+ (rowf m1 u (- b 1)) (get_flow m1 u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rowf m0 u b) (+ (rowf m0 u (- b 1)) (get_flow m0 u (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma rowf_nonneg (params (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires (nonneg m n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 b) (<= b n)))
  (ensures (>= (rowf m u b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call rowf_nonneg m u (- b 1) n)
        (assert (>= (get_flow m u (- b 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (rowf m u b) (+ (rowf m u (- b 1)) (get_flow m u (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma rowf_upper (params (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires (entries_in m n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 b) (<= b n)))
  (ensures (<= (rowf m u b) (* 100000 b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call rowf_upper m u (- b 1) n)
        (assert (<= (get_flow m u (- b 1)) 100000))
        (assert (== (rowf m u b) (+ (rowf m u (- b 1)) (get_flow m u (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma rect_step (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a0 int) (b0 int) (e int))
  (requires (rect m0 n) (single m0 m1 a0 b0 e))
  (ensures (rect m1 n))
  (body))
(lemma two_cells (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (p int) (c int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (single m0 m1 p c (- x 1)) (single m1 m2 c p (+ y 1)) (!= p c))
  (ensures (swapped m0 m2 p c x y))
  (body))
(lemma nonneg_step (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (p int) (c int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (nonneg m0 n) (swapped m0 m2 p c x y) (> x 0) (>= y 0))
  (ensures (nonneg m2 n))
  (body))
(lemma pairs_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (p int) (c int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (same_pairs r m0 n) (swapped m0 m2 p c x y) (== x (get_flow m0 p c)) (== y (get_flow m0 c p)) (!= p c))
  (ensures (same_pairs r m2 n))
  (body))
(lemma row_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int)))
                        (n int) (t int) (c int) (p int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (row_walk r m0 n t c) (single m0 m1 p c (- x 1)) (single m1 m2 c p (+ y 1)) (!= p c)
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 c) (< c n))
            (== x (get_flow m0 p c)) (== y (get_flow m0 c p)))
  (ensures (row_walk r m2 n t p))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow m1 c p) y))
    (forall ((a int)) (call rowf_single m0 m1 p c (- x 1) a n))
    (forall ((a int)) (call rowf_single m1 m2 c p (+ y 1) a n))))
(lemma path_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (parent (seq int)) (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int)))
                         (n int) (s int) (c int) (p int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (path_ok m0 ord parent s c) (tree_ok r ord parent s n) (swapped m0 m2 p c x y)
            (and (<= 0 c) (< c n)) (!= c s) (>= (idx ord c) 0) (== p (idx parent c)))
  (ensures (path_ok m2 ord parent s p))
  (body
    (assert (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)))
    (assert (< (idx ord p) (idx ord c)))
    (assert (>= (idx ord p) 0))
    (assert (== (at ord p) (idx ord p)))
    (assert (== (at ord c) (idx ord c)))))
(lemma pair_keep (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (entries_in cap n) (same_pairs cap r n))
  (ensures (pair_bound r n))
  (body))
(lemma entries_nonneg (params (m (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (entries_in m n))
  (ensures (nonneg m n))
  (body))
(lemma step_main (params (cap (seq (seq int))) (r1 (seq (seq int))) (r2 (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int) (t int) (total int))
  (requires (same_pairs cap r1 n) (same_pairs r1 r2 n) (balance cap r1 n s t) (row_walk r1 r2 n t s)
            (== (- (rowf cap s n) (rowf r1 s n)) total)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t))
  (ensures (same_pairs cap r2 n) (balance cap r2 n s t)
           (== (- (rowf cap s n) (rowf r2 s n)) (+ total 1)))
  (body (assert (== (rowf r2 s n) (- (rowf r1 s n) 1)))))
(lemma witness_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma built_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (i int) (d int) (c int))
  (requires (wf g) (built g m0 u i) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== d (dst g u i)) (== c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (single m0 m1 u d c))
  (ensures (built g m1 u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma built_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (built g m u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (built g m (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma only_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (d int) (c int))
  (requires (only g m0) (single m0 m1 u d c) (has_capacity g u d c))
  (ensures (only g m1))
  (body))
(lemma cap_entries (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (only g cap))
  (ensures (entries_in cap (len g)))
  (body))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma step_ge (params (dist0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (ge_m1 dist0) (upd dist0 dist v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (ge_m1 dist))
  (body))
(lemma step_q (params (ord0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (ord1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int) (n int))
  (requires (q_ok ord0 q0 n) (upd ord0 ord1 v x) (appended q0 q1 v) (== x (len q0))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (== (idx ord0 v) -1))
  (ensures (q_ok ord1 q1 n))
  (body))
(lemma step_pos (params (ord0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (ord1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (pos_ok ord0 q0) (upd ord0 ord1 v x) (appended q0 q1 v) (== x (len q0)))
  (ensures (pos_ok ord1 q1))
  (body))
(lemma step_tree (params (r (seq (seq int))) (ord0 (seq int)) (par0 (seq int)) (ord1 (seq int)) (par1 (seq int))
                         (s int) (n int) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (tree_ok r ord0 par0 s n) (upd ord0 ord1 v x) (upd par0 par1 v u) (== (idx ord0 v) -1)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (>= (idx ord0 u) 0) (< (idx ord0 u) x) (> (get_flow r u v) 0))
  (ensures (tree_ok r ord1 par1 s n))
  (body))
(lemma step_done (params (r (seq (seq int))) (ord0 (seq int)) (q0 (seq int)) (ord1 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int))
                         (head int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (done_ok r ord0 q0 head) (upd ord0 ord1 v x) (appended q0 q1 v) (<= head (len q0)) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (done_ok r ord1 q1 head))
  (body))
(lemma step_part (params (r (seq (seq int))) (ord0 (seq int)) (ord1 (seq int)) (u int) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (partial_ok r ord0 u v) (upd ord0 ord1 v x) (>= x 0))
  (ensures (partial_ok r ord1 u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma part_seen (params (r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (partial_ok r ord u v) (ge_m1 ord) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len ord)))
            (not (and (== (idx ord v) -1) (> (get_flow r u v) 0))))
  (ensures (partial_ok r ord u (+ v 1)))
  (body))
(lemma done_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (head int) (u int) (n int))
  (requires (done_ok r ord q head) (partial_ok r ord u n) (== (len ord) n)
            (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len q))) (== (idx q head) u))
  (ensures (done_ok r ord q (+ head 1)))
  (body))
(lemma close_one (params (r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (head int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (pos_ok ord q) (done_ok r ord q head) (== head (len q)))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (ins ord a) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len ord)))) (> (get_flow r a b) 0)) (ins ord b)))
  (body
    (if (ins ord a)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx q (idx ord a)) a))
        (assert (=> (and (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len ord))) (> (get_flow r (idx q (idx ord a)) b) 0))
                    (>= (idx ord b) 0))))
      (block))))
(lemma close_up (params (r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (head int))
  (requires (pos_ok ord q) (done_ok r ord q head) (== head (len q)))
  (ensures (closed_cut r ord))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call close_one r ord q head a b))))

(spec build_residual
  (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (returns (m (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (well_formed cg))
  (ensures (rect m (len (field cg adj)))
           (built (view cg) m (len (field cg adj)) 0)
           (only (view cg) m))
  (effects alloc))
(def build_residual
  (body
    (call wf_view cg)
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view cg))
    (let n i64 (len (field cg adj)))
    (assert (== n (len g)))
    (let-mut mat (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (j0) (seq-build n (fn (j1) 0)))))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (rect mat n))
      (invariant (built g mat u 0))
      (invariant (only g mat))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let du i64 (len (idx (field cg adj) u)))
      (assert (== du (len (idx g u))))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i du)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i du)))
        (invariant (rect mat n))
        (invariant (built g mat u i))
        (invariant (only g mat))
        (decreases (- du i))
        (let d i64 (get (idx (idx (field cg adj) u) i) 0))
        (let c i64 (get (idx (idx (field cg adj) u) i) 1))
        (assert (== d (dst g u i)))
        (assert (and (<= 0 d) (< d n)))
        (assert (== c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
        (call witness_cap g u i)
        (assert (has_capacity g u d c))
        (ghost-let m0 (seq (seq int)) mat)
        (set-idx (idx mat u) d c)
        (assert (single m0 mat u d c))
        (call rect_step m0 mat n u d c)
        (call built_step g m0 mat u i d c)
        (call only_step g m0 mat u d c)
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (call built_next g mat u)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (return mat)))

(spec search
  (params (r (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (n i64) (s i64))
  (returns (ord (vec i64)) (parent (vec i64)))
  (requires (rect r n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (tree_ok r ord parent s n)
           (== (idx ord s) 0)
           (closed_cut r ord))
  (effects alloc))
(def search
  (body
    (let-mut ord (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j0) -1)))
    (let-mut parent (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (j1) -1)))
    (set-idx ord s 0)
    (let-mut queue (vec i64) (vec-new))
    (push queue s)
    (let-mut head i64 0)
    (while (< head (len queue))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 head) (<= head (len queue))))
      (invariant (== (len parent) n))
      (invariant (== (+ (len queue) (occurrences ord -1)) n))
      (invariant (>= (occurrences ord -1) 0))
      (invariant (ge_m1 ord))
      (invariant (q_ok ord queue n))
      (invariant (pos_ok ord queue))
      (invariant (== (idx ord s) 0))
      (invariant (tree_ok r ord parent s n))
      (invariant (done_ok r ord queue head))
      (decreases (- n head))
      (let u i64 (idx queue head))
      (assert (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
      (assert (== (idx ord u) head))
      (let-mut v i64 0)
      (while (< v n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue))))
        (invariant (== (idx queue head) u))
        (invariant (== (len parent) n))
        (invariant (== (+ (len queue) (occurrences ord -1)) n))
        (invariant (>= (occurrences ord -1) 0))
        (invariant (ge_m1 ord))
        (invariant (q_ok ord queue n))
        (invariant (pos_ok ord queue))
        (invariant (== (idx ord s) 0))
        (invariant (tree_ok r ord parent s n))
        (invariant (done_ok r ord queue head))
        (invariant (partial_ok r ord u v))
        (decreases (- n v))
        (if (and (== (idx ord v) -1) (> (idx (idx r u) v) 0))
          (block
            (call count_member ord v (len ord))
            (let x i64 (len queue))
            (assert (== (idx ord u) head))
            (assert (> (get_flow r u v) 0))
            (ghost-let ord0 (seq int) ord)
            (ghost-let par0 (seq int) parent)
            (ghost-let q0 (seq int) queue)
            (set-idx ord v x)
            (set-idx parent v u)
            (push queue v)
            (assert (upd ord0 ord v x))
            (assert (upd par0 parent v u))
            (assert (appended q0 queue v))
            (call step_ge ord0 ord v x)
            (call step_q ord0 q0 ord queue v x n)
            (call step_pos ord0 q0 ord queue v x)
            (call step_tree r ord0 par0 ord parent s n u v x)
            (call step_done r ord0 q0 ord queue head v x)
            (call step_part r ord0 ord u v x))
          (call part_seen r ord u v))
        (set v (+ v 1)))
      (call done_step r ord queue head u n)
      (set head (+ head 1)))
    (call close_up r ord queue head)
    (return ord parent)))

(spec augment
  (params (r (vec (vec i64))) (ord (ref (slice i64))) (parent (ref (slice i64))) (n i64) (s i64) (t i64))
  (returns (res (vec (vec i64))))
  (requires (rect r n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
            (tree_ok r ord parent s n) (>= (idx ord t) 0) (nonneg r n) (pair_bound r n))
  (ensures (rect res n) (nonneg res n) (same_pairs r res n) (row_walk r res n t s))
  (effects))
(def augment
  (body
    (let-mut m (vec (vec i64)) r)
    (let-mut c i64 t)
    (while (!= c s)
      (invariant (rect m n))
      (invariant (nonneg m n))
      (invariant (same_pairs r m n))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 c) (< c n)))
      (invariant (>= (idx ord c) 0))
      (invariant (row_walk r m n t c))
      (invariant (path_ok m ord parent s c))
      (decreases (idx ord c))
      (let p i64 (idx parent c))
      (assert (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)))
      (assert (>= (idx ord p) 0))
      (assert (< (idx ord p) (idx ord c)))
      (assert (!= p c))
      (let x i64 (idx (idx m p) c))
      (let y i64 (idx (idx m c) p))
      (assert (== x (get_flow m p c)))
      (assert (== y (get_flow m c p)))
      (assert (== (at parent c) p))
      (assert (== (at ord c) (idx ord c)))
      (assert (> x 0))
      (assert (>= y 0))
      (assert (== (+ x y) (+ (get_flow r p c) (get_flow r c p))))
      (assert (<= (+ x y) 200000))
      (ghost-let m0 (seq (seq int)) m)
      (set-idx (idx m p) c (- x 1))
      (ghost-let m1 (seq (seq int)) m)
      (assert (single m0 m1 p c (- x 1)))
      (set-idx (idx m c) p (+ y 1))
      (assert (single m1 m c p (+ y 1)))
      (call rect_step m0 m1 n p c (- x 1))
      (call rect_step m1 m n c p (+ y 1))
      (call two_cells m0 m1 m p c x y)
      (call nonneg_step m0 m n p c x y)
      (call pairs_step r m0 m n p c x y)
      (call row_step r m0 m1 m n t c p x y)
      (call path_step r ord parent m0 m n s c p x y)
      (set c p))
    (return m)))

(def max_flow_value
  (body
    (call wf_view graph)
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== n (len g)))
    (assert (<= n 1000))
    (let ((r0 (vec (vec i64)))) (call build_residual graph))
    (ghost-let cap (seq (seq int)) r0)
    (call cap_entries g cap)
    (call entries_nonneg cap n)
    (call rowf_upper cap s n n)
    (call rowf_nonneg cap s n n)
    (ghost-let bound int (rowf cap s n))
    (assert (<= bound 100000000))
    (let-mut r (vec (vec i64)) r0)
    (let-mut total i64 0)
    (while true
      (invariant (<= bound 100000000))
      (invariant (rect r n))
      (invariant (nonneg r n))
      (invariant (same_pairs cap r n))
      (invariant (balance cap r n s t))
      (invariant (== (- (rowf cap s n) (rowf r s n)) total))

        (assert (== (wlhs h ord a n) (+ (wlhs h ord (- a 1) n) (wrow h ord (- a 1) n))))
        (assert (== (csum h ord a n) (+ (csum h ord (- a 1) n) (crow h ord (- a 1) n)))))
      (block))))
(lemma dsum (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (a int))
  (requires (row_out g h) (is_conserved g h s t) (ins ord s) (not (ins ord t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (== (len ord) (len g)) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (urow h ord a (len g)) (wrhs g h ord (len g) a)) (if (< s a) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call dsum g h ord s t (- a 1))
        (assert (== (urow h ord a (len g))
                    (+ (urow h ord (- a 1) (len g)) (if (ins ord (- a 1)) (rowf h (- a 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (wrhs g h ord (len g) a)
                    (+ (wrhs g h ord (len g) (- a 1)) (if (ins ord (- a 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- a 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) (len g))))
        (assert (== (total_flow_out g h (- a 1)) (rowf h (- a 1) (len g))))
        (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
        (assert (=> (and (ins ord (- a 1)) (!= (- a 1) s))
                    (== (total_flow_in g h (- a 1)) (total_flow_out g h (- a 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma value_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (is_valid_flow g h s t) (== (len ord) (len g)) (ins ord s) (not (ins ord t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (csum h ord (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (is_conserved g h s t))
    (assert (nonneg_any h))
    (forall ((u int)) (call out_is_row g h u))
    (assert (row_out g h))
    (call dsum g h ord s t (len g))
    (call flip_sums g h ord (len g) (len g))
    (call splitsum h ord (len g) (len g))))
(lemma crow_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (cut_le h f ord n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 b) (<= b n)))
  (ensures (<= (crow h ord u b) (crow f ord u b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call crow_mono h f ord n u (- b 1))
        (assert (<= (cterm h ord u (- b 1)) (cterm f ord u (- b 1))))
        (assert (== (crow h ord u b) (+ (crow h ord u (- b 1)) (cterm h ord u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (crow f ord u b) (+ (crow f ord u (- b 1)) (cterm f ord u (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma csum_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (cut_le h f ord n) (and (<= 0 a) (<= a n)))
  (ensures (<= (csum h ord a n) (csum f ord a n)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call csum_mono h f ord (- a 1) n)
        (call crow_mono h f ord n (- a 1) n)
        (assert (== (csum h ord a n) (+ (csum h ord (- a 1) n) (crow h ord (- a 1) n))))
        (assert (== (csum f ord a n) (+ (csum f ord (- a 1) n) (crow f ord (- a 1) n)))))
      (block))))
(lemma flow_le_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (built g cap (len g) 0) (respects_capacity g h)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (>= (get_flow cap a b) 0))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h a b) (get_flow cap a b)))
  (body
    (if (> (get_flow h a b) 0)
      (block
        (assert (> (idx (idx h a) b) 0))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (idx (idx h a) b) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) c))))
        (assert (== (dst g a i) b))
        (assert (== (get_flow cap a (dst g a i)) (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1)))
        (assert (<= (get_flow h a b) c)))
      (block))))
(lemma point_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                        (h (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (== n (len g)) (== (len ord) n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (built g cap n 0) (entries_in cap n) (nonneg r n) (same_pairs cap r n) (closed_cut r ord)
            (is_mk f cap r n) (respects_capacity g h) (nonneg_any h))
  (ensures (<= (cterm h ord a b) (cterm f ord a b)))
  (body
    (assert (and (>= (get_flow cap a b) 0) (>= (get_flow cap b a) 0)))
    (assert (and (>= (get_flow r a b) 0) (>= (get_flow r b a) 0)))
    (call flow_le_cap g cap h a b)
    (assert (>= (get_flow h a b) 0))
    (assert (== (get_flow f a b) (pos_part (- (get_flow cap a b) (get_flow r a b)))))
    (assert (== (+ (get_flow r a b) (get_flow r b a)) (+ (get_flow cap a b) (get_flow cap b a))))
    (assert (=> (and (ins ord a) (> (get_flow r a b) 0)) (ins ord b)))
    (assert (=> (and (ins ord b) (> (get_flow r b a) 0)) (ins ord a)))))
(lemma optimal_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                           (ord (seq int)) (n int) (s int) (t int) (h (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf g) (== n (len g)) (== (len ord) n) (ins ord s) (not (ins ord t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
            (built g cap n 0) (entries_in cap n) (nonneg r n) (same_pairs cap r n) (closed_cut r ord)
            (is_mk f cap r n) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (flow_val g f s) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g h))
    (assert (nonneg_any h))
    (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call point_le g cap r f h ord n a b))
    (assert (cut_le h f ord n))
    (call value_cut g h ord s t)
    (call value_cut g f ord s t)
    (call csum_mono h f ord n n)))
(lemma f_resp_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                          (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (== n (len g)) (only g cap) (nonneg r n) (is_mk f cap r n))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f a)))))
               (=> (> (idx (idx f a) b) 0)
                   (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (idx (idx f a) b) c))))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (idx f a) b) (get_flow f a b)))
        (assert (>= (get_flow r a b) 0))
        (if (> (get_flow f a b) 0)
          (block
            (assert (> (- (get_flow cap a b) (get_flow r a b)) 0))
            (assert (has_capacity g a b (get_flow cap a b)))
            (assert (<= (get_flow f a b) (get_flow cap a b))))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma f_respects (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (== n (len g)) (only g cap) (nonneg r n) (is_mk f cap r n))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call f_resp_one g cap r f n a b))))
(lemma f_nonneg_one (params (f (seq (seq int))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (is_mk f cap r n))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f a))))) (>= (idx (idx f a) b) 0)))
  (body (assert (>= (get_flow f a b) 0))))
(lemma f_nonneg (params (f (seq (seq int))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (is_mk f cap r n))
  (ensures (nonneg_any f))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call f_nonneg_one f cap r n a b))))
(lemma f_net (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                     (n int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (is_mk f cap r n) (same_pairs cap r n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 b) (<= b n)))
  (ensures (== (- (rowf f u b) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u b)) (- (rowf cap u b) (rowf r u b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call f_net g cap r f n u (- b 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u (- b 1)) (pos_part (- (get_flow cap u (- b 1)) (get_flow r u (- b 1))))))
        (assert (== (get_flow f (- b 1) u) (pos_part (- (get_flow cap (- b 1) u) (get_flow r (- b 1) u)))))
        (assert (== (+ (get_flow r u (- b 1)) (get_flow r (- b 1) u)) (+ (get_flow cap u (- b 1)) (get_flow cap (- b 1) u))))
        (assert (== (- (get_flow f u (- b 1)) (get_flow f (- b 1) u)) (- (get_flow cap u (- b 1)) (get_flow r u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rowf f u b) (+ (rowf f u (- b 1)) (get_flow f u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u b) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u (- b 1)) (get_flow f (- b 1) u))))
        (assert (== (rowf cap u b) (+ (rowf cap u (- b 1)) (get_flow cap u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rowf r u b) (+ (rowf r u (- b 1)) (get_flow r u (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma f_balance (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (== n (len g)) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg_any f) (is_mk f cap r n) (same_pairs cap r n)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g f u) (total_flow_in g f u)) (- (rowf cap u n) (rowf r u n))))
  (body
    (call out_is_row g f u)
    (call f_net g cap r f n u n)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u (len g))))))
(lemma flow_is_max (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cap (seq (seq int))) (r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int))
                           (n int) (s int) (t int) (total int))
  (requires (wf g) (== n (len g)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (!= s t)
            (built g cap n 0) (only g cap) (entries_in cap n)
            (nonneg r n) (same_pairs cap r n) (balance cap r n s t)
            (== (- (rowf cap s n) (rowf r s n)) total)
            (== (len ord) n) (ins ord s) (not (ins ord t)) (closed_cut r ord))
  (ensures (exists ((f (seq (seq int)))) (and (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) total))))
  (body
    (ghost-let f0 (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (i) (seq-build n (fn (j) (pos_part (- (get_flow cap i j) (get_flow r i j))))))))
    (assert (is_mk f0 cap r n))
    (call f_respects g cap r f0 n)
    (call f_nonneg f0 cap r n)
    (forall ((u int)) (call f_balance g cap r f0 n u))
    (call f_balance g cap r f0 n s)
    (assert (is_conserved g f0 s t))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f0 s t))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f0 s) total))
    (forall ((h (seq (seq int)))) (call optimal_one g cap r f0 ord n s t h))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f0 s t))
    (assert (and (is_max_flow g f0 s t) (== (flow_val g f0 s) total)))))

(lemma rowf_single (params (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (a0 int) (b0 int) (e int) (u int) (b int))
  (requires (single m0 m1 a0 b0 e) (<= 0 b0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (rowf m1 u b)
               (+ (rowf m0 u b) (if (and (== u a0) (< b0 b)) (- e (get_flow m0 a0 b0)) 0))))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call rowf_single m0 m1 a0 b0 e u (- b 1))
        (assert (== (rowf m1 u b) (+ (rowf m1 u (- b 1)) (get_flow m1 u (- b 1)))))
        (assert (== (rowf m0 u b) (+ (rowf m0 u (- b 1)) (get_flow m0 u (- b 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma rowf_nonneg (params (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires (nonneg m n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 b) (<= b n)))
  (ensures (>= (rowf m u b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body

        (assert (== (rowf m u b) (+ (rowf m u (- b 1)) (get_flow m u (- b 1))))))

(lemma rowf_upper (params (m (seq (seq int))) (u int) (b int) (n int))

  (ensures (<= (rowf m u b) (* 100000 b)))
  (decreases b)
  (body
    (if (> b 0)
      (block
        (call rowf_upper m u (- b 1) n)
        (assert (<= (get_flow m u (- b 1)) 100000))
        (assert (== (rowf m u b) (+ (rowf m u (- b 1)) (get_flow m u (- b 1))))))

  (requires (same_pairs r m0 n) (swapped m0 m2 p c x y) (== x (get_flow m0 p c)) (== y (get_flow m0 c p)) (!= p c))

(lemma row_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (m0 (seq (seq int))) (m1 (seq (seq int))) (m2 (seq (seq int)))
                        (n int) (t int) (c int) (p int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (row_walk r m0 n t c) (single m0 m1 p c (- x 1)) (single m1 m2 c p (+ y 1)) (!= p c)
            (and (<= 0 p) (< p n)) (and (<= 0 c) (< c n))
            (== x (get_flow m0 p c)) (== y (get_flow m0 c p)))
  (ensures (row_walk r m2 n t p))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow m1 c p) y))
    (forall ((a int)) (call rowf_single m0 m1 p c (- x 1) a n))
    (forall ((a int)) (call rowf_single m1 m2 c p (+ y 1) a n))))

                         (n int) (s int) (c int) (p int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (path_ok m0 ord parent s c) (tree_ok r ord parent s n) (swapped m0 m2 p c x y)
            (and (<= 0 c) (< c n)) (!= c s) (>= (idx ord c) 0) (== p (idx parent c)))
  (ensures (path_ok m2 ord parent s p))

    (assert (< (idx ord p) (idx ord c)))

(lemma done_step (params (r (seq (seq int))) (ord (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (head int) (u int) (n int))
